translation: 在本文中，我们提出并分析了一种用于椭圆界面问题的无拟合有限元方法。我们考虑了界面为 $C^2$ 光滑或多边形的情况，且精确解 $u \in H^{1+s}(\Omega_0 \cup \Omega_1)$ 对于任何 $s > 0$。通过结合局部多项式延拓技术和幽灵惩罚双线性形式，保证了界面附近的稳定性，并由此推导出了鲁棒的条件数估计和误差估计。此外，我们方法中用于弱化执行跳跃条件的跳跃惩罚项也是基于局部多项式延拓定义的，这使得我们能够特别地建立低正则性解的误差估计。我们在二维和三维中进行了一系列数值测试，以说明所提出方法的准确性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种用于具有低正则性解的椭圆界面问题的无拟合有限元方法，通过结合局部多项式延拓和幽灵惩罚技术，成功获得了稳定性和误差估计，并在数值上得到了验证。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于结合了局部多项式延拓技术和幽灵惩罚双线性形式来保证界面附近的稳定性和推导鲁棒的条件数估计，并特别针对低正则性解建立了误差估计。重要性在于为具有不光滑解的椭圆界面问题提供了一个稳定且可靠的数值方法。局限性未在摘要中明确说明。
motivation: 针对具有低正则性解的椭圆界面问题，需要一种稳定且能提供可靠误差估计的数值方法。
method: 提出并分析了一种无拟合有限元方法，结合了局部多项式延拓技术和幽灵惩罚双线性形式来保证界面附近的稳定性，并基于局部多项式延拓定义了跳跃惩罚项来弱化执行跳跃条件。
results: 推导出了鲁棒的条件数估计和误差估计，特别是针对正则性较低的解。数值测试（二维和三维）证明了该方法的准确性。

title: Discrete dualities for some algebras from rough sets
authors: Ivo Düntsch, Ewa Orłowska
abstract: A discrete duality is a relationship between classes of algebras and classes of relational systems (frames) resulting in two representation theorems building on the early work of Jónsson and Tarski, Kripke, and van Benthem. In this section we recall discrete dualities for various types of algebras arising from rough sets.
zh_title: 关于某些粗糙集代数的离散对偶性
translation: 离散对偶性是代数类与关系系统（框架）类之间的一种关系，它建立在Jónsson和Tarski、Kripke以及van Benthem的早期工作之上的两个表示定理。在本节中，我们回顾了源自粗糙集的各种类型的代数的离散对偶性。
tldr: 本文回顾了离散对偶性在粗糙集代数上的应用，这是一种基于早期理论的关系系统表示方法。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于将离散对偶性（Discrete Duality）的概念应用于源自粗糙集（Rough Sets）的代数结构，这扩展了Jónsson和Tarski等人的早期工作。其重要性在于为理解和表示这些特定代数提供了一种新的视角。摘要中未提及具体的局限性。
motivation: 在Jónsson和Tarski、Kripke和van Benthem的早期工作基础上，探索离散对偶性与源自粗糙集的代数之间的关系。
method: 回顾离散对偶性在源自粗糙集的各种代数上的应用。
results: 在本文中回顾了离散对偶性在各种源自粗糙集的代数上的应用。

title: GeoSurDepth: Spatial Geometry-Consistent Self-Supervised Depth Estimation for Surround-View Cameras
authors: Weimin Liu, Wenjun Wang, Joshua H. Meng
abstract: Accurate surround-view depth estimation provides a competitive alternative to laser-based sensors and is essential for 3D scene understanding in autonomous driving. While prior studies have proposed various approaches that primarily focus on enforcing cross-view constraints at the photometric level, few explicitly exploit the rich geometric structure inherent in both monocular and surround-view setting. In this work, we propose GeoSurDepth, a framework that leverages geometry consistency as the primary cue for surround-view depth estimation. Concretely, we utilize foundation models as a pseudo geometry prior and feature representation enhancement tool to guide the network to maintain surface normal consistency in spatial 3D space and regularize object- and texture-consistent depth estimation in 2D. In addition, we introduce a novel view synthesis pipeline where 2D-3D lifting is achieved with dense depth reconstructed via spatial warping, encouraging additional photometric supervision across temporal, spatial, and spatial-temporal contexts, and compensating for the limitations of single-view image reconstruction. Finally, a newly-proposed adaptive joint motion learning strategy enables the network to adaptively emphasize informative spatial geometry cues for improved motion reasoning. Extensive experiments on DDAD and nuScenes demonstrate that GeoSurDepth achieves state-of-the-art performance, validating the effectiveness of our approach. Our framework highlights the importance of exploiting geometry coherence and consistency for robust self-supervised multi-view depth estimation.
zh_title: GeoSurDepth：用于环视摄像头的空间几何一致性自监督深度估计
translation: 准确的环视深度估计为基于激光的传感器提供了一种有竞争力的替代方案，并且对于自动驾驶中的3D场景理解至关重要。虽然先前的研究提出了各种方法，主要侧重于在光度级别强制执行跨视角约束，但很少有方法明确利用单目和环视设置中固有的丰富几何结构。在这项工作中，我们提出了GeoSurDepth，这是一个利用几何一致性作为环视深度估计主要线索的框架。具体来说，我们利用基础模型作为伪几何先验和特征表示增强工具，指导网络在空间3D中保持曲面法线一致性，并规范2D中目标和纹理一致的深度估计。此外，我们引入了一种新颖的视角合成管线，其中通过空间形变重建的密集深度实现了2D-3D提升，从而在时间、空间和时空上下文中鼓励额外的光度监督，并弥补了单视角图像重建的局限性。最后，新提出的自适应联合运动学习策略使网络能够自适应地强调信息丰富的空间几何线索，以改进运动推理。在DDAD和nuScenes上的大量实验表明，GeoSurDepth实现了最先进的性能，验证了我们方法的有效性。我们的框架突出了利用几何连贯性和一致性对于鲁棒的自监督多视角深度估计的重要性。
tldr: GeoSurDepth是一种用于环视深度估计的自监督框架。它以几何一致性为核心线索，利用基础模型提供几何先验，并引入了基于空间形变的新颖视角合成管线和自适应运动学习策略，在DDAD和nuScenes数据集上达到了最先进的性能。
ai_comments: 该研究的创新点在于将自监督深度估计的核心焦点从传统的光度约束明确地转移到几何一致性上。通过利用基础模型作为几何先验（例如曲面法线和目标一致性），该方法有效地将高级语义信息融入到几何约束中。此外，引入基于空间形变的视角合成管线，通过密集深度重建增强了时空上下文中的光度监督，这对于提高环视设置下深度估计的鲁棒性具有重要意义。
motivation: 准确的环视深度估计是自动驾驶中3D场景理解的关键替代方案。现有研究主要侧重于光度约束，而很少明确利用单目和环视设置中固有的丰富几何结构。
method: 提出了GeoSurDepth框架，主要利用几何一致性作为主要线索。具体方法包括：1. 利用基础模型作为伪几何先验和特征增强工具，指导网络保持空间3D曲面法线一致性及2D目标/纹理一致性深度估计。2. 引入新颖的视角合成管线，通过空间形变重建密集深度实现2D-3D提升，以在时间、空间和时空上下文中鼓励额外的光度监督。3. 采用自适应联合运动学习策略，强调信息丰富的空间几何线索以改进运动推理。
results: 在DDAD和nuScenes数据集上的大量实验表明，GeoSurDepth实现了最先进的性能，验证了该方法的有效性。
conclusion: 该框架强调了利用几何连贯性和一致性对于鲁棒的自监督多视角深度估计的重要性。

title: DexterCap: An Affordable and Automated System for Capturing Dexterous Hand-Object Manipulation
authors: Yutong Liang, Shiyi Xu, Yulong Zhang, Bowen Zhan, He Zhang, Libin Liu
abstract: Capturing fine-grained hand-object interactions is challenging due to severe self-occlusion from closely spaced fingers and the subtlety of in-hand manipulation motions. Existing optical motion capture systems rely on expensive camera setups and extensive manual post-processing, while low-cost vision-based methods often suffer from reduced accuracy and reliability under occlusion. To address these challenges, we present DexterCap, a low-cost optical capture system for dexterous in-hand manipulation. DexterCap uses dense, character-coded marker patches to achieve robust tracking under severe self-occlusion, together with an automated reconstruction pipeline that requires minimal manual effort. With DexterCap, we introduce DexterHand, a dataset of fine-grained hand-object interactions covering diverse manipulation behaviors and objects, from simple primitives to complex articulated objects such as a Rubik's Cube. We release the dataset and code to support future research on dexterous hand-object interaction.

title: Left, Right, or Center? Evaluating LLM Framing in News Classification and Generation
authors: Molly Kennedy, Ali Parker, Yihong Liu, Hinrich Schütze
abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) based summarization and text generation are increasingly used for producing and rewriting text, raising concerns about political framing in journalism where subtle wording choices can shape interpretation. Across nine state-of-the-art LLMs, we study political framing by testing whether LLMs' classification-based bias signals align with framing behavior in their generated summaries. We first compare few-shot ideology predictions against LEFT/CENTER/RIGHT labels. We then generate "steered" summaries under FAITHFUL, CENTRIST, LEFT, and RIGHT prompts, and score all outputs using a single fixed ideology evaluator. We find pervasive ideological center-collapse in both article-level ratings and generated text, indicating a systematic tendency toward centrist framing. Among evaluated models, Grok 4 is by far the most ideologically expressive generator, while Claude Sonnet 4.5 and Llama 3.1 achieve the strongest bias-rating performance among commercial and open-weight models, respectively.
zh_title: 左、右，还是中间？评估大语言模型在新闻分类和生成中的“框架效应”
translation: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的摘要和文本生成正越来越多地用于文本的制作和重写，这引发了人们对新闻业中政治框架效应的担忧，因为微妙的措辞选择可以影响解读。我们研究了九个最先进的LLM，通过测试LLM基于分类的偏见信号是否与其生成的摘要中的框架行为一致，来研究政治框架效应。我们首先将少量样本（few-shot）的意识形态预测与“左/中/右”标签进行比较。然后，我们在“忠实”、“中立”、“左倾”和“右倾”提示下生成“引导性”摘要，并使用单一固定的意识形态评估器对所有输出进行评分。我们发现在文章级别评分和生成的文本中，普遍存在意识形态上的“中间坍塌”现象，这表明系统性地倾向于中立框架。在评估的模型中，Grok 4是迄今为止意识形态表达能力最强的生成器，而Claude Sonnet 4.5和Llama 3.1分别在商业模型和开源模型中实现了最强的偏见评级性能。
tldr: 研究发现，九个最先进的大语言模型在新闻分类和生成中普遍存在意识形态上的“中间坍塌”现象，系统性地倾向于中立的框架。Grok 4是表达意识形态最强的生成器，而Claude Sonnet 4.5和Llama 3.1在偏见评级上表现最佳。
ai_comments: 本研究的创新之处在于系统地将LLM的意识形态分类能力与其在文本生成中实际的“框架”行为进行了对比。发现“中间坍塌”现象对于理解LLM的内在偏见和安全对齐机制至关重要，它表明模型被训练或设计成避免极端的意识形态立场。这一发现对新闻机构和内容创作者具有重要意义，提示他们在依赖LLM生成内容时，可能需要警惕其系统性的中立化倾向，以及某些模型（如Grok 4）可能具有更强的可操纵性。
motivation: 随着大语言模型越来越多地用于文本生成和重写，人们担忧其在新闻业中可能产生的政治框架效应，因为微妙的措辞选择会影响解读。因此需要研究LLM的政治倾向性。
method: 1. 比较少量样本（few-shot）意识形态预测与“左/中/右”标签的对齐情况。2. 在“忠实”、“中立”、“左倾”和“右倾”提示下生成“引导性”摘要。3. 使用固定的意识形态评估器对所有输出进行评分。
results: 在文章级别评分和生成的文本中，普遍存在意识形态上的“中间坍塌”现象，这表明系统性地倾向于中立框架。Grok 4是迄今为止意识形态表达能力最强的生成器。Claude Sonnet 4.5和Llama 3.1分别在商业模型和开源模型中实现了最强的偏见评级性能。
conclusion: 结论是大语言模型在新闻分类和生成中普遍存在系统性的中立框架倾向（中间坍塌）。某些模型（如Grok 4）在表达意识形态方面比其他模型更具能力。

title: Semantic NLP Pipelines for Interoperable Patient Digital Twins from Unstructured EHRs
authors: Rafael Brens, Yuqiao Meng, Luoxi Tang, Zhaohan Xi
abstract: Digital twins -- virtual replicas of physical entities -- are gaining traction in healthcare for personalized monitoring, predictive modeling, and clinical decision support. However, generating interoperable patient digital twins from unstructured electronic health records (EHRs) remains challenging due to variability in clinical documentation and lack of standardized mappings. This paper presents a semantic NLP-driven pipeline that transforms free-text EHR notes into FHIR-compliant digital twin representations. The pipeline leverages named entity recognition (NER) to extract clinical concepts, concept normalization to map entities to SNOMED-CT or ICD-10, and relation extraction to capture structured associations between conditions, medications, and observations. Evaluation on MIMIC-IV Clinical Database Demo with validation against MIMIC-IV-on-FHIR reference mappings demonstrates high F1-scores for entity and relation extraction, with improved schema completeness and interoperability compared to baseline methods.

title: A New Family of Poisson Non-negative Matrix Factorization Methods Using the Shifted Log Link
authors: Eric Weine, Peter Carbonetto, Rafael A. Irizarry, Matthew Stephens
abstract: Poisson non-negative matrix factorization (NMF) is a widely used method to find interpretable "parts-based" decompositions of count data. While many variants of Poisson NMF exist, existing methods assume that the "parts" in the decomposition combine additively. This assumption may be natural in some settings, but not in others. Here we introduce Poisson NMF with the shifted-log link function to relax this assumption. The shifted-log link function has a single tuning parameter, and as this parameter varies the model changes from assuming that parts combine additively (i.e., standard Poisson NMF) to assuming that parts combine more multiplicatively. We provide an algorithm to fit this model by maximum likelihood, and also an approximation that substantially reduces computation time for large, sparse datasets (computations scale with the number of non-zero entries in the data matrix). We illustrate these new methods on a variety of real datasets. Our examples show how the choice of link function in Poisson NMF can substantively impact the results, and how in some settings the use of a shifted-log link function may improve interpretability compared with the standard, additive link.

title: Goal Force: Teaching Video Models To Accomplish Physics-Conditioned Goals
authors: Nate Gillman, Yinghua Zhou, Zitian Tang, Evan Luo, Arjan Chakravarthy, Daksh Aggarwal, Michael Freeman, Charles Herrmann, Chen Sun
abstract: Recent advancements in video generation have enabled the development of ``world models'' capable of simulating potential futures for robotics and planning. However, specifying precise goals for these models remains a challenge; text instructions are often too abstract to capture physical nuances, while target images are frequently infeasible to specify for dynamic tasks. To address this, we introduce Goal Force, a novel framework that allows users to define goals via explicit force vectors and intermediate dynamics, mirroring how humans conceptualize physical tasks. We train a video generation model on a curated dataset of synthetic causal primitives-such as elastic collisions and falling dominos-teaching it to propagate forces through time and space. Despite being trained on simple physics data, our model exhibits remarkable zero-shot generalization to complex, real-world scenarios, including tool manipulation and multi-object causal chains. Our results suggest that by grounding video generation in fundamental physical interactions, models can emerge as implicit neural physics simulators, enabling precise, physics-aware planning without reliance on external engines. We release all datasets, code, model weights, and interactive video demos at our project page.
comment: Code and interactive demos at https://goal-force.github.io/

title: Router-Suggest: Dynamic Routing for Multimodal Auto-Completion in Visually-Grounded Dialogs
authors: Sandeep Mishra, Devichand Budagam, Anubhab Mandal, Bishal Santra, Pawan Goyal, Manish Gupta
abstract: Real-time multimodal auto-completion is essential for digital assistants, chatbots, design tools, and healthcare consultations, where user inputs rely on shared visual context. We introduce Multimodal Auto-Completion (MAC), a task that predicts upcoming characters in live chats using partially typed text and visual cues. Unlike traditional text-only auto-completion (TAC), MAC grounds predictions in multimodal context to better capture user intent. To enable this task, we adapt MMDialog and ImageChat to create benchmark datasets. We evaluate leading vision-language models (VLMs) against strong textual baselines, highlighting trade-offs in accuracy and efficiency. We present Router-Suggest, a router framework that dynamically selects between textual models and VLMs based on dialog context, along with a lightweight variant for resource-constrained environments. Router-Suggest achieves a 2.3x to 10x speedup over the best-performing VLM. A user study shows that VLMs significantly excel over textual models on user satisfaction, notably saving user typing effort and improving the quality of completions in multi-turn conversations. These findings underscore the need for multimodal context in auto-completions, leading to smarter, user-aware assistants.
comment: Accepted to EACL 2026 Industry Track, 12 pages, 6 figures

title: Rigorous Implications of the Low-Degree Heuristic
authors: Jun-Ting Hsieh, Daniel M. Kane, Pravesh K. Kothari, Jerry Li, Sidhanth Mohanty, Stefan Tiegel
abstract:
Over the past decade, the low-degree heuristic has been used to estimate the algorithmic thresholds for a wide range of average-case planted vs null distinguishing problems. Such results rely on the hypothesis that if the low-degree moments of the planted and null distributions are sufficiently close, then no efficient (noise-tolerant) algorithm can distinguish between them. This hypothesis is appealing due to the simplicity of calculating the low-degree likelihood ratio (LDLR) -- a quantity that measures the similarity between low-degree moments. However, despite sustained interest in the area, it remains unclear whether low-degree indistinguishability actually rules out any interesting class of algorithms.
  In this work, we initiate the study and develop technical tools for translating LDLR upper bounds to rigorous lower bounds against concrete algorithms. As a consequence, we prove: for any permutation-invariant distribution $\mathsf{P}$,
  1. If $\mathsf{P}$ is over $\{0,1\}^n$ and is low-degree indistinguishable from $U = \mathrm{Unif}(\{0,1\}^n)$, then a noisy version of $\mathsf{P}$ is statistically indistinguishable from $U$.
  2. If $\mathsf{P}$ is over $\mathbb{R}^n$ and is low-degree indistinguishable from the standard Gaussian ${N}(0, 1)^n$, then no statistic based on symmetric polynomials of degree at most $O(\log n/\log \log n)$ can distinguish between a noisy version of $\mathsf{P}$ from ${N}(0, 1)^n$.
  3. If $\mathsf{P}$ is over $\mathbb{R}^{n\times n}$ and is low-degree indistinguishable from ${N}(0,1)^{n\times n}$, then no constant-sized subgraph statistic can distinguish between a noisy version of $\mathsf{P}$ and ${N}(0, 1)^{n\times n}$.

title: LayerGS: Decomposition and Inpainting of Layered 3D Human Avatars via 2D Gaussian Splatting
authors: Yinghan Xu, John Dingliana
abstract: We propose a novel framework for decomposing arbitrarily posed humans into animatable multi-layered 3D human avatars, separating the body and garments. Conventional single-layer reconstruction methods lock clothing to one identity, while prior multi-layer approaches struggle with occluded regions. We overcome both limitations by encoding each layer as a set of 2D Gaussians for accurate geometry and photorealistic rendering, and inpainting hidden regions with a pretrained 2D diffusion model via score-distillation sampling (SDS). Our three-stage training strategy first reconstructs the coarse canonical garment via single-layer reconstruction, followed by multi-layer training to jointly recover the inner-layer body and outer-layer garment details. Experiments on two 3D human benchmark datasets (4D-Dress, Thuman2.0) show that our approach achieves better rendering quality and layer decomposition and recomposition than the previous state-of-the-art, enabling realistic virtual try-on under novel viewpoints and poses, and advancing practical creation of high-fidelity 3D human assets for immersive applications. Our code is available at https://github.com/RockyXu66/LayerGS

title: Kidney Cancer Detection Using 3D-Based Latent Diffusion Models
authors: Jen Dusseljee, Sarah de Boer, Alessa Hering
abstract: In this work, we present a novel latent diffusion-based pipeline for 3D kidney anomaly detection on contrast-enhanced abdominal CT. The method combines Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models (DDPMs), Denoising Diffusion Implicit Models (DDIMs), and Vector-Quantized Generative Adversarial Networks (VQ-GANs). Unlike prior slice-wise approaches, our method operates directly on an image volume and leverages weak supervision with only case-level pseudo-labels. We benchmark our approach against state-of-the-art supervised segmentation and detection models. This study demonstrates the feasibility and promise of 3D latent diffusion for weakly supervised anomaly detection. While the current results do not yet match supervised baselines, they reveal key directions for improving reconstruction fidelity and lesion localization. Our findings provide an important step toward annotation-efficient, generative modeling of complex abdominal anatomy.
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures. This paper has been accepted at Bildverarbeitung für die Medizin (BVM) 2026

title: CLewR: Curriculum Learning with Restarts for Machine Translation Preference Learning
authors: Alexandra Dragomir, Florin Brad, Radu Tudor Ionescu
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated competitive performance in zero-shot multilingual machine translation (MT). Some follow-up works further improved MT performance via preference optimization, but they leave a key aspect largely underexplored: the order in which data samples are given during training. We address this topic by integrating curriculum learning into various state-of-the-art preference optimization algorithms to boost MT performance. We introduce a novel curriculum learning strategy with restarts (CLewR), which reiterates easy-to-hard curriculum multiple times during training to effectively mitigate the catastrophic forgetting of easy examples. We demonstrate consistent gains across several model families (Gemma2, Qwen2.5, Llama3.1) and preference optimization techniques. We publicly release our code at https://github.com/alexandra-dragomir/CLewR.

title: Bidirectional Channel-selective Semantic Interaction for Semi-Supervised Medical Segmentation
authors: Kaiwen Huang, Yizhe Zhang, Yi Zhou, Tianyang Xu, Tao Zhou
abstract: Semi-supervised medical image segmentation is an effective method for addressing scenarios with limited labeled data. Existing methods mainly rely on frameworks such as mean teacher and dual-stream consistency learning. These approaches often face issues like error accumulation and model structural complexity, while also neglecting the interaction between labeled and unlabeled data streams. To overcome these challenges, we propose a Bidirectional Channel-selective Semantic Interaction~(BCSI) framework for semi-supervised medical image segmentation. First, we propose a Semantic-Spatial Perturbation~(SSP) mechanism, which disturbs the data using two strong augmentation operations and leverages unsupervised learning with pseudo-labels from weak augmentations. Additionally, we employ consistency on the predictions from the two strong augmentations to further improve model stability and robustness. Second, to reduce noise during the interaction between labeled and unlabeled data, we propose a Channel-selective Router~(CR) component, which dynamically selects the most relevant channels for information exchange. This mechanism ensures that only highly relevant features are activated, minimizing unnecessary interference. Finally, the Bidirectional Channel-wise Interaction~(BCI) strategy is employed to supplement additional semantic information and enhance the representation of important channels. Experimental results on multiple benchmarking 3D medical datasets demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms existing semi-supervised approaches.
comment: Accepted to AAAI 2026. Code at: https://github.com/taozh2017/BCSI

title: Phase4DFD: Multi-Domain Phase-Aware Attention for Deepfake Detection
authors: Zhen-Xin Lin, Shang-Kuan Chen
abstract: Recent deepfake detection methods have increasingly explored frequency domain representations to reveal manipulation artifacts that are difficult to detect in the spatial domain. However, most existing approaches rely primarily on spectral magnitude, implicitly under exploring the role of phase information. In this work, we propose Phase4DFD, a phase aware frequency domain deepfake detection framework that explicitly models phase magnitude interactions via a learnable attention mechanism. Our approach augments standard RGB input with Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) magnitude and local binary pattern (LBP) representations to expose subtle synthesis artifacts that remain indistinguishable under spatial analysis alone. Crucially, we introduce an input level phase aware attention module that uses phase discontinuities commonly introduced by synthetic generation to guide the model toward frequency patterns that are most indicative of manipulation before backbone feature extraction. The attended multi domain representation is processed by an efficient BNext M backbone, with optional channel spatial attention applied for semantic feature refinement. Extensive experiments on the CIFAKE and DFFD datasets demonstrate that our proposed model Phase4DFD outperforms state of the art spatial and frequency-based detectors while maintaining low computational overhead. Comprehensive ablation studies further confirm that explicit phase modeling provides complementary and non-redundant information beyond magnitude-only frequency representations.

title: What do the metrics mean? A critical analysis of the use of Automated Evaluation Metrics in Interpreting
authors: Jonathan Downie, Joss Moorkens
abstract: With the growth of interpreting technologies, from remote interpreting and Computer-Aided Interpreting to automated speech translation and interpreting avatars, there is now a high demand for ways to quickly and efficiently measure the quality of any interpreting delivered. A range of approaches to fulfil the need for quick and efficient quality measurement have been proposed, each involving some measure of automation. This article examines these recently-proposed quality measurement methods and will discuss their suitability for measuring the quality of authentic interpreting practice, whether delivered by humans or machines, concluding that automatic metrics as currently proposed cannot take into account the communicative context and thus are not viable measures of the quality of any interpreting provision when used on their own. Across all attempts to measure or even categorise quality in Interpreting Studies, the contexts in which interpreting takes place have become fundamental to the final analysis.

title: Secure Change-Point Detection for Time Series under Homomorphic Encryption
authors: Federico Mazzone, Giorgio Micali, Massimiliano Pronesti
abstract: We introduce the first method for change-point detection on encrypted time series. Our approach employs the CKKS homomorphic encryption scheme to detect shifts in statistical properties (e.g., mean, variance, frequency) without ever decrypting the data. Unlike solutions based on differential privacy, which degrade accuracy through noise injection, our solution preserves utility comparable to plaintext baselines. We assess its performance through experiments on both synthetic datasets and real-world time series from healthcare and network monitoring. Notably, our approach can process one million points within 3 minutes.
zh_title: 基于同态加密的时间序列安全变点检测
translation: 我们引入了首个针对加密时间序列的变点检测方法。我们的方法采用CKKS同态加密方案，在不解密数据的情况下检测统计特性（例如，均值、方差、频率）的变化。与基于差分隐私的解决方案不同，后者会通过注入噪声降低准确性，而我们的解决方案能够保持与明文基线相当的实用性。我们通过对合成数据集以及来自医疗和网络监控的真实时间序列进行实验来评估其性能。值得注意的是，我们的方法可以在3分钟内处理一百万个数据点。
tldr: 提出首个基于CKKS同态加密的时间序列变点检测方法，无需解密即可检测统计变化，准确率与明文处理相当，且能在3分钟内处理一百万个点。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于首次提出了针对完全加密时间序列的变点检测方法。它解决了在保护数据隐私的同时进行复杂数据分析的挑战。通过使用CKKS同态加密方案，该方法避免了传统隐私保护技术（如差分隐私）中通过注入噪声导致的准确性损失，实现了与明文处理相当的实用性。其重要性在于为处理敏感数据（如医疗和网络监控数据）提供了一个高效（百万点/3分钟）且高准确率的安全分析工具。
motivation: 首次提出在加密时间序列上进行变点检测的方法，旨在不解密数据的情况下安全地检测时间序列统计属性的转变，以保护数据隐私。
method: 采用CKKS同态加密方案，在不解密数据的情况下，检测时间序列中统计特性（如均值、方差、频率）的变化。
results: 该方法保持了与明文基线相当的实用性（准确性），优于会降低准确性的差分隐私解决方案。在合成数据集以及来自医疗和网络监控的真实时间序列上进行了评估。性能显著，能够在3分钟内处理一百万个数据点。

title: IIB-LPO: Latent Policy Optimization via Iterative Information Bottleneck
authors: Huilin Deng, Hongchen Luo, Yue Zhu, Long Li, Zhuoyue Chen, Xinghao Zhao, Ming Li, Jihai Zhang, Mengchang Wang, Yang Cao, Yu Kang
abstract: Recent advances in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) for Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning have been hindered by a persistent challenge: exploration collapse. The semantic homogeneity of random rollouts often traps models in narrow, over-optimized behaviors. While existing methods leverage policy entropy to encourage exploration, they face inherent limitations. Global entropy regularization is susceptible to reward hacking, which can induce meaningless verbosity, whereas local token-selective updates struggle with the strong inductive bias of pre-trained models. To address this, we propose Latent Policy Optimization via Iterative Information Bottleneck (IIB-LPO), a novel approach that shifts exploration from statistical perturbation of token distributions to topological branching of reasoning trajectories. IIB-LPO triggers latent branching at high-entropy states to diversify reasoning paths and employs the Information Bottleneck principle both as a trajectory filter and a self-reward mechanism, ensuring concise and informative exploration. Empirical results across four mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that IIB-LPO achieves state-of-the-art performance, surpassing prior methods by margins of up to 5.3% in accuracy and 7.4% in diversity metrics.
zh_title: IIB-LPO：基于迭代信息瓶颈的潜在策略优化
translation: 最近在用于大型语言模型（LLM）推理的可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）方面的进展一直受到一个持续挑战的阻碍：探索崩溃。随机采样的语义同质性通常使模型陷入狭窄、过度优化的行为中。虽然现有方法利用策略熵来鼓励探索，但它们面临着固有的局限性。全局熵正则化容易受到奖励欺骗，可能导致毫无意义的冗长，而局部代币选择性更新则难以应对预训练模型的强大归纳偏差。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种新方法：基于迭代信息瓶颈的潜在策略优化（IIB-LPO），它将探索从代币分布的统计扰动转移到推理轨迹的拓扑分支。IIB-LPO在高熵状态触发潜在分支以使推理路径多样化，并采用信息瓶颈原则作为轨迹过滤器和自奖励机制，确保探索简洁且信息丰富。跨越四个数学推理基准的实证结果表明，IIB-LPO实现了最先进的性能，在准确性上超过现有方法高达5.3%，在多样性指标上超过高达7.4%。
tldr: 针对LLM推理中RLVR的探索崩溃问题，本文提出了IIB-LPO方法。它通过在潜在空间进行拓扑分支来多样化推理路径，并利用信息瓶颈原则来过滤轨迹和提供自奖励，实现了SOTA性能。
ai_comments: IIB-LPO的创新点在于其探索策略的范式转变。它识别了现有基于策略熵的探索方法的局限性（如奖励欺骗和难以克服预训练模型的归纳偏差），并通过引入“潜在拓扑分支”和“信息瓶颈”机制来解决这些问题。这种方法将探索从简单的统计噪声提升到更具结构性和信息性的轨迹多样化，尤其适用于需要复杂、多步骤推理的LLM任务，是RLVR领域解决探索和效率权衡问题的重要一步。
motivation: 现有的可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）在LLM推理中存在探索崩溃问题，即随机采样的语义同质性导致模型陷入狭窄的优化行为。虽然现有方法使用策略熵鼓励探索，但全局熵正则化易受奖励欺骗，局部更新难以克服预训练模型的归纳偏差。
method: 提出IIB-LPO（基于迭代信息瓶颈的潜在策略优化）。该方法将探索从token分布的统计扰动转向推理轨迹的拓扑分支。它在高熵状态触发潜在分支以多样化推理路径，并使用信息瓶颈原则作为轨迹过滤器和自奖励机制，确保探索简洁且信息丰富。
results: 在四个数学推理基准上，IIB-LPO取得了最先进的性能，在准确性上超过现有方法高达5.3%，在多样性指标上超过高达7.4%。
conclusion: IIB-LPO通过将探索转移到潜在空间的拓扑分支，并结合信息瓶颈原则，有效解决了RLVR在LLM推理中的探索崩溃问题，实现了性能和多样性的显著提升。

title: FACTUM: Mechanistic Detection of Citation Hallucination in Long-Form RAG
authors: Maxime Dassen, Rebecca Kotula, Kenton Murray, Andrew Yates, Dawn Lawrie, Efsun Kayi, James Mayfield, Kevin Duh
abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) models are critically undermined by citation hallucinations, a deceptive failure where a model confidently cites a source that fails to support its claim. Existing work often attributes hallucination to a simple over-reliance on the model's parametric knowledge. We challenge this view and introduce FACTUM (Framework for Attesting Citation Trustworthiness via Underlying Mechanisms), a framework of four mechanistic scores measuring the distinct contributions of a model's attention and FFN pathways, and the alignment between them. Our analysis reveals two consistent signatures of correct citation: a significantly stronger contribution from the model's parametric knowledge and greater use of the attention sink for information synthesis. Crucially, we find the signature of a correct citation is not static but evolves with model scale. For example, the signature of a correct citation for the Llama-3.2-3B model is marked by higher pathway alignment, whereas for the Llama-3.1-8B model, it is characterized by lower alignment, where pathways contribute more distinct, orthogonal information. By capturing this complex, evolving signature, FACTUM outperforms state-of-the-art baselines by up to 37.5% in AUC. Our findings reframe citation hallucination as a complex, scale-dependent interplay between internal mechanisms, paving the way for more nuanced and reliable RAG systems.
zh_title: FACTUM：长篇RAG中引用幻觉的机理检测
translation: 检索增强生成（RAG）模型受到引用幻觉的严重破坏，这是一种欺骗性的失败，即模型自信地引用一个无法支持其说法的来源。现有工作通常将幻觉归因于对模型参数知识的简单过度依赖。我们挑战了这一观点，并引入了FACTUM（通过底层机制证明引用可信度的框架），这是一个包含四个机械分数的框架，用于衡量模型注意力（attention）和FFN通路的独特贡献以及它们之间的对齐程度。我们的分析揭示了正确引用的两个一致特征：模型参数知识的贡献显著增强，以及更多地使用注意力汇（attention sink）进行信息合成。至关重要的是，我们发现正确引用的特征并非静态不变，而是随着模型规模而演变。例如，Llama-3.2-3B模型的正确引用特征表现为更高的通路对齐度，而Llama-3.1-8B模型则表现为更低的对齐度，即通路贡献了更多独特、正交的信息。通过捕获这种复杂的、不断演变的特征，FACTUM在AUC上比现有最先进的基线高出高达37.5%。我们的研究结果将引用幻觉重新定义为内部机制之间复杂的、依赖于规模的相互作用，为更精细和可靠的RAG系统铺平了道路。
tldr: RAG模型的引用幻觉是个大问题。我们提出了FACTUM框架，通过衡量模型内部机制（注意力、FFN及其对齐）的四种分数来检测幻觉。我们发现正确引用的特征会随模型规模变化，FACTUM的检测性能显著优于现有基线。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将引用幻觉的检测焦点从外部数据或简单的知识滥用转移到Transformer架构内部的机械性相互作用（注意力通路与FFN通路）。发现正确引用的特征会随着模型规模而变化（例如，不同Llama版本对通路对齐度的要求相反）是一个关键的深刻见解，这表明检测和缓解策略必须针对特定的模型尺寸进行定制，不能采用一刀切的解决方案。将幻觉重新定义为一种复杂的、依赖于规模的机制间相互作用，对于未来RAG系统的可靠性研究具有重要意义。
motivation: 现有工作将引用幻觉归因于对参数知识的过度依赖，本文挑战了这一观点，旨在通过研究模型内部机制来检测并解决RAG模型中具有欺骗性的引用幻觉问题。
method: 提出了FACTUM框架（Framework for Attesting Citation Trustworthiness via Underlying Mechanisms），该框架使用四个机械分数来衡量模型注意力（attention）通路和FFN通路的独特贡献以及它们之间的对齐程度。
results: 正确引用有两个一致特征：参数知识的贡献显著增强，以及更多地使用注意力汇（attention sink）进行信息合成。正确引用的特征会随着模型规模（如Llama-3.2-3B与Llama-3.1-8B）而变化。FACTUM在AUC上比现有SOTA基线高出高达37.5%。
conclusion: 引用幻觉是一种复杂的、依赖于模型规模的内部机制间的相互作用。本研究为构建更精细和可靠的RAG系统提供了途径。

title: How to Analyse Interviews: A Documentary Method of Interpretation
authors: Andy Crabtree
abstract: Interviews are commonplace in HCI. This paper presents a novel documentary method of interpretation that supports analysis of the topics contained within a collection of transcripts, topics that are endogenous to it and which elaborate participants collective reasoning about issues of relevance to research. We contrast endogenous topic analysis with established qualitative approaches, including content analysis, grounded theory, interpretative phenomenological analysis, and thematic analysis, to draw out the distinctive character of the documentary method of interpretation. Unlike established methods, the DMI does not require that the analyst be proficient in qualitative analysis, or have sound knowledge of underlying theories and methods. The DMI is a members method, not a social science method, that relies on mastery of natural language; a competence most people possess.
zh_title: 如何分析访谈：一种文献解读方法
translation: 访谈在人机交互（HCI）领域中很常见。本文提出了一种新颖的文献解读方法，它支持对访谈记录集合中所包含主题的分析，这些主题是内生的，并阐述了参与者对研究相关问题的集体推理。我们将内生主题分析与既有的定性方法（包括内容分析、扎根理论、解释性现象学分析和主题分析）进行对比，以突显文献解读方法的独特特征。与既有方法不同，DMI不要求分析师精通定性分析，或对基础理论和方法有深入的了解。DMI是一种“成员方法”，而非社会科学方法，它依赖于对自然语言的掌握，这是大多数人都具备的能力。
tldr: 本文提出了一种分析访谈的“文献解读方法”（DMI），用于识别转录文本中内生的集体推理主题。与现有定性方法相比，DMI更简单，因为它依赖于对自然语言的掌握，而非专业的分析技能。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了一种声称可降低定性分析门槛的方法。通过将其定位为依赖于自然语言掌握的“成员方法”，DMI有望使HCI等领域中非专业分析师能够进行更深入的访谈记录分析。其重要性在于，如果该方法是严谨的，它可以有效地普及分析参与者集体推理的能力。潜在的局限性在于，抽象中未提及该方法的严谨性或验证过程；声称不依赖于底层理论知识的分析，可能会在实践中面临深度和严谨性不足的风险。
motivation: 访谈在人机交互（HCI）领域很常见，需要一种新的分析方法。本文旨在提出一种“文献解读方法”（DMI），以支持对访谈记录中内生主题和参与者集体推理的分析，并且这种方法对不具备专业定性分析技能的人员也易于使用。
method: 提出了一种新颖的“文献解读方法”（DMI），该方法通过对访谈记录集合进行“内生主题分析”，以阐述参与者对相关问题的集体推理。
conclusion: 文献解读方法（DMI）是一种“成员方法”而非社会科学方法，其独特之处在于它依赖于对自然语言的掌握，因此分析师无需精通定性分析或具备扎实的理论知识。

title: Continual-learning for Modelling Low-Resource Languages from Large Language Models
authors: Santosh Srinath K, Mudit Somani, Varun Reddy Padala, Prajna Devi Upadhyay, Abhijit Das
abstract: Modelling a language model for a multi-lingual scenario includes several potential challenges, among which catastrophic forgetting is the major challenge. For example, small language models (SLM) built for low-resource languages by adapting large language models (LLMs) pose the challenge of catastrophic forgetting. This work proposes to employ a continual learning strategy using parts-of-speech (POS)-based code-switching along with a replay adapter strategy to mitigate the identified gap of catastrophic forgetting while training SLM from LLM. Experiments conducted on vision language tasks such as visual question answering and language modelling task exhibits the success of the proposed architecture.
zh_title: 基于大型语言模型的低资源语言建模的持续学习
translation: 为多语言场景建模语言模型涉及若干潜在挑战，其中灾难性遗忘是主要挑战。例如，通过调整大型语言模型（LLMs）为低资源语言构建小型语言模型（SLMs）会带来灾难性遗忘的挑战。本文提出采用一种持续学习策略，结合基于词性（POS）的代码转换和重放适配器策略，以减轻在从LLM训练SLM时所发现的灾难性遗忘问题。在视觉问答等视觉语言任务和语言建模任务上进行的实验表明了所提出架构的成功。
tldr: 提出一种持续学习策略（结合POS代码转换和重放适配器）来解决将LLM适应到低资源语言时发生的灾难性遗忘。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于将持续学习策略与基于词性（POS）的代码转换技术相结合，并利用重放适配器来解决LLM向低资源语言适应过程中的灾难性遗忘问题。这种方法对于在资源受限的多语言环境中高效部署大型模型、优化模型在处理新任务时的知识保留具有重要意义。
motivation: 在多语言场景中，尤其是将大型语言模型（LLMs）应用于低资源语言以构建小型语言模型（SLMs）时，灾难性遗忘是一个主要的挑战。
method: 提出了一种持续学习（Continual Learning）策略，该策略结合了基于词性（POS）的代码转换（code-switching）以及重放适配器（replay adapter）策略，以减轻灾难性遗忘。
results: 在视觉问答（VQA）等视觉语言任务和语言建模任务上进行的实验表明，所提出的架构是成功的。

title: Universal and Asymptotically Optimal Data and Task Allocation in Distributed Computing
authors: Javad Maheri, K. K. Krishnan Namboodiri, Petros Elia
abstract: We study the joint minimization of communication and computation costs in distributed computing, where a master node coordinates $N$ workers to evaluate a function over a library of $n$ files. Assuming that the function is decomposed into an arbitrary subfunction set $\mathbf{X}$, with each subfunction depending on $d$ input files, renders our distributed computing problem into a $d$-uniform hypergraph edge partitioning problem wherein the edge set (subfunction set), defined by $d$-wise dependencies between vertices (files) must be partitioned across $N$ disjoint groups (workers). The aim is to design a file and subfunction allocation, corresponding to a partition of $\mathbf{X}$, that minimizes the communication cost $π_{\mathbf{X}}$, representing the maximum number of distinct files per server, while also minimizing the computation cost $δ_{\mathbf{X}}$ corresponding to a maximal worker subfunction load. For a broad range of parameters, we propose a deterministic allocation solution, the \emph{Interweaved-Cliques (IC) design}, whose information-theoretic-inspired interweaved clique structure simultaneously achieves order-optimal communication and computation costs, for a large class of decompositions $\mathbf{X}$. This optimality is derived from our achievability and converse bounds, which reveal -- under reasonable assumptions on the density of $\mathbf{X}$ -- that the optimal scaling of the communication cost takes the form $n/N^{1/d}$, revealing that our design achieves the order-optimal \textit{partitioning gain} that scales as $N^{1/d}$, while also achieving an order-optimal computation cost. Interestingly, this order optimality is achieved in a deterministic manner, and very importantly, it is achieved blindly from $\mathbf{X}$, therefore enabling multiple desired functions to be computed without reshuffling files.
zh_title: 分布式计算中通用且渐近最优的数据与任务分配
translation: 我们研究了分布式计算中通信和计算成本的联合最小化问题，其中一个主节点协调 $N$ 个工作节点来评估一个基于 $n$ 个文件库的函数。假设该函数被分解为一个任意的子函数集 $\mathbf{X}$，其中每个子函数依赖于 $d$ 个输入文件，这使得我们的分布式计算问题转化为一个 $d$-均匀超图边划分问题，其中边集（子函数集）由顶点（文件）之间的 $d$ 重依赖关系定义，必须在 $N$ 个不相交的组（工作节点）之间进行划分。目标是设计一种文件和子函数分配方案（对应于 $\mathbf{X}$ 的划分），以最小化通信成本 $\pi_{\mathbf{X}}$（表示每个服务器的最大不同文件数），同时最小化计算成本 $\delta_{\mathbf{X}}$（对应于最大工作节点子函数负载）。对于广泛的参数范围，我们提出了一种确定性的分配解决方案——“交织团”（IC）设计，其受信息论启发的交织团结构，同时为一大类分解 $\mathbf{X}$ 实现了阶次最优的通信和计算成本。这种最优性源于我们的可达性界限和逆定理界限，这些界限表明——在对 $\mathbf{X}$ 密度做出合理假设下——最优通信成本的缩放形式为 $n/N^{1/d}$，揭示了我们的设计实现了阶次最优的划分增益，该增益以 $N^{1/d}$ 的形式缩放，同时也实现了阶次最优的计算成本。有趣的是，这种阶次最优性是以确定性方式实现的，并且非常重要的是，它是独立于 $\mathbf{X}$ “盲性”实现的，因此能够在不重新分配文件的情况下计算多个所需函数。
tldr: 本文提出了一种确定性的“交织团”（IC）设计，用于分布式计算中的数据和任务分配，旨在联合最小化通信和计算成本。该设计将问题建模为超图划分，并在广泛的参数范围内，实现了渐近最优的通信成本（$n/N^{1/d}$）和计算成本，且分配方案对具体的子函数分解 $\mathbf{X}$ 是通用的（盲性的）。
ai_comments: 本文的关键创新在于提出了“交织团”（IC）设计，它巧妙地将分布式计算中的数据依赖性映射到超图划分问题，并提供了一个具有理论保证的确定性解决方案。其重要性在于，它首次证明了在联合优化通信和计算成本时，存在一个通用的、与具体任务分解无关的（“盲性”）分配方案，并能达到渐近最优的性能。这种通用性对于实际的分布式系统部署具有极高的价值，因为它消除了因任务变化而进行昂贵文件重排的需要。通信成本的最优缩放形式$n/N^{1/d}$揭示了系统所能获得的最大理论划分增益。
motivation: 在分布式计算环境中，研究如何联合最小化通信成本（每个服务器的最大不同文件数）和计算成本（最大工作节点子函数负载）。
method: 1. 将分布式计算问题建模为$d$-均匀超图的边划分问题，其中顶点是文件，边是子函数。2. 提出一种确定性的分配方案：“交织团”（IC）设计。3. 利用可达性和逆定理界限（achievability and converse bounds）来分析和证明IC设计的性能。
results: 1. IC设计在广泛的参数范围内，同时实现了阶次最优的通信成本和计算成本。2. 在合理假设下，最优通信成本的缩放形式为$n/N^{1/d}$，IC设计实现了阶次最优的划分增益，该增益以$N^{1/d}$的形式缩放。
conclusion: IC设计以确定性方式实现了阶次最优，并且重要的是，它对子函数集$\mathbf{X}$是“盲性”的（通用性），从而允许在不重新分配文件的情况下计算多个所需函数。

title: iReasoner: Trajectory-Aware Intrinsic Reasoning Supervision for Self-Evolving Large Multimodal Models
authors: Meghana Sunil, Manikandarajan Venmathimaran, Muthu Subash Kavitha
abstract: Recent work shows that large multimodal models (LMMs) can self-improve from unlabeled data via self-play and intrinsic feedback. Yet existing self-evolving frameworks mainly reward final outcomes, leaving intermediate reasoning weakly constrained despite its importance for visually grounded decision making. We propose iReasoner, a self-evolving framework that improves an LMM's implicit reasoning by explicitly eliciting chain-of-thought (CoT) and rewarding its internal agreement. In a Proposer--Solver loop over unlabeled images, iReasoner augments outcome-level intrinsic rewards with a trajectory-aware signal defined over intermediate reasoning steps, providing learning signals that distinguish reasoning paths leading to the same answer without ground-truth labels or external judges. Starting from Qwen2.5-VL-7B, iReasoner yields up to $+2.1$ points across diverse multimodal reasoning benchmarks under fully unsupervised post-training. We hope this work serves as a starting point for reasoning-aware self-improvement in LMMs in purely unsupervised settings.
zh_title: iReasoner：面向自演化大型多模态模型的轨迹感知内在推理监督
translation: 最近的研究表明，大型多模态模型（LMMs）可以通过自博弈和内在反馈从未标记数据中自我改进。然而，现有的自演化框架主要奖励最终结果，对中间推理的约束较弱，尽管中间推理对于视觉决策制定至关重要。我们提出了iReasoner，这是一个自演化框架，通过明确地启发思维链（CoT）并奖励其内部一致性来改进LMM的隐式推理。在一个针对未标记图像的Proposer--Solver循环中，iReasoner用定义在中间推理步骤上的轨迹感知信号增强了结果层面的内在奖励，提供了无需基础事实标签或外部评判者即可区分导致相同答案的推理路径的学习信号。从Qwen2.5-VL-7B模型开始，iReasoner在完全无监督的后训练下，在各种多模态推理基准上取得了高达+2.1点的提升。我们希望这项工作能成为在纯无监督设置中实现LMMs推理感知自我改进的起点。
tldr: iReasoner是一个自演化框架，通过引入“轨迹感知”的内在奖励机制，明确地监督并奖励大型多模态模型（LMMs）的中间推理步骤（CoT），从而在无监督设置下提升其推理能力。
ai_comments: 这项工作的创新点在于将内在奖励机制从单纯的结果层面扩展到了推理轨迹层面，尤其是在完全无监督的设置下。通过引入“轨迹感知”信号来评估和奖励模型内部生成的CoT的质量和一致性，iReasoner有效地解决了LMMs自演化中长期存在的“黑箱”推理过程约束不足的问题。这对于提升模型在复杂视觉推理任务中的鲁棒性和可解释性具有重要意义。
motivation: 现有的自演化框架主要奖励最终结果，导致对中间推理过程的约束较弱，而中间推理对于视觉决策至关重要。需要一种机制来显式地约束和改进LMMs的隐式推理。
method: 提出了iReasoner框架，在一个Proposer--Solver循环中使用未标记图像。它通过显式地启发思维链（CoT）并奖励其内部一致性，将结果层面的内在奖励与定义在中间推理步骤上的“轨迹感知”信号相结合，以区分导致相同答案的不同推理路径。
results: 从Qwen2.5-VL-7B模型开始，iReasoner在完全无监督的后训练下，在各种多模态推理基准上取得了高达+2.1点的提升。
conclusion: 这项工作有望成为在纯无监督设置中实现LMMs推理感知自我改进的起点。

title: An Empirical Study on Preference Tuning Generalization and Diversity Under Domain Shift
authors: Constantinos Karouzos, Xingwei Tan, Nikolaos Aletras
abstract: Preference tuning aligns pretrained language models to human judgments of quality, helpfulness, or safety by optimizing over explicit preference signals rather than likelihood alone. Prior work has shown that preference-tuning degrades performance and reduces helpfulness when evaluated outside the training domain. However, the extent to which adaptation strategies mitigate this domain shift remains unexplored. We address this challenge by conducting a comprehensive and systematic study of alignment generalization under domain shift. We compare five popular alignment objectives and various adaptation strategies from source to target, including target-domain supervised fine-tuning and pseudo-labeling, across summarization and question-answering helpfulness tasks. Our findings reveal systematic differences in generalization across alignment objectives under domain shift. We show that adaptation strategies based on pseudo-labeling can substantially reduce domain-shift degradation
zh_title: 域迁移下偏好调优泛化性和多样性的实证研究
translation: 偏好调优通过优化显式偏好信号（而非仅似然性），使预训练语言模型与人类对质量、有用性或安全性的判断保持一致。先前的工作表明，在训练域之外评估时，偏好调优会降低性能并减少有用性。然而，适应策略在多大程度上缓解了这种域迁移问题仍未得到探索。我们通过对域迁移下的对齐泛化性进行全面系统的研究来解决这一挑战。我们比较了五种流行的对齐目标以及从源域到目标域的各种适应策略，包括目标域有监督微调和伪标签法，并在摘要和问答的有用性任务上进行了评估。我们的研究结果揭示了在域迁移下，不同对齐目标在泛化性上存在系统性差异。我们证明了基于伪标签的适应策略可以大幅减少域迁移带来的性能退化。
tldr: 偏好调优在域迁移下性能会下降。本研究系统比较了五种对齐目标和多种适应策略，发现基于伪标签的适应策略能显著减少域迁移带来的性能退化。
ai_comments: 创新性：本文系统地解决了偏好调优（如RLHF/DPO）的一个关键实际限制——在域迁移下的泛化性差。通过比较五种对齐目标和多种适应技术，它为它们在鲁棒性上的差异提供了具体的实证证据。重要性：发现基于伪标签的适应策略可以“大幅减少域迁移带来的性能退化”，为在多样化的实际环境中部署对齐模型提供了一条有价值、可操作的途径，打破了必须为每个新域从头开始重新训练对齐模型的标准假设。局限性：标题中提到了“多样性”，但在摘要的方法或结果部分中没有明确详细说明或测量（只讨论了“泛化性”），这可能意味着摘要遗漏了一个关键发现，或者“多样性”是次要焦点。
motivation: 先前工作表明偏好调优在训练域外评估时性能会下降。但目前尚未充分探究适应策略在多大程度上可以缓解这种域迁移问题。本文旨在通过系统研究域迁移下的对齐泛化性来解决这一挑战。
method: 进行了一项全面且系统的研究，比较了五种流行的对齐目标和多种从源域到目标域的适应策略（包括目标域有监督微调和伪标签法）。在摘要生成和问答的有用性任务上进行了评估。
results: 揭示了在域迁移下不同对齐目标之间泛化性存在系统性差异。结果表明，基于伪标签的适应策略可以显著减少域迁移带来的性能退化。
conclusion: 基于伪标签的适应策略可以显著减少偏好调优模型在域迁移下的性能退化。

title: Gender Bias in LLMs: Preliminary Evidence from Shared Parenting Scenario in Czech Family Law
authors: Jakub Harasta, Matej Vasina, Martin Kornel, Tomas Foltynek
abstract: Access to justice remains limited for many people, leading laypersons to increasingly rely on Large Language Models (LLMs) for legal self-help. Laypeople use these tools intuitively, which may lead them to form expectations based on incomplete, incorrect, or biased outputs. This study examines whether leading LLMs exhibit gender bias in their responses to a realistic family law scenario. We present an expert-designed divorce scenario grounded in Czech family law and evaluate four state-of-the-art LLMs GPT-5 nano, Claude Haiku 4.5, Gemini 2.5 Flash, and Llama 3.3 in a fully zero-shot interaction. We deploy two versions of the scenario, one with gendered names and one with neutral labels, to establish a baseline for comparison. We further introduce nine legally relevant factors that vary the factual circumstances of the case and test whether these variations influence the models' proposed shared-parenting ratios. Our preliminary results highlight differences across models and suggest gender-dependent patterns in the outcomes generated by some systems. The findings underscore both the risks associated with laypeople's reliance on LLMs for legal guidance and the need for more robust evaluation of model behavior in sensitive legal contexts. We present exploratory and descriptive evidence intended to identify systematic asymmetries rather than to establish causal effects.
comment: Accepted at AI for Access to Justice, Dispute Resolution, and Data Access (AIDA2J) at Jurix 2025, Torino, Italy
zh_title: LLM 中的性别偏见：来自捷克家庭法中共同抚养情景的初步证据
translation: 许多人获得司法途径仍然有限，导致普通人越来越依赖大型语言模型 (LLMs) 进行法律自助。普通人凭直觉使用这些工具，这可能导致他们基于不完整、不正确或有偏见的输出来形成期望。本研究检验了领先的 LLMs 在对现实的家庭法情景的回复中是否表现出性别偏见。我们提出了一个基于捷克家庭法的专家设计的离婚情景，并在完全零样本交互中评估了四种最先进的 LLMs：GPT-5 nano、Claude Haiku 4.5、Gemini 2.5 Flash 和 Llama 3.3。我们部署了两种版本的情景，一种带有性别化姓名，另一种带有中性标签，以建立比较基线。我们进一步引入了九个法律相关因素来改变案件的事实情况，并测试这些变化是否影响模型提出的共同抚养比例。我们的初步结果突出了模型之间的差异，并表明某些系统生成的共同抚养结果中存在依赖于性别的模式。研究结果强调了普通人依赖 LLMs 获取法律指导所带来的风险，以及在敏感法律环境中对模型行为进行更稳健评估的必要性。我们提供了探索性和描述性的证据，旨在识别系统性的不对称性，而非建立因果关系。
tldr: 研究评估了四种 LLMs 在捷克家庭法共同抚养情景中是否存在性别偏见。初步证据显示，某些模型的结果存在依赖于性别的模式，突显了使用 LLMs 进行法律自助的风险。
ai_comments: 本研究的重要性在于它将 LLM 偏见的研究扩展到了一个高度敏感且特定于国家的领域——捷克家庭法中的共同抚养权情景。通过使用专家设计的现实情景、比较性别化和中性标签，并系统地引入法律相关因素，该研究提供了一种识别 LLM 在法律咨询中潜在系统性性别不对称性的有效方法。其创新性在于对顶级 LLM（如 GPT-5 nano 和 Llama 3.3）进行了零样本、特定法律环境的评估。研究结果直接指向了普通民众在寻求法律自助时面临的重大风险。论文明确指出的局限性是证据尚属初步、探索性和描述性的，侧重于识别不对称性而非建立因果关系。
motivation: 由于司法途径有限，普通人越来越依赖大型语言模型 (LLMs) 进行法律自助，但他们可能因此依赖于有偏见的输出。本研究旨在检验领先的 LLMs 在现实的家庭法情景中是否表现出性别偏见。
method: 采用基于捷克家庭法的专家设计的离婚情景。评估了四种先进的 LLMs（GPT-5 nano, Claude Haiku 4.5, Gemini 2.5 Flash, 和 Llama 3.3）。使用完全零样本交互。部署了两个版本的情景（使用性别化姓名和使用中性标签）进行基线比较，并引入了九个法律相关因素来改变事实情况，以测试这些变化对模型提出的共同抚养比例的影响。
results: 初步结果显示模型之间存在差异，并表明某些系统生成的共同抚养结果中存在依赖于性别的模式。
conclusion: 研究结果强调了普通人依赖 LLMs 获取法律指导的风险，以及在敏感法律环境中对模型行为进行更稳健评估的必要性。本研究提供了探索性和描述性的证据，旨在识别系统性的不对称性。

title: Cybersecurity AI: A Game-Theoretic AI for Guiding Attack and Defense
authors: Víctor Mayoral-Vilches, María Sanz-Gómez, Francesco Balassone, Stefan Rass, Lidia Salas-Espejo, Benjamin Jablonski, Luis Javier Navarrete-Lozano, Maite del Mundo de Torres, Cristóbal R. J. Veas Chavez
abstract: AI-driven penetration testing now executes thousands of actions per hour but still lacks the strategic intuition humans apply in competitive security. To build cybersecurity superintelligence --Cybersecurity AI exceeding best human capability-such strategic intuition must be embedded into agentic reasoning processes. We present Generative Cut-the-Rope (G-CTR), a game-theoretic guidance layer that extracts attack graphs from agent's context, computes Nash equilibria with effort-aware scoring, and feeds a concise digest back into the LLM loop \emph{guiding} the agent's actions. Across five real-world exercises, G-CTR matches 70--90% of expert graph structure while running 60--245x faster and over 140x cheaper than manual analysis. In a 44-run cyber-range, adding the digest lifts success from 20.0% to 42.9%, cuts cost-per-success by 2.7x, and reduces behavioral variance by 5.2x. In Attack-and-Defense exercises, a shared digest produces the Purple agent, winning roughly 2:1 over the LLM-only baseline and 3.7:1 over independently guided teams. This closed-loop guidance is what produces the breakthrough: it reduces ambiguity, collapses the LLM's search space, suppresses hallucinations, and keeps the model anchored to the most relevant parts of the problem, yielding large gains in success rate, consistency, and reliability.
zh_title: 网络安全AI：用于指导攻击和防御的博弈论AI
translation: AI驱动的渗透测试现在每小时可以执行数千次操作，但仍缺乏人类在竞争性安全中应用的战略直觉。为了构建网络安全超智能（即超越人类最佳能力的网络安全AI），这种战略直觉必须嵌入到智能体的推理过程中。我们提出了Generative Cut-the-Rope (G-CTR)，这是一个博弈论指导层，它从智能体的上下文中提取攻击图，使用考虑努力的评分计算纳什均衡，并将简洁的摘要反馈到LLM循环中，从而“指导”智能体的行动。在五项真实世界练习中，G-CTR匹配了70-90%的专家图结构，同时运行速度比手动分析快60-245倍，成本便宜140倍以上。在一个44轮的网络靶场中，添加摘要将成功率从20.0%提高到42.9%，将每次成功的成本降低了2.7倍，并将行为差异降低了5.2倍。在攻防练习中，共享摘要产生了Purple智能体，它以大约2:1的比例战胜了纯LLM基线，并以3.7:1的比例战胜了独立指导的团队。正是这种闭环指导带来了突破：它减少了模糊性，压缩了LLM的搜索空间，抑制了幻觉，并使模型锚定在问题最相关的部分，从而在成功率、一致性和可靠性方面产生了巨大收益。

title: GlueNN: gluing patchwise analytic solutions with neural networks
authors: Doyoung Kim, Donghee Lee, Hye-Sung Lee, Jiheon Lee, Jaeok Yi
abstract: In many problems in physics and engineering, one encounters complicated differential equations with strongly scale-dependent terms for which exact analytical or numerical solutions are not available. A common strategy is to divide the domain into several regions (patches) and simplify the equation in each region. When approximate analytic solutions can be obtained in each patch, they are then matched at the interfaces to construct a global solution. However, this patching procedure can fail to reproduce the correct solution, since the approximate forms may break down near the matching boundaries. In this work, we propose a learning framework in which the integration constants of asymptotic analytic solutions are promoted to scale-dependent functions. By constraining these coefficient functions with the original differential equation over the domain, the network learns a globally valid solution that smoothly interpolates between asymptotic regimes, eliminating the need for arbitrary boundary matching. We demonstrate the effectiveness of this framework in representative problems from chemical kinetics and cosmology, where it accurately reproduces global solutions and outperforms conventional matching procedures.
zh_title: GlueNN：用神经网络粘合分块解析解
translation: 在许多物理学和工程学问题中，人们会遇到具有强烈尺度依赖项的复杂微分方程，这些方程缺乏精确的解析解或数值解。一种常见的策略是将区域划分为若干子区域（块），并在每个区域中简化方程。当在每个子区域中获得近似解析解后，将它们在接口处匹配以构建全局解。然而，这种分块过程可能无法重现正确的解，因为近似形式可能在匹配边界附近失效。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个学习框架，其中渐近解析解的积分常数被提升为尺度依赖函数。通过使用原始微分方程在整个域上约束这些系数函数，该网络学习到一个全局有效的解，该解在渐近区域之间进行平滑插值，从而消除了对任意边界匹配的需求。我们在化学动力学和宇宙学的代表性问题中证明了该框架的有效性，它准确地重现了全局解并优于传统的匹配过程。
tldr: GlueNN是一种新方法，它使用神经网络将近似解析解中的常数升级为函数，通过约束学习得到复杂微分方程的平滑、全局有效解，避免了传统边界匹配的失败问题。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了一种混合方法，将领域知识（分块渐近解析解）与神经网络相结合。通过将积分常数提升为受原始微分方程约束的尺度依赖函数，该框架克服了传统“分块匹配”方法在边界附近失效的局限性，实现了渐近区域间的平滑、全局有效插值。
motivation: 许多物理和工程问题中的复杂微分方程具有强烈的尺度依赖项，缺乏精确的解析解或数值解。传统的“分块匹配”策略可能在匹配边界附近失效，无法重现正确的全局解。
method: 提出一个名为GlueNN的学习框架。该框架将渐近解析解的积分常数提升为尺度依赖函数，并通过原始微分方程在整个域上约束这些系数函数，从而学习得到全局有效的解。
results: 在化学动力学和宇宙学的代表性问题中证明了其有效性。它能准确重现全局解，并优于传统的匹配过程。
conclusion: 该学习框架（GlueNN）提供了一种无需任意边界匹配、能够平滑插值于渐近区域的全局有效解，有效解决了复杂微分方程的求解难题。

title: Spectral Clustering in Birthday Paradox Time
authors: Michael Kapralov, Ekaterina Kochetkova, Weronika Wrzos-Kaminska
abstract:
Given a vertex in a $(k, \varphi, ε)$-clusterable graph, i.e. a graph whose vertex set can be partitioned into a disjoint union of $\varphi$-expanders of size $\approx n/k$ with outer conductance bounded by $ε$, can one quickly tell which cluster it belongs to? This question goes back to the expansion testing problem of Goldreich and Ron'11. For $k=2$ a sample of $\approx n^{1/2+O(ε/\varphi^2)}$ logarithmic length walks from a given vertex approximately determines its cluster membership by the birthday paradox: two vertices whose random walk samples are `close' are likely in the same cluster.
  The study of the general case $k>2$ was initiated by Czumaj, Peng and Sohler [STOC'15], and the works of Chiplunkar et al. [FOCS'18], Gluch et al. [SODA'21] showed that $\approx \text{poly}(k)\cdot n^{1/2+O(ε/\varphi^2)}$ random walk samples suffice for general $k$. This matches the $k=2$ result up to polynomial factors in $k$, but creates a conceptual inconsistency: if the birthday paradox is the guiding phenomenon, then the query complexity should decrease with the number of clusters $k$! Since clusters have size $\approx n/k$, we expect to need $\approx (n/k)^{1/2+O(ε/\varphi^2)}$ random walk samples, which decreases with $k$.
  We design a novel representation of vertices in a $(k, \varphi, ε)$-clusterable graph by a mixture of logarithmic length walks. This representation uses the optimal $\approx (n/k)^{1/2+O(ε/\varphi^2)}$ walks per vertex, and allows for a fast nearest neighbor search: given $k$ vertices representing the clusters, we can find the cluster of a given query vertex $x$ using nearly linear time in the representation size of $x$. This gives a clustering oracle with query time $\approx (n/k)^{1/2+O(ε/\varphi^2)}$ and space complexity $k\cdot (n/k)^{1/2+O(ε/\varphi^2)}$, matching the birthday paradox bound.

zh_title: 生日悖论时间内的谱聚类
translation:
给定一个 $(k, \varphi, \varepsilon)$-可聚类图中的顶点，即一个顶点集可以被划分为 $k$ 个大小约为 $n/k$ 的 $\varphi$-扩展器（其外部电导率受 $\varepsilon$ 限制）的不相交并集，能否快速判断它属于哪个簇？这个问题可以追溯到 Goldreich 和 Ron'11 的扩展性测试问题。对于 $k=2$，从给定顶点出发的 $\approx n^{1/2+O(\varepsilon/\varphi^2)}$ 次对数长度随机游走样本，通过生日悖论，可以近似确定其簇归属：两个随机游走样本“接近”的顶点很可能属于同一个簇。
对一般情况 $k>2$ 的研究始于 Czumaj、Peng 和 Sohler [STOC'15]，随后 Chiplunkar 等人 [FOCS'18]、Gluch 等人 [SODA'21] 的工作表明，对于一般的 $k$，大约 $\text{poly}(k)\cdot n^{1/2+O(\varepsilon/\varphi^2)}$ 次随机游走样本就足够了。这在多项式因子 $k$ 内与 $k=2$ 的结果相匹配，但造成了概念上的不一致：如果生日悖论是指导现象，那么查询复杂度应该随着簇的数量 $k$ 增加而降低！由于簇的大小约为 $n/k$，我们预期需要的随机游走样本数约为 $(n/k)^{1/2+O(\varepsilon/\varphi^2)}$，这会随着 $k$ 的增加而减少。
我们设计了一种新的顶点表示方法，用于 $(k, \varphi, \varepsilon)$-可聚类图中的顶点，该表示通过对数长度游走的混合来实现。这种表示对每个顶点使用了最优的 $\approx (n/k)^{1/2+O(\varepsilon/\varphi^2)}$ 次游走，并允许进行快速最近邻搜索：给定代表簇的 $k$ 个顶点，我们可以使用接近线性于查询顶点 $x$ 表示大小的时间，找到给定查询顶点 $x$ 的簇。这提供了一个聚类预言机，其查询时间为 $\approx (n/k)^{1/2+O(\varepsilon/\varphi^2)}$，空间复杂度为 $k\cdot (n/k)^{1/2+O(\varepsilon/\varphi^2)}$，与生日悖论的界限相匹配。
tldr: 针对具有 $k$ 个簇的图，本文设计了一种新的基于随机游走的顶点表示方法，实现了最优的查询复杂度 $\approx (n/k)^{1/2}$，匹配了生日悖论的界限，解决了现有方法在 $k>2$ 时效率不一致的问题。
ai_comments: 这项工作的创新点在于解决了 $k>2$ 聚类问题中查询复杂度与基于生日悖论的理论预期不符的长期不一致性。通过引入一种新颖的随机游走混合表示，作者成功地将随机游走样本数降低到与簇大小平方根成正比的最优界限 $(n/k)^{1/2}$。这不仅在理论上填补了与 $k=2$ 情况的差距，而且提供了一个高度高效、可扩展的聚类预言机，对于大规模图上的近似聚类和扩展性测试具有重要意义。
motivation: 现有针对 $k>2$ 簇图的聚类算法的查询复杂度为 $\approx \text{poly}(k)\cdot n^{1/2+\dots}$。这与基于生日悖论的直觉（即复杂度应随簇数量 $k$ 增加而降低，达到 $\approx (n/k)^{1/2+\dots}$）存在概念上的不一致。本文旨在设计一种匹配生日悖论最优界限的高效聚类方法。
method: 设计了一种新的顶点表示方法，该表示基于对数长度随机游走的混合。然后利用这种表示进行快速最近邻搜索，以确定查询顶点的簇归属。
results: 达到了最优的 $\approx (n/k)^{1/2+O(\varepsilon/\varphi^2)}$ 随机游走样本数。提供的聚类预言机（clustering oracle）查询时间为 $\approx (n/k)^{1/2+O(\varepsilon/\varphi^2)}$，空间复杂度为 $k\cdot (n/k)^{1/2+O(\varepsilon/\varphi^2)}$，匹配了生日悖论的界限。
conclusion: 通过使用新的顶点表示和快速最近邻搜索，实现了与生日悖论界限相匹配的聚类预言机，其查询复杂度和空间复杂度均达到了最优界限 $\approx (n/k)^{1/2+O(\varepsilon/\varphi^2)}$。

title: The Modal Logic of Abstraction Refinement
authors: Jakob Piribauer, Vinzent Zschuppe
abstract:
Iterative abstraction refinement techniques are one of the most prominent paradigms for the analysis and verification of systems with large or infinite state spaces. This paper investigates the changes of truth values of system properties expressible in computation tree logic (CTL) when abstractions of transition systems are refined. To this end, the paper utilizes modal logic by defining alethic modalities expressing possibility and necessity on top of CTL: The modal operator $\lozenge$ is interpreted as "there is a refinement, in which ..." and $\Box$ is interpreted as "in all refinements, ...".
  Upper and lower bounds for the resulting modal logics of abstraction refinement are provided for three scenarios: 1) when considering all finite abstractions of a transition system, 2) when considering all abstractions of a transition system, and 3) when considering the class of all transition systems. Furthermore, to prove these results, generic techniques to obtain upper bounds of modal logics using novel types of so-called control statements are developed.
comment: This is the extended version of a paper accepted for publication at FoSSaCS 2026
translation:
迭代抽象细化技术是分析和验证具有大型或无限状态空间的系统的最主要范式之一。本文研究了当转换系统的抽象被细化时，可计算树逻辑（CTL）表达的系统属性真值的变化。为此，本文利用模态逻辑，在CTL之上定义了表达可能性和必然性的真值模态：模态算子$\lozenge$被解释为“存在一个细化，其中...”，而$\Box$被解释为“在所有细化中，...”。
在三种场景下，为抽象细化的所得模态逻辑提供了上下界：1）考虑转换系统的所有有限抽象时，2）考虑转换系统的所有抽象时，以及3）考虑所有转换系统类时。此外，为了证明这些结果，开发了使用新型控制语句来获取模态逻辑上界的通用技术。

title: StackPlanner: A Centralized Hierarchical Multi-Agent System with Task-Experience Memory Management
authors: Ruizhe Zhang, Xinke Jiang, Zhibang Yang, Zhixin Zhang, Jiaran Gao, Yuzhen Xiao, Hongbin Lai, Xu Chu, Junfeng Zhao, Yasha Wang
abstract: Multi-agent systems based on large language models, particularly centralized architectures, have recently shown strong potential for complex and knowledge-intensive tasks. However, central agents often suffer from unstable long-horizon collaboration due to the lack of memory management, leading to context bloat, error accumulation, and poor cross-task generalization. To address both task-level memory inefficiency and the inability to reuse coordination experience, we propose StackPlanner, a hierarchical multi-agent framework with explicit memory control. StackPlanner addresses these challenges by decoupling high-level coordination from subtask execution with active task-level memory control, and by learning to retrieve and exploit reusable coordination experience via structured experience memory and reinforcement learning. Experiments on multiple deep-search and agent system benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach in enabling reliable long-horizon multi-agent collaboration.
zh_title: StackPlanner：一种具有任务经验记忆管理的集中式分层多智能体系统
translation: 基于大型语言模型的多智能体系统，特别是集中式架构，最近在复杂和知识密集型任务中显示出强大的潜力。然而，中央智能体通常因缺乏记忆管理而导致长期协作不稳定，从而引发上下文膨胀、错误积累和跨任务泛化能力差。为了解决任务级记忆效率低下和无法重用协调经验的问题，我们提出了StackPlanner，一个具有显式记忆控制的分层多智能体框架。StackPlanner通过主动的任务级记忆控制将高级协调与子任务执行解耦，并通过结构化经验记忆和强化学习来学习检索和利用可重用的协调经验，从而解决了这些挑战。在多个深度搜索和智能体系统基准上的实验证明了我们方法在实现可靠的长期多智能体协作方面的有效性。
tldr: 针对集中式多智能体系统在长期协作中存在的记忆管理缺失、上下文膨胀和泛化能力差的问题，本文提出了StackPlanner，一个通过解耦协调与执行、主动记忆控制以及利用强化学习和结构化经验记忆来提高长期可靠协作的分层框架。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于将传统的多智能体系统与先进的记忆管理技术相结合，特别是引入了“任务经验记忆管理”和“分层”结构来解决集中式LLM智能体在长期规划和协作中的核心痛点——上下文膨胀和经验复用困难。通过结合强化学习来学习经验的检索和利用，该系统有望提高协作的稳定性和跨任务的泛化能力，这对于构建实用、可靠的复杂LLM代理至关重要。
motivation: 集中式大语言模型多智能体系统在复杂任务中表现出潜力，但中央智能体缺乏记忆管理，导致上下文膨胀、错误积累和跨任务泛化能力差，从而造成不稳定的长期协作。
method: 提出StackPlanner，一个具有显式记忆控制的分层多智能体框架。该方法通过将高级协调与子任务执行解耦，并进行主动的任务级记忆控制；同时利用结构化经验记忆和强化学习来检索和利用可重用的协调经验。
results: 在多个深度搜索和智能体系统基准测试上，实验证明了该方法在实现可靠的长期多智能体协作方面的有效性。
conclusion: StackPlanner通过其分层架构和记忆管理机制，有效解决了集中式多智能体系统在长期任务中协作不稳定和记忆效率低的问题，实现了可靠的长期多智能体协作。

title: HAPS: Hierarchical LLM Routing with Joint Architecture and Parameter Search
authors: Zihang Tian, Rui Li, Jingsen Zhang, Xiaohe Bo, Wei Huo, Xu Chen
abstract: Large language model (LLM) routing aims to exploit the specialized strengths of different LLMs for diverse tasks. However, existing approaches typically focus on selecting LLM architectures while overlooking parameter settings, which are critical for task performance. In this paper, we introduce HAPS, a hierarchical LLM routing framework that jointly searches over model architectures and parameters. Specifically, we use a high-level router to select among candidate LLM architectures, and then search for the optimal parameters for the selected architectures based on a low-level router. We design a parameter generation network to share parameters between the two routers to mutually enhance their capabilities. In the training process, we design a reward-augmented objective to effectively optimize our framework. Experiments on two commonly used benchmarks show that HAPS consistently outperforms strong routing baselines. We have released our code at https://github.com/zihangtian/HAPS.
zh_title: HAPS：联合架构和参数搜索的分层LLM路由
translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）路由旨在利用不同LLM对不同任务的专门优势。然而，现有方法通常侧重于选择LLM架构，而忽略了对任务性能至关重要的参数设置。在本文中，我们提出了HAPS，一个分层LLM路由框架，它可以联合搜索模型架构和参数。具体来说，我们使用一个高层路由器在候选LLM架构中进行选择，然后根据低层路由器搜索所选架构的最佳参数。我们设计了一个参数生成网络，在两个路由器之间共享参数，以相互增强它们的能力。在训练过程中，我们设计了一个奖励增强的目标函数来有效地优化我们的框架。在两个常用基准测试上的实验表明，HAPS持续优于强大的路由基线。我们已在https://github.com/zihangtian/HAPS发布了我们的代码。
tldr: HAPS是一个新的分层LLM路由框架，它同时搜索要使用的LLM的架构和具体参数设置，而不是只选择架构。通过一个高层和低层路由器协同工作，并在它们之间共享参数，HAPS在基准测试中表现优于其他路由方法。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于首次将LLM路由与模型架构和参数搜索结合起来，并设计了参数生成网络来共享信息，这对于优化异构LLM的使用具有重要意义。其局限性未在摘要中明确说明，但多阶段搜索的复杂性可能是一个潜在挑战。
motivation: 现有的LLM路由方法通常只关注选择LLM架构，而忽略了对任务性能至关重要的参数设置。
method: 提出了一种分层LLM路由框架HAPS，它通过一个高层路由器选择候选LLM架构，然后通过一个低层路由器搜索所选架构的最佳参数。设计了一个参数生成网络在两个路由器之间共享参数以相互增强能力。训练过程中采用奖励增强目标函数来有效优化框架。
results: HAPS在两个常用基准测试上持续优于强大的路由基线。
conclusion: HAPS在两个常用基准测试上持续优于强大的路由基线。

title: Can AI mediation improve democratic deliberation?
authors: Michael Henry Tessler, Georgina Evans, Michiel A. Bakker, Iason Gabriel, Sophie Bridgers, Rishub Jain, Raphael Koster, Verena Rieser, Anca Dragan, Matthew Botvinick, Christopher Summerfield
abstract: The strength of democracy lies in the free and equal exchange of diverse viewpoints. Living up to this ideal at scale faces inherent tensions: broad participation, meaningful deliberation, and political equality often trade off with one another (Fishkin, 2011). We ask whether and how artificial intelligence (AI) could help navigate this "trilemma" by engaging with a recent example of a large language model (LLM)-based system designed to help people with diverse viewpoints find common ground (Tessler, Bakker, et al., 2024). Here, we explore the implications of the introduction of LLMs into deliberation augmentation tools, examining their potential to enhance participation through scalability, improve political equality via fair mediation, and foster meaningful deliberation by, for example, surfacing trustworthy information. We also point to key challenges that remain. Ultimately, a range of empirical, technical, and theoretical advancements are needed to fully realize the promise of AI-mediated deliberation for enhancing citizen engagement and strengthening democratic deliberation.
zh_title: AI调解能否改善民主协商？
translation: 民主的优势在于自由平等的多元观点交流。大规模实现这一理想面临固有的张力：广泛参与、有意义的协商和政治平等常常相互制约（Fishkin，2011）。我们通过探讨一个旨在帮助持不同观点者找到共同点的大型语言模型（LLM）系统（Tessler, Bakker, et al., 2024）的最新案例，来探讨人工智能（AI）是否以及如何帮助解决这一“三难困境”。在这里，我们探讨了将LLM引入协商增强工具的意义，考察了它们通过可扩展性增强参与、通过公平调解改善政治平等以及通过例如提供可靠信息来促进有意义的协商的潜力。我们也指出仍然存在的关键挑战。最终，需要一系列实证、技术和理论进步，才能充分实现AI调解协商在增强公民参与和加强民主协商方面的潜力。
tldr: 本文探讨了AI，特别是大型语言模型（LLM），在解决民主协商中广泛参与、有意义的协商和政治平等之间固有的“三难困境”方面的潜力，指出AI可以通过可扩展性、公平调解和提供可靠信息来增强民主协商，但仍需克服关键挑战。
ai_comments: 本文关注AI与民主交叉领域的一个关键且及时的问题。其对民主协商“三难困境”的探讨以及LLM在公平调解和信息呈现方面的潜力是具有创新性的。然而，文章也强调了存在的重大挑战，这表明AI作为工具需要谨慎开发和对其局限性的理解，才能真正增强而非损害民主进程。本文为未来的研究设定了明确的议程。
motivation: 民主的优势在于多元观点的自由平等交流，但大规模实现这一理想时，广泛参与、有意义的协商和政治平等之间存在固有的张力。本文旨在探讨人工智能（AI）是否以及如何帮助解决这一“三难困境”。
method: 本文通过研究一个旨在帮助持不同观点者找到共同点的大型语言模型（LLM）系统的最新案例，来探讨LLM引入协商增强工具的意义。具体分析了LLM在通过可扩展性增强参与、通过公平调解改善政治平等以及通过提供可靠信息促进有意义的协商方面的潜力。
results: LLM在通过可扩展性增强参与、通过公平调解改善政治平等以及通过提供可靠信息促进有意义的协商方面具有潜力。然而，本文也指出仍存在关键挑战。
conclusion: 最终，需要一系列实证、技术和理论进步，才能充分实现AI调解协商在增强公民参与和加强民主协商方面的潜力。

title: TowerMind: A Tower Defence Game Learning Environment and Benchmark for LLM as Agents
authors: Dawei Wang, Chengming Zhou, Di Zhao, Xinyuan Liu, Marci Chi Ma, Gary Ushaw, Richard Davison
abstract: Recent breakthroughs in Large Language Models (LLMs) have positioned them as a promising paradigm for agents, with long-term planning and decision-making emerging as core general-purpose capabilities for adapting to diverse scenarios and tasks. Real-time strategy (RTS) games serve as an ideal testbed for evaluating these two capabilities, as their inherent gameplay requires both macro-level strategic planning and micro-level tactical adaptation and action execution. Existing RTS game-based environments either suffer from relatively high computational demands or lack support for textual observations, which has constrained the use of RTS games for LLM evaluation. Motivated by this, we present TowerMind, a novel environment grounded in the tower defense (TD) subgenre of RTS games. TowerMind preserves the key evaluation strengths of RTS games for assessing LLMs, while featuring low computational demands and a multimodal observation space, including pixel-based, textual, and structured game-state representations. In addition, TowerMind supports the evaluation of model hallucination and provides a high degree of customizability. We design five benchmark levels to evaluate several widely used LLMs under different multimodal input settings. The results reveal a clear performance gap between LLMs and human experts across both capability and hallucination dimensions. The experiments further highlight key limitations in LLM behavior, such as inadequate planning validation, a lack of multifinality in decision-making, and inefficient action use. We also evaluate two classic reinforcement learning algorithms: Ape-X DQN and PPO. By offering a lightweight and multimodal design, TowerMind complements the existing RTS game-based environment landscape and introduces a new benchmark for the AI agent field. The source code is publicly available on GitHub(https://github.com/tb6147877/TowerMind).
zh_title: TowerMind：一个用于大型语言模型（LLM）作为智能体的塔防游戏学习环境与基准
translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）最近的突破已将其定位为有前景的智能体范式，其中长期规划和决策制定作为核心通用能力，能够适应各种场景和任务。实时战略（RTS）游戏是评估这两种能力的理想试验台，因为其固有的玩法需要宏观层面的战略规划和微观层面的战术适应与行动执行。然而，现有的基于RTS游戏的环境要么计算需求相对较高，要么缺乏对文本观察的支持，这限制了RTS游戏在LLM评估中的使用。受此启发，我们提出了TowerMind，一个基于RTS游戏子类型——塔防（TD）——的新颖环境。TowerMind保留了RTS游戏评估LLMs的关键优势，同时具有低计算需求和多模态观察空间，包括基于像素、文本和结构化的游戏状态表示。此外，TowerMind支持评估模型幻觉并提供高度的可定制性。我们设计了五个基准级别，用于在不同的多模态输入设置下评估几种广泛使用的LLMs。结果揭示了LLMs与人类专家在能力和幻觉维度上都存在明显的性能差距。实验进一步突出了LLM行为中的关键限制，例如规划验证不足、决策缺乏多终局性以及行动使用效率低下。我们还评估了两种经典的强化学习算法：Ape-X DQN和PPO。通过提供轻量级和多模态的设计，TowerMind补充了现有的RTS游戏环境格局，并为AI智能体领域引入了一个新的基准。源代码已在GitHub上公开。
tldr: 提出TowerMind，一个低计算需求、多模态的塔防游戏环境，用于评估大型语言模型（LLM）作为智能体的长期规划和决策能力，实验显示LLM与人类专家之间存在明显的性能差距。
ai_comments: 创新点在于创建了一个轻量级、多模态的环境（塔防子类型），它保留了RTS游戏复杂的规划需求，但降低了计算成本，使其适用于LLM研究。此外，纳入模型幻觉评估和结构化观察空间对于诊断LLM的深层限制非常重要。TowerMind为评估LLM智能体的复杂战略能力提供了一个实用且重要的基准。
motivation: 评估大型语言模型（LLM）作为智能体的长期规划和决策能力。现有的基于实时战略游戏（RTS）的环境计算需求高或缺乏对文本观察的支持，限制了LLM的评估。
method: 提出了TowerMind环境，基于塔防（TD）子类型RTS游戏。它具有低计算需求、多模态观察空间（像素、文本、结构化）和高可定制性，并支持评估模型幻觉。设计了五个基准级别来评估LLMs和强化学习算法（Ape-X DQN和PPO）。
results: 揭示了LLM与人类专家在能力和幻觉方面存在明显的性能差距。实验突出了LLM行为的主要限制：规划验证不足、决策缺乏多终局性以及行动使用效率低下。
conclusion: TowerMind通过提供一个轻量级和多模态的设计，补充了现有的RTS游戏环境，并为AI智能体领域引入了一个新的基准。

title: Illusions of Confidence? Diagnosing LLM Truthfulness via Neighborhood Consistency
authors: Haoming Xu, Ningyuan Zhao, Yunzhi Yao, Weihong Xu, Hongru Wang, Xinle Deng, Shumin Deng, Jeff Z. Pan, Huajun Chen, Ningyu Zhang
abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in real-world settings, correctness alone is insufficient. Reliable deployment requires maintaining truthful beliefs under contextual perturbations. Existing evaluations largely rely on point-wise confidence like Self-Consistency, which can mask brittle belief. We show that even facts answered with perfect self-consistency can rapidly collapse under mild contextual interference. To address this gap, we propose Neighbor-Consistency Belief (NCB), a structural measure of belief robustness that evaluates response coherence across a conceptual neighborhood. To validate the efficiency of NCB, we introduce a new cognitive stress-testing protocol that probes outputs stability under contextual interference. Experiments across multiple LLMs show that the performance of high-NCB data is relatively more resistant to interference. Finally, we present Structure-Aware Training (SAT), which optimizes context-invariant belief structure and reduces long-tail knowledge brittleness by approximately 30%. Code will be available at https://github.com/zjunlp/belief.
zh_title: 信心幻觉？通过邻域一致性诊断大型语言模型的真实性
translation: 随着大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地部署在实际环境中，仅有正确性是不够的。可靠的部署要求在上下文扰动下保持真实的信念。现有的评估主要依赖于点式置信度（如自洽性），但这可能会掩盖脆弱的信念。我们展示了即使是具有完美自洽性的事实，在轻微的上下文干扰下也会迅速崩溃。为了解决这一差距，我们提出了“邻域一致性信念”（NCB），这是一种衡量信念鲁棒性的结构化指标，用于评估概念邻域内的响应连贯性。为了验证NCB的有效性，我们引入了一种新的认知压力测试协议，用于探测上下文干扰下的输出稳定性。在多个LLM上的实验表明，高NCB数据的性能对干扰相对更具抵抗力。最后，我们提出了“结构感知训练”（SAT），它优化了上下文不变的信念结构，并将长尾知识的脆弱性降低了约30%。代码将可在https://github.com/zjunlp/belief 获取。
tldr: 现有LLM信心评估（如自洽性）不可靠，因为事实在轻微上下文干扰下会迅速崩溃。本文提出“邻域一致性信念”（NCB）来衡量信念的鲁棒性，引入认知压力测试协议，并提出“结构感知训练”（SAT），将长尾知识的脆弱性降低了约30%。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将LLM真实性评估从传统的点式置信度（如自洽性）提升到结构化鲁棒性（邻域一致性）。它强调了即使是“自信”的LLM输出也可能存在“信心幻觉”，并通过引入认知压力测试协议来量化这种脆弱性，这对于推动LLM在现实世界中的可靠部署至关重要。结构感知训练（SAT）提供了一个实用的解决方案来提高知识的抗干扰能力。
motivation: 在实际部署中，仅有正确性是不够的，LLM需要保持在上下文扰动下的真实信念。现有的点式置信度评估（如自洽性）会掩盖脆弱的信念，这些信念在轻微干扰下会迅速崩溃。
method: 提出了“邻域一致性信念”（NCB），这是一种衡量信念鲁棒性的结构化指标。引入了一种新的认知压力测试协议来探测模型输出稳定性。最后，提出了“结构感知训练”（SAT）来优化上下文不变的信念结构。
results: 即使是具有完美自洽性的事实，在轻微上下文干扰下也会迅速崩溃。高NCB数据的性能对干扰相对更具抵抗力。结构感知训练（SAT）将长尾知识的脆弱性降低了约30%。
conclusion: 现有的点式置信度评估（如自洽性）存在局限性。通过引入NCB和认知压力测试，可以更有效地诊断LLM的真实性。结构感知训练（SAT）是一种有效的提高LLM信念结构鲁棒性的方法。

title: Auditing Fairness under Model Updates: Fundamental Complexity and Property-Preserving Updates
authors: Ayoub Ajarra, Debabrota Basu
abstract:
As machine learning models become increasingly embedded in societal infrastructure, auditing them for bias is of growing importance. However, in real-world deployments, auditing is complicated by the fact that model owners may adaptively update their models in response to changing environments, such as financial markets. These updates can alter the underlying model class while preserving certain properties of interest, raising fundamental questions about what can be reliably audited under such shifts.
  In this work, we study group fairness auditing under arbitrary updates. We consider general shifts that modify the pre-audit model class while maintaining invariance of the audited property. Our goals are two-fold: (i) to characterize the information complexity of allowable updates, by identifying which strategic changes preserve the property under audit; and (ii) to efficiently estimate auditing properties, such as group fairness, using a minimal number of labeled samples.
  We propose a generic framework for PAC auditing based on an Empirical Property Optimization (EPO) oracle. For statistical parity, we establish distribution-free auditing bounds characterized by the SP dimension, a novel combinatorial measure that captures the complexity of admissible strategic updates. Finally, we demonstrate that our framework naturally extends to other auditing objectives, including prediction error and robust risk.
zh_title: 审计模型更新下的公平性：基本复杂性与保持属性的更新
translation: 随着机器学习模型越来越多地嵌入到社会基础设施中，审计其偏差变得越来越重要。然而，在实际部署中，由于模型所有者可能会根据不断变化的环境（如金融市场）自适应地更新其模型，审计变得复杂。这些更新可能会改变底层模型类别，同时保持某些受关注的属性不变，从而引发了在这些变化下哪些信息可以被可靠审计的基本问题。在这项工作中，我们研究了任意更新下的群体公平性审计。我们考虑了修改预审计模型类别同时保持被审计属性不变的一般性偏移。我们的目标有两个：（i）通过识别哪些策略性变化可以保持被审计属性不变，来表征允许更新的信息复杂性；（ii）使用最少数量的带标签样本来有效估计审计属性，例如群体公平性。我们提出了一个基于经验属性优化（EPO）神谕的PAC审计通用框架。对于统计均等性，我们建立了由SP维度（一种捕获允许策略性更新复杂性的新组合度量）表征的无分布审计界限。最后，我们证明了我们的框架可以自然地扩展到其他审计目标，包括预测误差和鲁棒风险。
tldr: 研究了模型自适应更新背景下的公平性审计问题，提出了一个通用框架，并用“SP维度”量化了在保持公平性前提下模型更新的复杂性。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了“SP维度”这一新的组合度量，用于量化在模型更新下保持公平性属性的允许策略性更新的复杂性。其重要性在于解决了现实世界中模型自适应更新背景下的公平性审计难题。论文的局限性是主要集中在PAC审计框架和统计均等性上，对更复杂的公平性指标的适用性需要进一步探讨。
motivation: 随着机器学习模型越来越多地嵌入到社会基础设施中，对其进行偏差审计变得越来越重要。然而，在实际部署中，模型所有者可能会根据不断变化的环境（如金融市场）自适应地更新模型，这使得审计复杂化，并引发了在这些变化下哪些信息可以被可靠审计的基本问题。
method: 提出一个基于经验属性优化（EPO）神谕的通用PAC审计框架；为统计均等性建立由SP维度（一种捕获允许策略性更新复杂性的新组合度量）表征的无分布审计界限。
results: 建立了由SP维度表征的统计均等性的无分布审计界限；证明了所提出的框架可以自然地扩展到包括预测误差和鲁棒风险在内的其他审计目标。
conclusion: 论文提出了一个基于经验属性优化（EPO）神谕的PAC审计通用框架，并为统计均等性建立了由SP维度表征的无分布审计界限，该框架可以自然地扩展到其他审计目标。

title: Distilling Lightweight Domain Experts from Large ML Models by Identifying Relevant Subspaces
authors: Pattarawat Chormai, Ali Hashemi, Klaus-Robert Müller, Grégoire Montavon
abstract: Knowledge distillation involves transferring the predictive capabilities of large, high-performing AI models (teachers) to smaller models (students) that can operate in environments with limited computing power. In this paper, we address the scenario in which only a few classes and their associated intermediate concepts are relevant to distill. This scenario is common in practice, yet few existing distillation methods explicitly focus on the relevant subtask. To address this gap, we introduce 'SubDistill', a new distillation algorithm with improved numerical properties that only distills the relevant components of the teacher model at each layer. Experiments on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet with Convolutional and Transformer models demonstrate that SubDistill outperforms existing layer-wise distillation techniques on a representative set of subtasks. Our benchmark evaluations are complemented by Explainable AI analyses showing that our distilled student models more closely match the decision structure of the original teacher model.
zh_title: 通过识别相关子空间从大型机器学习模型中蒸馏轻量级领域专家
translation: 知识蒸馏涉及将大型、高性能AI模型（教师）的预测能力转移到可以在计算能力有限的环境中运行的较小模型（学生）。在本文中，我们讨论了仅有少数类别及其相关的中间概念需要蒸馏的场景。这种情况在实践中很常见，但很少有现有的蒸馏方法明确关注相关的子任务。为了解决这一差距，我们引入了“SubDistill”，这是一种具有改进数值特性的新型蒸馏算法，它只蒸馏教师模型在每一层中的相关组件。在CIFAR-100和ImageNet上使用卷积和Transformer模型的实验表明，SubDistill在具有代表性的一组子任务上优于现有的逐层蒸馏技术。我们的基准评估辅以可解释AI分析，结果显示我们蒸馏出的学生模型与原始教师模型的决策结构更加匹配。
tldr: 提出了一种名为SubDistill的新蒸馏方法，通过只蒸馏大型AI模型中的相关组件来创建轻量级、专业的“领域专家”模型，该方法在子任务上优于现有技术，并且更好地保留了教师模型的决策结构。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了“相关子空间”的概念，使知识蒸馏过程具有任务特异性，从而实现了轻量级领域专家的蒸馏。这解决了在部署大型模型时，学生模型仅需执行教师模型部分任务的常见实际瓶颈。通过仅蒸馏相关组件，该方法显著提高了效率，并在保持与教师模型决策结构一致性方面表现优异，这对于边缘计算和资源受限环境下的模型部署具有重要意义。
motivation: 知识蒸馏通常将大型AI模型（教师）的预测能力转移到计算能力有限的小型模型（学生）。本文针对实践中常见但现有蒸馏方法很少明确关注的场景：即只需要蒸馏少数相关类别及其相关的中间概念。
method: 提出了一种新的蒸馏算法“SubDistill”。该算法具有改进的数值特性，通过识别相关子空间，仅蒸馏教师模型在每一层中的相关组件。
results: 在CIFAR-100和ImageNet上使用卷积和Transformer模型的实验表明，SubDistill在代表性子任务上优于现有的逐层蒸馏技术。可解释AI分析表明，蒸馏后的学生模型与原始教师模型的决策结构更匹配。
conclusion: SubDistill算法有效地解决了在知识蒸馏中仅针对相关子任务进行蒸馏的问题，能够从大型模型中提取出性能优越且决策结构匹配度更高的轻量级领域专家模型。

title: Pantagruel: Unified Self-Supervised Encoders for French Text and Speech
authors: Phuong-Hang Le, Valentin Pelloin, Arnault Chatelain, Maryem Bouziane, Mohammed Ghennai, Qianwen Guan, Kirill Milintsevich, Salima Mdhaffar, Aidan Mannion, Nils Defauw, Shuyue Gu, Alexandre Audibert, Marco Dinarelli, Yannick Estève, Lorraine Goeuriot, Steffen Lalande, Nicolas Hervé, Maximin Coavoux, François Portet, Étienne Ollion, Marie Candito, Maxime Peyrard, Solange Rossato, Benjamin Lecouteux, Aurélie Nardy, Gilles Sérasset, Vincent Segonne, Solène Evain, Diandra Fabre, Didier Schwab
abstract: We release Pantagruel models, a new family of self-supervised encoder models for French text and speech. Instead of predicting modality-tailored targets such as textual tokens or speech units, Pantagruel learns contextualized target representations in the feature space, allowing modality-specific encoders to capture linguistic and acoustic regularities more effectively. Separate models are pre-trained on large-scale French corpora, including Wikipedia, OSCAR and CroissantLLM for text, together with MultilingualLibriSpeech, LeBenchmark, and INA-100k for speech. INA-100k is a newly introduced 100,000-hour corpus of French audio derived from the archives of the Institut National de l'Audiovisuel (INA), the national repository of French radio and television broadcasts, providing highly diverse audio data. We evaluate Pantagruel across a broad range of downstream tasks spanning both modalities, including those from the standard French benchmarks such as FLUE or LeBenchmark. Across these tasks, Pantagruel models show competitive or superior performance compared to strong French baselines such as CamemBERT, FlauBERT, and LeBenchmark2.0, while maintaining a shared architecture that can seamlessly handle either speech or text inputs. These results confirm the effectiveness of feature-space self-supervised objectives for French representation learning and highlight Pantagruel as a robust foundation for multimodal speech-text understanding.
zh_title: Pantagruel：统一的法语文本和语音自监督编码器
translation: 我们发布了 Pantagruel 模型，这是一系列新的法语文本和语音自监督编码器模型。Pantagruel 没有预测特定于模态的目标（如文本标记或语音单元），而是在特征空间中学习上下文目标表示，从而使特定于模态的编码器能够更有效地捕捉语言和声学规律。我们使用大规模法语语料库（包括用于文本的 Wikipedia、OSCAR 和 CroissantLLM，以及用于语音的 MultilingualLibriSpeech、LeBenchmark 和 INA-100k）分别预训练了模型。INA-100k 是一个新引入的包含 10 万小时法语音频的语料库，来源于法国国家视听研究所（INA）的档案，该研究所是法国广播电视节目的国家存储库，提供了高度多样化的音频数据。我们在广泛的下游任务中评估了 Pantagruel，这些任务涵盖了两种模态，包括来自标准法语基准（如 FLUE 或 LeBenchmark）的任务。在这些任务中，Pantagruel 模型与 CamemBERT、FlauBERT 和 LeBenchmark2.0 等强大的法语基线模型相比，表现出具有竞争性或更优的性能，同时保持了能够无缝处理语音或文本输入的共享架构。这些结果证实了特征空间自监督目标在法语表示学习中的有效性，并突显了 Pantagruel 作为多模态语音-文本理解的稳健基础。
tldr: Pantagruel 是一个统一的法语文本和语音自监督编码器系列，它通过在特征空间中学习上下文目标表示来提高模态特定编码器的效率，并在各种下游任务中表现出与现有模型相当或更优的性能。
ai_comments: Pantagruel 模型在统一处理法语文本和语音方面取得了显著进展，其在特征空间学习目标表示的方法具有创新性。新引入的 INA-100k 语料库为法语语音处理提供了宝贵资源。然而，该模型在多语言环境下的泛化能力以及在更复杂、噪声环境下的鲁棒性仍有待进一步探索。此外，模型的可解释性以及其在实际应用中的部署效率也是未来研究的方向。
motivation: 现有的自监督模型通常针对特定模态（文本或语音）进行优化，未能充分利用跨模态的共性。本文旨在开发一种统一的自监督编码器，能够同时有效地处理法语文本和语音，并提升在各种下游任务中的表现。
method: Pantagruel 模型通过在特征空间中学习上下文目标表示，而不是预测特定模态的目标（如文本标记或语音单元），来训练模态特定的编码器。这些模型在大量的法语语料库（包括文本和语音数据）上进行预训练。新引入的 INA-100k 语料库包含 10 万小时的法语音频数据。模型在 FLUE 和 LeBenchmark 等标准法语基准的跨模态下游任务上进行了评估。
results: Pantagruel 模型在各种下游任务中表现出具有竞争性或优于现有法语基线模型（如 CamemBERT, FlauBERT, LeBenchmark2.0）的性能。其共享架构能够无缝处理文本和语音输入。
conclusion: Pantagruel 模型证明了特征空间自监督目标在法语表示学习中的有效性，并为多模态语音-文本理解提供了一个强大的基础。

title: Agentic LLMs as Powerful Deanonymizers: Re-identification of Participants in the Anthropic Interviewer Dataset
authors: Tianshi Li
abstract: On December 4, 2025, Anthropic released Anthropic Interviewer, an AI tool for running qualitative interviews at scale, along with a public dataset of 1,250 interviews with professionals, including 125 scientists, about their use of AI for research. Focusing on the scientist subset, I show that widely available LLMs with web search and agentic capabilities can link six out of twenty-four interviews to specific scientific works, recovering associated authors and, in some cases, uniquely identifying the interviewees. My contribution is to show that modern LLM-based agents make such re-identification attacks easy and low-effort: off-the-shelf tools can, with a few natural-language prompts, search the web, cross-reference details, and propose likely matches, effectively lowering the technical barrier. Existing safeguards can be bypassed by breaking down the re-identification into benign tasks. I outline the attack at a high level, discuss implications for releasing rich qualitative data in the age of LLM agents, and propose mitigation recommendations and open problems. I have notified Anthropic of my findings.
zh_title: 代理式大型语言模型作为强大的去匿名化工具：Anthropic面试数据集参与者的再识别
translation: 2025年12月4日，Anthropic发布了Anthropic Interviewer，这是一款用于大规模进行定性访谈的AI工具，同时发布了一个包含1250份专业人士访谈的公开数据集，其中包括125位科学家，访谈内容涉及他们将AI用于研究的情况。本文着重关注科学家子集，我展示了广泛可用的、具备网络搜索和代理能力的LLM可以将24份访谈中的6份与特定的科学著作关联起来，从而恢复了相关的作者，在某些情况下甚至可以唯一地识别出受访者。我的贡献在于表明，现代基于LLM的代理使得这种再识别攻击变得容易且省力：现成的工具只需几个自然语言提示，就可以搜索网络，交叉引用详细信息，并提出可能的匹配项，从而有效地降低了技术门槛。通过将再识别分解为良性任务，可以绕过现有的防护措施。我概要地阐述了这种攻击，讨论了在LLM代理时代发布丰富的定性数据所带来的影响，并提出了缓解建议和开放问题。我已将我的发现告知Anthropic。
tldr: 具备代理能力的LLM可以轻松地对Anthropic Interviewer数据集中的参与者进行再识别，通过将其访谈与科学著作关联起来。
ai_comments: 这篇论文揭示了在强大LLM代理时代一个关键且及时的隐私问题，尤其是在涉及定性数据时。其创新之处在于证明了使用现成工具进行去匿名化的实际简易性，降低了此类攻击的门槛。这些发现对数据共享实践和AI研究中的伦理考量具有重大意义。
motivation: 本文旨在展示现代基于LLM的代理如何使再识别攻击变得容易且省力，尤其是在处理丰富的定性数据时，这源于Anthropic Interviewer数据集的发布。
method: 研究者利用广泛可用的、具备网络搜索和代理能力的LLM。攻击方法包括将再识别分解为良性任务，通过自然语言提示搜索网络，交叉引用细节，并提出可能的匹配项。研究重点是Anthropic Interviewer数据集中科学家子集。
results: 在24份科学家访谈中，有6份可以与特定的科学著作关联起来，从而恢复了相关作者，在某些情况下甚至可以唯一地识别出受访者。
conclusion: 现代基于LLM的代理显著降低了再识别攻击的技术门槛，并能绕过现有防护措施。这对于发布丰富的定性数据具有重要影响，需要制定缓解策略。

title: Can We Predict Before Executing Machine Learning Agents?
authors: Jingsheng Zheng, Jintian Zhang, Yujie Luo, Yuren Mao, Yunjun Gao, Lun Du, Huajun Chen, Ningyu Zhang
abstract: Autonomous machine learning agents have revolutionized scientific discovery, yet they remain constrained by a Generate-Execute-Feedback paradigm. Previous approaches suffer from a severe Execution Bottleneck, as hypothesis evaluation relies strictly on expensive physical execution. To bypass these physical constraints, we internalize execution priors to substitute costly runtime checks with instantaneous predictive reasoning, drawing inspiration from World Models. In this work, we formalize the task of Data-centric Solution Preference and construct a comprehensive corpus of 18,438 pairwise comparisons. We demonstrate that LLMs exhibit significant predictive capabilities when primed with a Verified Data Analysis Report, achieving 61.5% accuracy and robust confidence calibration. Finally, we instantiate this framework in FOREAGENT, an agent that employs a Predict-then-Verify loop, achieving a 6x acceleration in convergence while surpassing execution-based baselines by +6%. Our code and dataset will be publicly available soon at https://github.com/zjunlp/predict-before-execute.
zh_title: 我们能在执行机器学习代理之前预测它们吗？
