motivation: 研究两线中心问题，即找到两条线，使平面上所有点到其最近线的最大距离最小化。目的是改进现有算法的运行时间，特别是寻求更快的 $(1+\varepsilon)$-近似算法。
method: 提出了 $(1+\varepsilon)$-近似算法。具体方法细节（如使用的几何技术或数据结构）摘要中未提及，但通过分析和改进实现了显著优化的时间复杂度。
results: 1. 对于主两线中心问题，给出了运行时间为 $O((n/\varepsilon) \log (1/\varepsilon))$ 的 $(1+\varepsilon)$-近似算法，改进了先前最优的 $O(n\log n + ({n}/{\varepsilon^2}) \log ({1}/{\varepsilon}) + (1/\varepsilon^3)\log ({1}/{\varepsilon}))$ 时间算法。2. 对于三个受限变体问题（一条线方向固定、两条线方向均固定、两条线平行），首次给出了线性时间的 $(1+\varepsilon)$-近似算法。3. 对于其中一条线方向固定的变体，还给出了运行时间为 $O(n \log n)$ 的改进精确算法，并证明了其最优性。
conclusion: 论文成功地为两线中心问题及其受限变体提供了显著改进的、接近线性的 $(1+\varepsilon)$-近似算法，其中一些结果达到了时间最优性。

title: A Vision-Language-Action Model with Visual Prompt for OFF-Road Autonomous Driving
authors: Liangdong Zhang, Yiming Nie, Haoyang Li, Fanjie Kong, Baobao Zhang, Shunxin Huang, Kai Fu, Chen Min, Liang Xiao
abstract: Efficient trajectory planning in off-road terrains presents a formidable challenge for autonomous vehicles, often necessitating complex multi-step pipelines. However, traditional approaches exhibit limited adaptability in dynamic environments. To address these limitations, this paper proposes OFF-EMMA, a novel end-to-end multimodal framework designed to overcome the deficiencies of insufficient spatial perception and unstable reasoning in visual-language-action (VLA) models for off-road autonomous driving scenarios. The framework explicitly annotates input images through the design of a visual prompt block and introduces a chain-of-thought with self-consistency (COT-SC) reasoning strategy to enhance the accuracy and robustness of trajectory planning. The visual prompt block utilizes semantic segmentation masks as visual prompts, enhancing the spatial understanding ability of pre-trained visual-language models for complex terrains. The COT- SC strategy effectively mitigates the error impact of outliers on planning performance through a multi-path reasoning mechanism. Experimental results on the RELLIS-3D off-road dataset demonstrate that OFF-EMMA significantly outperforms existing methods, reducing the average L2 error of the Qwen backbone model by 13.3% and decreasing the failure rate from 16.52% to 6.56%.
zh_title: 带有视觉提示的越野自动驾驶视觉-语言-动作模型
translation: 越野地形中的高效轨迹规划对自动驾驶车辆提出了严峻的挑战，通常需要复杂的、多步骤的流程。然而，传统方法在动态环境中的适应性有限。为了解决这些局限性，本文提出了 OFF-EMMA，这是一种新颖的端到端多模态框架，旨在克服越野自动驾驶场景中视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型空间感知不足和推理不稳定的缺陷。该框架通过设计视觉提示块来显式标注输入图像，并引入带有自洽性（COT-SC）的思维链推理策略，以提高轨迹规划的准确性和鲁棒性。视觉提示块利用语义分割掩码作为视觉提示，增强了预训练视觉-语言模型对复杂地形的空间理解能力。COT-SC 策略通过多路径推理机制，有效地减轻了异常值对规划性能的错误影响。在 RELLIS-3D 越野数据集上的实验结果表明，OFF-EMMA 显著优于现有方法，将 Qwen 主干模型的平均 L2 误差降低了 13.3%，并将故障率从 16.52% 降低到了 6.56%。
tldr: 针对越野自动驾驶中 VLA 模型空间感知不足和推理不稳定的问题，本文提出了端到端多模态框架 OFF-EMMA。它通过设计视觉提示块（使用语义分割掩码）和引入带有自洽性（COT-SC）的思维链推理策略，显著提高了轨迹规划的精度和鲁棒性，在 RELLIS-3D 数据集上将故障率从 16.52% 降至 6.56%。
ai_comments: OFF-EMMA 的创新点在于将两种强大的机制——视觉提示（利用明确的语义信息）和带有自洽性的思维链（用于稳定推理）——结合到一个端到端的 VLA 框架中，专门解决越野这一高难度场景。这种方法有效地将高级感知信息（语义分割）直接注入到 VLA 模型中，弥补了其在空间理解上的不足，并通过多路径推理机制提高了决策的可靠性。其在 L2 误差和故障率上的显著改善，证明了该框架在实际应用中的潜力和重要性。
motivation: 越野地形的高效轨迹规划对自动驾驶车辆构成严峻挑战，传统方法通常复杂且在动态环境中适应性有限。现有的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在越野自动驾驶场景中存在空间感知不足和推理不稳定的缺陷。
method:
本文提出了 OFF-EMMA 框架，这是一个端到端的多模态框架，旨在增强轨迹规划的准确性和鲁棒性。该方法包含两个关键策略：
1. **视觉提示块（Visual Prompt Block）**：通过设计该模块来显式标注输入图像，利用语义分割掩码作为视觉提示，增强预训练视觉-语言模型对复杂地形的空间理解能力。
2. **带有自洽性（COT-SC）的思维链推理策略**：通过多路径推理机制，有效减轻异常值对规划性能的错误影响。
results: 在 RELLIS-3D 越野数据集上的实验结果表明，OFF-EMMA 显著优于现有方法。它将基于 Qwen 主干模型的平均 L2 误差降低了 13.3%，并将故障率从 16.52% 降低到了 6.56%。

title: Semantic Belief-State World Model for 3D Human Motion Prediction
authors: Sarim Chaudhry
abstract: Human motion prediction has traditionally been framed as a sequence regression problem where models extrapolate future joint coordinates from observed pose histories. While effective over short horizons this approach does not separate observation reconstruction with dynamics modeling and offers no explicit representation of the latent causes governing motion. As a result, existing methods exhibit compounding drift, mean-pose collapse, and poorly calibrated uncertainty when rolled forward beyond the training regime. Here we propose a Semantic Belief-State World Model (SBWM) that reframes human motion prediction as latent dynamical simulation on the human body manifold. Rather than predicting poses directly, SBWM maintains a recurrent probabilistic belief state whose evolution is learned independently of pose reconstruction and explicitly aligned with the SMPL-X anatomical parameterization. This alignment imposes a structural information bottleneck that prevents the latent state from encoding static geometry or sensor noise, forcing it to capture motion dynamics, intent, and control-relevant structure. Inspired by belief-state world models developed for model-based reinforcement learning, SBWM adapts stochastic latent transitions and rollout-centric training to the domain of human motion. In contrast to RSSM-based, transformer, and diffusion approaches optimized for reconstruction fidelity, SBWM prioritizes stable forward simulation. We demonstrate coherent long-horizon rollouts, and competitive accuracy at substantially lower computational cost. These results suggest that treating the human body as part of the world models state space rather than its output fundamentally changes how motion is simulated, and predicted.
zh_title: 3D人体运动预测的语义信念状态世界模型
translation: 人体运动预测传统上被框架为一个序列回归问题，模型从观察到的姿势历史中外推未来的关节坐标。尽管在短期内有效，但这种方法没有将观测重建与动力学建模分离，也没有提供控制运动的潜在原因的明确表示。结果，现有方法在超出训练范围进行前向滚动时，表现出累积漂移、平均姿势崩溃和校准不良的不确定性。在这里，我们提出了一个语义信念状态世界模型（SBWM），它将人体运动预测重新定义为人体流形上的潜在动力学模拟。SBWM不是直接预测姿势，而是维护一个循环概率信念状态，其演化独立于姿势重建学习，并明确与SMPL-X解剖参数化对齐。这种对齐施加了一个结构性信息瓶颈，阻止潜在状态编码静态几何或传感器噪声，迫使其捕获运动动力学、意图和控制相关结构。受为基于模型的强化学习开发的信念状态世界模型的启发，SBWM将随机潜在转换和以展开为中心的训练应用于人体运动领域。与优化重建保真度的基于RSSM、Transformer和扩散方法相反，SBWM优先考虑稳定的前向模拟。我们展示了连贯的长期展开模拟，以及在显著较低计算成本下的竞争力精度。这些结果表明，将人体视为世界模型状态空间的一部分而不是其输出，从根本上改变了运动的模拟和预测方式。
keywords: 语义信念状态世界模型
tldr: 针对传统人体运动预测长期不稳定的问题，本文提出语义信念状态世界模型（SBWM）。它将运动建模为与SMPL-X结构对齐的潜在动力学，分离了动态建模与姿势重建，实现了稳定、长期的运动模拟，且计算成本较低。
ai_comments: 本文的创新在于将强化学习中的世界模型（特别是信念状态模型）引入人体运动预测领域。关键的创新点是通过将潜在状态与SMPL-X解剖参数明确对齐，施加了一个结构性信息瓶颈。这迫使模型捕获纯粹的运动动力学和意图，从而实现了对运动的稳定、长期模拟，克服了传统上以重建为中心的模型容易出现的漂移和崩溃问题。同时，该方法在保持竞争性精度的前提下显著降低了计算成本，具有重要的实际意义。
motivation: 传统的运动预测方法将问题框架为序列回归，该方法未能将观测重建与动力学建模分离，缺乏对运动潜在原因的明确表示，导致在长期预测中出现累积漂移、平均姿势崩溃和校准不良的不确定性。
method: 提出语义信念状态世界模型（SBWM）。该模型将人体运动预测重新定义为在人体流形上的潜在动力学模拟。SBWM维护一个循环概率信念状态，其演化独立于姿势重建学习，并明确与SMPL-X解剖参数化对齐。它借鉴了基于模型的强化学习中的信念状态世界模型，采用随机潜在转换和以展开为中心的训练，优先考虑稳定的前向模拟。
results: 实现了连贯的长期展开模拟，与基于RSSM、Transformer和扩散的方法相比，在显著较低的计算成本下获得了具有竞争力的精度。
conclusion: 将人体视为世界模型状态空间的一部分而不是其输出，从根本上改变了运动的模拟和预测方式。

title: A Tool for Estimating Success Rates of Raycasting-Based Object Selection in Virtual Reality
authors: Tatsuya Okuno, Haruto Shimizu, Nobuhito Kasahara, Taiyu Honma, Shota Yamanaka, Homei Miyashita
abstract: As XR devices become widespread, 3D interaction has become commonplace, and UI developers are increasingly required to consider usability to deliver better user experiences. The HCI community has long studied target-pointing performance, and research on 3D environments has progressed substantially. However, for practitioners to directly leverage research findings in UI improvements, practical tools are needed. To bridge this gap between research and development in VR systems, we propose a system that estimates object selection success rates within a development tool (Unity). In this paper, we validate the underlying theory, describe the tool's functions, and report feedback from VR developers who tried the tool to assess its usefulness.
zh_title: 一种用于估计虚拟现实中基于光线投射的对象选择成功率的工具
translation: 随着XR设备变得普及，3D交互已司空见惯，UI开发者被要求越来越关注可用性以提供更好的用户体验。HCI社区长期以来一直在研究目标指向性能，并且在3D环境中的研究已取得实质性进展。然而，对于从业者而言，若要直接利用研究结果来改进UI，则需要实用的工具。为了弥合VR系统研究与开发之间的差距，我们提出了一个在开发工具（Unity）中估计对象选择成功率的系统。在本文中，我们验证了基础理论，描述了该工具的功能，并报告了尝试使用该工具的VR开发者的反馈，以评估其实用性。
tldr: 提出了一种在Unity中估计基于光线投射的VR对象选择成功率的工具，旨在帮助开发者利用HCI研究成果改善用户体验。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将长期的HCI研究成果转化为面向实际开发者的实用工具，特别是在VR中关键的基于光线投射的对象选择任务上。通过将可用性估计功能直接集成到主流开发环境（Unity）中，它提供了一个即时、可操作的反馈机制，有助于开发者在设计阶段就优化用户体验。
motivation: 随着XR设备的普及，3D交互变得常见，UI开发者需要提高可用性。尽管人机交互（HCI）社区在3D环境下的目标指向性能研究取得了进展，但从业者缺乏实用的工具来直接将这些研究成果应用于UI改进中，因此需要弥合研究与开发之间的差距。
method: 提出了一个系统/工具，用于在主流开发工具（Unity）中估计对象选择的成功率。该方法包括验证基础理论、描述工具功能，并通过收集VR开发者的反馈来评估其实用性。
results: 报告了VR开发者试用该工具后的反馈，以评估其有用性。（具体的量化结果摘要中未提及。）

title: A Reinforcement Learning-Based Model for Mapping and Goal-Directed Navigation Using Multiscale Place Fields
authors: Bekarys Dukenbaev, Andrew Gerstenslager, Alexander Johnson, Ali A. Minai
abstract: Autonomous navigation in complex and partially observable environments remains a central challenge in robotics. Several bio-inspired models of mapping and navigation based on place cells in the mammalian hippocampus have been proposed. This paper introduces a new robust model that employs parallel layers of place fields at multiple spatial scales, a replay-based reward mechanism, and dynamic scale fusion. Simulations show that the model improves path efficiency and accelerates learning compared to single-scale baselines, highlighting the value of multiscale spatial representations for adaptive robot navigation.
comment: 11 pages, 8 figures. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Cognitive and Developmental Systems
zh_title: 基于多尺度位置场的强化学习模型，用于建图和目标导向导航。
translation: 在复杂且部分可观察的环境中实现自主导航仍然是机器人技术的核心挑战。目前已提出了几种基于哺乳动物海马体中位置细胞的生物启发式建图和导航模型。本文介绍了一种新的鲁棒模型，该模型采用了多空间尺度的并行位置场层、基于重放的奖励机制和动态尺度融合。仿真结果表明，与单尺度基线模型相比，该模型提高了路径效率并加速了学习，突显了多尺度空间表征对于自适应机器人导航的价值。
tldr: 提出了一种新的基于强化学习的导航模型，该模型使用多尺度位置场、重放奖励机制和动态尺度融合，在复杂环境中提高了路径效率并加速了学习。
ai_comments:
**创新性：** 该模型将生物学启发的多尺度位置场概念与现代强化学习（RL）技术相结合，特别是引入了“基于重放的奖励机制”和“动态尺度融合”，这在解决复杂环境下的导航问题上是重要的结合点。这种多尺度表示解决了单尺度模型在复杂和部分可观察环境中的局限性。
**重要性：** 解决了自主导航中的核心挑战，通过提高路径效率和学习速度，为更高效、更具适应性的机器人导航系统提供了理论基础和实用模型。
**局限性 (基于摘要的推测)：** 摘要中仅提及“仿真”（Simulations），未提及在真实机器人硬件上的测试或部署，这可能是该研究在实际应用中的下一步挑战。
motivation: 在复杂且部分可观察的环境中实现自主导航仍然是机器人技术的核心挑战。已有的基于哺乳动物海马体位置细胞的生物启发式模型需要改进。
method: 该模型是一种新的基于强化学习的鲁棒模型，它采用了以下机制：1. 多空间尺度的并行位置场层。2. 基于重放的奖励机制。3. 动态尺度融合。
results: 模拟结果显示，与单尺度基线模型相比，该模型提高了路径效率并加速了学习。
conclusion: 多尺度空间表征对于自适应机器人导航具有重要价值。

title: Variance Computation for Weighted Model Counting with Knowledge Compilation Approach
authors: Kengo Nakamura, Masaaki Nishino, Norihito Yasuda
abstract: One of the most important queries in knowledge compilation is weighted model counting (WMC), which has been applied to probabilistic inference on various models, such as Bayesian networks. In practical situations on inference tasks, the model's parameters have uncertainty because they are often learned from data, and thus we want to compute the degree of uncertainty in the inference outcome. One possible approach is to regard the inference outcome as a random variable by introducing distributions for the parameters and evaluate the variance of the outcome. Unfortunately, the tractability of computing such a variance is hardly known. Motivated by this, we consider the problem of computing the variance of WMC and investigate this problem's tractability. First, we derive a polynomial time algorithm to evaluate the WMC variance when the input is given as a structured d-DNNF. Second, we prove the hardness of this problem for structured DNNFs, d-DNNFs, and FBDDs, which is intriguing because the latter two allow polynomial time WMC algorithms. Finally, we show an application that measures the uncertainty in the inference of Bayesian networks. We empirically show that our algorithm can evaluate the variance of the marginal probability on real-world Bayesian networks and analyze the impact of the variances of parameters on the variance of the marginal.
comment: 25 pages; accepted for AAAI 2026 main track
zh_title: 知识编译方法下的加权模型计数方差计算
translation: 加权模型计数（WMC）是知识编译中最重要的一项查询，已应用于贝叶斯网络等各种模型的概率推断。在实际推断任务中，由于模型参数通常是从数据中学习得到的，它们具有不确定性，因此我们希望计算推断结果中的不确定性程度。一种可能的方法是为参数引入分布，将推断结果视为一个随机变量，并评估该结果的方差。不幸的是，计算这种方差的可处理性鲜为人知。受此启发，我们考虑计算WMC方差的问题，并研究其可处理性。首先，我们推导出一个多项式时间算法来评估输入为结构化d-DNNF时的WMC方差。其次，我们证明了对于结构化DNNF、d-DNNF和FBDD，该问题是难解的，这一点很有趣，因为后两者允许多项式时间WMC算法。最后，我们展示了一个应用，用于测量贝叶斯网络推断中的不确定性。我们通过实验证明，我们的算法可以评估真实世界贝叶斯网络上边际概率的方差，并分析参数方差对边际方差的影响。
tldr: 本文研究了加权模型计数（WMC）方差的计算及其可处理性，以量化推断不确定性。我们提出了一个针对结构化d-DNNF的多项式时间算法，但证明了该问题对于更一般的知识编译形式（如d-DNNF和FBDD）是难解的。该方法被应用于贝叶斯网络以测量推断不确定性。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将计算WMC方差这一重要但可处理性未知的问题引入知识编译领域。其重要性在于，它为量化基于WMC的概率推断（如贝叶斯网络）中的不确定性提供了一个严格的理论框架和实用的算法。研究结果揭示了计算方差与计算WMC本身在复杂性上的显著差异：尽管某些知识编译形式（如d-DNNF）允许高效的WMC计算，但计算其方差却被证明是难解的，这对于依赖这些编译形式的实际应用具有重要的理论指导意义。
motivation: 在实际推断任务中，模型参数通常是从数据中学习得到的，存在不确定性，因此需要计算推断结果的不确定性程度。由于计算加权模型计数（WMC）方差的可处理性尚不清楚，本文旨在研究这一问题。
method: 1. 将推断结果视为随机变量，通过为参数引入分布来评估其方差。2. 针对输入为结构化d-DNNF的情况，推导出一个多项式时间算法来评估WMC方差。3. 将该方法应用于衡量贝叶斯网络推断中的不确定性。
results: 1. 提出了一个多项式时间算法来计算结构化d-DNNF的WMC方差。2. 证明了对于结构化DNNF、d-DNNF和FBDD，该方差计算问题是难解的（即使后两者允许多项式时间WMC）。3. 经验性地证明了该算法可以评估真实世界贝叶斯网络上边际概率的方差，并分析了参数方差对边际方差的影响。

title: VeRPO: Verifiable Dense Reward Policy Optimization for Code Generation
authors: Longwen Wang, Xuan'er Wu, Xiaohui Hu, Yirui Liu, Yuankai Fan, Kaidong Yu, Qizhen Weng, Wei Xi, Xuelong Li
abstract: Effective reward design is a central challenge in Reinforcement Learning (RL) for code generation. Mainstream pass/fail outcome rewards enforce functional correctness via executing unit tests, but the resulting sparsity limits potential performance gains. While recent work has explored external Reward Models (RM) to generate richer, continuous rewards, the learned RMs suffer from reward misalignment and prohibitive computational cost. In this paper, we introduce \textbf{VeRPO} (\textbf{V}erifiable D\textbf{e}nse \textbf{R}eward \textbf{P}olicy \textbf{O}ptimization), a novel RL framework for code generation that synthesizes \textit{robust and dense rewards fully grounded in verifiable execution feedback}. The core idea of VeRPO is constructing dense rewards from weighted partial success: by dynamically estimating the difficulty weight of each unit test based on the execution statistics during training, a dense reward is derived from the sum of weights of the passed unit tests. To solidify the consistency between partial success and end-to-end functional correctness, VeRPO further integrates the dense signal with global execution outcomes, establishing a robust and dense reward paradigm relying solely on verifiable execution feedback. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks and settings demonstrate that VeRPO consistently outperforms outcome-driven and RM-based baselines, achieving up to +8.83\% gain in pass@1 with negligible time cost (< 0.02\%) and zero GPU memory overhead.
zh_title: VeRPO：用于代码生成的**可验证**密集奖励策略优化
translation: 在代码生成的强化学习（RL）中，有效的奖励设计是核心挑战。主流的通过/失败结果奖励通过执行单元测试来确保功能正确性，但由此产生的稀疏性限制了潜在的性能提升。虽然最近的工作探索了外部奖励模型（RM）来生成更丰富、连续的奖励，但学习到的RM存在奖励错位和计算成本过高的问题。在本文中，我们介绍了VeRPO（可验证密集奖励策略优化），这是一种新颖的用于代码生成的RL框架，它合成了完全基于可验证执行反馈的鲁棒且密集的奖励。VeRPO的核心思想是从加权的部分成功中构建密集奖励：通过根据训练期间的执行统计数据动态估计每个单元测试的难度权重，将通过的单元测试的权重总和作为密集奖励。为了巩固部分成功与端到端功能正确性之间的一致性，VeRPO进一步将密集信号与全局执行结果相结合，建立了一个仅依赖可验证执行反馈的鲁棒且密集的奖励范式。跨越不同基准和设置的广泛实验表明，VeRPO始终优于结果驱动型和基于RM的基线，在pass@1上实现了高达+8.83%的增益，同时时间成本可忽略不计（< 0.02%），且零GPU内存开销。
tldr: VeRPO是一种新的代码生成强化学习框架，它通过动态加权部分通过的单元测试来构建密集且可验证的奖励，解决了传统稀疏奖励和奖励模型（RM）的缺点。它在性能上优于现有基线，且计算成本极低。
ai_comments: VeRPO的创新点在于它巧妙地利用了单元测试的粒度信息来克服奖励稀疏性问题，而无需依赖外部、难以训练和对齐的奖励模型。通过动态加权单元测试难度，该方法能够有效地引导策略学习，使其专注于更具挑战性的部分。更重要的是，它在实现显著性能提升的同时，保持了极低的计算开销（< 0.02%时间成本和零内存开销），这对于实际应用和大规模训练至关重要，解决了现有密集奖励方法的主要限制。
motivation: 传统的代码生成强化学习（RL）依赖于通过单元测试的稀疏的“通过/失败”结果奖励，这限制了性能提升。同时，现有的外部奖励模型（RM）虽然提供了更丰富的奖励，但存在奖励错位和计算成本过高的问题。
method: 提出VeRPO框架，该框架仅依赖可验证的执行反馈来合成鲁棒且密集的奖励。核心方法是通过加权部分成功构建密集奖励：根据训练期间的执行统计数据动态估计每个单元测试的难度权重，然后将通过的单元测试的权重总和作为密集奖励。此外，VeRPO将该密集信号与全局执行结果相结合，以确保部分成功与端到端功能正确性的一致性。
results: 在各种基准和设置上的实验表明，VeRPO始终优于结果驱动型和基于奖励模型（RM）的基线，在pass@1指标上实现了高达+8.83%的提升，同时时间成本可忽略不计（< 0.02%），且零GPU内存开销。
conclusion: VeRPO通过仅依赖可验证的执行反馈，成功构建了一种鲁棒且密集的奖励范式，有效解决了代码生成RL中的奖励稀疏性问题，并在性能和效率上表现出色。

title: CloudMatch: Weak-to-Strong Consistency Learning for Semi-Supervised Cloud Detection
authors: Jiayi Zhao, Changlu Chen, Jingsheng Li, Tianxiang Xue, Kun Zhan
abstract: Due to the high cost of annotating accurate pixel-level labels, semi-supervised learning has emerged as a promising approach for cloud detection. In this paper, we propose CloudMatch, a semi-supervised framework that effectively leverages unlabeled remote sensing imagery through view-consistency learning combined with scene-mixing augmentations. An observation behind CloudMatch is that cloud patterns exhibit structural diversity and contextual variability across different scenes and within the same scene category. Our key insight is that enforcing prediction consistency across diversely augmented views, incorporating both inter-scene and intra-scene mixing, enables the model to capture the structural diversity and contextual richness of cloud patterns. Specifically, CloudMatch generates one weakly augmented view along with two complementary strongly augmented views for each unlabeled image: one integrates inter-scene patches to simulate contextual variety, while the other employs intra-scene mixing to preserve semantic coherence. This approach guides pseudolabel generation and enhances generalization. Extensive experiments show that CloudMatch achieves good performance, demonstrating its capability to utilize unlabeled data efficiently and advance semi-supervised cloud detection.
zh_title: CloudMatch：用于半监督云检测的弱到强一致性学习
translation: 由于标注精确像素级标签的成本高昂，半监督学习已成为云检测的一种有前景的方法。在本文中，我们提出了CloudMatch，一个半监督框架，它通过结合场景混合增强的视图一致性学习，有效利用未标记的遥感图像。CloudMatch背后的一个观察是，云模式在不同场景和同一场景类别中表现出结构多样性和上下文变异性。我们的关键见解是，在纳入场景间和场景内混合的多种增强视图之间强制执行预测一致性，使模型能够捕获云模式的结构多样性和上下文丰富性。具体而言，CloudMatch为每张未标记图像生成一个弱增强视图以及两个互补的强增强视图：一个整合了场景间补丁以模拟上下文变化，另一个采用场景内混合以保留语义连贯性。这种方法指导了伪标签的生成并增强了泛化能力。广泛的实验表明，CloudMatch取得了良好的性能，证明了其有效利用未标记数据和推进半监督云检测的能力。
tldr: CloudMatch是一种半监督云检测框架，它通过结合场景混合增强（跨场景和场景内）的视图一致性学习，高效利用未标记遥感数据。
ai_comments: 创新点在于为云检测量身定制的视图一致性学习。它通过结合场景间和场景内混合增强，明确解决了云模式的结构多样性和上下文变异性问题。这种方法有效地将半监督学习范式应用于遥感图像分割任务，提高了模型利用未标记数据的效率和泛化能力。
motivation: 由于精确的像素级标签标注成本高昂，因此半监督学习成为云检测的有前景方法。该研究的观察是云模式在不同场景和同一场景类别中表现出结构多样性和上下文变异性。
method: 提出CloudMatch框架，采用视图一致性学习结合场景混合增强。具体而言，为每张未标记图像生成一个弱增强视图和两个互补的强增强视图：一个强视图整合跨场景补丁（模拟上下文变化），另一个强视图采用场景内混合（保留语义连贯性）。通过强制预测一致性来指导伪标签生成和增强泛化能力。
results: 广泛的实验表明，CloudMatch取得了良好的性能，证明了其有效利用未标记数据和推进半监督云检测的能力。
conclusion: CloudMatch是一个有效的半监督框架，能够高效利用未标记遥感图像，并推进了半监督云检测领域的发展。

title: PALM-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Personalized Audio-Language Models
authors: Yuwen Wang, Xinyuan Qian, Tian-Hao Zhang, Jiaran Gao, Yuchen Pan, Xin Wang, Zhou Pan, Chen Wei, Yiming Wang
abstract: Large Audio-Language Models (LALMs) have demonstrated strong performance in audio understanding and generation. Yet, our extensive benchmarking reveals that their behavior is largely generic (e.g., summarizing spoken content) and fails to adequately support personalized question answering (e.g., summarizing what my best friend says). In contrast, human conditions their interpretation and decision-making on each individual's personal context. To bridge this gap, we formalize the task of Personalized LALMs (PALM) for recognizing personal concepts and reasoning within personal context. Moreover, we create the first benchmark (PALM-Bench) to foster the methodological advances in PALM and enable structured evaluation on several tasks across multi-speaker scenarios. Our extensive experiments on representative open-source LALMs, show that existing training-free prompting and supervised fine-tuning strategies, while yield improvements, remains limited in modeling personalized knowledge and transferring them across tasks robustly. Data and code will be released.
zh_title: PALM-Bench：一个用于个性化音频-语言模型的综合基准测试
translation: 大型音频-语言模型（LALMs）在音频理解和生成方面表现出强大的性能。然而，我们广泛的基准测试揭示了它们的行为大多是通用的（例如，总结口语内容），并且未能充分支持个性化问答（例如，总结我最好的朋友说了什么）。相比之下，人类的解释和决策是基于每个个体的个人上下文的。为了弥合这一差距，我们正式定义了个性化LALMs（PALM）的任务，用于识别个人概念并在个人上下文中进行推理。此外，我们创建了第一个基准测试（PALM-Bench），以促进PALM的方法学进步，并能够在多说话人场景下的多项任务上进行结构化评估。我们对具有代表性的开源LALMs进行的广泛实验表明，现有的免训练提示和监督微调策略虽然能带来改进，但在建模个性化知识和稳健地跨任务迁移这些知识方面仍然存在局限性。数据和代码将发布。
tldr: 现有的大型音频-语言模型（LALMs）缺乏个性化能力。本文提出了个性化LALMs（PALM）任务，并创建了首个基准测试PALM-Bench，用于评估模型在多说话人场景下识别和推理个人概念的能力。实验显示现有方法在处理个性化知识方面表现有限。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于正式定义并提出了“个性化音频-语言模型”（PALM）这一重要的新研究方向，直接针对现有LALMs在多说话人/多用户场景中缺乏个体识别和上下文推理能力的局限性。PALM-Bench的创建为该领域提供了一个急需的、结构化的评估工具，对于推动模型从通用理解迈向个性化智能具有重要意义。局限性在于抽象并未详细说明PALM-Bench的具体数据构成或任务类型，但其明确指出现有SOTA方法表现不佳，为后续研究设定了清晰的挑战目标。
motivation: 现有的大型音频-语言模型（LALMs）虽然性能强大，但行为过于通用，无法支持个性化问答（例如，总结特定人物的发言）。为了弥合LALMs与人类在利用个人上下文进行解释和决策方面的差距，作者提出了个性化LALMs（PALM）的任务。
method: 1. 正式定义了个性化LALMs (PALM) 任务，旨在识别个人概念并在个人上下文中进行推理。2. 创建了首个基准测试PALM-Bench，用于在多说话人场景下的多项任务上进行结构化评估。3. 对代表性的开源LALMs使用了免训练提示和监督微调策略进行评估。
results: 广泛实验表明，现有的免训练提示和监督微调策略虽然能带来改进，但在建模个性化知识和稳健地跨任务迁移这些知识方面仍然存在局限性。
conclusion: 现有的大型音频-语言模型（LALMs）在建模和跨任务迁移个性化知识方面存在显著局限性，凸显了PALM-Bench在推动未来个性化音频-语言模型研究中的重要性。

title: Physics-Constrained Cross-Resolution Enhancement Network for Optics-Guided Thermal UAV Image Super-Resolution
authors: Zhicheng Zhao, Fengjiao Peng, Jinquan Yan, Wei Lu, Chenglong Li, Jin Tang
abstract: Optics-guided thermal UAV image super-resolution has attracted significant research interest due to its potential in all-weather monitoring applications. However, existing methods typically compress optical features to match thermal feature dimensions for cross-modal alignment and fusion, which not only causes the loss of high-frequency information that is beneficial for thermal super-resolution, but also introduces physically inconsistent artifacts such as texture distortions and edge blurring by overlooking differences in the imaging physics between modalities. To address these challenges, we propose PCNet to achieve cross-resolution mutual enhancement between optical and thermal modalities, while physically constraining the optical guidance process via thermal conduction to enable robust thermal UAV image super-resolution. In particular, we design a Cross-Resolution Mutual Enhancement Module (CRME) to jointly optimize thermal image super-resolution and optical-to-thermal modality conversion, facilitating effective bidirectional feature interaction across resolutions while preserving high-frequency optical priors. Moreover, we propose a Physics-Driven Thermal Conduction Module (PDTM) that incorporates two-dimensional heat conduction into optical guidance, modeling spatially-varying heat conduction properties to prevent inconsistent artifacts. In addition, we introduce a temperature consistency loss that enforces regional distribution consistency and boundary gradient smoothness to ensure generated thermal images align with real-world thermal radiation principles. Extensive experiments on VGTSR2.0 and DroneVehicle datasets demonstrate that PCNet significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods on both reconstruction quality and downstream tasks including semantic segmentation and object detection.
zh_title: 物理约束跨分辨率增强网络用于光学引导热红外无人机图像超分辨率
translation: 光学引导的热红外无人机图像超分辨率因其在全天候监测应用中的潜力而引起了重要的研究兴趣。然而，现有方法通常压缩光学特征以匹配热红外特征维度进行跨模态对齐和融合，这不仅会导致有利于热红外超分辨率的高频信息丢失，还会因忽略模态间成像物理学的差异而引入纹理失真和边缘模糊等物理不一致的伪影。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了PCNet，以实现光学和热红外模态之间的跨分辨率相互增强，同时通过热传导物理约束光学引导过程，从而实现鲁棒的热红外无人机图像超分辨率。具体而言，我们设计了一个跨分辨率互增强模块（CRME）来联合优化热红外图像超分辨率和光到热模态转换，促进跨分辨率的有效双向特征交互，同时保留高频光学先验。此外，我们提出了一个物理驱动热传导模块（PDTM），将二维热传导纳入光学引导中，建模空间变化的热传导特性以防止不一致的伪影。此外，我们引入了温度一致性损失，强制执行区域分布一致性和边界梯度平滑性，以确保生成的超分辨率热红外图像与真实世界的热辐射原理保持一致。在VGTSR2.0和DroneVehicle数据集上进行的大量实验表明，PCNet在重建质量以及包括语义分割和目标检测在内的下游任务上均显著优于现有最先进的方法。
tldr: 针对现有光学引导热红外超分方法存在的特征压缩导致信息丢失和物理不一致伪影问题，本文提出PCNet。PCNet利用跨分辨率互增强模块（CRME）进行双向特征交互，并引入物理驱动热传导模块（PDTM）和温度一致性损失，通过模拟热传导过程来物理约束光学引导，显著提升了热红外无人机图像的超分质量和下游任务性能。
ai_comments: 本文的核心创新在于将物理学原理（热传导）明确地整合到跨模态超分辨率任务中，以解决现有方法中常见的物理不一致性伪影问题。这种“物理约束”的方法论对于提升多模态融合任务的鲁棒性和可解释性具有重要意义。通过同时优化跨分辨率特征交互和物理建模，PCNet有效地平衡了信息增强和物理真实性，尤其适用于对精度要求高的全天候无人机监测应用。
motivation: 现有的光学引导热红外无人机图像超分辨率方法通常压缩光学特征以匹配热红外特征维度，导致高频信息丢失。此外，它们忽略了模态间成像物理学的差异，引入了纹理失真和边缘模糊等物理不一致的伪影。
method: 提出PCNet网络。核心组件包括：1. **跨分辨率互增强模块 (CRME)**：联合优化热红外超分和光-热模态转换，实现跨分辨率双向特征交互，并保留高频光学先验。2. **物理驱动热传导模块 (PDTM)**：将二维热传导引入光学引导过程，建模空间变化的热传导特性，以防止不一致的伪影。3. **温度一致性损失**：强制执行区域分布一致性和边界梯度平滑性，以确保生成的图像符合真实世界的热辐射原理。
results: 在VGTSR2.0和DroneVehicle数据集上的大量实验表明，PCNet在重建质量和下游任务（包括语义分割和目标检测）方面均显著优于现有最先进的方法。

title: Persona-aware and Explainable Bikeability Assessment: A Vision-Language Model Approach
authors: Yilong Dai, Ziyi Wang, Chenguang Wang, Kexin Zhou, Yiheng Qian, Susu Xu, Xiang Yan
abstract: Bikeability assessment is essential for advancing sustainable urban transportation and creating cyclist-friendly cities, and it requires incorporating users' perceptions of safety and comfort. Yet existing perception-based bikeability assessment approaches face key limitations in capturing the complexity of road environments and adequately accounting for heterogeneity in subjective user perceptions. This paper proposes a persona-aware Vision-Language Model framework for bikeability assessment with three novel contributions: (i) theory-grounded persona conditioning based on established cyclist typology that generates persona-specific explanations via chain-of-thought reasoning; (ii) multi-granularity supervised fine-tuning that combines scarce expert-annotated reasoning with abundant user ratings for joint prediction and explainable assessment; and (iii) AI-enabled data augmentation that creates controlled paired data to isolate infrastructure variable impacts. To test and validate this framework, we developed a panoramic image-based crowdsourcing system and collected 12,400 persona-conditioned assessments from 427 cyclists. Experiment results show that the proposed framework offers competitive bikeability rating prediction while uniquely enabling explainable factor attribution.
zh_title: 基于个性化感知和可解释性的骑行适宜性评估：一种视觉-语言模型方法
translation: 骑行适宜性评估对于推动可持续城市交通和创建骑行友好型城市至关重要，它需要纳入用户对安全性和舒适性的感知。然而，现有的基于感知的骑行适宜性评估方法在捕捉道路环境的复杂性和充分考虑用户主观感知异质性方面面临着关键局限。本文提出了一种基于个性化感知的视觉-语言模型框架，用于骑行适宜性评估，并做出了三项新颖贡献：(i) 基于既定骑行者类型学的理论基础个性化条件设置，通过思维链推理生成针对特定个体的解释；(ii) 结合稀缺专家标注推理和丰富用户评分的多粒度监督微调，用于联合预测和可解释性评估；(iii) AI驱动的数据增强，创建受控配对数据以隔离基础设施变量的影响。为了测试和验证该框架，我们开发了一个基于全景图像的众包系统，并从427名骑行者那里收集了12,400份基于个性化感知的评估。实验结果表明，所提出的框架提供了具有竞争力的骑行适宜性评分预测，同时独特地实现了可解释的因素归因。
tldr: 本文提出一个基于视觉-语言模型（VLM）的框架，用于评估城市骑行适宜性。该模型考虑不同骑行者类型（个性化感知），并结合专家知识和用户评分，提供可解释的评分预测和因素归因，性能具有竞争力。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于将“个性化感知”（基于骑行者类型学）和“可解释性”（通过思维链推理实现）明确地整合到骑行适宜性评估中，解决了现有感知评估模型在处理用户主观异质性方面的核心问题。采用视觉-语言模型（VLM）来融合道路图像信息和主观感知，为城市规划提供了基于用户视角的、可操作的洞察。此外，结合专家标注和大众评分的多粒度微调方法，有效利用了不同质量的数据资源。这对推动更精细化和以人为本的城市交通规划具有重要意义。
motivation: 骑行适宜性评估对于推动可持续城市交通和创建骑行友好型城市至关重要。然而，现有的基于感知的评估方法在捕捉道路环境复杂性和充分考虑用户主观感知异质性方面存在关键局限性。
method: 提出了一种基于个性化感知的视觉-语言模型（VLM）框架，包含三个创新点：(i) 基于既定骑行者类型学的理论基础个性化条件设置，通过思维链推理生成个性化解释；(ii) 结合稀缺专家标注推理和丰富用户评分的多粒度监督微调，用于联合预测和可解释性评估；(iii) AI驱动的数据增强，创建受控配对数据以隔离基础设施变量影响。通过一个基于全景图像的众包系统收集了12,400份评估数据进行验证。
results: 实验结果表明，所提出的框架提供了具有竞争力的骑行适宜性评分预测，同时独特地实现了可解释的因素归因。
conclusion: 所提出的基于视觉-语言模型的框架成功地实现了具有竞争力的骑行适宜性预测，并提供了独特的、个性化感知的可解释性因素归因，克服了现有方法的局限性。

title: Spider web-inspired sensing and computation with fiber network physical reservoirs
authors: Apoorva Khairnar, Yogesh Phalak, Jun Wang, Ziyang Zhou, Benjamin Jantzen, Suyi Li, Noel Naughton
abstract: Physical reservoir computing leverages the intrinsic dynamics of mechanical systems to perform computation through their natural responses to input signals. Here, we study a compliant fiber network inspired by orb-weaving spider webs and investigate how its mechanical design and operating conditions shape its computational capability. Using Cosserat rod-based simulations, we identify how network topology, geometry, actuation, and axial tension impact the nonlinear computation and memory capacity of the network. We further evaluate several readout reduction strategies to assess how computational performance varies with the number and placement of measured outputs. We then experimentally validate these results using a physical fiber-network prototype. Overall, results provide insights and guidance on design, actuation, and sensing choices to enable fiber networks for mechano-intelligent computation. They demonstrate the ability of structured compliant fibers networks to serve as physical reservoirs capable of nonlinear transformation and input-history retention.
zh_title: 蜘蛛网启发的纤维网络物理储层的传感与计算
translation: 物理储层计算利用机械系统的内在动力学，通过其对输入信号的自然响应来进行计算。本文研究了一种受圆网蜘蛛网启发的柔性纤维网络，并探讨了其机械设计和操作条件如何塑造其计算能力。利用基于Cosserat杆的模拟，我们确定了网络拓扑、几何形状、驱动和轴向张力如何影响网络的非线性计算和记忆容量。我们进一步评估了几种读出减少策略，以评估计算性能如何随测量输出的数量和位置而变化。随后，我们使用一个物理纤维网络原型对这些结果进行了实验验证。总而言之，研究结果为设计、驱动和传感选择提供了见解和指导，以使纤维网络能够实现机械智能计算。它们证明了结构化柔性纤维网络能够作为物理储层，具备非线性转换和输入历史保留的能力。
tldr: 研究了一种受蜘蛛网启发的柔性纤维网络作为物理储层，利用Cosserat杆模拟和实验验证，确定了网络设计参数（拓扑结构、几何形状、张力等）如何影响其非线性计算和记忆能力，为机械智能计算提供了设计指导。
ai_comments: 这项工作的创新点在于将仿生学（蜘蛛网）与物理储层计算相结合，利用柔性纤维网络的固有机械动力学进行计算，而非依赖传统的电子元件。通过系统地模拟和实验验证，该研究深入分析了材料和结构参数（如拓扑结构、张力）对计算性能的具体影响，为设计高效的“机械智能”设备提供了实用的工程指导。这种方法代表了储层计算硬件实现的一种新颖且有前景的方向。
motivation: 研究受圆网蜘蛛网启发的柔性纤维网络，并探究其机械设计和操作条件如何影响其计算能力，以实现机械智能计算。
method: 1. 使用基于Cosserat杆的模拟来确定网络拓扑、几何形状、驱动和轴向张力对非线性计算和记忆容量的影响。2. 评估了几种读出减少策略，以评估计算性能如何随测量输出的数量和位置而变化。3. 使用物理纤维网络原型对结果进行实验验证。
results: 研究结果提供了关于设计、驱动和传感选择的见解和指导，能够使纤维网络实现机械智能计算。
conclusion: 结构化柔性纤维网络能够作为物理储层，具备非线性转换和输入历史保留的能力，为机械智能计算提供了设计和传感选择的指导。

title: STAR-S: Improving Safety Alignment through Self-Taught Reasoning on Safety Rules
authors: Di Wu, Yanyan Zhao, Xin Lu, Mingzhe Li, Bing Qin
abstract: Defending against jailbreak attacks is crucial for the safe deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs). Recent research has attempted to improve safety by training models to reason over safety rules before responding. However, a key issue lies in determining what form of safety reasoning effectively defends against jailbreak attacks, which is difficult to explicitly design or directly obtain. To address this, we propose \textbf{STAR-S} (\textbf{S}elf-\textbf{TA}ught \textbf{R}easoning based on \textbf{S}afety rules), a framework that integrates the learning of safety rule reasoning into a self-taught loop. The core of STAR-S involves eliciting reasoning and reflection guided by safety rules, then leveraging fine-tuning to enhance safety reasoning. Repeating this process creates a synergistic cycle. Improvements in the model's reasoning and interpretation of safety rules allow it to produce better reasoning data under safety rule prompts, which is then utilized for further training. Experiments show that STAR-S effectively defends against jailbreak attacks, outperforming baselines. Code is available at: https://github.com/pikepokenew/STAR_S.git.
zh_title: STAR-S：通过基于安全规则的自学推理改进安全对齐
translation: 防御越狱攻击对于大型语言模型（LLMs）的安全部署至关重要。最近的研究试图通过训练模型在响应前对安全规则进行推理来提高安全性。然而，一个关键问题在于确定何种形式的安全推理能够有效防御越狱攻击，而这种形式难以明确设计或直接获取。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了**STAR-S**（基于安全规则的**自学推理**）框架，该框架将安全规则推理的学习集成到一个自学循环中。STAR-S的核心在于，在安全规则的指导下激发推理和反思，然后利用微调来增强安全推理。重复这一过程创造了一个协同循环。模型在安全规则的推理和解释方面的改进使其能够在安全规则提示下产生更好的推理数据，这些数据随后被用于进一步的训练。实验表明，STAR-S能有效防御越狱攻击，性能优于基线模型。代码可在：https://github.com/pikepokenew/STAR_S.git 获取。
tldr: STAR-S框架使用基于安全规则的自学推理循环来训练LLM进行安全推理和反思，以解决难以设计有效推理形式的问题，从而有效提高模型防御越狱攻击的能力。
ai_comments: 该研究的创新之处在于引入“自学循环”机制来解决难以显式设计有效安全推理形式的挑战。STAR-S通过迭代地激发、反思和微调，使得模型能够持续自我完善其对安全规则的理解和推理能力。这种协同学习方法提供了一种强大的数据增强策略，有望提高LLM防御不断演变的越狱攻击的鲁棒性。
motivation: 防御越狱攻击对于大型语言模型（LLMs）的安全部署至关重要。现有研究难以明确设计或直接获取能够有效防御越狱攻击的安全推理形式。
method: 本文提出了STAR-S框架，将安全规则推理的学习整合到自学循环中。具体方法是：首先，在安全规则的指导下激发推理和反思；其次，利用微调增强安全推理；最后，重复该过程，利用模型改进后的推理能力生成更好的推理数据进行进一步训练，形成协同循环。
results: 实验结果显示，STAR-S能有效防御越狱攻击，并优于基线模型。

title: Layer-Order Inversion: Rethinking Latent Multi-Hop Reasoning in Large Language Models
authors: Xukai Liu, Ye Liu, Jipeng Zhang, Yanghai Zhang, Kai Zhang, Qi Liu
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) perform well on multi-hop reasoning, yet how they internally compose multiple facts remains unclear. Recent work proposes \emph{hop-aligned circuit hypothesis}, suggesting that bridge entities are computed sequentially across layers before later-hop answers. Through systematic analyses on real-world multi-hop queries, we show that this hop-aligned assumption does not generalize: later-hop answer entities can become decodable earlier than bridge entities, a phenomenon we call \emph{layer-order inversion}, which strengthens with total hops. To explain this behavior, we propose a \emph{probabilistic recall-and-extract} framework that models multi-hop reasoning as broad probabilistic recall in shallow MLP layers followed by selective extraction in deeper attention layers. This framework is empirically validated through systematic probing analyses, reinterpreting prior layer-wise decoding evidence, explaining chain-of-thought gains, and providing a mechanistic diagnosis of multi-hop failures despite correct single-hop knowledge. Code is available at https://github.com/laquabe/Layer-Order-Inversion.
zh_title: 层序倒置：重新思考大型语言模型中的潜在多跳推理
translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在多跳推理方面表现良好，但它们内部如何组合多个事实仍不清楚。最近的工作提出了“跳对齐电路假设”，认为桥接实体是在后续跳答案之前跨层序贯计算的。通过对真实世界多跳查询的系统分析，我们发现这种跳对齐假设不具普适性：后一跳的答案实体可以比桥接实体更早地变得可解码，我们称之为“层序倒置”现象，这种现象随着总跳数的增加而增强。为了解释这种行为，我们提出了一个“概率性召回与提取”框架，将多跳推理建模为浅层MLP层中的广泛概率性召回，然后是深层注意力层中的选择性提取。该框架通过系统的探测分析得到了经验验证，重新解释了先前的层级解码证据，解释了思维链（CoT）带来的收益，并提供了对多跳失败的机制诊断，即使模型具有正确的单跳知识。代码可在 https://github.com/laquabe/Layer-Order-Inversion 获取。
tldr: 大型语言模型的多跳推理并非总是按层序（桥接实体先于答案）进行。我们发现存在“层序倒置”现象（答案实体比桥接实体更早可解码），且跳数越多越明显。我们提出了一个“概率性召回与提取”框架来解释这一现象。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于提出了“层序倒置”现象，直接挑战了关于LLM多跳推理的流行机制假设（跳对齐电路假设），揭示了LLM内部的推理过程并非严格的顺序计算。提出的“概率性召回与提取”框架提供了一种新的、可解释的机制视图，将浅层的广泛召回与深层的选择性提取区分开来，这对于提高模型可解释性、理解思维链的功效以及设计更稳健的推理架构具有重要意义。
motivation: 尽管大型语言模型在多跳推理上表现良好，但其内部如何组合多个事实的机制尚不明确。现有的“跳对齐电路假设”认为桥接实体是按层序计算的，作者旨在系统地检验这一假设。
method: 对现实世界的多跳查询进行系统分析，以检验现有的“跳对齐”假设。提出并验证了“概率性召回与提取”框架，该框架将多跳推理建模为浅层MLP中的广泛概率性召回和深层注意力层中的选择性提取。
results: 现有的跳对齐假设不具普适性。发现“层序倒置”现象：后一跳的答案实体可以比桥接实体更早地变得可解码，且这种现象随着总跳数的增加而增强。提出的框架得到了经验验证，并能重新解释先前的层级解码证据，解释思维链的收益，并诊断多跳失败的机制。
conclusion: 大型语言模型中的潜在多跳推理机制并非严格遵循层序，而是存在“层序倒置”现象。提出的“概率性召回与提取”框架为理解LLMs如何进行多跳推理提供了一种新的机制解释，即浅层负责广泛召回，深层负责选择性提取。

title: EvolMem: A Cognitive-Driven Benchmark for Multi-Session Dialogue Memory
authors: Ye Shen, Dun Pei, Yiqiu Guo, Junying Wang, Yijin Guo, Zicheng Zhang, Qi Jia, Jun Zhou, Guangtao Zhai
abstract: Despite recent advances in understanding and leveraging long-range conversational memory, existing benchmarks still lack systematic evaluation of large language models(LLMs) across diverse memory dimensions, particularly in multi-session settings. In this work, we propose EvolMem, a new benchmark for assessing multi-session memory capabilities of LLMs and agent systems. EvolMem is grounded in cognitive psychology and encompasses both declarative and non-declarative memory, further decomposed into multiple fine-grained abilities. To construct the benchmark, we introduce a hybrid data synthesis framework that consists of topic-initiated generation and narrative-inspired transformations. This framework enables scalable generation of multi-session conversations with controllable complexity, accompanied by sample-specific evaluation guidelines. Extensive evaluation reveals that no LLM consistently outperforms others across all memory dimensions. Moreover, agent memory mechanisms do not necessarily enhance LLMs' capabilities and often exhibit notable efficiency limitations. Data and code will be released at https://github.com/shenye7436/EvolMem.
zh_title: EvolMem：一个认知驱动的多轮对话记忆基准测试
translation: 尽管最近在理解和利用长程对话记忆方面取得了进展，但现有基准仍然缺乏对大型语言模型（LLMs）跨越不同记忆维度的系统性评估，尤其是在多轮对话设置中。在这项工作中，我们提出了EvolMem，这是一个用于评估LLMs和代理系统的多轮对话记忆能力的新基准。EvolMem植根于认知心理学，涵盖陈述性记忆和非陈述性记忆，并进一步分解为多种细粒度的能力。为了构建该基准，我们引入了一个混合数据合成框架，该框架包括主题启动生成和叙事启发转换。该框架能够以可控的复杂性可扩展地生成多轮对话，并附带样本特定的评估指南。广泛的评估表明，没有LLM能够在所有记忆维度上持续优于其他模型。此外，代理记忆机制不一定能增强LLMs的能力，并且通常表现出明显的效率限制。数据和代码将在https://github.com/shenye7436/EvolMem 发布。
tldr: 提出了EvolMem，这是一个基于认知心理学的多轮对话记忆新基准，用于评估LLM。测试结果显示，现有LLM和代理系统在不同记忆维度上表现不一致且效率有限。
ai_comments: 这项工作的创新之处在于将基准测试（EvolMem）建立在认知心理学的基础上，超越了简单的上下文长度限制，对LLMs在多轮对话中的陈述性、非陈述性等细粒度记忆能力进行了系统性评估。其重要性在于揭示了现有LLMs和代理系统在处理复杂、长期记忆方面的不足，为未来开发更高效、更具认知能力的对话模型提供了明确的方向和挑战。
motivation: 尽管长程对话记忆研究取得了进展，但现有基准缺乏对大型语言模型（LLMs）在多轮对话场景中、跨越不同记忆维度的系统性评估。
method: 提出了EvolMem基准，该基准基于认知心理学，涵盖陈述性记忆和非陈述性记忆，并细分为多种能力。构建数据时，采用了混合数据合成框架，包括主题启动生成和叙事启发转换，以实现可扩展和可控复杂度的多轮对话生成。
results: 评估显示，没有LLM能在所有记忆维度上持续优于其他模型。此外，代理记忆机制不一定能增强LLMs的能力，并且通常表现出明显的效率限制。
conclusion: EvolMem基准测试揭示了当前LLMs在多轮对话记忆能力上的不足和不一致性，以及代理记忆机制在提升能力和效率上的局限性。

title: Value-Action Alignment in Large Language Models under Privacy-Prosocial Conflict
authors: Guanyu Chen, Chenxiao Yu, Xiyang Hu
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to simulate decision-making tasks involving personal data sharing, where privacy concerns and prosocial motivations can push choices in opposite directions. Existing evaluations often measure privacy-related attitudes or sharing intentions in isolation, which makes it difficult to determine whether a model's expressed values jointly predict its downstream data-sharing actions as in real human behaviors. We introduce a context-based assessment protocol that sequentially administers standardized questionnaires for privacy attitudes, prosocialness, and acceptance of data sharing within a bounded, history-carrying session. To evaluate value-action alignments under competing attitudes, we use multi-group structural equation modeling (MGSEM) to identify relations from privacy concerns and prosocialness to data sharing. We propose Value-Action Alignment Rate (VAAR), a human-referenced directional agreement metric that aggregates path-level evidence for expected signs. Across multiple LLMs, we observe stable but model-specific Privacy-PSA-AoDS profiles, and substantial heterogeneity in value-action alignment.
zh_title: 隐私-亲社会冲突下大型语言模型中的价值-行动一致性
translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地用于模拟涉及个人数据共享的决策任务，其中隐私顾虑和亲社会动机可能将选择推向相反的方向。现有的评估通常孤立地衡量隐私相关态度或共享意图，这使得难以确定模型的表达价值是否能像真实人类行为一样，共同预测其下游数据共享行动。我们引入了一个基于上下文的评估协议，在一个有界限、携带历史信息的会话中，顺序执行标准化的隐私态度、亲社会性和数据共享接受度问卷。为了评估在竞争态度下的价值-行动一致性，我们使用多组结构方程建模（MGSEM）来识别隐私顾虑和亲社会性到数据共享的关系。我们提出了价值-行动一致性率（VAAR），这是一个以人类为参考的方向一致性指标，用于汇总预期符号的路径级证据。在多个LLMs中，我们观察到稳定但特定于模型的“隐私-亲社会性-数据共享接受度”（Privacy-PSA-AoDS）画像，以及价值-行动一致性方面的显著异质性。
tldr: 本文研究了在隐私与亲社会动机冲突下，大型语言模型（LLMs）的价值（隐私态度和亲社会性）如何预测其数据共享行动。提出了一个上下文评估协议、多组结构方程模型（MGSEM）和价值-行动一致性率（VAAR）指标来衡量这种一致性。
ai_comments: 本研究的创新点在于将复杂的社会科学方法（如MGSEM和顺序评估协议）应用于大型语言模型的行为评估。它超越了孤立的态度测量，专注于在模拟现实心理冲突（隐私与亲社会性）情境下，模型表达的价值与其模拟行动之间的一致性。提出的VAAR指标为衡量LLMs的行为一致性提供了一个新颖且以人类行为为参考的工具，对于理解LLMs作为决策模拟器的可靠性至关重要。
motivation: 现有对大型语言模型（LLMs）的评估通常孤立地衡量隐私相关态度或共享意图，难以确定模型所表达的价值是否能像真实人类行为一样，共同预测其下游数据共享行动，尤其是在隐私顾虑和亲社会动机发生冲突时。
method: 引入了一个基于上下文的评估协议，在一个有界限、携带历史信息的会话中，顺序执行标准化的隐私态度、亲社会性和数据共享接受度问卷。使用多组结构方程建模（MGSEM）来识别隐私顾虑和亲社会性到数据共享的关系。提出了价值-行动一致性率（VAAR），这是一个以人类为参考的方向一致性指标。
results: 在多个LLMs中观察到稳定但特定于模型的“隐私-亲社会性-数据共享接受度”（Privacy-PSA-AoDS）画像。发现价值-行动一致性存在显著的异质性。

title: DeepSynth-Eval: Objectively Evaluating Information Consolidation in Deep Survey Writing
authors: Hongzhi Zhang, Yuanze Hu, Tinghai Zhang, Jia Fu, Tao Wang, Junwei Jing, Zhaoxin Fan, Qi Wang, Ruiming Tang, Han Li, Guorui Zhou, Kun Gai
abstract: The evolution of Large Language Models (LLMs) towards autonomous agents has catalyzed progress in Deep Research. While retrieval capabilities are well-benchmarked, the post-retrieval synthesis stage--where agents must digest massive amounts of context and consolidate fragmented evidence into coherent, long-form reports--remains under-evaluated due to the subjectivity of open-ended writing. To bridge this gap, we introduce DeepSynth-Eval, a benchmark designed to objectively evaluate information consolidation capabilities. We leverage high-quality survey papers as gold standards, reverse-engineering research requests and constructing "Oracle Contexts" from their bibliographies to isolate synthesis from retrieval noise. We propose a fine-grained evaluation protocol using General Checklists (for factual coverage) and Constraint Checklists (for structural organization), transforming subjective judgment into verifiable metrics. Experiments across 96 tasks reveal that synthesizing information from hundreds of references remains a significant challenge. Our results demonstrate that agentic plan-and-write workflows significantly outperform single-turn generation, effectively reducing hallucinations and improving adherence to complex structural constraints.
zh_title: DeepSynth-Eval：客观评估深度综述写作中的信息整合能力
translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）向自主代理的演进推动了深度研究的进步。尽管检索能力已经得到了充分的基准测试，但后检索合成阶段——即代理必须消化大量上下文并将零散证据整合为连贯的长篇报告的阶段——由于开放式写作的主观性而仍然缺乏评估。为了弥补这一差距，我们引入了DeepSynth-Eval，这是一个旨在客观评估信息整合能力的基准。我们利用高质量的综述论文作为黄金标准，逆向工程研究请求，并从其参考文献中构建“Oracle Contexts”，以将合成能力与检索的干扰隔离开来。我们提出了一种细粒度的评估协议，使用通用清单（用于事实覆盖）和约束清单（用于结构组织），将主观判断转化为可验证的指标。对96项任务的实验表明，从数百个参考文献中合成信息仍然是一项重大挑战。我们的结果证明，基于代理的“规划-写作”工作流程显著优于单轮生成，有效地减少了幻觉并改善了对复杂结构约束的遵守。
tldr: 我们创建了DeepSynth-Eval基准，用于客观评估LLMs将海量零散信息整合为长篇综述报告的能力，结果显示，基于代理的“规划-写作”方法远优于简单的单次生成。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于成功地将信息合成任务与检索噪声隔离开来，通过使用高质量综述论文的参考文献构建“Oracle Contexts”。更重要的是，它将长期以来主观的开放式写作评估转化为客观、可验证的指标（通过通用和约束清单），解决了深度研究代理评估的核心难题。研究结果强调了在处理海量信息时，规划和多步骤代理工作流程的必要性，为未来构建更可靠的LLM研究助手提供了关键的评估工具和方向。
motivation: 尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）在检索能力上表现良好，但在深度研究中，代理（agents）需要消化大量上下文并将零散证据整合为连贯的长篇报告的“后检索合成阶段”仍缺乏客观评估，因为开放式写作具有主观性。
method: 引入了DeepSynth-Eval基准，旨在客观评估信息整合能力。该方法使用高质量的综述论文作为黄金标准，逆向工程研究请求，并从其参考文献中构建“Oracle Contexts”以隔离合成与检索的干扰。提出了一种细粒度的评估协议，使用通用清单（General Checklists，评估事实覆盖）和约束清单（Constraint Checklists，评估结构组织），将主观判断转化为可验证的指标。
results: 对96项任务的实验表明，从数百个参考文献中合成信息仍然是一项重大挑战。结果显示，基于代理的“规划-写作”（plan-and-write）工作流程显著优于单轮生成，有效地减少了幻觉并提高了对复杂结构约束的遵守程度。
conclusion: DeepSynth-Eval成功地提供了一个客观评估深度综述写作中信息整合能力的基准。研究证明，尽管挑战巨大，但采用规划和写作的代理工作流程是提高信息合成质量、减少幻觉和满足复杂结构要求的有效途径。

title: EASLT: Emotion-Aware Sign Language Translation
authors: Guobin Tu, Di Weng
abstract: Sign Language Translation (SLT) is a complex cross-modal task requiring the integration of Manual Signals (MS) and Non-Manual Signals (NMS). While recent gloss-free SLT methods have made strides in translating manual gestures, they frequently overlook the semantic criticality of facial expressions, resulting in ambiguity when distinct concepts share identical manual articulations. To address this, we present **EASLT** (**E**motion-**A**ware **S**ign **L**anguage **T**ranslation), a framework that treats facial affect not as auxiliary information, but as a robust semantic anchor. Unlike methods that relegate facial expressions to a secondary role, EASLT incorporates a dedicated emotional encoder to capture continuous affective dynamics. These representations are integrated via a novel *Emotion-Aware Fusion* (EAF) module, which adaptively recalibrates spatio-temporal sign features based on affective context to resolve semantic ambiguities. Extensive evaluations on the PHOENIX14T and CSL-Daily benchmarks demonstrate that EASLT establishes advanced performance among gloss-free methods, achieving BLEU-4 scores of 26.15 and 22.80, and BLEURT scores of 61.0 and 57.8, respectively. Ablation studies confirm that explicitly modeling emotion effectively decouples affective semantics from manual dynamics, significantly enhancing translation fidelity. Code is available at https://github.com/TuGuobin/EASLT.
translation: 手语翻译（SLT）是一项复杂的跨模态任务，需要整合手动信号（MS）和非手动信号（NMS）。虽然最近的无语素SLT方法在翻译手动手势方面取得了进展，但它们经常忽略面部表情的语义关键性，导致当不同概念共享相同的手动表达时产生歧义。为解决此问题，我们提出了EASLT（情感感知手语翻译），这是一个将面部情感不视为辅助信息，而是视为鲁棒语义锚点的框架。与将面部表情降级为次要角色的方法不同，EASLT包含一个专用的情感编码器来捕获连续的情感动态。这些表征通过一种新颖的“情感感知融合”（EAF）模块进行整合，该模块根据情感上下文自适应地重新校准时空手语特征，以解决语义歧义。在PHOENIX14T和CSL-Daily基准测试上的广泛评估表明，EASLT在无语素方法中确立了先进的性能，BLEU-4得分分别为26.15和22.80，BLEURT得分分别为61.0和57.8。消融研究证实，明确建模情感能有效解耦情感语义和手动动态，显著提高翻译保真度。代码可在https://github.com/TuGuobin/EASLT获取。
tldr: 现有的无语素手语翻译方法常忽略面部表情，导致语义模糊。本文提出了EASLT框架，利用专用的情感编码器和情感感知融合（EAF）模块，将面部情感作为核心语义锚点，显著提高了手语翻译的准确性和性能。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将面部情感（非手动信号）从辅助信息提升为核心的“鲁棒语义锚点”，并通过专用的情感编码器和情感感知融合（EAF）模块进行显式建模和整合。这解决了无语素手语翻译中因手动信号相同而产生的语义歧义问题，在方法论上具有重要意义。通过量化指标（高BLEU-4和BLEURT分数）证明了其在两个主流基准上的有效性，表明该方法在提高手语翻译的准确性和自然度方面迈出了重要一步。局限性（未在摘要中明确提及）：可能在于情感编码的鲁棒性，以及该方法是否能有效处理更微妙或混合的情感表达。
motivation: 手语翻译（SLT）是一项复杂的跨模态任务，需要整合手动信号（MS）和非手动信号（NMS）。当前的无语素SLT方法通常忽视面部表情的语义关键性，导致当不同概念共享相同的手动表达时产生歧义。
method: 提出了EASLT（情感感知手语翻译）框架。该方法将面部情感视为鲁棒的语义锚点，并包含一个专用的情感编码器来捕获连续的情感动态。这些表征通过新颖的“情感感知融合”（EAF）模块进行整合，该模块根据情感上下文自适应地重新校准时空手语特征，以解决语义歧义。
results: 在PHOENIX14T和CSL-Daily基准测试中，EASLT在无语素方法中取得了先进的性能。具体得分：PHOENIX14T的BLEU-4为26.15，BLEURT为61.0；CSL-Daily的BLEU-4为22.80，BLEURT为57.8。消融研究证实，明确建模情感能有效解耦情感语义和手动动态，显著提高翻译保真度。
conclusion: EASLT框架通过将面部情感作为核心语义锚点并进行显式建模，显著增强了翻译的保真度，并在主流基准测试中确立了无语素手语翻译的先进性能。

title: ReEfBench: Quantifying the Reasoning Efficiency of LLMs
authors: Zhizhang Fu, Yuancheng Gu, Chenkai Hu, Hanmeng Liu, Yue Zhang
abstract: Test-time scaling has enabled Large Language Models (LLMs) to tackle complex reasoning, yet the limitations of current Chain-of-Thought (CoT) evaluation obscures whether performance gains stem from genuine reasoning or mere verbosity. To address this, (1) we propose a novel neuro-symbolic framework for the non-intrusive, comprehensive process-centric evaluation of reasoning. (2) Through this lens, we identify four distinct behavioral prototypes and diagnose the failure modes. (3) We examine the impact of inference mode, training strategy, and model scale. Our analysis reveals that extended token generation is not a prerequisite for deep reasoning. Furthermore, we reveal critical constraints: mixing long and short CoT data in training risks in premature saturation and collapse, while distillation into smaller models captures behavioral length but fails to replicate logical efficacy due to intrinsic capacity limits.
zh_title: ReEfBench：量化大型语言模型的推理效率
translation: 测时缩放使得大型语言模型（LLMs）能够处理复杂的推理任务，然而当前思维链（CoT）评估的局限性模糊了性能提升是源于真正的推理能力还是仅仅是词汇量冗长。为解决此问题，（1）我们提出了一个新颖的神经符号框架，用于对推理进行非侵入式、全面的、以过程为中心的评估。（2）通过这一视角，我们确定了四种不同的行为原型并诊断了故障模式。（3）我们检验了推理模式、训练策略和模型规模的影响。我们的分析揭示，扩展的标记生成并非深度推理的先决条件。此外，我们揭示了关键的约束：在训练中混合长短CoT数据存在过早饱和和崩溃的风险，而蒸馏到较小模型中虽然捕获了行为长度，但由于内在能力限制，未能复制逻辑有效性。
tldr: 现有的思维链（CoT）评估无法区分真实推理和冗长输出。本文提出了一个名为ReEfBench的神经符号框架来量化推理效率，发现长输出并非深度推理的必要条件，并揭示了混合CoT数据和模型蒸馏的局限性。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了一个名为ReEfBench的神经符号框架，专门用于量化LLM的推理效率，而非仅仅关注最终结果或输出长度。这解决了现有CoT评估中一个核心的局限性——即无法区分“深度推理”与“单纯冗余”。研究结果对于指导LLM的训练和蒸馏策略具有重要指导意义，特别是关于混合CoT数据和模型容量对逻辑复制的制约，强调了效率（Efficacy）和长度（Length）之间的脱节，对未来高效能LLM的设计至关重要。
motivation: 现有的思维链（CoT）评估方法的局限性在于无法判断性能提升是源于真正的推理能力还是仅仅是输出的冗长性（词汇量）。因此，需要一个框架来对推理过程进行非侵入式、全面的、以过程为中心的评估，从而量化推理效率。
method: 1. 提出了一个新颖的神经符号框架（ReEfBench），用于对推理进行非侵入式、全面的、以过程为中心的评估。2. 利用该框架识别了四种不同的行为原型并诊断了故障模式。3. 考察了推理模式、训练策略和模型规模的影响。
results: 分析表明，扩展的标记生成（即冗长的输出）并非深度推理的先决条件。此外，研究揭示了关键限制：在训练中混合长短CoT数据有导致过早饱和和崩溃的风险；而将模型蒸馏到较小模型中虽然能捕获行为长度，但由于内在能力限制，无法复制逻辑有效性。

title: Dissolving a Digital Relationship: A Critical Examination of Digital Severance Behaviours in Close Relationships
authors: Michael Yin, Angela Chiang, Robert Xiao
abstract: Fulfilling social connections are crucial for human well-being and belonging, but not all relationships last forever. As interactions increasingly move online, the act of digitally severing a relationship - e.g. through blocking or unfriending - has become progressively more common as well. This study considers actions of "digital severance" through interviews with 30 participants with experience as the initiator and/or recipient of such situations. Through a critical interpretative lens, we explore how people perceive and interpret their severance experience and how the online setting of social media shapes these dynamics. We develop themes that position digital severance as being intertwined with power and control, and we highlight (im)balances between an individual's desires that can lead to feelings of disempowerment and ambiguous loss for both parties. We discuss the implications of our research, outlining three key tensions and four open questions regarding digital relationships, meaning-making, and design outcomes for future exploration.
comment: 27 pages, 1 figure, Accepted to ACM CSCW 2026
zh_title: 解散数字关系：对亲密关系中数字断绝行为的批判性审视
translation: 建立充实的社会联系对人类的福祉和归属感至关重要，但并非所有关系都能持续到永远。随着互动日益转移到线上，通过数字方式断绝一段关系（例如通过拉黑或取关）的行为也变得越来越普遍。本研究通过访谈了30名具有作为此类情况发起者和/或接收者经验的参与者，来审视“数字断绝”行为。通过批判性解释的视角，我们探索了人们如何感知和解释他们的断绝体验，以及社交媒体的在线设置如何塑造这些动态。我们提出了将数字断绝定位为与权力及控制相互交织的主题，并强调了个体愿望之间的（不）平衡，这可能导致双方产生无力感和模糊性失落。我们讨论了研究的意义，概述了关于数字关系、意义构建和面向未来探索的设计成果的三个关键张力和四个开放性问题。
tldr: 本研究通过访谈探讨了人们如何感知和解释“数字断绝”（如拉黑、取关）行为。结果发现，数字断绝与权力、控制、失衡以及双方的无力感和模糊性失落紧密相关。
ai_comments: 本研究的重要性在于它将传统的社会关系解除过程置于数字环境中进行深入分析，填补了人机交互（HCI）和关系研究的交叉空白。通过引入“权力与控制”以及“模糊性失落”等社会学概念来解释数字断绝行为的复杂情感后果，提供了批判性的解释视角。其创新点在于将看似简单的“点击操作”（如拉黑）提升到涉及深层心理和权力动态的社会行为层面。
motivation: 社交联系对人类福祉至关重要，但关系并非永恒。随着互动日益在线化，通过数字手段（如拉黑或取关）断绝关系的行为越来越普遍。因此，研究旨在探讨人们如何看待和解释这种数字断绝体验，以及社交媒体的在线环境如何塑造这些动态。
method: 采用批判性解释视角，通过对30名具有数字断绝发起者和/或接收者经验的参与者进行访谈。
results: 研究提出了多个主题，将数字断绝定位为与权力、控制相互交织的行为。研究强调了个体愿望之间的（不）平衡，这可能导致双方产生无力感和模糊性失落。
conclusion: 研究讨论了其影响，并概述了关于数字关系、意义构建和面向未来探索的设计成果的三个关键张力和四个开放性问题。

title: Do Autonomous Agents Contribute Test Code? A Study of Tests in Agentic Pull Requests
authors: Sabrina Haque, Sarvesh Ingale, Christoph Csallner
abstract: Testing is a critical practice for ensuring software correctness and long-term maintainability. As agentic coding tools increasingly submit pull requests (PRs), it becomes essential to understand how testing appears in these agent-driven workflows. Using the AIDev dataset, we present an empirical study of test inclusion in agentic pull requests. We examine how often tests are included, when they are introduced during the PR lifecycle and how test-containing PRs differ from non-test PRs in terms of size, turnaround time, and merge outcomes. Across agents, test-containing PRs are more common over time and tend to be larger and take longer to complete, while merge rates remain largely similar. We also observe variation across agents in both test adoption and the balance between test and production code within test PRs. Our findings provide a descriptive view of testing behavior in agentic pull requests and offer empirical grounding for future studies of autonomous software development.
zh_title: 自主代理会贡献测试代码吗？一项关于代理式拉取请求中测试的研究
translation: 测试是确保软件正确性和长期可维护性的关键实践。随着代理编码工具越来越多地提交拉取请求（PRs），了解这些代理驱动的工作流程中测试是如何出现的变得至关重要。我们利用AIDev数据集，对代理拉取请求中的测试包含情况进行了实证研究。我们考察了测试被包含的频率、它们在PR生命周期中引入的时机，以及包含测试的PR在大小、周转时间和合并结果方面与不包含测试的PR有何不同。在所有代理中，包含测试的PRs随时间推移更为常见，且倾向于更大、完成时间更长，而合并率基本保持相似。我们还观察到不同代理在测试采纳率以及测试PR中测试代码与生产代码的平衡方面存在差异。我们的发现为代理拉取请求中的测试行为提供了描述性视图，并为未来对自主软件开发的实证研究提供了经验基础。
tldr: 研究了AI代理提交的Pull Request中是否包含测试代码，发现随着时间发展，测试代码PRs变多，但它们通常更大、耗时更长，且不同AI代理的测试习惯各不相同。
ai_comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于首次对代理（Agentic）拉取请求中的测试代码包含情况进行了实证研究，填补了对自主软件开发测试实践认知的空白。其重要性在于为理解和改进未来基于AI的软件开发流程中的质量保证机制提供了基础数据。局限性在于它仅基于AIDev数据集进行描述性分析，并未深入探究测试代码的质量或有效性。
motivation: 随着代理编码工具提交的拉取请求（PRs）日益增多，理解这些代理驱动的工作流程中测试代码是如何出现的，对于确保软件的正确性和长期可维护性至关重要。
method: 使用AIDev数据集，对代理拉取请求（PRs）中的测试包含情况进行了实证研究。分析了测试代码的引入频率、引入时机，并比较了包含测试的PR与不包含测试的PR在大小、周转时间和合并结果上的差异。
results: 随着时间的推移，包含测试的PRs变得越来越普遍，并且倾向于更大、完成时间更长，而合并率基本保持不变。研究还观察到不同代理在测试采纳率以及测试代码与生产代码的比例上存在差异。
conclusion: 研究结果提供了代理拉取请求中测试行为的描述性视图，并为未来对自主软件开发的实证研究提供了基础。

title: SCRIBE: Structured Mid-Level Supervision for Tool-Using Language Models
authors: Yuxuan Jiang, Francis Ferraro
abstract:
Training reliable tool-augmented agents remains a significant challenge, largely due to the difficulty of credit assignment in multi-step reasoning. While process-level reward models offer a promising direction, existing LLM-based judges often produce noisy and inconsistent signals because they lack fine-grained, task-specific rubrics to distinguish high-level planning from low-level execution. In this work, we introduce SCRIBE (Skill-Conditioned Reward with Intermediate Behavioral Evaluation), a reinforcement learning framework that intervenes at a novel mid-level abstraction. SCRIBE grounds reward modeling in a curated library of skill prototypes, transforming open-ended LLM evaluation into a constrained verification problem. By routing each subgoal to a corresponding prototype, the reward model is equipped with precise, structured rubrics that substantially reduce reward variance.
  Experimental results show that SCRIBE achieves state-of-the-art performance across a range of reasoning and tool-use benchmarks. In particular, it improves the AIME25 accuracy of a Qwen3-4B model from 43.3% to 63.3%, and significantly increases success rates in complex multi-turn tool interactions.
  Further analysis of training dynamics reveals a co-evolution across abstraction levels, where mastery of mid-level skills consistently precedes the emergence of effective high-level planning behaviors. Finally, we demonstrate that SCRIBE is additive to low-level tool optimizations, providing a scalable and complementary pathway toward more autonomous and reliable tool-using agents.
zh_title: SCRIBE：用于工具使用语言模型的结构化中层监督
translation:
SCRIBE：用于工具使用语言模型的结构化中层监督

训练可靠的工具增强型智能体仍然是一个重大挑战，主要由于多步推理中信用分配的困难。虽然过程级奖励模型提供了一个有希望的方向，但现有的基于LLM的裁判由于缺乏区分高层规划和低层执行的细粒度、任务特定的评分标准，往往产生嘈杂且不一致的信号。在这项工作中，我们引入了SCRIBE（技能条件奖励与中间行为评估），一个在新的中层抽象级别进行干预的强化学习框架。SCRIBE将奖励建模建立在精心策划的技能原型库上，将开放式的LLM评估转化为一个约束验证问题。通过将每个子目标路由到相应的原型，奖励模型配备了精确、结构化的评分标准，从而大大减少了奖励方差。

实验结果表明，SCRIBE在各种推理和工具使用基准测试中实现了最先进的性能。特别是，它将Qwen3-4B模型在AIME25上的准确率从43.3%提高到63.3%，并显著提高了复杂多轮工具交互的成功率。对训练动态的进一步分析揭示了跨抽象级别的协同演化，其中中层技能的掌握一致地先于有效的高层规划行为的出现。最后，我们证明SCRIBE可以与低层工具优化相加，为实现更自主和可靠的工具使用代理提供了一条可扩展且互补的途径。
tldr: SCRIBE通过引入基于技能原型的中层监督信号，为工具使用LLM提供了一种结构化的奖励机制，有效解决了多步推理中的信用分配问题，实验证明其在推理和工具使用任务上取得了SOTA性能。
ai_comments: SCRIBE的创新点在于引入了“中层抽象”的监督信号，通过将开放式的LLM评估转化为基于技能原型的约束验证问题，有效解决了多步骤推理中信用分配的难题，显著降低了奖励信号的方差，是提升工具使用LLM可靠性的重要进展。
motivation: 训练可靠的工具增强型智能体存在显著挑战，主要源于多步骤推理中信用分配的困难，现有的基于LLM的裁判会产生嘈杂且不一致的信号，因为它们缺乏区分高层规划和低层执行的细粒度、特定任务的评分标准。
method: SCRIBE（Skill-Conditioned Reward with Intermediate Behavioral Evaluation）是一个强化学习框架，它通过将奖励建模建立在精心策划的技能原型库上，将开放式的LLM评估转化为约束验证问题，通过将每个子目标路由到相应的原型，为奖励模型提供了精确、结构化的评分标准。
results: SCRIBE在各种推理和工具使用基准测试中实现了最先进的性能，特别是将Qwen3-4B模型在AIME25上的准确率从43.3%提高到63.3%，并显著提高了复杂多轮工具交互的成功率。
conclusion: SCRIBE提供了一种可扩展且互补的途径，通过中层技能的掌握促进了高层规划行为的出现，从而实现了更自主和可靠的工具使用代理。

title: Evaluating LLMs for Police Decision-Making: A Framework Based on Police Action Scenarios
authors: Sangyub Lee, Heedou Kim, Hyeoncheol Kim
abstract: The use of Large Language Models (LLMs) in police operations is growing, yet an evaluation framework tailored to police operations remains absent. While LLM's responses may not always be legally incorrect, their unverified use still can lead to severe issues such as unlawful arrests and improper evidence collection. To address this, we propose PAS (Police Action Scenarios), a systematic framework covering the entire evaluation process. Applying this framework, we constructed a novel QA dataset from over 8,000 official documents and established key metrics validated through statistical analysis with police expert judgements. Experimental results show that commercial LLMs struggle with our new police-related tasks, particularly in providing fact-based recommendations. This study highlights the necessity of an expandable evaluation framework to ensure reliable AI-driven police operations. We release our data and prompt template.
comment: This work was accepted at AAAI 2026 social good track
zh_title: 评估大型语言模型在警察决策中的表现：一个基于警察行动场景的框架
translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在警务行动中的使用日益增多，但仍缺乏专门针对警务操作的评估框架。虽然LLMs的回答可能不总是法律上错误的，但未经核实的使用仍然可能导致非法逮捕和不当证据收集等严重问题。为解决此问题，我们提出了PAS（警察行动场景），一个涵盖整个评估过程的系统性框架。应用此框架，我们从超过8000份官方文件中构建了一个新颖的问答数据集，并通过与警察专家判断的统计分析确立了关键指标。实验结果表明，商业LLMs在我们的新警察相关任务中表现挣扎，尤其是在提供基于事实的建议方面。本研究突显了建立一个可扩展的评估框架的必要性，以确保人工智能驱动的警务操作的可靠性。我们发布了我们的数据和提示模板。
tldr: 研究人员开发了一个名为PAS的系统框架，用于评估LLMs在警察决策中的表现，并创建了一个新的警务QA数据集。结果显示，现有商业LLMs在这些高风险任务中表现不佳，需要一个专门的、可扩展的评估工具来确保AI在警务中的可靠性。
ai_comments: 该研究创新性地提出了一个专门针对警察行动场景的LLM评估框架（PAS），并构建了一个基于大量官方文件的新型问答数据集。其重要性在于揭示了当前商用LLM在专业、高风险的警务决策任务中的局限性。局限性可能在于评估框架的通用性或专家判断的覆盖范围。
motivation: 警务操作中大型语言模型（LLMs）的使用正在增长，但目前缺乏一个专门为警务操作量身定制的评估框架，未经核实的LLM使用可能导致非法逮捕和不当取证等严重问题。
method: 提出了一个名为PAS（Police Action Scenarios）的系统性框架来覆盖整个评估过程，并利用该框架构建了一个包含超过8000份官方文件的新型QA数据集，同时建立了通过与警察专家判断进行统计分析验证的关键指标。
results: 实验结果表明，商业LLM在新的、与警务相关的任务中表现不佳，尤其是在提供基于事实的建议方面。
conclusion: 这项研究强调了建立一个可扩展的评估框架的必要性，以确保人工智能驱动的警务操作的可靠性。

title: From Risk Perception to Behavior Large Language Models-Based Simulation of Pandemic Prevention Behaviors
authors: Lujia Bo, Mingxuan Chen, Youduo Chen, Xiaofan Gui, Jiang Bian, Chunyan Wang, Yi Liu
abstract: Individual prevention behaviors are a primary line of defense during the early stages of novel infectious disease outbreaks, yet their adoption is heterogeneous and difficult to forecast-especially when empirical data are scarce and epidemic-policy contexts evolve rapidly. To address this gap, we develop an LLM-based prevention-behavior simulation framework that couples (i) a static module for behavior-intensity prediction under a specified external context and (ii) a dynamic module that updates residents' perceived risk over time and propagates these updates into behavior evolution. The model is implemented via structured prompt engineering in a first-person perspective and is evaluated against two rounds of survey data from Beijing residents (R1: December 2020; R2: August 2021) under progressively realistic data-availability settings: zero-shot, few-shot, and cross-context transfer. Using Kolmogorov-Smirnov tests to compare simulated and observed behavior distributions (p > 0.001 as the validity criterion), the framework demonstrates robust performance and improves with limited reference examples; reported predictive accuracy increases from 72.7% (zero-shot) to 81.8% (few-shot), and remains high at 77.8% under transfer to novel contexts. We further apply the framework to simulate behavior changes during China's December 2022 policy relaxation and to stress-test behavioral responses across 120 systematically varied epidemic conditions (R0, CFR, and control-measure tiers). Results indicate broad behavioral loosening under relaxation but a distinctive counter-trend increase in drain-related disinfection, highlighting how low-cost, low-friction behaviors may persist or intensify even when external constraints recede-raising a potential environmental tradeoff.
zh_title: 从风险感知到行为：基于大型语言模型的疫情预防行为模拟
translation: 在新型传染病爆发的早期阶段，个体预防行为是主要的防线，但其采用具有异质性且难以预测——尤其是在经验数据稀缺和疫情政策环境快速演变的情况下。为了弥补这一空白，我们开发了一个基于大型语言模型（LLM）的预防行为模拟框架，该框架耦合了（i）一个用于预测在特定外部情境下行为强度的静态模块，以及（ii）一个随时间更新居民风险感知并将其传播到行为演变中的动态模块。该模型通过第一人称视角的结构化提示工程实现，并根据北京居民的两轮调查数据（R1：2020年12月；R2：2021年8月）在逐步现实的数据可用性设置下进行了评估：零样本、少样本和跨情境迁移。使用Kolmogorov-Smirnov检验比较模拟和观察到的行为分布（p > 0.001作为有效性标准），该框架展示了鲁棒的性能，并随着有限参考示例的增加而改进；报告的预测准确率从72.7%（零样本）提高到81.8%（少样本），在迁移到新的情境下仍保持77.8%的高水平。我们进一步应用该框架模拟了中国2022年12月政策放松期间的行为变化，并对120种系统变化后的疫情条件（R0、CFR和控制措施等级）下的行为反应进行了压力测试。结果表明，在放松政策下行为普遍松懈，但与排水管相关的消毒行为却出现了独特的逆势增加，突显了即使外部限制减弱，低成本、低摩擦的行为也可能持续或加强——这带来了潜在的环境权衡问题。
tldr: 开发了一个基于大语言模型的框架，用于模拟和预测疫情预防行为如何随风险感知而演变，在零样本、少样本和跨情境迁移中表现出鲁棒的高准确性，并可用于政策放松和压力测试模拟。
ai_comments: 本研究的创新点在于利用大型语言模型（LLMs）进行复杂的社会行为模拟，将LLMs从传统的自然语言处理任务扩展到预测风险感知驱动下的人类行为演变。在疫情等经验数据稀缺且政策快速变化的环境中，该框架为政策制定者提供了一种快速、鲁棒的预测工具。其在评估中达到了较高的准确性，并成功模拟了现实政策情境（如政策放松）。特别值得注意的是，研究发现低成本、低摩擦的预防行为（如排水管消毒）即使在外部约束减少后仍会持续或加强，这揭示了模型捕捉人类行为细微差别的能力，对公共卫生政策制定具有重要的启示意义。
motivation: 个体预防行为是应对新型传染病爆发的初级防线，但其采用具有异质性且难以预测，尤其是在缺乏经验数据和疫情政策快速演变的情况下。
method: 开发了一个基于LLM的预防行为模拟框架，包含一个静态模块（预测指定情境下的行为强度）和一个动态模块（随时间更新居民的风险感知并将其传播到行为演变中）。通过结构化提示工程以第一人称视角实现。使用Kolmogorov-Smirnov检验，并用北京居民的两轮调查数据（零样本、少样本、跨情境迁移）进行评估。
results: 框架表现出鲁棒的性能，预测准确率从零样本的72.7%提高到少样本的81.8%，跨情境迁移中仍保持77.8%的高水平。模拟结果显示，在2022年12月政策放松期间，行为普遍放松，但与排水管相关的消毒行为却逆势增加，突显了低成本、低摩擦行为的持久性或增强。
conclusion: 该框架在模拟和预测疫情预防行为方面表现出鲁棒的有效性和高准确性，尤其适用于数据稀缺和政策快速变化的情境。它揭示了在政策放松下，低成本、低摩擦的预防行为可能会持续甚至加强。

title: DiffCoT: Diffusion-styled Chain-of-Thought Reasoning in LLMs
authors: Shidong Cao, Hongzhan Lin, Yuxuan Gu, Ziyang Luo, Jing Ma
abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning improves multi-step mathematical problem solving in large language models but remains vulnerable to exposure bias and error accumulation, as early mistakes propagate irreversibly through autoregressive decoding. In this work, we propose DiffCoT, a diffusion-styled CoT framework that reformulates CoT reasoning as an iterative denoising process. DiffCoT integrates diffusion principles at the reasoning-step level via a sliding-window mechanism, enabling unified generation and retrospective correction of intermediate steps while preserving token-level autoregression. To maintain causal consistency, we further introduce a causal diffusion noise schedule that respects the temporal structure of reasoning chains. Extensive experiments on three multi-step CoT reasoning benchmarks across diverse model backbones demonstrate that DiffCoT consistently outperforms existing CoT preference optimization methods, yielding improved robustness and error-correction capability in CoT reasoning.
comment: DiffCoT improves multi-step LLM reasoning by applying diffusion-based iterative denoising to correct intermediate Chain-of-Thought steps

title: Green's-Function Spherical Neural Operators for Biological Heterogeneity
authors: Hao Tang, Hao Chen, Hao Li, Chao Li
abstract: Spherical deep learning has been widely applied to a broad range of real-world problems. Existing approaches often face challenges in balancing strong spherical geometric inductive biases with the need to model real-world heterogeneity. To solve this while retaining spherical geometry, we first introduce a designable Green's function framework (DGF) to provide new spherical operator solution strategy: Design systematic Green's functions under rotational group. Based on DGF, to model biological heterogeneity, we propose Green's-Function Spherical Neural Operator (GSNO) fusing 3 operator solutions: (1) Equivariant Solution derived from Equivariant Green's Function for symmetry-consistent modeling; (2) Invariant Solution derived from Invariant Green's Function to eliminate nuisance heterogeneity, e.g., consistent background field; (3) Anisotropic Solution derived from Anisotropic Green's Function to model anisotropic systems, especially fibers with preferred direction. Therefore, the resulting model, GSNO can adapt to real-world heterogeneous systems with nuisance variability and anisotropy while retaining spectral efficiency. Evaluations on spherical MNIST, Shallow Water Equation, diffusion MRI fiber prediction, cortical parcellation and molecule structure modeling demonstrate the superiority of GSNO.

title: A Proposed Paradigm for Imputing Missing Multi-Sensor Data in the Healthcare Domain
authors: Vaibhav Gupta, Florian Grensing, Beyza Cinar, Maria Maleshkova
abstract: Chronic diseases such as diabetes pose significant management challenges, particularly due to the risk of complications like hypoglycemia, which require timely detection and intervention. Continuous health monitoring through wearable sensors offers a promising solution for early prediction of glycemic events. However, effective use of multisensor data is hindered by issues such as signal noise and frequent missing values. This study examines the limitations of existing datasets and emphasizes the temporal characteristics of key features relevant to hypoglycemia prediction. A comprehensive analysis of imputation techniques is conducted, focusing on those employed in state-of-the-art studies. Furthermore, imputation methods derived from machine learning and deep learning applications in other healthcare contexts are evaluated for their potential to address longer gaps in time-series data. Based on this analysis, a systematic paradigm is proposed, wherein imputation strategies are tailored to the nature of specific features and the duration of missing intervals. The review concludes by emphasizing the importance of investigating the temporal dynamics of individual features and the implementation of multiple, feature-specific imputation techniques to effectively address heterogeneous temporal patterns inherent in the data.

title: Local Intrinsic Dimensionality of Ground Motion Data for Early Detection of Complex Catastrophic Slope Failure
authors: Yuansan Liu, Antoinette Tordesillas, James Bailey
abstract: Local Intrinsic Dimensionality (LID) has shown strong potential for identifying anomalies and outliers in high-dimensional data across a wide range of real-world applications, including landslide failure detection in granular media. Early and accurate identification of failure zones in landslide-prone areas is crucial for effective geohazard mitigation. While existing approaches typically rely on surface displacement data analyzed through statistical or machine learning techniques, they often fall short in capturing both the spatial correlations and temporal dynamics that are inherent in such data. To address this gap, we focus on ground-monitored landslides and introduce a novel approach that jointly incorporates spatial and temporal information, enabling the detection of complex landslides and including multiple successive failures occurring in distinct areas of the same slope. To be specific, our method builds upon an existing LID-based technique, known as sLID. We extend its capabilities in three key ways. (1) Kinematic enhancement: we incorporate velocity into the sLID computation to better capture short-term temporal dependencies and deformation rate relationships. (2) Spatial fusion: we apply Bayesian estimation to aggregate sLID values across spatial neighborhoods, effectively embedding spatial correlations into the LID scores. (3) Temporal modeling: we introduce a temporal variant, tLID, that learns long-term dynamics from time series data, providing a robust temporal representation of displacement behavior. Finally, we integrate both components into a unified framework, referred to as spatiotemporal LID (stLID), to identify samples that are anomalous in either or both dimensions. Extensive experiments show that stLID consistently outperforms existing methods in failure detection precision and lead-time.

title: Counting hypertriangles through hypergraph orientations
authors: Daniel Paul-Pena, Vaishali Surianarayanan, Deeparnab Chakrabarty, C. Seshadhri
abstract:
Counting the number of small patterns is a central task in network analysis. While this problem is well studied for graphs, many real-world datasets are naturally modeled as hypergraphs, motivating the need for efficient hypergraph motif counting algorithms. In particular, we study the problem of counting hypertriangles - collections of three pairwise-intersecting hyperedges. These hypergraph patterns have a rich structure with multiple distinct intersection patterns unlike graph triangles.
  Inspired by classical graph algorithms based on orientations and degeneracy, we develop a theoretical framework that generalizes these concepts to hypergraphs and yields provable algorithms for hypertriangle counting. We implement these ideas in DITCH (Degeneracy Inspired Triangle Counter for Hypergraphs) and show experimentally that it is 10-100x faster and more memory efficient than existing state-of-the-art methods.

title: From Score to Sound: An End-to-End MIDI-to-Motion Pipeline for Robotic Cello Performance
authors: Samantha Sudhoff, Pranesh Velmurugan, Jiashu Liu, Vincent Zhao, Yung-Hsiang Lu, Kristen Yeon-Ji Yun
abstract:
Robot musicians require precise control to obtain proper note accuracy, sound quality, and musical expression. Performance of string instruments, such as violin and cello, presents a significant challenge due to the precise control required over bow angle and pressure to produce the desired sound. While prior robotic cellists focus on accurate bowing trajectories, these works often rely on expensive motion capture techniques, and fail to sightread music in a human-like way.
  We propose a novel end-to-end MIDI score to robotic motion pipeline which converts musical input directly into collision-aware bowing motions for a UR5e robot cellist. Through use of Universal Robot Freedrive feature, our robotic musician can achieve human-like sound without the need for motion capture. Additionally, this work records live joint data via Real-Time Data Exchange (RTDE) as the robot plays, providing labeled robotic playing data from a collection of five standard pieces to the research community. To demonstrate the effectiveness of our method in comparison to human performers, we introduce the Musical Turing Test, in which a collection of 132 human participants evaluate our robot's performance against a human baseline. Human reference recordings are also released, enabling direct comparison for future studies. This evaluation technique establishes the first benchmark for robotic cello performance. Finally, we outline a residual reinforcement learning methodology to improve upon baseline robotic controls, highlighting future opportunities for improved string-crossing efficiency and sound quality.

title: How Do Large Language Models Learn Concepts During Continual Pre-Training?
authors: Barry Menglong Yao, Sha Li, Yunzhi Yao, Minqian Liu, Zaishuo Xia, Qifan Wang, Lifu Huang
abstract: Human beings primarily understand the world through concepts (e.g., dog), abstract mental representations that structure perception, reasoning, and learning. However, how large language models (LLMs) acquire, retain, and forget such concepts during continual pretraining remains poorly understood. In this work, we study how individual concepts are acquired and forgotten, as well as how multiple concepts interact through interference and synergy. We link these behavioral dynamics to LLMs' internal Concept Circuits, computational subgraphs associated with specific concepts, and incorporate Graph Metrics to characterize circuit structure. Our analysis reveals: (1) LLMs concept circuits provide a non-trivial, statistically significant signal of concept learning and forgetting; (2) Concept circuits exhibit a stage-wise temporal pattern during continual pretraining, with an early increase followed by gradual decrease and stabilization; (3) concepts with larger learning gains tend to exhibit greater forgetting under subsequent training; (4) semantically similar concepts induce stronger interference than weakly related ones; (5) conceptual knowledge differs in their transferability, with some significantly facilitating the learning of others. Together, our findings offer a circuit-level view of concept learning dynamics and inform the design of more interpretable and robust concept-aware training strategies for LLMs.

title: Auditable DevOps Automation via VSM and GQM
authors: Mamdouh Alenezi
abstract: DevOps automation can accelerate software delivery, yet many organizations still struggle to justify and prioritize automation work in terms of strategic project-management outcomes such as waste reduction, delivery predictability, cross-team coordination, and customer-facing quality. This paper presents \textit{VSM--GQM--DevOps}, a unified, traceable framework that integrates (i) Value Stream Mapping (VSM) to visualize the end-to-end delivery system and quantify delays, rework, and handoffs, (ii) the Goal--Question--Metric (GQM) paradigm to translate stakeholder objectives into a minimal, decision-relevant measurement model (combining DORA with project and team outcomes), and (iii) maturity-aligned DevOps automation to remediate empirically observed bottlenecks through small, reversible interventions. The framework operationalizes traceability from observed waste to goal-aligned questions, metrics, and automation candidates, and provides a defensible prioritization approach that balances expected impact, confidence, and cost. We also define a multi-site, longitudinal mixed-method validation protocol that combines telemetry-based quasi-experimental analysis (interrupted time series and, where feasible, controlled rollouts) with qualitative triangulation from interviews and retrospectives. The expected contribution is a validated pathway and a set of practical instruments that enables organizations to select automation investments that demonstrably improve both delivery performance and project-management outcomes.

title: SpatiaLoc: Leveraging Multi-Level Spatial Enhanced Descriptors for Cross-Modal Localization
authors: Tianyi Shang, Pengjie Xu, Zhaojun Deng, Zhenyu Li, Zhicong Chen, Lijun Wu
abstract: Cross-modal localization using text and point clouds enables robots to localize themselves via natural language descriptions, with applications in autonomous navigation and interaction between humans and robots. In this task, objects often recur across text and point clouds, making spatial relationships the most discriminative cues for localization. Given this characteristic, we present SpatiaLoc, a framework utilizing a coarse-to-fine strategy that emphasizes spatial relationships at both the instance and global levels. In the coarse stage, we introduce a Bezier Enhanced Object Spatial Encoder (BEOSE) that models spatial relationships at the instance level using quadratic Bezier curves. Additionally, a Frequency Aware Encoder (FAE) generates spatial representations in the frequency domain at the global level. In the fine stage, an Uncertainty Aware Gaussian Fine Localizer (UGFL) regresses 2D positions by modeling predictions as Gaussian distributions with a loss function aware of uncertainty. Extensive experiments on KITTI360Pose demonstrate that SpatiaLoc significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods.

title: PsychEthicsBench: Evaluating Large Language Models Against Australian Mental Health Ethics
authors: Yaling Shen, Stephanie Fong, Yiwen Jiang, Zimu Wang, Feilong Tang, Qingyang Xu, Xiangyu Zhao, Zhongxing Xu, Jiahe Liu, Jinpeng Hu, Dominic Dwyer, Zongyuan Ge
abstract: The increasing integration of large language models (LLMs) into mental health applications necessitates robust frameworks for evaluating professional safety alignment. Current evaluative approaches primarily rely on refusal-based safety signals, which offer limited insight into the nuanced behaviors required in clinical practice. In mental health, clinically inadequate refusals can be perceived as unempathetic and discourage help-seeking. To address this gap, we move beyond refusal-centric metrics and introduce \texttt{PsychEthicsBench}, the first principle-grounded benchmark based on Australian psychology and psychiatry guidelines, designed to evaluate LLMs' ethical knowledge and behavioral responses through multiple-choice and open-ended tasks with fine-grained ethicality annotations. Empirical results across 14 models reveal that refusal rates are poor indicators of ethical behavior, revealing a significant divergence between safety triggers and clinical appropriateness. Notably, we find that domain-specific fine-tuning can degrade ethical robustness, as several specialized models underperform their base backbones in ethical alignment. PsychEthicsBench provides a foundation for systematic, jurisdiction-aware evaluation of LLMs in mental health, encouraging more responsible development in this domain.

title: Variational Inference, Entropy, and Orthogonality: A Unified Theory of Mixture-of-Experts
authors: Ye Su, Yong Liu
abstract: Mixture-of-Experts models enable large language models to scale efficiently, as they only activate a subset of experts for each input. Their core mechanisms, Top-k routing and auxiliary load balancing, remain heuristic, however, lacking a cohesive theoretical underpinning to support them. To this end, we build the first unified theoretical framework that rigorously derives these practices as optimal sparse posterior approximation and prior regularization from a Bayesian perspective, while simultaneously framing them as mechanisms to minimize routing ambiguity and maximize channel capacity from an information-theoretic perspective. We also pinpoint the inherent combinatorial hardness of routing, defining it as the NP-hard sparse subset selection problem. We rigorously prove the existence of a "Coherence Barrier"; when expert representations exhibit high mutual coherence, greedy routing strategies theoretically fail to recover the optimal expert subset. Importantly, we formally verify that imposing geometric orthogonality in the expert feature space is sufficient to narrow the divide between the NP-hard global optimum and polynomial-time greedy approximation. Our comparative analyses confirm orthogonality regularization as the optimal engineering relaxation for large-scale models. Our work offers essential theoretical support and technical assurance for a deeper understanding and novel designs of MoE.

title: Local Gradient Regulation Stabilizes Federated Learning under Client Heterogeneity
authors: Ping Luo, Jiahuan Wang, Ziqing Wen, Tao Sun, Dongsheng Li
abstract: Federated learning (FL) enables collaborative model training across distributed clients without sharing raw data, yet its stability is fundamentally challenged by statistical heterogeneity in realistic deployments. Here, we show that client heterogeneity destabilizes FL primarily by distorting local gradient dynamics during client-side optimization, causing systematic drift that accumulates across communication rounds and impedes global convergence. This observation highlights local gradients as a key regulatory lever for stabilizing heterogeneous FL systems. Building on this insight, we develop a general client-side perspective that regulates local gradient contributions without incurring additional communication overhead. Inspired by swarm intelligence, we instantiate this perspective through Exploratory--Convergent Gradient Re-aggregation (ECGR), which balances well-aligned and misaligned gradient components to preserve informative updates while suppressing destabilizing effects. Theoretical analysis and extensive experiments, including evaluations on the LC25000 medical imaging dataset, demonstrate that regulating local gradient dynamics consistently stabilizes federated learning across state-of-the-art methods under heterogeneous data distributions.

title: Detecting AI-Generated Images via Distributional Deviations from Real Images
authors: Yakun Niu, Yingjian Chen, Lei Zhang
abstract: The rapid advancement of generative models has significantly enhanced the quality of AI-generated images, raising concerns about misinformation and the erosion of public trust. Detecting AI-generated images has thus become a critical challenge, particularly in terms of generalizing to unseen generative models. Existing methods using frozen pre-trained CLIP models show promise in generalization but treat the image encoder as a basic feature extractor, failing to fully exploit its potential. In this paper, we perform an in-depth analysis of the frozen CLIP image encoder (CLIP-ViT), revealing that it effectively clusters real images in a high-level, abstract feature space. However, it does not truly possess the ability to distinguish between real and AI-generated images. Based on this analysis, we propose a Masking-based Pre-trained model Fine-Tuning (MPFT) strategy, which introduces a Texture-Aware Masking (TAM) mechanism to mask textured areas containing generative model-specific patterns during fine-tuning. This approach compels CLIP-ViT to attend to the "distributional deviations"from authentic images for AI-generated image detection, thereby achieving enhanced generalization performance. Extensive experiments on the GenImage and UniversalFakeDetect datasets demonstrate that our method, fine-tuned with only a minimal number of images, significantly outperforms existing approaches, achieving up to 98.2% and 94.6% average accuracy on the two datasets, respectively.

title: Deontic Knowledge Graphs for Privacy Compliance in Multimodal Disaster Data Sharing
authors: Kelvin Uzoma Echenim, Karuna Pande Joshi
abstract: Disaster response requires sharing heterogeneous artifacts, from tabular assistance records to UAS imagery, under overlapping privacy mandates. Operational systems often reduce compliance to binary access control, which is brittle in time-critical workflows. We present a novel deontic knowledge graph-based framework that integrates a Disaster Management Knowledge Graph (DKG) with a Policy Knowledge Graph (PKG) derived from IoT-Reg and FEMA/DHS privacy drivers. Our release decision function supports three outcomes: Allow, Block, and Allow-with-Transform. The latter binds obligations to transforms and verifies post-transform compliance via provenance-linked derived artifacts; blocked requests are logged as semantic privacy incidents.
