Unlike traditional operator learning models such as DeepONet and Fourier Neural Operator, which require large paired datasets and often struggle near sharp features, our approach minimizes the residual of a DG-based weak formulation using the Symmetric Interior Penalty Galerkin (SIPG) scheme. DG-FEONet predicts element-wise solution coefficients via a neural network, enabling data-free training without the need for precomputed input-output pairs. We provide theoretical justification through convergence analysis and validate the model's performance on a series of one- and two-dimensional PDE problems, demonstrating accurate recovery of discontinuities, strong generalization across parameter space, and reliable convergence rates. Our results highlight the potential of combining local discretization schemes with machine learning to achieve robust, singularity-aware operator approximation in challenging PDE settings.

title: e5-omni: Explicit Cross-modal Alignment for Omni-modal Embeddings
authors: Haonan Chen, Sicheng Gao, Radu Timofte, Tetsuya Sakai, Zhicheng Dou
abstract: Modern information systems often involve different types of items, e.g., a text query, an image, a video clip, or an audio segment. This motivates omni-modal embedding models that map heterogeneous modalities into a shared space for direct comparison. However, most recent omni-modal embeddings still rely heavily on implicit alignment inherited from pretrained vision-language model (VLM) backbones. In practice, this causes three common issues: (i) similarity logits have modality-dependent sharpness, so scores are not on a consistent scale; (ii) in-batch negatives become less effective over time because mixed-modality batches create an imbalanced hardness distribution; as a result, many negatives quickly become trivial and contribute little gradient; and (iii) embeddings across modalities show mismatched first- and second-order statistics, which makes rankings less stable. To tackle these problems, we propose e5-omni, a lightweight explicit alignment recipe that adapts off-the-shelf VLMs into robust omni-modal embedding models. e5-omni combines three simple components: (1) modality-aware temperature calibration to align similarity scales, (2) a controllable negative curriculum with debiasing to focus on confusing negatives while reducing the impact of false negatives, and (3) batch whitening with covariance regularization to better match cross-modal geometry in the shared embedding space. Experiments on MMEB-V2 and AudioCaps show consistent gains over strong bi-modal and omni-modal baselines, and the same recipe also transfers well to other VLM backbones. We release our model checkpoint at https://huggingface.co/Haon-Chen/e5-omni-7B.
zh_title: e5-omni：显式跨模态对齐以实现全模态嵌入
translation: 现代信息系统通常涉及不同类型的项目，例如文本查询、图像、视频片段或音频片段。这促使人们开发全模态嵌入模型，将异构模态映射到共享空间以进行直接比较。然而，大多数最近的全模态嵌入仍然严重依赖从预训练的视觉-语言模型（VLM）骨干网络继承的隐式对齐。实际上，这会导致三个常见问题：（i）相似度分数具有模态依赖的锐度，因此分数不在一致的尺度上；（ii）随着时间的推移，批内负例的效果会越来越差，因为混合模态批次会产生不平衡的难度分布；因此，许多负例会很快变得无关紧要，贡献的梯度很小；以及（iii）跨模态的嵌入显示出不匹配的一阶和二阶统计数据，这使得排名不太稳定。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了e5-omni，一种轻量级的显式对齐方法，可将现成的VLM适配为鲁棒的全模态嵌入模型。e5-omni结合了三个简单的组件：（1）模态感知温度校准以对齐相似度尺度，（2）具有去偏的受控负例课程，以关注令人困惑的负例，同时减少假负例的影响，以及（3）批白化和协方差正则化，以更好地匹配共享嵌入空间中的跨模态几何。在MMEB-V2和AudioCaps上的实验表明，与强大的双模态和全模态基线相比，e5-omni取得了持续的收益，并且相同的配方也能很好地迁移到其他VLM骨干网络。我们在https://huggingface.co/Haon-Chen/e5-omni-7B发布了我们的模型检查点。
tldr: e5-omni通过显式对齐解决了现有全模态嵌入模型的三个问题：模态依赖的相似度校准、无效的批内负例以及不匹配的跨模态统计数据。它通过模态感知温度校准、可控负例课程和批白化实现这一点，并在实验中取得了优于基线模型的性能。
ai_comments: e5-omni通过引入显式对齐机制，有效地解决了现有全模态嵌入模型的关键痛点，例如模态依赖的尺度问题和负例效率低下。其模块化的设计（温度校准、负例课程、批白化）使其易于集成和扩展。然而，该方法在处理极其罕见或高度特异性模态组合时的鲁棒性仍有待进一步验证。
motivation: 现有全模态嵌入模型严重依赖预训练视觉-语言模型（VLM）的隐式对齐，导致相似度得分尺度不一致、批内负例效果不佳以及跨模态嵌入统计数据不匹配等问题。
method: e5-omni是一种轻量级的显式对齐方法，包含三个组件：1. 模态感知温度校准以对齐相似度尺度；2. 可控负例课程和去偏以关注难例并减少假负例的影响；3. 批白化和协方差正则化以匹配共享嵌入空间的跨模态几何。
results: 在MMEB-V2和AudioCaps数据集上的实验表明，e5-omni相比于强大的双模态和全模态基线模型取得了持续的性能提升，并且该方法可以很好地迁移到其他VLM骨干网络。
conclusion: e5-omni通过显式对齐有效解决了现有全模态嵌入模型的局限性，提高了跨模态嵌入的性能和稳定性。

title: eTracer: Towards Traceable Text Generation via Claim-Level Grounding
authors: Bohao Chu, Qianli Wang, Hendrik Damm, Hui Wang, Ula Muhabbek, Elisabeth Livingstone, Christoph M. Friedrich, Norbert Fuhr
abstract: How can system-generated responses be efficiently verified, especially in the high-stakes biomedical domain? To address this challenge, we introduce eTracer, a plug-and-play framework that enables traceable text generation by grounding claims against contextual evidence. Through post-hoc grounding, each response claim is aligned with contextual evidence that either supports or contradicts it. Building on claim-level grounding results, eTracer not only enables users to precisely trace responses back to their contextual source but also quantifies response faithfulness, thereby enabling the verifiability and trustworthiness of generated responses. Experiments show that our claim-level grounding approach alleviates the limitations of conventional grounding methods in aligning generated statements with contextual sentence-level evidence, resulting in substantial improvements in overall grounding quality and user verification efficiency. The code and data are available at https://github.com/chubohao/eTracer.

title: DisastQA: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating Question Answering in Disaster Management
authors: Zhitong Chen, Kai Yin, Xiangjue Dong, Chengkai Liu, Xiangpeng Li, Yiming Xiao, Bo Li, Junwei Ma, Ali Mostafavi, James Caverlee
abstract: Accurate question answering (QA) in disaster management requires reasoning over uncertain and conflicting information, a setting poorly captured by existing benchmarks built on clean evidence. We introduce DisastQA, a large-scale benchmark of 3,000 rigorously verified questions (2,000 multiple-choice and 1,000 open-ended) spanning eight disaster types. The benchmark is constructed via a human-LLM collaboration pipeline with stratified sampling to ensure balanced coverage. Models are evaluated under varying evidence conditions, from closed-book to noisy evidence integration, enabling separation of internal knowledge from reasoning under imperfect information. For open-ended QA, we propose a human-verified keypoint-based evaluation protocol emphasizing factual completeness over verbosity. Experiments with 20 models reveal substantial divergences from general-purpose leaderboards such as MMLU-Pro. While recent open-weight models approach proprietary systems in clean settings, performance degrades sharply under realistic noise, exposing critical reliability gaps for disaster response. All code, data, and evaluation resources are available at https://github.com/TamuChen18/DisastQA_open.

title: NeuronScope: A Multi-Agent Framework for Explaining Polysemantic Neurons in Language Models
authors: Weiqi Liu, Yongliang Miao, Haiyan Zhao, Yanguang Liu, Mengnan Du
abstract: Neuron-level interpretation in large language models (LLMs) is fundamentally challenged by widespread polysemanticity, where individual neurons respond to multiple distinct semantic concepts. Existing single-pass interpretation methods struggle to faithfully capture such multi-concept behavior. In this work, we propose NeuronScope, a multi-agent framework that reformulates neuron interpretation as an iterative, activation-guided process. NeuronScope explicitly deconstructs neuron activations into atomic semantic components, clusters them into distinct semantic modes, and iteratively refines each explanation using neuron activation feedback. Experiments demonstrate that NeuronScope uncovers hidden polysemanticity and produces explanations with significantly higher activation correlation compared to single-pass baselines.

title: Sandwich Reasoning: An Answer-Reasoning-Answer Approach for Low-Latency Query Correction
authors: Chen Zhang, Kepu Zhang, Jiatong Zhang, Xiao Zhang, Jun Xu
abstract: Query correction is a critical entry point in modern search pipelines, demanding high accuracy strictly within real-time latency constraints. Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning improves accuracy but incurs prohibitive latency for real-time query correction. A potential solution is to output an answer before reasoning to reduce latency; however, under autoregressive decoding, the early answer is independent of subsequent reasoning, preventing the model from leveraging its reasoning capability to improve accuracy. To address this issue, we propose Sandwich Reasoning (SandwichR), a novel approach that explicitly aligns a fast initial answer with post-hoc reasoning, enabling low-latency query correction without sacrificing reasoning-aware accuracy. SandwichR follows an Answer-Reasoning-Answer paradigm, producing an initial correction, an explicit reasoning process, and a final refined correction. To align the initial answer with post-reasoning insights, we design a consistency-aware reinforcement learning (RL) strategy: a dedicated consistency reward enforces alignment between the initial and final corrections, while margin-based rejection sampling prioritizes borderline samples where reasoning drives the most impactful corrective gains. Additionally, we construct a high-quality query correction dataset, addressing the lack of specialized benchmarks for complex query correction. Experimental results demonstrate that SandwichR achieves SOTA accuracy comparable to standard CoT while delivering a 40-70% latency reduction, resolving the latency-accuracy trade-off in online search.

title: Disentangling Aleatoric and Epistemic Uncertainty in Physics-Informed Neural Networks. Application to Insulation Material Degradation Prognostics
authors: Ibai Ramirez, Jokin Alcibar, Joel Pino, Mikel Sanz, Jose I. Aizpurua
abstract: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) provide a framework for integrating physical laws with data. However, their application to Prognostics and Health Management (PHM) remains constrained by the limited uncertainty quantification (UQ) capabilities. Most existing PINN-based prognostics approaches are deterministic or account only for epistemic uncertainty, limiting their suitability for risk-aware decision-making. This work introduces a heteroscedastic Bayesian Physics-Informed Neural Network (B-PINN) framework that jointly models epistemic and aleatoric uncertainty, yielding full predictive posteriors for spatiotemporal insulation material ageing estimation. The approach integrates Bayesian Neural Networks (BNNs) with physics-based residual enforcement and prior distributions, enabling probabilistic inference within a physics-informed learning architecture. The framework is evaluated on transformer insulation ageing application, validated with a finite-element thermal model and field measurements from a solar power plant, and benchmarked against deterministic PINNs, dropout-based PINNs (d-PINNs), and alternative B-PINN variants. Results show that the proposed B-PINN provides improved predictive accuracy and better-calibrated uncertainty estimates than competing approaches. A systematic sensitivity study further analyzes the impact of boundary-condition, initial-condition, and residual sampling strategies on accuracy, calibration, and generalization. Overall, the findings highlight the potential of Bayesian physics-informed learning to support uncertainty-aware prognostics and informed decision-making in transformer asset management.

title: Towards Compositional Generalization of LLMs via Skill Taxonomy Guided Data Synthesis
authors: Yifan Wei, Li Du, Xiaoyan Yu, Yang Feng, Angsheng Li
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) and agent-based systems often struggle with compositional generalization due to a data bottleneck in which complex skill combinations follow a long-tailed, power-law distribution, limiting both instruction-following performance and generalization in agent-centric tasks. To address this challenge, we propose STEPS, a Skill Taxonomy guided Entropy-based Post-training data Synthesis framework for generating compositionally challenging data. STEPS explicitly targets compositional generalization by uncovering latent relationships among skills and organizing them into an interpretable, hierarchical skill taxonomy using structural information theory. Building on this taxonomy, we formulate data synthesis as a constrained information maximization problem, selecting skill combinations that maximize marginal structural information within the hierarchy while preserving semantic coherence. Experiments on challenging instruction-following benchmarks show that STEPS outperforms existing data synthesis baselines, while also yielding improved compositional generalization in downstream agent-based evaluations.
comment: The code and data for our methods and experiments are available at https://github.com/weiyifan1023/STEPS

title: From Implicit to Explicit: Token-Efficient Logical Supervision for Mathematical Reasoning in LLMs
authors: Shaojie Wang, Liang Zhang
abstract: Recent studies reveal that large language models (LLMs) exhibit limited logical reasoning abilities in mathematical problem-solving, instead often relying on pattern-matching and memorization. We systematically analyze this limitation, focusing on logical relationship understanding, which is a core capability underlying genuine logical reasoning, and reveal that errors related to this capability account for over 90\% of incorrect predictions, with Chain-of-Thought Supervised Fine-Tuning (CoT-SFT) failing to substantially reduce these errors. To address this bottleneck, we propose First-Step Logical Reasoning (FSLR), a lightweight training framework targeting logical relationship understanding. Our key insight is that the first planning step-identifying which variables to use and which operation to apply-encourages the model to derive logical relationships directly from the problem statement. By training models on this isolated step, FSLR provides explicit supervision for logical relationship understanding, unlike CoT-SFT which implicitly embeds such relationships within complete solution trajectories. Extensive experiments across multiple models and datasets demonstrate that FSLR consistently outperforms CoT-SFT under both in-distribution and out-of-distribution settings, with average improvements of 3.2\% and 4.6\%, respectively. Moreover, FSLR achieves 4-6x faster training and reduces training token consumption by over 80\%.

title: Accounting for Optimal Control in the Sizing of Isolated Hybrid Renewable Energy Systems Using Imitation Learning
authors: Simon Halvdansson, Lucas Ferreira Bernardino, Brage Rugstad Knudsen
abstract: Decarbonization of isolated or off-grid energy systems through phase-in of large shares of intermittent solar or wind generation requires co-installation of energy storage or continued use of existing fossil dispatchable power sources to balance supply and demand. The effective CO2 emission reduction depends on the relative capacity of the energy storage and renewable sources, the stochasticity of the renewable generation, and the optimal control or dispatch of the isolated energy system. While the operations of the energy storage and dispatchable sources may impact the optimal sizing of the system, it is challenging to account for the effect of finite horizon, optimal control at the stage of system sizing. Here, we present a flexible and computationally efficient sizing framework for energy storage and renewable capacity in isolated energy systems, accounting for uncertainty in the renewable generation and the optimal feedback control. To this end, we implement an imitation learning approach to stochastic neural model predictive control (MPC) which allows us to relate the battery storage and wind peak capacities to the emissions reduction and investment costs while accounting for finite horizon, optimal control. Through this approach, decision makers can evaluate the effective emission reduction and costs of different storage and wind capacities at any price point while accounting for uncertainty in the renewable generation with limited foresight. We evaluate the proposed sizing framework on a case study of an offshore energy system with a gas turbine, a wind farm and a battery energy storage system (BESS). In this case, we find a nonlinear, nontrivial relationship between the investment costs and reduction in gas usage relative to the wind and BESS capacities, emphasizing the complexity and importance of accounting for optimal control in the design of isolated energy systems.

title: Rethinking Recurrent Neural Networks for Time Series Forecasting: A Reinforced Recurrent Encoder with Prediction-Oriented Proximal Policy Optimization
authors: Xin Lai, Shiming Deng, Lu Yu, Yumin Lai, Shenghao Qiao, Xinze Zhang
abstract: Time series forecasting plays a crucial role in contemporary engineering information systems for supporting decision-making across various industries, where Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) have been widely adopted due to their capability in modeling sequential data. Conventional RNN-based predictors adopt an encoder-only strategy with sliding historical windows as inputs to forecast future values. However, this approach treats all time steps and hidden states equally without considering their distinct contributions to forecasting, leading to suboptimal performance. To address this limitation, we propose a novel Reinforced Recurrent Encoder with Prediction-oriented Proximal Policy Optimization, RRE-PPO4Pred, which significantly improves time series modeling capacity and forecasting accuracy of the RNN models. The core innovations of this method are: (1) A novel Reinforced Recurrent Encoder (RRE) framework that enhances RNNs by formulating their internal adaptation as a Markov Decision Process, creating a unified decision environment capable of learning input feature selection, hidden skip connection, and output target selection; (2) An improved Prediction-oriented Proximal Policy Optimization algorithm, termed PPO4Pred, which is equipped with a Transformer-based agent for temporal reasoning and develops a dynamic transition sampling strategy to enhance sampling efficiency; (3) A co-evolutionary optimization paradigm to facilitate the learning of the RNN predictor and the policy agent, providing adaptive and interactive time series modeling. Comprehensive evaluations on five real-world datasets indicate that our method consistently outperforms existing baselines, and attains accuracy better than state-of-the-art Transformer models, thus providing an advanced time series predictor in engineering informatics.

title: Domain Adaptation of the Pyannote Diarization Pipeline for Conversational Indonesian Audio
authors: Muhammad Daffa'i Rafi Prasetyo, Ramadhan Andika Putra, Zaidan Naufal Ilmi, Kurniawati Azizah
abstract: This study presents a domain adaptation approach for speaker diarization targeting conversational Indonesian audio. We address the challenge of adapting an English-centric diarization pipeline to a low-resource language by employing synthetic data generation using neural Text-to-Speech technology. Experiments were conducted with varying training configurations, a small dataset (171 samples) and a large dataset containing 25 hours of synthetic speech. Results demonstrate that the baseline \texttt{pyannote/segmentation-3.0} model, trained on the AMI Corpus, achieves a Diarization Error Rate (DER) of 53.47\% when applied zero-shot to Indonesian. Domain adaptation significantly improves performance, with the small dataset models reducing DER to 34.31\% (1 epoch) and 34.81\% (2 epochs). The model trained on the 25-hour dataset achieves the best performance with a DER of 29.24\%, representing a 13.68\% absolute improvement over the baseline while maintaining 99.06\% Recall and 87.14\% F1-Score.
comment: Experiments conducted using synthetic Indonesian conversational speech for domain adaptation

title: Dual-Attention Heterogeneous GNN for Multi-robot Collaborative Area Search via Deep Reinforcement Learning
authors: Lina Zhu, Jiyu Cheng, Yuehu Liu, Wei Zhang
abstract: In multi-robot collaborative area search, a key challenge is to dynamically balance the two objectives of exploring unknown areas and covering specific targets to be rescued. Existing methods are often constrained by homogeneous graph representations, thus failing to model and balance these distinct tasks. To address this problem, we propose a Dual-Attention Heterogeneous Graph Neural Network (DA-HGNN) trained using deep reinforcement learning. Our method constructs a heterogeneous graph that incorporates three entity types: robot nodes, frontier nodes, and interesting nodes, as well as their historical states. The dual-attention mechanism comprises the relational-aware attention and type-aware attention operations. The relational-aware attention captures the complex spatio-temporal relationships among robots and candidate goals. Building on this relational-aware heterogeneous graph, the type-aware attention separately computes the relevance between robots and each goal type (frontiers vs. points of interest), thereby decoupling the exploration and coverage from the unified tasks. Extensive experiments conducted in interactive 3D scenarios within the iGibson simulator, leveraging the Gibson and MatterPort3D datasets, validate the superior scalability and generalization capability of the proposed approach.

title: Personalized Medication Planning via Direct Domain Modeling and LLM-Generated Heuristics
authors: Yonatan Vernik, Alexander Tuisov, David Izhaki, Hana Weitman, Gal A. Kaminka, Alexander Shleyfman
abstract: Personalized medication planning involves selecting medications and determining a dosing schedule to achieve medical goals specific to each individual patient. Previous work successfully demonstrated that automated planners, using general domain-independent heuristics, are able to generate personalized treatments, when the domain and problems are modeled using a general domain description language (\pddlp). Unfortunately, this process was limited in practice to consider no more than seven medications. In clinical terms, this is a non-starter. In this paper, we explore the use of automatically-generated domain- and problem-specific heuristics to be used with general search, as a method of scaling up medication planning to levels allowing closer work with clinicians. Specifically, we specify the domain programmatically (specifying an initial state and a successor generation procedure), and use an LLM to generate a problem specific heuristic that can be used by a fixed search algorithm (GBFS). The results indicate dramatic improvements in coverage and planning time, scaling up the number of medications to at least 28, and bringing medication planning one step closer to practical applications.

title: A Pre-trained Reaction Embedding Descriptor Capturing Bond Transformation Patterns
authors: Weiqi Liu, Fenglei Cao, Yuan Qi, Li-Cheng Xu
abstract: With the rise of data-driven reaction prediction models, effective reaction descriptors are crucial for bridging the gap between real-world chemistry and digital representations. However, general-purpose, reaction-wise descriptors remain scarce. This study introduces RXNEmb, a novel reaction-level descriptor derived from RXNGraphormer, a model pre-trained to distinguish real reactions from fictitious ones with erroneous bond changes, thereby learning intrinsic bond formation and cleavage patterns. We demonstrate its utility by data-driven re-clustering of the USPTO-50k dataset, yielding a classification that more directly reflects bond-change similarities than rule-based categories. Combined with dimensionality reduction, RXNEmb enables visualization of reaction space diversity. Furthermore, attention weight analysis reveals the model's focus on chemically critical sites, providing mechanistic insight. RXNEmb serves as a powerful, interpretable tool for reaction fingerprinting and analysis, paving the way for more data-centric approaches in reaction analysis and discovery.
zh_title: 一个捕获键变换模式的预训练反应嵌入描述符
translation: 随着数据驱动的反应预测模型的兴起，有效的反应描述符对于弥合真实化学与数字表示之间的鸿沟至关重要。然而，通用、反应级别的描述符仍然稀缺。本研究引入了RXNEmb，一个新颖的反应级描述符，它源自RXNGraphormer模型。该模型经过预训练，用于区分真实反应和具有错误键变化的虚构反应，从而学习固有的成键和断键模式。我们通过对USPTO-50k数据集进行数据驱动的重新聚类，证明了其效用，得到的分类比基于规则的类别更能直接反映键变化相似性。结合降维技术，RXNEmb能够实现反应空间多样性的可视化。此外，注意力权重分析揭示了模型对化学关键位点的关注，提供了机理洞察。RXNEmb可作为反应指纹识别和分析的强大、可解释的工具，为反应分析和发现中的更多数据中心方法铺平了道路。
tldr: 引入了RXNEmb，这是一个基于预训练RXNGraphormer模型的新型反应级描述符。它通过区分真实和虚假反应来学习键变化模式，并被证明在反应聚类、空间可视化和提供机理洞察方面优于传统方法。
ai_comments: 该研究的创新点在于提出了RXNEmb，一个通用的、反应级别的描述符，解决了现有描述符稀缺的问题。通过利用预训练模型（RXNGraphormer）来学习区分真实与虚假键变化的内在模式，RXNEmb实现了对反应本质特征的有效捕获。其重要性在于，它为数据驱动的反应预测和分析提供了一个强大且可解释的基础工具，尤其是在反应聚类和机理洞察方面显示出优越性，推动了化学信息学向更数据中心化的范式发展。
motivation: 随着数据驱动的反应预测模型的兴起，有效的反应描述符至关重要，但通用、反应级别的描述符仍然稀缺。
method: 提出了RXNEmb，一个新颖的反应级描述符，它源自预训练的RXNGraphormer模型。该模型通过区分真实反应和具有错误键变化的虚构反应进行训练，从而学习固有的成键和断键模式。
results: RXNEmb成功地对USPTO-50k数据集进行了数据驱动的重新聚类，其分类结果比基于规则的类别更能直接反映键变化相似性。结合降维技术，它实现了反应空间多样性的可视化。此外，注意力权重分析揭示了模型对化学关键位点的关注，提供了机理洞察。
conclusion: RXNEmb是一种功能强大、可解释的工具，可用于反应指纹识别和分析，为反应分析和发现中的更多数据中心方法铺平了道路。

title: Evaluation Framework for AI Creativity: A Case Study Based on Story Generation
authors: Pharath Sathya, Yin Jou Huang, Fei Cheng
abstract: Evaluating creative text generation remains a challenge because existing reference-based metrics fail to capture the subjective nature of creativity. We propose a structured evaluation framework for AI story generation comprising four components (Novelty, Value, Adherence, and Resonance) and eleven sub-components. Using controlled story generation via ``Spike Prompting'' and a crowdsourced study of 115 readers, we examine how different creative components shape both immediate and reflective human creativity judgments. Our findings show that creativity is evaluated hierarchically rather than cumulatively, with different dimensions becoming salient at different stages of judgment, and that reflective evaluation substantially alters both ratings and inter-rater agreement. Together, these results support the effectiveness of our framework in revealing dimensions of creativity that are obscured by reference-based evaluation.
zh_title: AI创造力评估框架：基于故事生成的案例研究
translation: 评估创造性文本生成仍然是一个挑战，因为现有的基于参考的指标未能捕捉创造力的主观性质。我们提出了一个用于AI故事生成的结构化评估框架，包含四个组成部分（新颖性、价值性、依从性和共鸣性）和十一个子组成部分。通过使用“Spike Prompting”进行受控故事生成，并进行了一项包含115名读者的众包研究，我们检验了不同的创造性组成部分如何塑造即时和反思性的人类创造力判断。我们的研究结果表明，创造力的评估是分层的，而非累积的，且不同维度在判断的不同阶段变得显著，同时反思性评估会显著改变评分和评分者间的一致性。总而言之，这些结果支持了我们的框架在揭示被基于参考的评估所掩盖的创造力维度方面的有效性。
tldr: 针对AI故事生成，提出了一个包含四个维度（新颖性、价值性等）的新型结构化创造力评估框架。研究发现，创造力判断是分层的，且反思性评估会显著改变结果，证明了该框架比传统基于参考的指标更有效。
ai_comments: 本文的主要创新在于提出了一个全面、多维度的评估框架（新颖性、价值性、依从性、共鸣性），专门用于处理AI生成创造性的主观性质，超越了简单的基于参考的指标。研究发现创造力判断是分层的，并且在反思后会发生变化，这一发现至关重要，它揭示了人类感知的复杂性，并为基准测试创造性AI系统提供了一种更细致入微的方法。这项工作对于推动AI创造力评估领域的发展具有重要意义。
motivation: 现有的基于参考的指标无法捕捉创造力的主观性，使得评估创造性文本生成仍然是一个挑战。
method: 提出了一个用于AI故事生成的结构化评估框架，包含四个主要组成部分（新颖性、价值性、依从性和共鸣性）和十一个子组成部分。使用“Spike Prompting”进行受控故事生成，并进行了一项包含115名读者的众包研究，以检验不同创造性组成部分如何影响即时和反思性的人类创造力判断。
results: 创造力的评估是分层的，而非累积的；不同维度在判断的不同阶段变得显著；反思性评估会显著改变评分和评分者间的一致性。
conclusion: 研究结果支持该框架的有效性，能够揭示基于参考的评估所掩盖的创造力维度。

title: RedBench: A Universal Dataset for Comprehensive Red Teaming of Large Language Models
authors: Quy-Anh Dang, Chris Ngo, Truong-Son Hy
abstract: As large language models (LLMs) become integral to safety-critical applications, ensuring their robustness against adversarial prompts is paramount. However, existing red teaming datasets suffer from inconsistent risk categorizations, limited domain coverage, and outdated evaluations, hindering systematic vulnerability assessments. To address these challenges, we introduce RedBench, a universal dataset aggregating 37 benchmark datasets from leading conferences and repositories, comprising 29,362 samples across attack and refusal prompts. RedBench employs a standardized taxonomy with 22 risk categories and 19 domains, enabling consistent and comprehensive evaluations of LLM vulnerabilities. We provide a detailed analysis of existing datasets, establish baselines for modern LLMs, and open-source the dataset and evaluation code. Our contributions facilitate robust comparisons, foster future research, and promote the development of secure and reliable LLMs for real-world deployment. Code: https://github.com/knoveleng/redeval
zh_title: RedBench：一个用于大型语言模型全面红队测试的通用数据集
translation: 随着大型语言模型（LLMs）成为安全关键应用中不可或缺的一部分，确保它们对对抗性提示的鲁棒性至关重要。然而，现有的红队测试数据集存在风险分类不一致、领域覆盖有限以及评估过时的问题，阻碍了系统性的漏洞评估。为了应对这些挑战，我们引入了RedBench，这是一个通用的数据集，它聚合了来自领先会议和存储库的37个基准数据集，包含29,362个攻击和拒绝提示样本。RedBench采用了标准化的分类法，包含22个风险类别和19个领域，从而能够对LLM的漏洞进行一致且全面的评估。我们提供了对现有数据集的详细分析，建立了现代LLMs的基线，并开源了该数据集和评估代码。我们的贡献促进了稳健的比较，推动了未来的研究，并促进了用于实际部署的安全可靠的LLMs的开发。代码：https://github.com/knoveleng/redeval
tldr: RedBench是一个通用的、汇集了37个基准数据集的大型语言模型（LLM）红队测试数据集，旨在通过标准化的风险分类法（22类风险，19个领域）解决现有数据集不一致和覆盖有限的问题，从而实现对LLM漏洞的全面评估。
ai_comments: RedBench的关键创新在于其对现有红队测试数据集的聚合（37个）和标准化。通过引入统一的22种风险类别和19个领域的分类法，它解决了现有安全评估中碎片化、分类不一致和覆盖有限的问题，为LLM漏洞的系统性和可比较的评估提供了通用框架，对LLM安全基准研究具有重要意义。
motivation: 确保大型语言模型（LLMs）在安全关键应用中对对抗性提示的鲁棒性。现有红队数据集存在风险分类不一致、领域覆盖有限和评估过时的问题，阻碍了系统性的漏洞评估。
method: 聚合了来自领先会议和存储库的37个基准数据集，构建了包含29,362个样本（包括攻击和拒绝提示）的RedBench。该数据集采用了标准化的分类法，包含22个风险类别和19个领域，以确保评估的一致性和全面性。
results: 提供了对现有数据集的详细分析，并建立了现代大型语言模型的基线。数据集和评估代码已开源。
conclusion: RedBench促进了稳健的模型比较，推动了未来的研究，并有助于开发用于实际部署的安全可靠的大型语言模型。

title: Detection and Prevention of Process Disruption Attacks in the Electrical Power Systems using MMS Traffic: An EPIC Case
authors: Praneeta K Maganti, Daisuke Mashima, Rajib Ranjan Maiti
abstract: Smart grids are increasingly exposed to sophisticated cyber threats due to their reliance on interconnected communication networks, as demonstrated by real world incidents such as the cyberattacks on the Ukrainian power grid. In IEC61850 based smart substations, the Manufacturing Message Specification protocol operates over TCP to facilitate communication between SCADA systems and field devices such as Intelligent Electronic Devices and Programmable Logic Controllers. Although MMS enables efficient monitoring and control, it can be exploited by adversaries to generate legitimate looking packets for reconnaissance, unauthorized state reading, and malicious command injection, thereby disrupting grid operations. In this work, we propose a fully automated attack detection and prevention framework for IEC61850 compliant smart substations to counter remote cyberattacks that manipulate process states through compromised PLCs and IEDs. A detailed analysis of the MMS protocol is presented, and critical MMS field value pairs are extracted during both normal SCADA operation and active attack conditions. The proposed framework is validated using seven datasets comprising benign operational scenarios and multiple attack instances, including IEC61850Bean based attacks and script driven attacks leveraging the libiec61850 library. Our approach accurately identifies attack signature carrying MMS packets that attempt to disrupt circuit breaker status, specifically targeting the smart home zone IED and PLC of the EPIC testbed. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework in precisely detecting malicious MMS traffic and enhancing the cyber resilience of IEC61850 based smart grid environments.
zh_title: 使用MMS流量检测和预防电力系统中的过程中断攻击：一个EPIC案例
translation: 智能电网由于依赖互联通信网络，日益暴露于复杂的网络威胁之下，正如对乌克兰电网的网络攻击等现实世界事件所证明的那样。在基于IEC61850的智能变电站中，制造报文规范（MMS）协议通过TCP运行，以促进SCADA系统与现场设备（如智能电子设备（IED）和可编程逻辑控制器（PLC））之间的通信。尽管MMS实现了高效的监控和控制，但它可能被攻击者利用来生成看似合法的报文，用于侦察、未经授权的状态读取和恶意命令注入，从而中断电网运行。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种针对IEC61850兼容智能变电站的全自动攻击检测和预防框架，以应对通过受损PLC和IED操纵过程状态的远程网络攻击。本文详细分析了MMS协议，并在正常SCADA操作和主动攻击条件下提取了关键的MMS字段值对。所提出的框架使用七个数据集进行了验证，这些数据集包括良性运行场景和多个攻击实例，包括基于IEC61850Bean的攻击和利用libiec61850库的脚本驱动攻击。我们的方法准确识别了试图破坏断路器状态的、携带攻击特征的MMS数据包，具体目标是EPIC测试平台的智能家居区域的IED和PLC。结果证明了所提出的框架在精确检测恶意MMS流量和增强基于IEC61850的智能电网环境的网络弹性方面的有效性。
tldr: 针对IEC61850智能变电站，本文提出了一种全自动的检测和预防框架，通过分析MMS流量中的关键字段值对，有效识别并阻止了针对断路器状态的恶意网络攻击，增强了智能电网的弹性。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了一个专门针对IEC61850标准中MMS流量的自动化检测和预防框架，这直接解决了智能电网/智能变电站面临的实际且复杂的网络安全挑战。其重要性在于，MMS协议是SCADA与现场设备通信的核心，对其进行深度分析和特征提取（关键MMS字段值对）能够有效区分合法操作和伪装的恶意指令。通过在现实测试平台（EPIC）上使用多种攻击工具（IEC61850Bean, libiec61850）进行验证，提高了研究结果的实用性和可信度。该研究为增强关键电力基础设施的网络弹性提供了具体的、基于协议层面的解决方案。
motivation: 智能电网（特别是基于IEC61850的智能变电站）因依赖互联通信网络而面临复杂的网络威胁。制造报文规范（MMS）协议虽然实现了高效的监控和控制，但可能被攻击者利用来生成看似合法的报文，进行侦察、未经授权的状态读取和恶意命令注入，从而中断电网运行。
method: 提出了一种针对IEC61850兼容智能变电站的全自动攻击检测和预防框架。该方法包括对MMS协议的详细分析，并在正常SCADA操作和主动攻击条件下提取关键的MMS字段值对作为特征。框架使用七个数据集进行验证，数据集包含良性运行场景和多种攻击实例（包括基于IEC61850Bean和利用libiec61850库的攻击）。
results: 该方法成功地识别了携带攻击特征的MMS数据包，这些数据包试图破坏断路器的状态，并具体针对EPIC测试平台的智能家居区域的IED和PLC。实验结果证明了所提出框架在精确检测恶意MMS流量方面的有效性。
conclusion: 所提出的框架能够精确检测恶意MMS流量，并有效增强基于IEC61850的智能电网环境的网络弹性。

title: Can AI Chatbots Provide Coaching in Engineering? Beyond Information Processing Toward Mastery
authors: Junaid Qadir, Muhammad Adil Attique, Saleha Shoaib, Syed Ibrahim Ghaznavi
abstract: Engineering education faces a double disruption: traditional apprenticeship models that cultivated judgment and tacit skill are eroding, just as generative AI emerges as an informal coaching partner. This convergence rekindles long-standing questions in the philosophy of AI and cognition about the limits of computation, the nature of embodied rationality, and the distinction between information processing and wisdom. Building on this rich intellectual tradition, this paper examines whether AI chatbots can provide coaching that fosters mastery rather than merely delivering information. We synthesize critical perspectives from decades of scholarship on expertise, tacit knowledge, and human-machine interaction, situating them within the context of contemporary AI-driven education. Empirically, we report findings from a mixed-methods study (N = 75 students, N = 7 faculty) exploring the use of a coaching chatbot in engineering education. Results reveal a consistent boundary: participants accept AI for technical problem solving (convergent tasks; M = 3.84 on a 1-5 Likert scale) but remain skeptical of its capacity for moral, emotional, and contextual judgment (divergent tasks). Faculty express stronger concerns over risk (M = 4.71 vs. M = 4.14, p = 0.003), and privacy emerges as a key requirement, with 64-71 percent of participants demanding strict confidentiality. Our findings suggest that while generative AI can democratize access to cognitive and procedural support, it cannot replicate the embodied, value-laden dimensions of human mentorship. We propose a multiplex coaching framework that integrates human wisdom within expert-in-the-loop models, preserving the depth of apprenticeship while leveraging AI scalability to enrich the next generation of engineering education.
zh_title: 聊天机器人能否在工程领域提供指导？超越信息处理，迈向精通。
translation: 工程教育面临双重颠覆：培养判断力和默会技能的传统学徒制模式正在瓦解，同时生成式AI正在成为非正式的指导伙伴。这种融合重新引发了AI与认知哲学中关于计算的局限性、具身理性本质以及信息处理与智慧之间区别的长期问题。本文立足于这一丰富的知识传统，检验了AI聊天机器人是否能提供培养精通而非仅仅传递信息的指导。我们综合了数十年关于专业知识、默会知识和人机交互学术研究的批判性观点，并将其置于当代AI驱动的教育背景下。在实证方面，我们报告了一项混合方法研究（N = 75名学生，N = 7名教职员工）的发现，该研究探索了在工程教育中使用指导型聊天机器人的情况。结果揭示了一个一致的界限：参与者接受AI用于技术问题解决（收敛性任务；M = 3.84，基于1-5李克特量表），但对其在道德、情感和情境判断（发散性任务）方面的能力表示怀疑。教职员工对风险表达了更强烈的担忧（M = 4.71 vs. M = 4.14, p = 0.003），并且隐私成为一个关键要求，有64-71%的参与者要求严格保密。我们的发现表明，虽然生成式AI可以普及认知和程序性支持，但它无法复制人类导师所具有的具身化、价值导向的维度。我们提出了一个多重指导框架，将人类智慧整合到“专家在环”模型中，从而在利用AI可扩展性的同时保留学徒制的深度，以丰富下一代工程教育。
tldr: AI聊天机器人在工程教育中可以提供技术支持，但无法处理需要道德和情境判断的发散性任务，也无法取代人类导师的具身智慧。研究提出了整合人类专家的多重指导框架。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新之处在于，它超越了简单地测试AI传递事实（信息处理）的能力，解决了培养“精通”和“默会知识”这一更深层次的哲学和教学挑战，这些技能传统上是通过人类学徒制培养的。它的重要性在于为AI在高风险领域（如工程）的应用提供了经验性的界限，明确划分了AI被接受的领域（技术/收敛性任务）和人类智慧仍然不可或缺的领域（道德/发散性/情境判断）。提出的“专家在环”框架是一种实用的解决方案，可以在不牺牲必要的人类元素的情况下整合AI的可扩展性，同时解决了研究中识别出的风险和隐私等关键问题。
motivation: 工程教育中培养判断力和默会技能的传统学徒制模式正在瓦解，同时生成式AI正在成为非正式的指导伙伴。这促使研究AI聊天机器人是否能够提供培养精通（而非仅仅是信息传递）的指导。
method: 综合了关于专业知识、默会知识和人机交互的数十年学术研究的批判性观点。实证方面，报告了一项混合方法研究（N = 75名学生，N = 7名教职员工）的发现，该研究探索了在工程教育中使用指导型聊天机器人的情况。
results: 参与者接受AI用于技术问题解决（收敛性任务；M = 3.84），但对其在道德、情感和情境判断（发散性任务）方面的能力表示怀疑。教职员工对风险的担忧更强烈（M = 4.71 vs. M = 4.14, p = 0.003）。隐私是一个关键要求（64-71%的参与者要求严格保密）。
conclusion: 生成式AI可以普及认知和程序性支持，但无法复制人类导师所具有的具身化、价值导向的维度。因此，论文提出了一个多重指导框架，将人类智慧整合到“专家在环”模型中，以保留学徒制的深度并利用AI的可扩展性，从而丰富下一代工程教育。

title: ADEPT: Adaptive Dynamic Early-Exit Process for Transformers
authors: Sangmin Yoo, Srikanth Malla, Chiho Choi, Wei D. Lu, Joon Hee Choi
abstract: The inference of large language models imposes significant computational workloads, often requiring the processing of billions of parameters. Although early-exit strategies have proven effective in reducing computational demands by halting inference earlier, they apply either to only the first token in the generation phase or at the prompt level in the prefill phase. Thus, the Key-Value (KV) cache for skipped layers remains a bottleneck for subsequent token generation, limiting the benefits of early exit. We introduce ADEPT (Adaptive Dynamic Early-exit Process for Transformers), a novel approach designed to overcome this issue and enable dynamic early exit in both the prefill and generation phases. The proposed adaptive token-level early-exit mechanism adjusts computation dynamically based on token complexity, optimizing efficiency without compromising performance. ADEPT further enhances KV generation procedure by decoupling sequential dependencies in skipped layers, making token-level early exit more practical. Experimental results demonstrate that ADEPT improves efficiency by up to 25% in language generation tasks and achieves a 4x speed-up in downstream classification tasks, with up to a 45% improvement in performance.
zh_title: ADEPT：面向 Transformer 的自适应动态提前退出过程
translation: 大型语言模型的推理带来了巨大的计算工作负载，通常需要处理数十亿个参数。尽管提前退出策略已被证明能通过提前停止推理来有效减少计算需求，但它们要么仅应用于生成阶段的第一个令牌，要么仅应用于预填充阶段的提示级别。因此，跳过层的 Key-Value (KV) 缓存仍然是后续令牌生成的瓶颈，限制了提前退出的益处。我们引入了 ADEPT（面向 Transformer 的自适应动态提前退出过程），这是一种旨在克服此问题并实现预填充和生成阶段动态提前退出的新方法。所提出的自适应逐令牌提前退出机制根据令牌的复杂性动态调整计算，从而在不影响性能的情况下优化效率。ADEPT 通过解耦跳过层中的序列依赖关系，进一步增强了 KV 缓存生成过程，使逐令牌提前退出更加实用。实验结果表明，ADEPT 在语言生成任务中将效率提高了高达 25%，并在下游分类任务中实现了 4 倍的加速，性能提升高达 45%。
tldr: 针对大型语言模型推理计算量大的问题，本文提出了 ADEPT，一种在预填充和生成阶段均适用的自适应动态逐令牌提前退出机制，通过解耦跳过层的 KV 缓存依赖，将生成任务效率提升高达 25%，分类任务速度提升 4 倍。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于解决了现有提前退出策略在实际应用中的关键瓶颈——即跳过层的 Key-Value (KV) 缓存依赖问题。通过在预填充和生成阶段实现动态的、逐令牌的退出，并解耦 KV 缓存，ADEPT 显著提高了大型语言模型推理的实用性和部署效率。这是一个对降低 LLM 运营成本和提高实时性能至关重要的贡献。
motivation: 大型语言模型（LLM）的推理计算量巨大。虽然现有的提前退出策略能减少计算，但它们要么只应用于生成阶段的第一个令牌，要么只应用于预填充阶段的提示级别，导致跳过层的 Key-Value (KV) 缓存仍然是后续令牌生成的瓶颈，限制了提前退出带来的益处。
method: 提出 ADEPT（面向 Transformer 的自适应动态提前退出过程）。该方法引入了一种新的自适应逐令牌提前退出机制，可根据令牌复杂性动态调整计算。它通过解耦跳过层中的序列依赖关系，改进了 KV 缓存的生成过程，使逐令牌提前退出更加实用。
results: 在语言生成任务中，效率提高了高达 25%。在下游分类任务中，实现了 4 倍的加速，性能提升高达 45%。
conclusion: ADEPT 通过实现预填充和生成阶段的动态逐令牌提前退出，并解耦跳过层的 KV 缓存依赖，成功克服了现有策略的局限性，在语言生成和分类任务中显著提高了效率和性能。

title: Inference Attacks Against Graph Generative Diffusion Models
authors: Xiuling Wang, Xin Huang, Guibo Luo, Jianliang Xu
abstract: Graph generative diffusion models have recently emerged as a powerful paradigm for generating complex graph structures, effectively capturing intricate dependencies and relationships within graph data. However, the privacy risks associated with these models remain largely unexplored. In this paper, we investigate information leakage in such models through three types of black-box inference attacks. First, we design a graph reconstruction attack, which can reconstruct graphs structurally similar to those training graphs from the generated graphs. Second, we propose a property inference attack to infer the properties of the training graphs, such as the average graph density and the distribution of densities, from the generated graphs. Third, we develop two membership inference attacks to determine whether a given graph is present in the training set. Extensive experiments on three different types of graph generative diffusion models and six real-world graphs demonstrate the effectiveness of these attacks, significantly outperforming the baseline approaches. Finally, we propose two defense mechanisms that mitigate these inference attacks and achieve a better trade-off between defense strength and target model utility than existing methods. Our code is available at https://zenodo.org/records/17946102.
comment: This work has been accepted by USENIX Security 2026
zh_title: 针对图生成扩散模型的推理攻击
translation: 图生成扩散模型最近已成为生成复杂图结构的强大范例，可有效捕获图数据中错综复杂的依赖关系和关联。然而，与这些模型相关的隐私风险在很大程度上尚未得到探索。在本文中，我们通过三种类型的黑盒推理攻击来调查此类模型中的信息泄露问题。首先，我们设计了一种图重建攻击，可以从生成的图重建出与训练图结构相似的图。其次，我们提出了一种属性推理攻击，可以从生成的图推断出训练图的属性，例如平均图密度和密度分布。第三，我们开发了两种成员身份推理攻击，用于确定给定的图是否存在于训练集中。在三种不同类型的图生成扩散模型和六个真实世界图上进行的广泛实验证明了这些攻击的有效性，显著优于基线方法。最后，我们提出了两种防御机制，可以减轻这些推理攻击，并在防御强度和目标模型效用之间实现了比现有方法更好的权衡。我们的代码可在 https://zenodo.org/records/17946102 获取。
tldr: 图生成扩散模型容易受到黑盒推理攻击（重建、属性推断、成员身份推断）导致的数据泄露。本文设计了三种有效的攻击方法，并提出了两种在隐私保护和模型效用之间取得更好平衡的防御机制。
ai_comments: 本文的创新性在于系统地将黑盒推理攻击（包括重建、属性推断和成员身份推断）应用于新兴且强大的图生成扩散模型。这揭示了这类模型中一个关键且未被充分探索的隐私漏洞。研究的重要性在于强调了在利用这类模型生成复杂图结构时，必须关注和解决训练数据的隐私泄露问题。同时，提出的防御机制为后续研究提供了实用的解决方案，平衡了隐私保护和模型效用。
motivation: 图生成扩散模型在生成复杂图结构方面表现出色，但与其相关的隐私风险在很大程度上尚未得到探索。本文旨在调查此类模型中的信息泄露问题。
method: 通过三种类型的黑盒推理攻击来研究信息泄露：1. 图重建攻击（从生成的图重建出结构相似的训练图）；2. 属性推理攻击（从生成的图推断训练图的属性，如平均密度和密度分布）；3. 成员身份推理攻击（确定给定图是否在训练集中）。最后，提出了两种防御机制来减轻这些攻击。
results: 在三种不同的图生成扩散模型和六个真实世界图上进行的广泛实验证明了这些攻击的有效性，显著优于基线方法。此外，提出的两种防御机制能够减轻这些推理攻击，并在防御强度和目标模型效用之间实现了比现有方法更好的权衡。
conclusion: 图生成扩散模型容易受到信息泄露的推理攻击。本文提出的黑盒攻击在图重建、属性推断和成员身份推断方面非常有效。同时，提出的防御机制可以有效地减轻这些攻击，并优化了防御强度与模型效用之间的平衡。

title: TreeAdv: Tree-Structured Advantage Redistribution for Group-Based RL
authors: Lang Cao, Hui Ruan, Yongqian Li, Peng Chao, Wu Ning, Haonan Song, Renhong Chen, Yitong Li
abstract: Reinforcement learning with group-based objectives, such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), is a common framework for aligning large language models on complex reasoning tasks. However, standard GRPO treats each rollout trajectory as an independent flat sequence and assigns a single sequence-level advantage to all tokens, which leads to sample inefficiency and a length bias toward verbose, redundant chains of thought without improving logical depth. We introduce TreeAdv (Tree-Structured Advantage Redistribution for Group-Based RL), which makes the tree structure of group rollouts explicit for both exploration and advantage assignment. Specifically, TreeAdv builds a group of trees (a forest) based on an entropy-driven sampling method where each tree branches at high-uncertainty decisions while sharing low-uncertainty tokens across rollouts. Then, TreeAdv aggregates token-level advantages for internal tree segments by redistributing the advantages of complete rollouts (all leaf nodes), and TreeAdv can easily apply to group-based objectives such as GRPO or GSPO. Across 10 math reasoning benchmarks, TreeAdv consistently outperforms GRPO and GSPO, while using substantially fewer generated tokens under identical supervision, data, and decoding budgets.
zh_title: TreeAdv：面向群组强化学习的树形结构优势重分配
translation: 基于群组目标的强化学习（例如群组相对策略优化，GRPO）是用于在复杂推理任务上对大型语言模型进行对齐的常见框架。然而，标准的GRPO将每个rollout轨迹视为一个独立的平面序列，并为所有标记分配单一的序列级优势值，这导致样本效率低下，并产生对冗长、冗余的思维链的长度偏差，而没有提高逻辑深度。我们引入了TreeAdv（面向群组强化学习的树形结构优势重分配），它明确了群组rollout的树形结构，用于探索和优势分配。具体来说，TreeAdv基于熵驱动的采样方法构建了一组树（一个森林），其中每棵树在高不确定性决策处进行分支，同时在不同rollout间共享低不确定性标记。然后，TreeAdv通过重新分配完整rollout（所有叶节点）的优势值，来聚合内部树段的标记级优势值，并且TreeAdv可以轻松应用于GRPO或GSPO等群组目标。在10个数学推理基准测试中，TreeAdv持续优于GRPO和GSPO，同时在相同的监督、数据和解码预算下，使用的生成标记数量显著减少。
tldr: TreeAdv通过显式地利用群组rollout的树形结构和熵驱动采样，解决了标准群组RL（如GRPO）的样本效率低下和长度偏差问题，并在数学推理任务上以更少的标记生成量持续超越GRPO和GSPO。
ai_comments: 这项工作的创新点在于将强化学习中的优势分配机制与大型语言模型（LLMs）推理过程的内在树状搜索结构相结合。通过从平面序列视图转向树结构视图，TreeAdv能够更精确地在标记级别分配信用（优势），这解决了标准序列级优势分配导致的信度分配模糊问题（credit assignment problem）。其重要性在于，它提高了LLM对齐的样本效率，并鼓励模型生成逻辑更深、而非仅仅更长的思维链，这对于依赖复杂推理的AI应用至关重要。
motivation: 现有的群组强化学习（如GRPO）将轨迹视为独立的平面序列，并分配单一的序列级优势值，这导致样本效率低下，并偏向于生成冗长、冗余的思维链，而没有提高逻辑深度。
method: 提出了TreeAdv，它明确了群组rollout的树形结构以进行探索和优势分配。具体方法包括：1) 基于熵驱动的采样构建“森林”（一组树），在高不确定性决策处分支，共享低不确定性标记；2) 通过重新分配完整rollout（叶节点）的优势值，聚合内部树段的标记级优势值。TreeAdv可应用于GRPO或GSPO等群组目标。
results: 在10个数学推理基准测试中，TreeAdv持续优于GRPO和GSPO，并且在相同的监督、数据和解码预算下，使用的生成标记数量显著减少。

title: AirNav: A Large-Scale Real-World UAV Vision-and-Language Navigation Dataset with Natural and Diverse Instructions
authors: Hengxing Cai, Yijie Rao, Ligang Huang, Zanyang Zhong, Jinhan Dong, Jingjun Tan, Wenhao Lu, Renxin Zhong
abstract: Existing Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) datasets face issues such as dependence on virtual environments, lack of naturalness in instructions, and limited scale. To address these challenges, we propose AirNav, a large-scale UAV VLN benchmark constructed from real urban aerial data, rather than synthetic environments, with natural and diverse instructions. Additionally, we introduce the AirVLN-R1, which combines Supervised Fine-Tuning and Reinforcement Fine-Tuning to enhance performance and generalization. The feasibility of the model is preliminarily evaluated through real-world tests. Our dataset and code are publicly available.
zh_title: AirNav：一个具有自然多样指令的大规模真实世界无人机视觉-语言导航数据集
translation: 现有的无人机视觉-语言导航（UAV Vision-Language Navigation, VLN）数据集面临着依赖虚拟环境、指令缺乏自然性以及规模有限等问题。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了AirNav，这是一个从真实的城市航拍数据而非合成环境中构建的大规模UAV VLN基准数据集，具有自然和多样化的指令。此外，我们引入了AirVLN-R1模型，该模型结合了监督微调（Supervised Fine-Tuning）和强化微调（Reinforcement Fine-Tuning）以提高性能和泛化能力。通过真实世界的测试，初步评估了该模型的可行性。我们的数据集和代码是公开可用的。
tldr: 研究者提出了AirNav，一个基于真实城市航拍数据的大规模无人机视觉-语言导航（VLN）数据集，以解决现有数据集中虚拟环境、指令不自然和规模有限的问题。同时提出了结合SFT和RFT的AirVLN-R1模型进行基准测试。
ai_comments: 本文的主要创新点在于构建了一个基于真实世界、大规模、具有自然多样指令的无人机VLN数据集（AirNav），这直接解决了现有研究过度依赖合成环境和指令自然性不足的局限性，对于推动真实世界的无人机自主导航研究具有重要意义。提出的AirVLN-R1模型结合了SFT和RFT，为该任务提供了一个强大的基线方法。
motivation: 现有的无人机视觉-语言导航（UAV VLN）数据集面临依赖虚拟环境、指令缺乏自然性以及规模有限的问题。
method: 1. 构建了AirNav数据集，该数据集基于真实的城市航拍数据，具有自然和多样化的指令。2. 提出了AirVLN-R1模型，该模型结合了监督微调（Supervised Fine-Tuning, SFT）和强化微调（Reinforcement Fine-Tuning, RFT）以增强性能和泛化能力。
results: 通过真实世界的测试，初步评估了所提出模型（AirVLN-R1）的可行性。

title: A Chromatographic Process Design and Optimization Platform Powered by Large Language Models: A Case Application on Extract of Ginkgo Biloba Leaf
authors: Zhilong Tang, Shaohua Wu, Xinyan Zhao, Yu Wang, Xingchu Gong
abstract: Chromatographic separation technology has been widely applied in pharmaceutical, chemical, and food industries due to its high efficiency. However, traditional human-dependent chromatographic process development faces challenges such as reliance on expert experience, long development cycles, and labor intensity. ChromR, a large language model (LLM)-driven platform for chromatographic process design and optimization, is presented in this work. The platform integrates ChromLLM, a domain-specific LLM trained for chromatography, along with a multi-agent system and an automated chromatographic experimental device. The multi-agent system comprises four agents: domain knowledge answering, experimental design, experimental execution, and data analysis. ChromR enables automatic completion of the entire workflow-including initial process parameter recommendation, experimental design, automated execution, data analysis, and multi-objective optimization. By utilizing ChromR, dependency on expert knowledge is effectively reduced, while labor input and development time are significantly decreased. Chromatographic purification of the extract of Ginkgo biloba leaf (EGBL) was selected as a case study. ChromR successfully developed a chromatographic process within one week that meets multiple objectives, including fraction quality and production efficiency, reducing development time to approximately one-seventh of that required by the conventional paradigm. An intelligent, automated, and universally applicable new paradigm was established for chromatographic process development.
zh_title: 基于大型语言模型的色谱过程设计与优化平台：以银杏叶提取物为例
translation: 色谱分离技术因其高效率而被广泛应用于制药、化工和食品工业。然而，传统的、依赖人工的色谱过程开发面临着依赖专家经验、开发周期长和劳动强度大等挑战。本文提出了一种由大型语言模型（LLM）驱动的色谱过程设计与优化平台——ChromR。该平台集成了专用于色谱的领域特定LLM（ChromLLM）、一个多智能体系统以及一个自动化色谱实验设备。多智能体系统包含四个智能体：领域知识问答、实验设计、实验执行和数据分析。ChromR 能够自动完成整个工作流程，包括初始过程参数推荐、实验设计、自动化执行、数据分析和多目标优化。通过使用 ChromR，对专家知识的依赖性被有效降低，同时人力投入和开发时间也显著减少。选择了银杏叶提取物（EGBL）的色谱纯化作为案例研究。ChromR 成功地在一周内开发出满足包括馏分质量和生产效率在内的多目标的色谱工艺，将开发时间缩短至传统范式所需时间的约七分之一。这为色谱过程开发建立了一种智能、自动化且普遍适用的新范式。
tldr: 研发了一个名为 ChromR 的基于大型语言模型（LLM）和多智能体系统的自动化平台，用于色谱过程的设计与优化。通过在银杏叶提取物纯化中的应用，该平台能在一周内自动完成整个流程，将开发时间缩短至传统方法的七分之一。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将领域特定大型语言模型（ChromLLM）与多智能体系统及自动化实验设备相结合，构建了一个名为 ChromR 的全自动色谱过程设计与优化平台。这代表了化学和制药工艺开发领域从传统的依赖专家经验向人工智能驱动的自动化科学发现的重大范式转变。该平台通过实现从参数推荐到多目标优化的全流程自动化，显著解决了传统方法开发周期长、人力投入大的痛点。在实际应用中，它将银杏叶提取物纯化工艺的开发时间缩短至传统方法的七分之一，展示了其在提高效率和降低成本方面的巨大潜力，为复杂混合物分离工艺的快速开发提供了一个通用且智能化的解决方案。
motivation: 传统的色谱分离过程开发严重依赖专家经验，面临着开发周期长和劳动强度大等挑战，需要一种更高效、自动化的新范式。
method: 提出了 ChromR 平台，它集成了专用于色谱的领域特定 LLM（ChromLLM）、一个包含四个智能体（领域知识问答、实验设计、实验执行、数据分析）的多智能体系统，以及自动化色谱实验设备。该平台实现了从初始参数推荐、实验设计、自动化执行、数据分析到多目标优化的全流程自动化。
results: 在银杏叶提取物（EGBL）的色谱纯化案例研究中，ChromR 平台成功地在一周内开发出满足包括馏分质量和生产效率在内的多目标色谱工艺，将开发时间缩短至传统范式的约七分之一。
conclusion: 建立了一种智能、自动化且普遍适用的色谱过程开发新范式，有效减少了对专家知识的依赖，并显著降低了人力投入和开发时间。

title: The Geometry of the Pivot: A Note on Lazy Pivoted Cholesky and Farthest Point Sampling
authors: Gil Shabat
abstract: Low-rank approximations of large kernel matrices are ubiquitous in machine learning, particularly for scaling Gaussian Processes to massive datasets. The Pivoted Cholesky decomposition is a standard tool for this task, offering a computationally efficient, greedy low-rank approximation. While its algebraic properties are well-documented in numerical linear algebra, its geometric intuition within the context of kernel methods often remains obscure. In this note, we elucidate the geometric interpretation of the algorithm within the Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Space (RKHS). We demonstrate that the pivotal selection step is mathematically equivalent to Farthest Point Sampling (FPS) using the kernel metric, and that the Cholesky factor construction is an implicit Gram-Schmidt orthogonalization. We provide a concise derivation and a minimalist Python implementation to bridge the gap between theory and practice.
zh_title: 枢轴的几何：关于惰性枢轴Cholesky分解和最远点采样的注释
translation: 大规模核矩阵的低秩近似在机器学习中无处不在，尤其是在将高斯过程扩展到海量数据集时。枢轴Cholesky分解是执行此任务的标准工具，提供了一种计算高效的贪婪低秩近似。尽管其代数特性在数值线性代数中已有充分记录，但其在核方法背景下的几何直觉通常仍然模糊。在本注释中，我们阐明了该算法在再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）中的几何解释。我们证明了枢轴选择步骤在数学上等同于使用核度量的最远点采样（FPS），并且Cholesky因子构造是一种隐式Gram-Schmidt正交化。我们提供了一个简洁的推导和一个极简的Python实现，以弥合理论与实践之间的差距。
tldr: 枢轴Cholesky分解（用于大规模核矩阵低秩近似）在几何上等同于在再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）中使用核度量的最远点采样（FPS），且其因子构造是一种隐式Gram-Schmidt正交化。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于将数值线性代数中的标准算法（枢轴Cholesky分解）与核方法中的几何采样技术（最远点采样）建立了明确的、数学等价的联系。这种几何洞察对于理解和潜在改进大规模高斯过程的稀疏化和缩放策略至关重要，弥合了代数效率和几何直觉之间的鸿沟。论文通过提供简洁的理论推导和极简实现，成功地将理论与实践联系起来。
motivation: 低秩近似对于将高斯过程扩展到大规模数据集至关重要。虽然枢轴Cholesky分解的代数特性已得到充分记录，但其在核方法背景下的几何直觉通常仍然模糊，需要被阐明。
method: 通过在再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）中分析枢轴Cholesky分解的算法，数学上证明其枢轴选择步骤等同于使用核度量的最远点采样（FPS），并证明Cholesky因子构造是一种隐式Gram-Schmidt正交化。
results: 证明了枢轴Cholesky分解的枢轴选择步骤在几何上等同于使用核度量的最远点采样（FPS），并且其Cholesky因子构造是一种隐式Gram-Schmidt正交化。提供了简洁的理论推导和极简的Python实现。

title: Investigating Knowledge Distillation Through Neural Networks for Protein Binding Affinity Prediction
authors: Wajid Arshad Abbasi, Syed Ali Abbas, Maryum Bibi, Saiqa Andleeb, Muhammad Naveed Akhtar
abstract: The trade-off between predictive accuracy and data availability makes it difficult to predict protein--protein binding affinity accurately. The lack of experimentally resolved protein structures limits the performance of structure-based machine learning models, which generally outperform sequence-based methods. In order to overcome this constraint, we suggest a regression framework based on knowledge distillation that uses protein structural data during training and only needs sequence data during inference. The suggested method uses binding affinity labels and intermediate feature representations to jointly supervise the training of a sequence-based student network under the guidance of a structure-informed teacher network. Leave-One-Complex-Out (LOCO) cross-validation was used to assess the framework on a non-redundant protein--protein binding affinity benchmark dataset. A maximum Pearson correlation coefficient (P_r) of 0.375 and an RMSE of 2.712 kcal/mol were obtained by sequence-only baseline models, whereas a P_r of 0.512 and an RMSE of 2.445 kcal/mol were obtained by structure-based models. With a P_r of 0.481 and an RMSE of 2.488 kcal/mol, the distillation-based student model greatly enhanced sequence-only performance. Improved agreement and decreased bias were further confirmed by thorough error analyses. With the potential to close the performance gap between sequence-based and structure-based models as larger datasets become available, these findings show that knowledge distillation is an efficient method for transferring structural knowledge to sequence-based predictors. The source code for running inference with the proposed distillation-based binding affinity predictor can be accessed at https://github.com/wajidarshad/ProteinAffinityKD.
zh_title: 基于神经网络的知识蒸馏在蛋白质结合亲和力预测中的研究
translation: 预测蛋白质-蛋白质结合亲和力在预测准确性和数据可用性之间存在权衡，这使得准确预测变得困难。缺乏实验解析的蛋白质结构限制了通常优于基于序列方法的基于结构的机器学习模型的性能。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了一种基于知识蒸馏的回归框架，该框架在训练期间使用蛋白质结构数据，但在推断期间仅需要序列数据。所提出的方法利用结合亲和力标签和中间特征表示，在结构信息丰富的教师网络的指导下，共同监督基于序列的学生网络的训练。我们使用“留一复合物交叉验证”（LOCO）在一个非冗余的蛋白质-蛋白质结合亲和力基准数据集上评估了该框架。仅基于序列的基线模型获得了0.375的最大皮尔逊相关系数（P_r）和2.712 kcal/mol的RMSE，而基于结构的模型获得了0.512的P_r和2.445 kcal/mol的RMSE。基于蒸馏的学生模型获得了0.481的P_r和2.488 kcal/mol的RMSE，极大地增强了仅基于序列的性能。全面的误差分析进一步证实了改进的一致性和降低的偏差。这些发现表明，知识蒸馏是将结构知识转移到基于序列的预测器的一种有效方法，随着更大数据集的可用，它有潜力缩小基于序列和基于结构模型之间的性能差距。所提出的基于蒸馏的结合亲和力预测器的推断源代码可在https://github.com/wajidarshad/ProteinAffinityKD获取。
tldr: 为解决蛋白质结构数据稀缺问题，研究人员使用知识蒸馏，将基于结构的教师网络的知识转移给基于序列的学生网络，显著提高了仅使用序列数据进行蛋白质结合亲和力预测的性能。
ai_comments: 该研究的创新点在于使用知识蒸馏（Knowledge Distillation）来解决蛋白质结合亲和力预测中结构数据稀缺的问题。它成功地将强大的结构感知信息从教师网络转移到仅基于序列的学生网络，从而在推断阶段无需结构数据即可实现显著的性能提升。这对于生物信息学和药物发现领域至关重要，因为实验解析的蛋白质结构获取成本高昂且耗时。虽然蒸馏后的模型性能仍略低于完全基于结构的教师模型，但它成功地缩小了与仅基于序列的基线模型之间的性能差距，为在数据受限环境下部署高性能预测模型提供了高效途径。
motivation: 由于预测准确性与数据可用性之间的权衡，准确预测蛋白质-蛋白质结合亲和力存在困难。具体而言，缺乏实验解析的蛋白质结构限制了通常性能更优的基于结构的机器学习模型的性能。
method: 提出了一种基于知识蒸馏的回归框架，该框架在训练阶段使用结合亲和力标签和中间特征表示，由一个结构信息丰富的教师网络联合监督基于序列的学生网络。评估采用“留一复合物交叉验证”（LOCO）方法，在一个非冗余的蛋白质-蛋白质结合亲和力基准数据集上进行。
results: 仅基于序列的基线模型获得的皮尔逊相关系数（P_r）为0.375，均方根误差（RMSE）为2.712 kcal/mol；基于结构的模型获得的P_r为0.512，RMSE为2.445 kcal/mol。而基于蒸馏的学生模型获得的P_r为0.481，RMSE为2.488 kcal/mol，极大地提高了仅基于序列的性能，并通过误差分析证实了改进的一致性和偏差降低。
conclusion: 知识蒸馏是将结构知识转移到基于序列的预测器的一种有效方法，随着更大规模数据集的出现，它有潜力缩小基于序列模型和基于结构模型之间的性能差距。

title: MHRC-Bench: A Multilingual Hardware Repository-Level Code Completion benchmark
authors: Qingyun Zou, Jiahao Cui, Nuo Chen, Bingsheng He, Weng-Fai Wong
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance on code completion tasks in general-purpose programming languages. However, existing repository-level code completion benchmarks focus almost exclusively on software code and largely overlook hardware description languages. In this work, we present \textbf{MHRC-Bench}, consisting of \textbf{MHRC-Bench-Train} and \textbf{MHRC-Bench-Eval}, the first benchmark designed for multilingual hardware code completion at the repository level. Our benchmark targets completion tasks and covers three major hardware design coding styles. Each completion target is annotated with code-structure-level and hardware-oriented semantic labels derived from concrete syntax tree analysis. We conduct a comprehensive evaluation of models on MHRC-Bench-Eval. Comprehensive evaluation results and analysis demonstrate the effectiveness of MHRC-Bench.
zh_title: MHRC-Bench：一个多语言硬件仓库级代码补全基准
translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在通用编程语言的代码补全任务中取得了强大的性能。然而，现有的仓库级代码补全基准几乎只关注软件代码，很大程度上忽视了硬件描述语言。在这项工作中，我们提出了 **MHRC-Bench**，它由 **MHRC-Bench-Train** 和 **MHRC-Bench-Eval** 组成，是第一个为仓库级多语言硬件代码补全设计的基准。我们的基准针对补全任务，涵盖了三种主要的硬件设计编码风格。每个补全目标都通过具体语法树分析标注了代码结构级和面向硬件的语义标签。我们对模型在 MHRC-Bench-Eval 上进行了综合评估。综合评估结果和分析证明了 MHRC-Bench 的有效性。
tldr: 提出了 MHRC-Bench，这是首个多语言硬件仓库级代码补全基准，旨在弥补现有基准忽视硬件描述语言的缺陷。该基准涵盖三种编码风格，并提供结构级和语义级标签，评估结果证明了其有效性。
ai_comments: 创新性地将代码补全研究扩展到了硬件描述语言（HDL）领域，解决了现有基准的重大局限性。该基准的设立对于评估和提升大型语言模型在专业硬件设计领域的应用能力具有重要意义。通过引入代码结构级和硬件语义标签，为模型提供了更精细的评估维度，有助于推动更具针对性的模型优化。
motivation: 现有仓库级代码补全基准几乎只关注软件代码，很大程度上忽视了硬件描述语言（HDL），缺乏针对性的评估工具。
method: 提出了 MHRC-Bench，包含训练集（MHRC-Bench-Train）和评估集（MHRC-Bench-Eval），这是首个针对仓库级多语言硬件代码补全设计的基准。该基准涵盖了三种主要的硬件设计编码风格。每个补全目标都通过具体语法树分析（concrete syntax tree analysis）标注了代码结构级和面向硬件的语义标签。
results: 综合评估结果和分析证明了 MHRC-Bench 的有效性。

title: The Power of 10: New Rules for the Digital World
authors: Sarah Spiekermann-Hoff, Marc Langheinrich, Johannes Hoff, Christiane Wendehorst, Jürgen Pfeffer, Thomas Fuchs, Armin Grunwald
abstract: As artificial intelligence rapidly advances, society is increasingly captivated by promises of superhuman machines and seamless digital futures. Yet these visions often obscure mounting social, ethical, and psychological concerns tied to pervasive digital technologies - from surveillance to mental health crises. This article argues that a guiding ethos is urgently needed to navigate these transformations. Inspired by the lasting influence of the biblical Ten Commandments, a European interdisciplinary group has proposed "Ten Rules for the Digital World" - a novel ethical framework to help individuals and societies make prudent, human-centered decisions in the age of "supercharged" technology.
comment: to be published in Communications of the ACM (submitted 26 June 2025, revised 29 August 2025, accepted 3 November 2025)
zh_title: 十的力量：数字世界的新规则
translation: 随着人工智能的迅速发展，社会越来越被超人机器和无缝数字未来的承诺所吸引。然而，这些愿景往往掩盖了与普遍存在的数字技术相关的日益增长的社会、伦理和心理担忧——从监控到心理健康危机。本文认为，迫切需要一种指导性的精神来驾驭这些变革。受《圣经十诫》持久影响的启发，一个欧洲跨学科小组提出了“数字世界十条规则”——一个新颖的伦理框架，旨在帮助个人和社会在“超强”技术时代做出审慎的、以人为中心的决策。
tldr: 随着人工智能发展，数字技术带来了社会和伦理问题。本文提出了一套受《十诫》启发的“数字世界十条规则”，作为指导个人和社会进行以人为本决策的伦理框架。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于它将古老的、具有普适影响力的道德框架（《十诫》）作为基础，来构建适用于现代数字世界的伦理准则。这表明作者认识到，解决新兴技术带来的伦理困境，可能需要回归基本的人类价值观。其重要性在于，它试图提供一个具体的、易于理解的“操作手册”，而非仅仅停留在抽象的伦理讨论层面，对于推动数字伦理的实际应用具有潜在价值。其潜在的局限性可能在于，将宗教或文化背景强烈的框架应用于全球性、技术性的问题，可能面临文化适应性和普适性的挑战。
motivation: 尽管人工智能和数字技术进步带来了美好前景，但随之而来的监控、心理健康危机等社会、伦理和心理问题日益严重，亟需一套指导性的道德准则来应对这些变革。
method: 提出并倡导由一个欧洲跨学科小组受《圣经十诫》启发而提出的“数字世界十条规则”这一新颖的伦理框架。

title: Visual Merit or Linguistic Crutch? A Close Look at DeepSeek-OCR
authors: Yunhao Liang, Ruixuan Ying, Bo Li, Hong Li, Kai Yan, Qingwen Li, Min Yang, Okamoto Satoshi, Zhe Cui, Shiwen Ni
abstract: DeepSeek-OCR utilizes an optical 2D mapping approach to achieve high-ratio vision-text compression, claiming to decode text tokens exceeding ten times the input visual tokens. While this suggests a promising solution for the LLM long-context bottleneck, we investigate a critical question: "Visual merit or linguistic crutch - which drives DeepSeek-OCR's performance?" By employing sentence-level and word-level semantic corruption, we isolate the model's intrinsic OCR capabilities from its language priors. Results demonstrate that without linguistic support, DeepSeek-OCR's performance plummets from approximately 90% to 20%. Comparative benchmarking against 13 baseline models reveals that traditional pipeline OCR methods exhibit significantly higher robustness to such semantic perturbations than end-to-end methods. Furthermore, we find that lower visual token counts correlate with increased reliance on priors, exacerbating hallucination risks. Context stress testing also reveals a total model collapse around 10,000 text tokens, suggesting that current optical compression techniques may paradoxically aggravate the long-context bottleneck. This study empirically defines DeepSeek-OCR's capability boundaries and offers essential insights for future optimizations of the vision-text compression paradigm. We release all data, results and scripts used in this study at https://github.com/dududuck00/DeepSeekOCR.
zh_title: 视觉优势还是语言拐杖？对 DeepSeek-OCR 的深入探究
translation: DeepSeek-OCR 利用光学 2D 映射方法实现高比例的视觉-文本压缩，声称能够解码超过输入视觉 token 十倍的文本 token。虽然这似乎为大型语言模型（LLM）的长上下文瓶颈提供了一个有前景的解决方案，但我们调查了一个关键问题：“视觉优势还是语言拐杖——是什么驱动了 DeepSeek-OCR 的性能？”通过采用句子级和词汇级的语义破坏，我们将模型固有的 OCR 能力与其语言先验隔离开来。结果表明，在没有语言支持的情况下，DeepSeek-OCR 的性能从大约 90% 骤降至 20%。与 13 个基线模型的对比基准测试显示，传统的流水线 OCR 方法比端到端方法对此类语义扰动表现出显著更高的鲁棒性。此外，我们发现较低的视觉 token 数量与对先验的更高依赖性相关，从而加剧了幻觉风险。上下文压力测试还揭示了模型在大约 10,000 个文本 token 处完全崩溃，这表明当前的光学压缩技术可能反而加剧了长上下文瓶颈。本研究实证定义了 DeepSeek-OCR 的能力边界，并为未来视觉-文本压缩范式的优化提供了重要见解。我们发布了本研究中使用的所有数据、结果和脚本。
tldr: 研究发现 DeepSeek-OCR 的高性能主要依赖于语言先验而非视觉优势。通过语义破坏测试，其性能从 90% 降至 20%。模型在 10,000 文本 token 处崩溃，表明光学压缩可能加剧长上下文瓶颈。
ai_comments: 本研究通过新颖的语义破坏方法，对 DeepSeek-OCR 这种新兴的视觉-文本压缩模型提出了关键性质疑。其创新点在于设计了精巧的实验来解耦模型的视觉识别能力和语言推理能力。重要性在于它揭示了此类高压缩比模型可能存在的内在缺陷——即过度依赖语言先验导致鲁棒性极差，并为未来的多模态长上下文模型设计提供了警示：单纯追求高压缩比可能以牺牲准确性和可靠性为代价，反而加剧了实际应用中的瓶颈问题。
motivation: DeepSeek-OCR 利用光学 2D 映射实现高比例视觉-文本压缩，被视为解决 LLM 长上下文瓶颈的有前景方案。本文旨在调查其高性能究竟是源于“视觉优势”还是“语言拐杖”。
method: 采用句子级和词汇级的语义破坏（semantic corruption）来隔离模型固有的 OCR 能力和语言先验。同时，与 13 个基线模型进行对比基准测试，并进行了上下文压力测试。
results: 在没有语言支持的情况下，DeepSeek-OCR 的性能从约 90% 急剧下降到 20%。传统流水线 OCR 方法比端到端方法对语义扰动表现出更高的鲁棒性。较低的视觉 token 数量与对先验的更高依赖性相关，加剧了幻觉风险。上下文压力测试显示模型在大约 10,000 个文本 token 处完全崩溃。
conclusion: 本研究实证定义了 DeepSeek-OCR 的能力边界，并为未来视觉-文本压缩范式的优化提供了重要见解。当前的光学压缩技术可能反而加剧了长上下文瓶颈。

title: BREATH-VL: Vision-Language-Guided 6-DoF Bronchoscopy Localization via Semantic-Geometric Fusion
authors: Qingyao Tian, Bingyu Yang, Huai Liao, Xinyan Huang, Junyong Li, Dong Yi, Hongbin Liu
abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have recently shown remarkable performance in navigation and localization tasks by leveraging large-scale pretraining for semantic understanding. However, applying VLMs to 6-DoF endoscopic camera localization presents several challenges: 1) the lack of large-scale, high-quality, densely annotated, and localization-oriented vision-language datasets in real-world medical settings; 2) limited capability for fine-grained pose regression; and 3) high computational latency when extracting temporal features from past frames. To address these issues, we first construct BREATH dataset, the largest in-vivo endoscopic localization dataset to date, collected in the complex human airway. Building on this dataset, we propose BREATH-VL, a hybrid framework that integrates semantic cues from VLMs with geometric information from vision-based registration methods for accurate 6-DoF pose estimation. Our motivation lies in the complementary strengths of both approaches: VLMs offer generalizable semantic understanding, while registration methods provide precise geometric alignment. To further enhance the VLM's ability to capture temporal context, we introduce a lightweight context-learning mechanism that encodes motion history as linguistic prompts, enabling efficient temporal reasoning without expensive video-level computation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the vision-language module delivers robust semantic localization in challenging surgical scenes. Building on this, our BREATH-VL outperforms state-of-the-art vision-only localization methods in both accuracy and generalization, reducing translational error by 25.5% compared with the best-performing baseline, while achieving competitive computational latency.
zh_title: BREATH-VL：通过语义-几何融合实现的视觉-语言引导的六自由度支气管镜定位
translation: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）最近通过利用大规模预训练进行语义理解，在导航和定位任务中展现出卓越的性能。然而，将VLM应用于六自由度（6-DoF）内窥镜相机定位面临几个挑战：1）在真实医疗环境中缺乏大规模、高质量、密集标注且面向定位的视觉-语言数据集；2）进行精细姿态回归的能力有限；3）从历史帧中提取时序特征时计算延迟高。为解决这些问题，我们首先构建了BREATH数据集，这是迄今为止在复杂人体气道中收集到的最大的体内内窥镜定位数据集。基于该数据集，我们提出了BREATH-VL，这是一个混合框架，它集成了来自VLM的语义线索和来自基于视觉的配准方法的几何信息，以实现精确的六自由度姿态估计。我们的动机在于这两种方法的互补优势：VLM提供可泛化的语义理解，而配准方法提供精确的几何对齐。为了进一步增强VLM捕获时序上下文的能力，我们引入了一种轻量级上下文学习机制，将运动历史编码为语言提示（linguistic prompts），从而无需昂贵的视频级计算即可实现高效的时序推理。广泛的实验证明，视觉-语言模块在具有挑战性的手术场景中提供了鲁棒的语义定位。在此基础上，我们的BREATH-VL在准确性和泛化性方面均优于最先进的纯视觉定位方法，与性能最佳的基线相比，平移误差降低了25.5%，同时实现了具有竞争力的计算延迟。
tldr: 我们构建了最大的体内支气管镜定位数据集BREATH，并提出了BREATH-VL框架。该框架融合了视觉-语言模型（VLM）的语义理解和几何配准，并引入了轻量级上下文学习机制以提高效率。BREATH-VL在六自由度定位精度上显著优于现有纯视觉方法。
ai_comments:
**创新性：** 核心创新在于为六自由度医疗定位量身定制了混合语义-几何融合框架（BREATH-VL），它将视觉-语言模型的语义理解与几何配准的精度相结合，有效解决了VLM在精细姿态回归和数据稀缺方面的挑战。此外，利用轻量级上下文学习机制将运动历史编码为语言提示，实现了高效的时序推理，避免了昂贵的视频级计算。

**重要性：** 这项工作对于医疗机器人和导航领域具有重要意义。BREATH数据集的构建（迄今为止最大的体内内窥镜定位数据集）解决了该领域关键的数据瓶颈问题。BREATH-VL在复杂手术场景中表现出的高精度和强泛化能力，有望推动支气管镜手术的自动化和导航精度提升。
motivation: 将视觉-语言模型（VLM）应用于六自由度内窥镜定位存在三个主要挑战：缺乏大规模、高质量、面向定位的视觉-语言数据集；精细姿态回归能力有限；以及提取时序特征的计算延迟高。核心动机在于结合VLM（提供可泛化的语义理解）和配准方法（提供精确的几何对齐）的互补优势。
method: 1. 构建了BREATH数据集，这是迄今为止最大的体内内窥镜定位数据集。2. 提出了BREATH-VL混合框架，该框架将来自视觉-语言模型的语义线索与基于视觉的配准方法的几何信息相集成。3. 引入了一种轻量级上下文学习机制，将运动历史编码为语言提示（linguistic prompts），以实现高效的时序推理。
results: BREATH-VL在准确性和泛化性上均优于最先进的纯视觉定位方法。与性能最佳的基线相比，它将平移误差降低了25.5%，同时保持了具有竞争力的计算延迟。视觉-语言模块提供了鲁棒的语义定位。
conclusion: 提出的BREATH-VL框架通过融合VLM语义和几何对齐，并利用高效的时序上下文机制，在六自由度支气管镜定位方面实现了优于现有纯视觉方法的精度和泛化能力，并将平移误差降低了25.5%。

title: R$^3$L: Reflect-then-Retry Reinforcement Learning with Language-Guided Exploration, Pivotal Credit, and Positive Amplification
authors: Weijie Shi, Yanxi Chen, Zexi Li, Xuchen Pan, Yuchang Sun, Jiajie Xu, Xiaofang Zhou, Yaliang Li
abstract: Reinforcement learning drives recent advances in LLM reasoning and agentic capabilities, yet current approaches struggle with both exploration and exploitation. Exploration suffers from low success rates on difficult tasks and high costs of repeated rollouts from scratch. Exploitation suffers from coarse credit assignment and training instability: Trajectory-level rewards penalize valid prefixes for later errors, and failure-dominated groups overwhelm the few positive signals, leaving optimization without constructive direction. To this end, we propose R$^3$L, Reflect-then-Retry Reinforcement Learning with Language-Guided Exploration, Pivotal Credit, and Positive Amplification. To synthesize high-quality trajectories, R$^3$L shifts from stochastic sampling to active synthesis via reflect-then-retry, leveraging language feedback to diagnose errors, transform failed attempts into successful ones, and reduce rollout costs by restarting from identified failure points. With errors diagnosed and localized, Pivotal Credit Assignment updates only the diverging suffix where contrastive signals exist, excluding the shared prefix from gradient update. Since failures dominate on difficult tasks and reflect-then-retry produces off-policy data, risking training instability, Positive Amplification upweights successful trajectories to ensure positive signals guide the optimization process. Experiments on agentic and reasoning tasks demonstrate 5\% to 52\% relative improvements over baselines while maintaining training stability. Our code is released at https://github.com/shiweijiezero/R3L.
zh_title: R$^3$L：基于语言引导探索、关键信用分配和正向放大的“反思-重试”强化学习
translation: 强化学习推动了大型语言模型（LLM）推理和Agent能力方面的最新进展，但当前方法在探索和利用方面都面临挑战。探索方面，困难任务的成功率低，且重复从头开始的试错（rollouts）成本高。利用方面，信用分配过于粗糙，训练不稳定：轨迹级奖励会因后来的错误而惩罚有效的轨迹前缀，且失败主导的数据组会淹没少数正向信号，使得优化缺乏建设性方向。为此，我们提出了R$^3$L，即基于语言引导探索、关键信用分配和正向放大的“反思-重试”强化学习。为了合成高质量的轨迹，R$^3$L从随机采样转向通过“反思-重试”的主动合成，利用语言反馈诊断错误，将失败的尝试转化为成功的尝试，并通过从识别出的失败点重启来降低试错成本。在错误得到诊断和定位后，“关键信用分配”仅更新存在对比信号的分歧后缀，将共享前缀排除在梯度更新之外。由于在困难任务上失败占主导地位，且“反思-重试”会产生离线（off-policy）数据，可能导致训练不稳定，“正向放大”机制会提高成功轨迹的权重，以确保正向信号引导优化过程。在Agent和推理任务上的实验表明，R$^3$L比基线方法有5%到52%的相对改进，同时保持了训练的稳定性。我们的代码已发布在https://github.com/shiweijiezero/R3L。
tldr: 提出R$^3$L框架，通过“反思-重试”利用语言反馈提高探索效率，使用“关键信用分配”解决粗粒度奖励问题，并通过“正向放大”稳定训练，在Agent和推理任务上实现了显著提升（5%-52%）。
ai_comments: R$^3$L的创新点在于将语言反馈机制深度集成到强化学习的探索和信用分配过程中。通过“反思-重试”实现主动合成轨迹，显著提高了数据效率，并避免了重复的昂贵试错。关键信用分配有效地解决了传统轨迹级奖励分配过于粗糙的问题，即避免了对有效前缀的惩罚，这对于RL在长序列、多步骤推理任务中的应用是一个重要且实用的进步。此外，“正向放大”机制体现了对实际训练中失败数据占主导的实用主义处理，确保了训练的稳定性。
motivation:
现有LLM强化学习方法在探索和利用方面均存在严重问题：
1. **探索方面：** 困难任务成功率低，且重复从头开始的试错（rollouts）成本高。
2. **利用方面：** 信用分配过于粗糙（轨迹级奖励会惩罚有效的轨迹前缀），且失败主导的数据组淹没了少数正向信号，导致优化缺乏建设性方向。
method:
本文提出了R$^3$L框架，包含三个核心组件：
1. **语言引导探索（反思-重试）：** 将随机采样转变为主动合成，利用语言反馈诊断错误，并从识别出的失败点重启，以提高轨迹生成效率并降低成本。
2. **关键信用分配：** 错误诊断和定位后，仅更新存在对比信号的分歧后缀（diverging suffix），将共享前缀排除在梯度更新之外，解决粗糙信用分配问题。
3. **正向放大：** 提高成功轨迹的权重，以确保正向信号在优化过程中起主导作用，从而解决失败数据占主导和离线数据可能导致的训练不稳定问题。
results: 在Agent和推理任务上的实验表明，R$^3$L比基线方法有5%到52%的相对改进，同时保持了训练的稳定性。
conclusion: R$^3$L通过结合语言引导探索、关键信用分配和正向放大，有效解决了现有强化学习方法在LLM推理和Agent能力提升中面临的探索效率低下和粗糙信用分配的挑战，并在实际任务中取得了显著且稳定的性能提升。

title: MIND: From Passive Mimicry to Active Reasoning through Capability-Aware Multi-Perspective CoT Distillation
authors: Jin Cui, Jiaqi Guo, Jiepeng Zhou, Ruixuan Yang, Jiayi Lu, Jiajun Xu, Jiangcheng Song, Boran Zhao, Pengju Ren
abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged with remarkable capabilities in complex tasks through Chain-of-Thought reasoning, practical resource constraints have sparked interest in transferring these abilities to smaller models. However, achieving both domain performance and cross-domain generalization remains challenging. Existing approaches typically restrict students to following a single golden rationale and treat different reasoning paths independently. Due to distinct inductive biases and intrinsic preferences, alongside the student's evolving capacity and reasoning preferences during training, a teacher's "optimal" rationale could act as out-of-distribution noise. This misalignment leads to a degeneration of the student's latent reasoning distribution, causing suboptimal performance. To bridge this gap, we propose MIND, a capability-adaptive framework that transitions distillation from passive mimicry to active cognitive construction. We synthesize diverse teacher perspectives through a novel "Teaching Assistant" network. By employing a Feedback-Driven Inertia Calibration mechanism, this network utilizes inertia-filtered training loss to align supervision with the student's current adaptability, effectively enhancing performance while mitigating catastrophic forgetting. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MIND achieves state-of-the-art performance on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution benchmarks, and our sophisticated latent space analysis further confirms the mechanism of reasoning ability internalization.
zh_title: MIND：通过能力感知多视角CoT蒸馏，实现从被动模仿到主动推理
translation: 尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）通过思维链（Chain-of-Thought, CoT）推理在复杂任务中展现出卓越的能力，但实际的资源限制引发了人们对将这些能力转移到更小模型的兴趣。然而，实现域内性能和跨域泛化仍然具有挑战性。现有方法通常限制学生模型遵循单一的“黄金”基本原理，并独立处理不同的推理路径。由于学生模型独特的归纳偏差和内在偏好，以及训练过程中其不断演变的能力和推理偏好，教师的“最优”推理路径可能成为分布外噪声。这种错位导致了学生潜在推理分布的退化，从而造成次优的性能。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了MIND，这是一个能力适应性框架，将蒸馏从被动模仿过渡到主动认知构建。我们通过一个新颖的“助教”（Teaching Assistant）网络来合成多样化的教师视角。通过采用反馈驱动的惯性校准机制，该网络利用惯性过滤的训练损失来使监督与学生模型当前的适应能力对齐，有效地提高了性能，同时减轻了灾难性遗忘。广泛的实验证明，MIND在域内和域外基准测试上均实现了最先进的性能，我们复杂的潜在空间分析进一步证实了推理能力内在化的机制。
tldr: 针对LLM知识蒸馏中学生模型对单一CoT推理路径的被动模仿和错位问题，本文提出了MIND框架。MIND利用“助教”网络合成多视角教师推理，并通过反馈驱动的惯性校准机制，使蒸馏过程适应学生的能力，从而在域内和域外任务上均达到了SOTA性能。
ai_comments: MIND的核心创新在于它认识到单一“黄金”CoT路径对学生模型可能造成伤害，并提出了多视角合成（通过“助教”网络）和能力自适应监督（通过“反馈驱动的惯性校准”）的解决方案。这标志着知识蒸馏领域从静态、单路径模仿转向动态、多路径、能力感知的认知构建。该工作对于在资源受限环境中部署高性能、高泛化性的小型LLM至关重要，有效地解决了CoT蒸馏中学生模型归纳偏置与教师推理路径错位这一关键挑战。
motivation: 现有LLM知识蒸馏方法限制学生模型遵循单一“黄金”推理路径，并将不同路径独立对待。然而，由于学生模型的内在偏好和不断演变的能力，教师的“最优”推理可能成为分布外噪声，导致学生潜在推理分布退化和次优性能。因此，需要一种能力适应性的框架来解决这种错位问题。
method: 提出MIND框架，这是一种能力适应性的蒸馏框架，将蒸馏从被动模仿转变为主动认知构建。具体方法包括：1. 通过“助教”（Teaching Assistant）网络合成多样化的教师视角。2. 采用“反馈驱动的惯性校准”（Feedback-Driven Inertia Calibration）机制，利用惯性过滤的训练损失，使监督与学生模型当前的适应能力对齐，以减轻灾难性遗忘。
results: MIND在域内（in-distribution）和域外（out-of-distribution）基准测试上均实现了最先进的性能（SOTA）。复杂的潜在空间分析进一步证实了推理能力内在化的机制。
conclusion: MIND框架成功地将知识蒸馏从对单一路径的被动模仿转变为主动认知构建，通过能力自适应的多视角监督解决了现有CoT蒸馏中推理路径错位和学生能力退化的问题，并在泛化和性能上取得了显著的提升。

title: Towards Real-world Lens Active Alignment with Unlabeled Data via Domain Adaptation
authors: Wenyong Lia, Qi Jiang, Weijian Hu, Kailun Yang, Zhanjun Zhang, Wenjun Tian, Kaiwei Wang, Jian Bai
abstract: Active Alignment (AA) is a key technology for the large-scale automated assembly of high-precision optical systems. Compared with labor-intensive per-model on-device calibration, a digital-twin pipeline built on optical simulation offers a substantial advantage in generating large-scale labeled data. However, complex imaging conditions induce a domain gap between simulation and real-world images, limiting the generalization of simulation-trained models. To address this, we propose augmenting a simulation baseline with minimal unlabeled real-world images captured at random misalignment positions, mitigating the gap from a domain adaptation perspective. We introduce Domain Adaptive Active Alignment (DA3), which utilizes an autoregressive domain transformation generator and an adversarial-based feature alignment strategy to distill real-world domain information via self-supervised learning. This enables the extraction of domain-invariant image degradation features to facilitate robust misalignment prediction. Experiments on two lens types reveal that DA3 improves accuracy by 46% over a purely simulation pipeline. Notably, it approaches the performance achieved with precisely labeled real-world data collected on 3 lens samples, while reducing on-device data collection time by 98.7%. The results demonstrate that domain adaptation effectively endows simulation-trained models with robust real-world performance, validating the digital-twin pipeline as a practical solution to significantly enhance the efficiency of large-scale optical assembly.
zh_title: 基于域适应的无标签数据实景镜头主动对准研究
translation: 主动对准（AA）是高精度光学系统大规模自动化装配的关键技术。与劳动密集型的、针对每个模型的设备上校准相比，基于光学仿真的数字孪生管线在生成大规模标注数据方面具有显著优势。然而，复杂的成像条件会在仿真与真实图像之间引入域差异（domain gap），限制了仿真训练模型的泛化能力。为解决此问题，我们提出使用在随机失准位置捕获的少量无标签真实世界图像来增强仿真基线，从域适应的角度弥补这一差距。我们引入了域适应主动对准（DA3），它利用自回归域转换生成器和基于对抗的特征对齐策略，通过自监督学习提炼真实世界域信息。这使得模型能够提取域不变的图像退化特征，从而促进鲁棒的失准预测。在两种镜头类型上的实验表明，DA3比纯仿真管线提高了46%的精度。值得注意的是，它接近了使用在3个镜头样本上收集的精确标注真实世界数据所达到的性能，同时将设备上的数据采集时间减少了98.7%。结果表明，域适应有效地赋予了仿真训练模型强大的真实世界性能，验证了数字孪生管线作为显著提高大规模光学装配效率的实用解决方案的有效性。
tldr: 针对光学系统主动对准中的仿真-实景域差异问题，本文提出了域适应主动对准（DA3）方法，结合少量无标签真实数据和自监督学习，大幅提升了仿真模型的实景性能（精度提高46%），同时将数据采集时间减少了98.7%。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于将域适应技术应用于高精度光学系统的主动对准（AA）领域。通过利用数字孪生管线生成大规模仿真数据，并结合少量易于获取的无标签真实数据（而非昂贵的标注数据），有效解决了仿真与真实环境之间的域差异问题。其重要性体现在极大地提高了大规模光学装配的效率和鲁棒性，特别是将关键的设备数据采集时间减少了98.7%，这对于工业应用具有巨大的实际价值。该方法为未来在数据受限的高精度工业视觉任务中，利用仿真数据和域适应提供了一个可行的范例。
motivation: 基于光学仿真的数字孪生管线虽然能生成大规模标注数据，但复杂的成像条件会在仿真与真实图像之间引入域差异（domain gap），限制了仿真训练模型的泛化能力。
method: 提出域适应主动对准（DA3）框架，该框架结合了少量无标签的真实世界图像来增强仿真基线。DA3利用自回归域转换生成器和基于对抗的特征对齐策略，通过自监督学习来提炼真实世界域信息，从而提取域不变的图像退化特征，实现鲁棒的失准预测。
results: 在两种镜头类型上的实验表明，DA3比纯仿真管线提高了46%的精度。它接近了使用少量精确标注的真实数据（3个镜头样本）所达到的性能，同时将设备上的数据采集时间减少了98.7%。
conclusion: 域适应能够有效地赋予仿真训练模型强大的真实世界性能，验证了数字孪生管线作为显著提高大规模光学装配效率的实用解决方案的有效性。

title: ETR: Outcome-Guided Elastic Trust Regions for Policy Optimization
authors: Shijie Zhang, Kevin Zhang, Zheyuan Gu, Xiang Guo, Rujun Guo, Shaoyu Liu, Guanjun Jiang, Xiaozhao Wang
abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has emerged as an important paradigm for unlocking reasoning capabilities in large language models, exemplified by the success of OpenAI o1 and DeepSeek-R1. Currently, Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) stands as the dominant algorithm in this domain due to its stable training and critic-free efficiency. However, we argue that GRPO suffers from a structural limitation: it imposes a uniform, static trust region constraint across all samples. This design implicitly assumes signal homogeneity, a premise misaligned with the heterogeneous nature of outcome-driven learning, where advantage magnitudes and variances fluctuate significantly. Consequently, static constraints fail to fully exploit high-quality signals while insufficiently suppressing noise, often precipitating rapid entropy collapse. To address this, we propose \textbf{E}lastic \textbf{T}rust \textbf{R}egions (\textbf{ETR}), a dynamic mechanism that aligns optimization constraints with signal quality. ETR constructs a signal-aware landscape through dual-level elasticity: at the micro level, it scales clipping boundaries based on advantage magnitude to accelerate learning from high-confidence paths; at the macro level, it leverages group variance to implicitly allocate larger update budgets to tasks in the optimal learning zone. Extensive experiments on AIME and MATH benchmarks demonstrate that ETR consistently outperforms GRPO, achieving superior accuracy while effectively mitigating policy entropy degradation to ensure sustained exploration.
zh_title: ETR：用于策略优化的结果引导弹性信任区域
translation: 强化学习与可验证奖励（RLVR）已成为释放大型语言模型推理能力的重要范式，OpenAI o1和DeepSeek-R1的成功就是例证。目前，群相对策略优化（GRPO）是该领域的主导算法，因其训练稳定且无需评估器而高效。然而，我们认为GRPO存在结构性限制：它对所有样本施加了统一的、静态的信任区域约束。这种设计隐含地假设了信号同质性，而这与结果驱动学习的异质性本质不符，在结果驱动学习中，优势幅度和方差会显著波动。因此，静态约束未能充分利用高质量信号，同时又未能充分抑制噪声，常常导致熵快速坍塌。为解决此问题，我们提出了	extbf{E}lastic 	extbf{T}rust 	extbf{R}egions (	extbf{ETR})，一种动态机制，使优化约束与信号质量保持一致。ETR通过双层弹性构建了一个信号感知的景观：在微观层面，它根据优势幅度缩放裁剪边界，以加速从高置信度路径学习；在宏观层面，它利用组方差来隐式地为处于最优学习区域的任务分配更大的更新预算。在AIME和MATH基准测试上的广泛实验表明，ETR持续优于GRPO，实现了更高的准确性，并有效缓解了策略熵退化，以确保持续探索。
tldr: ETR通过动态调整信任区域来改进策略优化，以适应不同信号质量，并在AIME和MATH基准测试中优于GRPO。
ai_comments: 该研究提出了一种名为ETR的新型策略优化方法，解决了RLVR领域中GRPO算法的局限性。ETR通过引入动态的、基于信号质量的信任区域，实现了更优的样本利用和更稳定的训练过程。该方法在实际基准测试中表现出色，并且在防止策略熵过早衰减方面取得了显著进展，为RLVR的研究和应用提供了有价值的贡献。然而，该方法的计算复杂度和可扩展性仍需进一步评估。
motivation: GRPO在RLVR中存在结构性限制，因为它对所有样本施加了统一、静态的信任区域约束，这与结果驱动学习中信号异质性的本质不符，导致无法充分利用高质量信号或抑制噪声，并可能导致熵快速坍塌。
method: ETR通过双层弹性构建了一个信号感知的优化景观：在微观层面，它根据优势幅度调整裁剪边界，以加速从高置信度路径学习；在宏观层面，它利用组方差来为处于最优学习区域的任务隐式分配更大的更新预算。
results: ETR在AIME和MATH基准测试上的大量实验表明，ETR的性能持续优于GRPO，实现了更高的准确性，并有效缓解了策略熵退化，确保了持续探索。
conclusion: ETR是一种动态机制，通过根据信号质量调整优化约束来解决GRPO的局限性，从而在策略优化中实现更优的性能和更持久的探索。

title: Derivation of the Thermal Conductivity in a Latent Thermal Energy Storage Unit for Use in Simplified System Models
authors: Lauritz Zendel, Chiara Springer, Frank Dammel, Peter Stephan
abstract: Latent Thermal Energy Storages (LTES) can store thermal energy in a narrow temperature range. Therefore, they are favorable for integration into Rankine-based Carnot Batteries. For the design of such systems, simulations based on accurate models are desirable. However, physical phenomena such as natural convection in LTES units cannot be modeled directly in transient system models. Simplified models are required. Therefore, the objective of this work is to derive simplified LTES unit models for use in system models. In transient simulations the state of charge of the LTES influences its temperature profile. The temperature profile depends on the geometry of the LTES unit. Therefore, the geometry must be considered to model the transient behavior of an LTES unit. The LTES unit under investigation has a shell and tube heat exchanger structure. The phase change material (PCM) is located between the hexagonal fins and in the space between the finned tubes. Aluminum fins are used. They have a high thermal conductivity and thus compensate for the low thermal conductivity of the sodium nitrate used as PCM. The interaction between fins and PCM is complex. Therefore, a numerical approach can be used to gain insight into the behavior of the LTES unit. To transfer the results of a complex model to a simplified model where fins and PCM are not considered individually, the effective thermal conductivity of a single finned tube can be used to approximate the performance of the LTES unit. In this study, a model of a section with a single finned tube is developed using the COMSOL software. The effective thermal conductivity of the system is determined by varying the effective thermal conductivity in a simplified model and comparing the results with reference cases based on a complex modeling approach. The results can serve as model input for simplified system models of Carnot Batteries, among others.
zh_title: 简化系统模型中潜热储能单元导热系数的推导
translation: 潜热储能（LTES）可以在狭窄的温度范围内储存热能。因此，它们有利于集成到基于朗肯循环的卡诺电池中。对于此类系统的设计，基于准确模型的模拟是可取的。然而，LTES单元中的自然对流等物理现象不能直接在瞬态系统模型中建模。因此，需要简化模型。因此，这项工作的目标是推导出用于系统模型的简化LTES单元模型。在瞬态模拟中，LTES的荷电状态会影响其温度分布。温度分布取决于LTES单元的几何形状。因此，必须考虑几何形状来模拟LTES单元的瞬态行为。所研究的LTES单元具有管壳式换热器结构。相变材料（PCM）位于六角形翅片之间以及带翅片管之间的空间中。使用了铝翅片。它们具有高导热性，从而弥补了用作PCM的硝酸钠的低导热性。翅片与PCM之间的相互作用是复杂的。因此，可以使用数值方法来深入了解LTES单元的行为。为了将复杂模型的结果转移到不单独考虑翅片和PCM的简化模型中，可以使用单个带翅片管的有效导热系数来近似LTES单元的性能。在本研究中，使用COMSOL软件开发了一个包含单个翅片管截面的模型。通过在一个简化模型中改变有效导热系数，并将其结果与基于复杂建模方法的参考案例进行比较，从而确定系统的有效导热系数。这些结果可以作为卡诺电池等简化系统模型的模型输入。
tldr: 为了将复杂的潜热储能（LTES）单元集成到卡诺电池的瞬态系统模型中，本文提出了一种方法。通过建立一个复杂的数值模型，然后将其结果与一个简化的模型进行比较，从而推导出考虑了几何和材料相互作用的有效导热系数。
ai_comments: 这项工作的创新在于提供了一种将复杂的、几何依赖的潜热储能（LTES）热性能参数化的方法，使其适用于计算效率更高的系统级瞬态模型。通过引入“有效导热系数”的概念，它成功地桥接了详细组件建模（如COMSOL中的CFD/热传导）与宏观系统仿真之间的差距。这对于卡诺电池等大型储能系统的设计和优化至关重要，因为在系统级模拟中，运行速度比精度更受重视。
