ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将Swin Transformer架构应用于皮肤病鉴别诊断，并结合了不平衡感知策略（尽管具体策略在摘要中未详述）和预训练来应对医学图像数据中的挑战。其重要性在于提供了一个高准确率的自动化诊断工具，能够有效缓解皮肤科医生资源稀缺的压力，并提高诊断的及时性和可及性。局限性可能在于87.71%的准确率对于实际临床应用可能仍需进一步提高，且模型的泛化能力（特别是在非ISIC数据集上）和对罕见疾病的诊断能力未在摘要中体现。
motivation: 由于皮肤病日益普遍且皮肤科医生资源有限，需要智能工具来及时准确地支持患者和临床医生进行皮肤病诊断。
method: 开发了一个基于深度学习的模型（最终基于Swin Transformer），用于皮肤病分类和诊断。方法包括利用公开数据集进行预训练、优化数据预处理流程、改进模型架构以及应用有针对性的数据增强技术。
results: 最终模型（基于Swin Transformer）在ISIC2019数据集的八个皮肤病变类别上达到了87.71%的预测准确率。
conclusion: 该结果证明了该模型作为临床医生诊断支持工具和患者自我评估辅助工具的潜力。

title: Impact Assessment of Heterogeneous Grid Support Functions in Smart Inverter Deployments
authors: S. Gokul Krishnan, Mohd. Asim Aftab, Nabil Mohammed, Shehab Ahmed, Charalambos Konstantinou
abstract: The decarbonization of the energy sector has led to a significant high penetration of distributed energy resources (DERs), particularly photovoltaic (PV) systems, in low-voltage (LV) distribution networks. To maintain grid stability, recent standards (e.g., IEEE 1547-2018) mandate DERs to provide grid-support functionalities through smart inverters (SIs), which typically operate autonomously based on local measurements. However, as DER penetration increases, uncoordinated control modes of SIs can lead to adverse interactions, compromising system efficiency, voltage regulation, and overall stability. While previous studies have demonstrated the benefits of coordinated inverter control and optimal dispatch strategies, the system-wide impacts of heterogeneous SI groups operating under different control modes remain largely unexamined. This paper addresses this gap by assessing the dynamic interactions among multiple SI groups with varying control strategies, namely: Constant Power Factor (CPF), Volt-VAR, and Volt-Watt modes. Furthermore, the analysis covers both resistive and inductive feeder types. The validation is performed using a real-time setup. The CIRGE low-voltage (LV) distribution network is simulated in the Opal-RT platform as the test network, enabling realistic and high-fidelity evaluation of SI control interactions under practical grid conditions.
zh_title: 智能逆变器部署中异构电网支持功能的影响评估
translation: 能源部门的脱碳导致分布式能源（DERs），特别是光伏（PV）系统，在低压（LV）配电网络中的渗透率显著提高。为了保持电网稳定性，最近的标准（例如IEEE 1547-2018）要求DER通过智能逆变器（SIs）提供电网支持功能，这些功能通常基于本地测量自主运行。然而，随着DER渗透率的增加，SI未协调的控制模式可能导致不良的相互作用，损害系统效率、电压调节和整体稳定性。尽管先前的研究已经证明了协调逆变器控制和优化调度策略的益处，但异构智能逆变器组在不同控制模式下运行的系统级影响仍未得到充分检验。本文通过评估采用不同控制策略（即：恒定功率因数（CPF）、Volt-VAR和Volt-Watt模式）的多个SI组之间的动态相互作用来解决这一空白。此外，分析涵盖了电阻性和电感性馈线类型。验证是使用实时设置进行的。在Opal-RT平台上模拟了CIRGE低压（LV）配电网络作为测试网络，从而能够在实际电网条件下对SI控制相互作用进行真实和高保真的评估。
tldr: 本文评估了在分布式能源高渗透率的低压配电网中，不同控制模式（CPF、Volt-VAR、Volt-Watt）的异构智能逆变器组之间的动态相互作用及其对系统稳定性的影响，使用实时仿真平台进行了验证。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于专注于评估“异构”智能逆变器控制模式（CPF、Volt-VAR、Volt-Watt）在分布式能源高渗透环境下的系统级动态相互作用。这对于理解和改进符合IEEE 1547-2018等新标准的电网运行至关重要。通过使用实时仿真平台（Opal-RT）和真实的测试网络（CIRGE LV网络），该研究提供了高保真度且贴近实际的评估结果，对于未来的智能电网规划和控制策略优化具有重要的实践价值。
motivation: 能源部门脱碳导致分布式能源（特别是光伏系统）在高渗透率下接入低压配电网。虽然智能逆变器被要求提供电网支持功能，但未协调的异构智能逆变器控制模式可能导致不良相互作用，损害系统效率、电压调节和整体稳定性。现有研究缺乏对异构智能逆变器组系统级影响的评估。
method: 通过评估采用不同控制策略（即：恒定功率因数（CPF）、Volt-VAR和Volt-Watt模式）的多个智能逆变器组之间的动态相互作用来解决该问题。分析涵盖了电阻性和电感性馈线类型。验证是使用实时设置进行的，在Opal-RT平台上模拟了CIRGE低压（LV）配电网络作为测试网络。

title: SV-GS: Sparse View 4D Reconstruction with Skeleton-Driven Gaussian Splatting
authors: Jun-Jee Chao, Volkan Isler
abstract: Reconstructing a dynamic target moving over a large area is challenging. Standard approaches for dynamic object reconstruction require dense coverage in both the viewing space and the temporal dimension, typically relying on multi-view videos captured at each time step. However, such setups are only possible in constrained environments. In real-world scenarios, observations are often sparse over time and captured sparsely from diverse viewpoints (e.g., from security cameras), making dynamic reconstruction highly ill-posed. We present SV-GS, a framework that simultaneously estimates a deformation model and the object's motion over time under sparse observations. To initialize SV-GS, we leverage a rough skeleton graph and an initial static reconstruction as inputs to guide motion estimation. (Later, we show that this input requirement can be relaxed.) Our method optimizes a skeleton-driven deformation field composed of a coarse skeleton joint pose estimator and a module for fine-grained deformations. By making only the joint pose estimator time-dependent, our model enables smooth motion interpolation while preserving learned geometric details. Experiments on synthetic datasets show that our method outperforms existing approaches under sparse observations by up to 34% in PSNR, and achieves comparable performance to dense monocular video methods on real-world datasets despite using significantly fewer frames. Moreover, we demonstrate that the input initial static reconstruction can be replaced by a diffusion-based generative prior, making our method more practical for real-world scenarios.
zh_title: SV-GS：基于骨架驱动高斯溅射的稀疏视角 4D 重建
translation: 重建在大范围内移动的动态目标极具挑战性。标准的动态物体重建方法需要在视角空间和时间维度上进行密集覆盖，通常依赖于在每个时间步捕获的多视角视频。然而，这种设置只在受限环境中可行。在现实世界场景中，观测数据在时间上往往是稀疏的，并且是从不同视角稀疏捕获的（例如，来自安全摄像头），这使得动态重建成为一个高度不适定的问题。我们提出了 SV-GS，一个在稀疏观测下同时估计形变模型和物体随时间运动的框架。为了初始化 SV-GS，我们利用粗略的骨架图和初始静态重建作为输入来指导运动估计（随后我们证明了这一输入要求可以放宽）。我们的方法优化了一个骨架驱动的形变场，该形变场由一个粗略的骨架关节姿态估计器和一个用于细粒度形变的模块组成。通过仅使关节姿态估计器与时间相关，我们的模型能够在保留学习到的几何细节的同时实现平滑的运动插值。在合成数据集上的实验表明，我们的方法在稀疏观测下性能优于现有方法，PSNR 提高了高达 34%，并且在真实世界数据集上，尽管使用的帧数明显更少，但仍能达到与密集单目视频方法相当的性能。此外，我们证明了输入的初始静态重建可以被基于扩散的生成先验取代，这使得我们的方法在现实世界场景中更具实用性。
tldr: SV-GS 是一种新的框架，用于在稀疏时空观测下重建动态目标。它利用骨架驱动的高斯溅射模型，通过仅使骨架姿态估计器与时间相关，实现了高质量的运动插值和几何细节保留。在稀疏数据集上表现优于现有方法，并提高了实际应用性。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将高斯溅射技术应用于极具挑战性的稀疏时空 4D 重建问题。通过引入骨架驱动的形变分解，将复杂的动态建模简化为时间相关的粗略姿态估计和时间无关的细节保持，有效地解决了稀疏数据下的不适定性问题。其在性能上（PSNR 提高 34%）的显著提升以及通过引入扩散生成先验来提高实用性的设计，表明该方法在推动现实世界稀疏监控场景下的动态重建方面具有重要意义。
motivation: 标准的动态目标重建方法需要密集的视角和时间覆盖（例如，每一步都有多视角视频），这在现实世界场景（如安全摄像头）中难以实现，导致动态重建问题高度不适定。本文旨在解决稀疏时空观测下的动态目标重建挑战。
method: 提出了 SV-GS 框架，用于同时估计稀疏观测下的形变模型和物体运动。该方法优化了一个骨架驱动的形变场，该形变场由一个粗略的骨架关节姿态估计器和一个细粒度形变模块组成。通过仅使关节姿态估计器与时间相关，模型实现了平滑的运动插值并保留了几何细节。初始输入可以是一个粗略的骨架图和静态重建（后者可被基于扩散的生成先验取代）。
results: 在合成数据集上，本方法在稀疏观测下性能优于现有方法，PSNR 提高了高达 34%。在真实世界数据集上，尽管使用了明显更少的帧，但仍能达到与密集单目视频方法相当的性能。此外，证明了初始静态重建输入可以被基于扩散的生成先验取代，使得方法更具实用性。

title: ClinicalReTrial: A Self-Evolving AI Agent for Clinical Trial Protocol Optimization
authors: Sixue Xing, Xuanye Xia, Kerui Wu, Meng Jiang, Jintai Chen, Tianfan Fu
abstract: Clinical trial failure remains a central bottleneck in drug development, where minor protocol design flaws can irreversibly compromise outcomes despite promising therapeutics. Although cutting-edge AI methods achieve strong performance in predicting trial success, they are inherently reactive for merely diagnosing risk without offering actionable remedies once failure is anticipated. To fill this gap, this paper proposes ClinicalReTrial, a self-evolving AI agent framework that addresses this gap by casting clinical trial reasoning as an iterative protocol redesign problem. Our method integrates failure diagnosis, safety-aware modification, and candidate evaluation in a closed-loop, reward-driven optimization framework. Serving the outcome prediction model as a simulation environment, ClinicalReTrial enables low-cost evaluation of protocol modifications and provides dense reward signals for continuous self-improvement. To support efficient exploration, the framework maintains hierarchical memory that captures iteration-level feedback within trials and distills transferable redesign patterns across trials. Empirically, ClinicalReTrial improves 83.3% of trial protocols with a mean success probability gain of 5.7%, and retrospective case studies demonstrate strong alignment between the discovered redesign strategies and real-world clinical trial modifications.
zh_title: ClinicalReTrial：一种用于临床试验方案优化的自进化AI智能体
translation: 临床试验失败仍然是药物开发中的一个核心瓶颈，微小的方案设计缺陷可能会不可逆转地损害结果，即使治疗方法本身很有前景。尽管尖端的AI方法在预测试验成功方面取得了强大的性能，但它们本质上是被动的，仅能诊断风险，一旦预期失败，却无法提供可操作的补救措施。为了填补这一空白，本文提出了ClinicalReTrial，一个自进化的AI智能体框架，通过将临床试验推理视为一个迭代的方案重新设计问题来解决这一问题。我们的方法在一个闭环、奖励驱动的优化框架中整合了失败诊断、安全感知修改和候选评估。通过将结果预测模型作为仿真环境，ClinicalReTrial能够对方案修改进行低成本评估，并为持续的自我改进提供密集的奖励信号。为了支持高效探索，该框架维护了分层记忆，用于捕获试验内的迭代级反馈并提炼跨试验的可转移重新设计模式。从经验上看，ClinicalReTrial改善了83.3%的试验方案，平均成功概率增益为5.7%，并且回顾性案例研究表明，所发现的重新设计策略与现实世界的临床试验修改高度一致。
tldr: ClinicalReTrial是一种自进化的AI智能体，它通过将临床试验推理视为迭代协议重新设计问题，主动优化试验方案，将成功率平均提高5.7%，解决了现有AI只能诊断风险但不能提供行动方案的局限。
ai_comments: 创新性在于将临床试验方案优化从传统的风险诊断（被动）转向了迭代、奖励驱动的协议重新设计（主动）框架。通过利用现有的预测模型作为模拟环境，该方法有效地实现了低成本的“试错”和自我改进，这是传统临床研究中成本极高且耗时的。分层记忆机制对于学习可泛化的重新设计模式至关重要，增强了智能体的实用性。其重要性在于，该系统有望显著减少新药开发中的时间和资源浪费，加速药物上市。摘要中未提及具体的模型架构细节（如使用了哪种强化学习或深度学习技术），这可能是其局限性，但核心思想清晰且具有很高的应用潜力。
motivation: 临床试验失败是药物研发的主要瓶颈，微小的方案设计缺陷可能导致不可逆转的后果。现有的AI方法虽然能预测试验成功率，但它们是被动的，只能诊断风险，无法提供可操作的补救措施。
method: 提出ClinicalReTrial，一个自进化的AI智能体框架，将临床试验推理转化为迭代协议重新设计问题。该方法在一个闭环、奖励驱动的优化框架中集成了失败诊断、安全感知修改和候选评估。它利用结果预测模型作为仿真环境，实现低成本评估和密集的奖励信号。框架维护分层记忆，用于捕获试验内的迭代级反馈和提炼跨试验的可转移重新设计模式。
results: ClinicalReTrial改善了83.3%的试验方案，平均成功概率提高了5.7%。回顾性案例研究表明，其发现的重新设计策略与现实世界中的临床试验修改高度一致。
conclusion: ClinicalReTrial通过迭代优化和自我进化，有效地解决了临床试验方案设计中的瓶颈问题，提供了主动的、可操作的方案修改策略，并获得了显著的成功率提升和实际应用价值。

title: Timed text extraction from Taiwanese Kua-á-hì TV series
authors: Tzu-Hung Huang, Yun-En Tsai, Yun-Ning Hung, Chih-Wei Wu, I-Chieh Wei, Li Su
abstract: Taiwanese opera (Kua-á-hì), a major form of local theatrical tradition, underwent extensive television adaptation notably by pioneers like Iûnn Lē-hua. These videos, while potentially valuable for in-depth studies of Taiwanese opera, often have low quality and require substantial manual effort during data preparation. To streamline this process, we developed an interactive system for real-time OCR correction and a two-step approach integrating OCR-driven segmentation with Speech and Music Activity Detection (SMAD) to efficiently identify vocal segments from archival episodes with high precision. The resulting dataset, consisting of vocal segments and corresponding lyrics, can potentially supports various MIR tasks such as lyrics identification and tune retrieval. Code is available at https://github.com/z-huang/ocr-subtitle-editor .
zh_title: 台湾歌仔戏电视剧的带时间文本提取
translation: 台湾歌仔戏（Kua-á-hì）作为一种主要的本土戏曲传统，经历了广泛的电视改编，其中以杨丽花等先驱者最为著名。这些视频虽然对歌仔戏的深入研究具有潜在价值，但通常质量较低，并且在数据准备过程中需要大量的体力劳动。为了简化这一过程，我们开发了一个用于实时OCR校正的交互式系统，并提出了一种两步法，将OCR驱动的分割与语音和音乐活动检测（SMAD）相结合，以高精度有效地识别档案剧集中的歌唱片段。由此产生的数据集，包含歌唱片段和相应的歌词，有可能支持各种音乐信息检索（MIR）任务，例如歌词识别和曲调检索。代码可在https://github.com/z-huang/ocr-subtitle-editor 获取。
tldr: 为解决低质量台湾歌仔戏视频数据准备困难的问题，本文开发了一个结合实时OCR校正和SMAD的两步法系统，用于高效、高精度地提取歌唱片段及其对应歌词，以支持音乐信息检索（MIR）任务。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将OCR技术与SMAD（语音和音乐活动检测）相结合，专门解决历史或低质量视频中字幕和歌唱片段难以自动对齐和提取的问题。这项工作对于保护和数字化像台湾歌仔戏这样的本土文化遗产具有重要意义，因为它将耗时的手动数据准备过程转化为半自动化流程。其局限性可能在于系统的性能高度依赖于OCR在低质量视频上的表现，以及SMAD对复杂背景音乐和人声的区分能力。
motivation: 台湾歌仔戏（Kua-á-hì）是一种重要的本土戏曲传统，其电视改编视频对深入研究歌仔戏具有价值。然而，这些视频通常质量低且数据准备需要大量手动工作。因此，需要开发一个系统来简化和提高数据提取的效率和精度。
method: 采用了一个两步法，结合了光学字符识别（OCR）驱动的分割和语音与音乐活动检测（SMAD）技术，以高精度识别存档剧集中的歌唱片段。同时，还开发了一个用于实时OCR校正的交互式系统。
results: 成功创建了一个由歌唱片段及其对应歌词组成的数据集。
conclusion: 提取出的数据集（包含歌唱片段和对应歌词）能够支持各种音乐信息检索（MIR）任务，例如歌词识别和曲调检索。

title: TimeColor: Flexible Reference Colorization via Temporal Concatenation
authors: Bryan Constantine Sadihin, Yihao Meng, Michael Hua Wang, Matteo Jiahao Chen, Hang Su
abstract: Most colorization models condition only on a single reference, typically the first frame of the scene. However, this approach ignores other sources of conditional data, such as character sheets, background images, or arbitrary colorized frames. We propose TimeColor, a sketch-based video colorization model that supports heterogeneous, variable-count references with the use of explicit per-reference region assignment. TimeColor encodes references as additional latent frames which are concatenated temporally, permitting them to be processed concurrently in each diffusion step while keeping the model's parameter count fixed. TimeColor also uses spatiotemporal correspondence-masked attention to enforce subject-reference binding in addition to modality-disjoint RoPE indexing. These mechanisms mitigate shortcutting and cross-identity palette leakage. Experiments on SAKUGA-42M under both single- and multi-reference protocols show that TimeColor improves color fidelity, identity consistency, and temporal stability over prior baselines.
comment: Demo samples are available at: https://bconstantine.github.io/TimeColor/
zh_title: TimeColor：通过时间连接实现的灵活参考着色
translation: 大多数着色模型仅以单个参考（通常是场景的第一帧）为条件。然而，这种方法忽略了其他条件数据的来源，例如角色设定图、背景图像或任意着色帧。我们提出了TimeColor，一个基于草图的视频着色模型，它通过显式的按参考区域分配，支持异构、可变数量的参考。TimeColor将参考编码为额外的潜在帧，然后进行时间连接，允许它们在每个扩散步骤中并发处理，同时保持模型的参数数量固定。TimeColor还使用时空对应掩码注意力机制，以及模态分离的RoPE索引，以加强主体与参考的绑定。这些机制减轻了捷径学习（shortcutting）和跨身份调色板泄露（cross-identity palette leakage）的问题。在单参考和多参考协议下，对SAKUGA-42M进行的实验表明，TimeColor在颜色保真度、身份一致性和时间稳定性方面均优于现有基线。
tldr: TimeColor是一种基于草图的视频着色模型，它通过将多种异构参考（如角色设定图、背景图等）作为额外的潜在帧进行时间连接，从而在保持参数量固定的情况下，提高了着色的颜色保真度和时间一致性。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了“时间连接”的方法，将数量可变的异构参考（如外部角色设定图）统一编码为潜在帧并沿时间维度拼接，使得模型能够在保持固定参数量的同时高效利用多源信息。这解决了传统视频着色模型只能依赖单一或固定数量参考的限制。此外，通过引入时空对应掩码注意力和模态分离的RoPE索引，有效缓解了多参考输入中常见的“捷径学习”和“调色板泄露”问题，对于提高长视频着色的身份一致性和时间稳定性具有重要意义。
motivation: 大多数着色模型仅依赖单个参考（通常是场景的第一帧），忽略了其他有价值的条件数据来源，如角色设定图、背景图像或任意着色帧。
method: 提出TimeColor模型，它通过显式的按参考区域分配，支持异构、可变数量的参考。方法是将参考编码为额外的潜在帧，然后进行时间连接，使其在每个扩散步骤中并发处理，同时保持模型参数量固定。此外，使用时空对应掩码注意力机制和模态分离的RoPE索引来增强主体-参考绑定。
results: 在SAKUGA-42M数据集上，无论是在单参考还是多参考协议下，TimeColor均在颜色保真度、身份一致性和时间稳定性方面优于现有基线。
conclusion: TimeColor通过时间连接和创新的注意力机制，成功支持了多种异构参考，有效解决了现有模型的局限性，显著提高了视频着色的质量、一致性和稳定性。

title: Spectral Schur analysis of structured moment matrices for quadratic histopolation
authors: Allal Guessab, Federico Nudo
abstract: In this paper we study parameter-dependent structured moment matrices with a canonical block form arising from weighted quadratic histopolation on simplicial meshes. For a strictly positive density on a simplex, we construct compatible face densities and an orthogonal decomposition of the quadratic polynomial space into face and interior components, which induces a natural face-interior block structure. A reduced Schur complement is identified that fully characterizes enrichment and well-posedness and provides a sharp spectral stability result. We show that this quantity coincides with the square root of the smallest eigenvalue of a low-dimensional symmetric positive definite operator. This matrix-based viewpoint yields simple spectral criteria for the invertibility of local moment systems and motivates spectrally preferable choices of face and interior bases with improved conditioning. Using the resulting degrees of freedom together with density and scaling parameters as design variables, we formulate a small eigenvalue optimization problem aimed at improving stability and reducing the condition number of the global reconstruction system. Three-dimensional experiments on uniform and quasi-uniform simplicial meshes illustrate the predicted stability, conditioning, and convergence behaviour of the enriched quadratic reconstruction.
zh_title: 结构化矩矩阵的谱舒尔分析在二次历史插值中的应用
translation: 在本文中，我们研究了源于单纯形网格上加权二次历史插值的具有规范块形式的参数依赖结构化矩矩阵。对于单纯形上的严格正密度，我们构造了相容的面密度，并将二次多项式空间正交分解为面和内部分量，这诱导了一个自然的面-内部块结构。一个约化舒尔补被识别出来，它完全表征了富集和适定性，并提供了一个尖锐的谱稳定性结果。我们证明了这个量与一个低维对称正定算子的最小特征值的平方根相一致。这种基于矩阵的观点产生了用于可逆性的简单谱判据，用于局部矩系统，并启发了具有改进条件数的面向和内部基底的选择。使用由此产生的自由度以及密度和缩放参数作为设计变量，我们制定了一个旨在提高稳定性和减小全局重建系统条件数的小特征值优化问题。均匀和准均匀单纯形网格上的三维实验说明了富集二次重构的预测稳定性、条件和收敛行为。
tldr: 研究了用于二次历史插值的结构化矩矩阵，通过谱舒尔分析找到了一个关键的稳定性指标（约化舒尔补），该指标与一个小型算子的最小特征值相关。这提供了判断系统是否可逆的简单准则，并指导了如何选择更好的基底来优化系统的条件数和稳定性，最终通过优化问题和实验验证了这些发现。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于利用谱舒尔分析来研究由加权二次历史插值产生的结构化矩矩阵的性质，特别是识别了一个完全表征富集和适定性的约化舒尔补。其重要性在于提供了一个清晰的谱稳定性结果，并将其与低维算子的最小特征值联系起来，从而为选择具有更好条件数的基底提供了理论依据。局限性是目前的研究似乎集中在单纯形网格上的二次插值。
motivation: 动机是研究源于加权二次历史插值在单纯形网格上的参数依赖结构化矩矩阵，特别是为了理解和提高与这些系统相关的稳定性和条件数。
method: 研究人员首先在给定严格正密度的情况下，在单纯形上构造了相容的面密度，并将二次多项式空间正交分解为面和内部分量，从而产生了自然的块结构。然后，他们识别了一个约化舒尔补，并推导出了一个尖锐的谱稳定性结果。该方法利用矩阵观点来获得局部矩系统的可逆性的谱准则，并提出了一种利用自由度、密度和缩放参数的小特征值优化问题。
results: 得出了一个尖锐的谱稳定性结果，表明约化舒尔补与一个低维对称正定算子的最小特征值的平方根相一致。这为局部矩系统的可逆性提供了简单的谱判据，并启发了具有改进条件数的面和内部基底的选择。三维实验证明了富集二次重构的稳定性、条件和收敛行为。
conclusion: 该研究通过识别一个约化舒尔补，提供了关于局部矩系统的可逆性的清晰谱判据，并启发了具有改进条件数的面和内部基底的选择。基于由此产生的自由度、密度和缩放参数，研究人员提出了一个旨在提高全局重建系统稳定性和减小条件数的小特征值优化问题。三维实验验证了富集二次重构的稳定性和收敛性。

title: Combining Time-Series and Graph Data: A Survey of Existing Systems and Approaches
authors: Mouna Ammar, Marvin Hofer, Erhard Rahm
abstract: We provide a comprehensive overview of current approaches and systems for combining graphs and time series data. We categorize existing systems into four architectural categories and analyze how these systems meet different requirements and exhibit distinct implementation characteristics to support both data types in a unified manner. Our overview aims to help readers understand and evaluate current options and trade-offs, such as the degree of cross-model integration, maturity, and openness.
zh_title: 结合时间序列和图数据：现有系统与方法的综述
translation: 我们对当前结合图数据和时间序列数据的现有方法和系统进行了全面概述。我们将现有系统分为四种架构类别，并分析了这些系统如何满足不同需求以及为以统一方式支持这两种数据类型所表现出的不同实现特征。我们的概述旨在帮助读者理解和评估当前选项和权衡，例如跨模型集成的程度、成熟度和开放性。
tldr: 综述了处理和集成图数据与时间序列数据的现有系统和方法，并根据架构对其进行分类，帮助读者理解不同方法的优缺点。
ai_comments: 这项工作的创新之处在于对现有系统进行了系统的分类和分析，重点关注了跨模型集成、成熟度和开放性等关键权衡点，为研究人员和实践者提供了一个清晰的评估框架。
motivation: 帮助读者理解和评估当前用于结合图和时间序列数据的选项及其权衡，例如跨模型集成度、成熟度和开放性。
method: 对现有系统进行全面概述、分类（分为四种架构类别）和分析。
results: 对现有系统进行了分类，并分析了它们如何满足不同需求以及支持两种数据类型的统一方式所表现出的不同实现特征。

title: Replaceable Bit-based Gripper for Picking Cluttered Food Items
authors: Prashant Kumar, Yukiyasu Domae, Weiwei Wan, Kensuke Harada
abstract: The food packaging industry goes through changes in food items and their weights quite rapidly. These items range from easy-to-pick, single-piece food items to flexible, long and cluttered ones. We propose a replaceable bit-based gripper system to tackle the challenge of weight-based handling of cluttered food items. The gripper features specialized food attachments(bits) that enhance its grasping capabilities, and a belt replacement system allows switching between different food items during packaging operations. It offers a wide range of control options, enabling it to grasp and drop specific weights of granular, cluttered, and entangled foods. We specifically designed bits for two flexible food items that differ in shape: ikura(salmon roe) and spaghetti. They represent the challenging categories of sticky, granular food and long, sticky, cluttered food, respectively. The gripper successfully picked up both spaghetti and ikura and demonstrated weight-specific dropping of these items with an accuracy over 80% and 95% respectively. The gripper system also exhibited quick switching between different bits, leading to the handling of a large range of food items.
zh_title: 可更换比特式夹爪，用于抓取杂乱食物
translation: 食品包装行业在食品及其重量方面变化相当迅速。这些物品范围从易于抓取的单件食品到柔性、长形和杂乱的食品。我们提出了一种可更换比特式夹爪系统，以应对基于重量处理杂乱食品的挑战。该夹爪具有专门的食品附件（比特），以增强其抓取能力，并且皮带更换系统允许在包装操作中在不同食品之间进行切换。它提供了广泛的控制选项，使其能够抓取和丢弃特定重量的颗粒状、杂乱和缠绕的食品。我们专门为两种形状不同的柔性食品设计了比特：鲑鱼籽（ikura）和意大利面。它们分别代表了粘性颗粒状食品和长形、粘性、杂乱食品的挑战性类别。该夹爪成功抓取了意大利面和鲑鱼籽，并分别以超过80%和95%的准确率展示了这些物品的重量特定投掷。该夹爪系统还展示了在不同比特之间快速切换的能力，从而能够处理各种食品。
tldr: 提出一种可更换比特式夹爪系统，用于处理重量变化大且形状杂乱的食品包装任务。该夹爪通过更换不同的“比特”（食品附件）来适应不同食品，并能精确抓取和投掷特定重量的颗粒状、杂乱或缠绕状食品。实验表明，该夹爪在抓取鲑鱼籽和意大利面方面表现出色，重量投掷准确率分别超过80%和95%。
ai_comments: 该研究提出的可更换比特式夹爪系统在解决食品包装自动化中的一个关键痛点方面具有显著的创新性。通过模块化的“比特”设计和快速更换机制，该系统有效地提高了对不同形状、重量和粘性食品的适应性和处理能力。特别是其在精确重量投掷方面的准确率令人印象深刻。然而，该系统的长期耐用性、在极端温度或湿度条件下的表现，以及更换比特的自动化程度和成本效益，可能是在实际工业应用中需要进一步考虑和研究的方面。
motivation: 食品包装行业需要快速适应不同重量和形状的食品（从易于抓取的单一食品到柔性、长形和杂乱的食品），现有技术难以应对这种挑战。
method: 提出一种可更换比特式夹爪系统，该系统包含专门的食品附件（比特）以增强抓取能力，并采用皮带更换系统以在包装操作中快速切换不同比特，从而适应不同食品。该夹爪提供多种控制选项，能够抓取和投掷特定重量的颗粒状、杂乱和缠绕状食品。针对鲑鱼籽（粘性颗粒状食品）和意大利面（长形、粘性、杂乱食品）这两种具有挑战性的柔性食品，设计了专门的比特。
results: 夹爪成功抓取了意大利面和鲑鱼籽，并能根据设定的重量进行投掷，其中对意大利面的投掷准确率超过80%，对鲑鱼籽的投掷准确率超过95%。该夹爪系统还展示了快速切换比特的能力，能够处理各种食品。
conclusion: 提出的可更换比特式夹爪系统能够有效应对食品包装行业中遇到的重量和形状多变的食品抓取挑战，尤其在处理杂乱、粘性或缠绕状食品方面表现出高效率和高准确性。

title: DepFlow: Disentangled Speech Generation to Mitigate Semantic Bias in Depression Detection
authors: Yuxin Li, Xiangyu Zhang, Yifei Li, Zhiwei Guo, Haoyang Zhang, Eng Siong Chng, Cuntai Guan
abstract: Speech is a scalable and non-invasive biomarker for early mental health screening. However, widely used depression datasets like DAIC-WOZ exhibit strong coupling between linguistic sentiment and diagnostic labels, encouraging models to learn semantic shortcuts. As a result, model robustness may be compromised in real-world scenarios, such as Camouflaged Depression, where individuals maintain socially positive or neutral language despite underlying depressive states. To mitigate this semantic bias, we propose DepFlow, a three-stage depression-conditioned text-to-speech framework. First, a Depression Acoustic Encoder learns speaker- and content-invariant depression embeddings through adversarial training, achieving effective disentanglement while preserving depression discriminability (ROC-AUC: 0.693). Second, a flow-matching TTS model with FiLM modulation injects these embeddings into synthesis, enabling control over depressive severity while preserving content and speaker identity. Third, a prototype-based severity mapping mechanism provides smooth and interpretable manipulation across the depression continuum. Using DepFlow, we construct a Camouflage Depression-oriented Augmentation (CDoA) dataset that pairs depressed acoustic patterns with positive/neutral content from a sentiment-stratified text bank, creating acoustic-semantic mismatches underrepresented in natural data. Evaluated across three depression detection architectures, CDoA improves macro-F1 by 9%, 12%, and 5%, respectively, consistently outperforming conventional augmentation strategies in depression Detection. Beyond enhancing robustness, DepFlow provides a controllable synthesis platform for conversational systems and simulation-based evaluation, where real clinical data remains limited by ethical and coverage constraints.
zh_title: DepFlow：解耦语音生成以减轻抑郁检测中的语义偏见
translation: 语音是一种可扩展且非侵入性的早期心理健康筛查生物标志物。然而，广泛使用的抑郁数据集如DAIC-WOZ在语言情感和诊断标签之间表现出强烈的耦合，促使模型学习语义捷径。因此，模型的鲁棒性在现实场景中可能会受到损害，例如在“伪装性抑郁”中，个体尽管存在潜在的抑郁状态，但仍保持社会性积极或中性的语言。为了减轻这种语义偏见，我们提出了DepFlow，一个三阶段的抑郁条件文本到语音框架。首先，一个抑郁声学编码器通过对抗性训练学习说话者和内容无关的抑郁嵌入，在保持抑郁可区分性的同时实现了有效的解耦（ROC-AUC：0.693）。其次，一个带有FiLM调制的流匹配TTS模型将这些嵌入注入合成过程，从而能够在保持内容和说话者身份的同时控制抑郁严重程度。第三，一个基于原型的严重性映射机制在整个抑郁连续体上提供平滑且可解释的操作。利用DepFlow，我们构建了一个面向伪装性抑郁的数据增强（CDoA）数据集，该数据集将来自情感分层文本库的积极/中性内容与抑郁声学模式配对，创建了自然数据中代表性不足的声学-语义不匹配。在跨越三种抑郁检测架构的评估中，CDoA使宏观F1分数分别提高了9%、12%和5%，持续优于抑郁检测中的传统增强策略。除了增强鲁棒性外，DepFlow还为对话系统和模拟评估提供了一个可控的合成平台，在这些领域，由于伦理和覆盖范围的限制，真实临床数据受到限制。
tldr: DepFlow是一个新的文本到语音系统，它将抑郁声音特征与说话内容分离开来，用以生成更逼真的“伪装性抑郁”语音样本（CDoA数据集），从而训练出的抑郁检测模型在现实场景中性能提升了9%到12%。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地提出了一个三阶段的文本到语音框架（DepFlow）来解耦语音中的语义内容和抑郁特征，从而解决了现有抑郁检测数据集中语义偏见的问题。其重要性在于通过生成具有声学-语义不匹配的合成数据（CDoA）来提高模型对“伪装性抑郁”的鲁棒性。局限性可能在于其在特定数据集上的性能（ROC-AUC: 0.693）是否能完全代表真实世界的复杂性。
motivation: 现有的抑郁数据集（如DAIC-WOZ）在语言情感和诊断标签之间存在强耦合，导致模型学习语义捷径，损害了模型在“伪装性抑郁”等现实场景中的鲁棒性，即个体在抑郁状态下仍保持社会性积极或中性语言。
method: DepFlow是一个三阶段的抑郁条件文本到语音框架：1. 抑郁声学编码器通过对抗性训练学习内容和说话者无关的抑郁嵌入；2. 基于流匹配的TTS模型使用FiLM调制注入这些嵌入以控制抑郁严重性；3. 原型驱动的严重性映射机制提供平滑的连续体操作。最后，利用DepFlow构建了CDoA数据集用于模型增强。
results: 抑郁声学编码器实现了有效的解耦，同时保持了抑郁的可区分性（ROC-AUC: 0.693）。使用CDoA数据集，在三种抑郁检测架构上，宏观F1分数分别提高了9%、12%和5%，持续优于传统增强策略。
conclusion: DepFlow提供了一个可控的合成平台，通过生成具有声学-语义不匹配的CDoA数据集，持续提高了三种抑郁检测架构的宏观F1分数，显著优于传统增强策略，增强了模型对伪装性抑郁的鲁棒性。

title: The Generative AI Paradox: GenAI and the Erosion of Trust, the Corrosion of Information Verification, and the Demise of Truth
authors: Emilio Ferrara
abstract: Generative AI (GenAI) now produces text, images, audio, and video that can be perceptually convincing at scale and at negligible marginal cost. While public debate often frames the associated harms as "deepfakes" or incremental extensions of misinformation and fraud, this view misses a broader socio-technical shift: GenAI enables synthetic realities; coherent, interactive, and potentially personalized information environments in which content, identity, and social interaction are jointly manufactured and mutually reinforcing. We argue that the most consequential risk is not merely the production of isolated synthetic artifacts, but the progressive erosion of shared epistemic ground and institutional verification practices as synthetic content, synthetic identity, and synthetic interaction become easy to generate and hard to audit. This paper (i) formalizes synthetic reality as a layered stack (content, identity, interaction, institutions), (ii) expands a taxonomy of GenAI harms spanning personal, economic, informational, and socio-technical risks, (iii) articulates the qualitative shifts introduced by GenAI (cost collapse, throughput, customization, micro-segmentation, provenance gaps, and trust erosion), and (iv) synthesizes recent risk realizations (2023-2025) into a compact case bank illustrating how these mechanisms manifest in fraud, elections, harassment, documentation, and supply-chain compromise. We then propose a mitigation stack that treats provenance infrastructure, platform governance, institutional workflow redesign, and public resilience as complementary rather than substitutable, and outline a research agenda focused on measuring epistemic security. We conclude with the Generative AI Paradox: as synthetic media becomes ubiquitous, societies may rationally discount digital evidence altogether.
zh_title: 生成式AI悖论：生成式AI与信任的侵蚀、信息验证的腐蚀以及真相的消亡
translation: 生成式人工智能（GenAI）现在能够以规模化和极低的边际成本生成在感知上令人信服的文本、图像、音频和视频。尽管公众辩论通常将相关危害定性为“深度伪造”或错误信息和欺诈的渐进式延伸，但这种观点错失了一个更广泛的社会技术转变：GenAI能够实现合成现实；即内容、身份和社会互动被共同制造和相互强化的连贯、交互式且可能个性化的信息环境。我们认为，最重大的风险不仅仅是产生孤立的合成制品，而是随着合成内容、合成身份和合成交互变得易于生成且难以审计，共享的认知基础和制度验证实践将逐渐被侵蚀。本文（i）将合成现实形式化为一个分层堆栈（内容、身份、交互、制度），（ii）扩展了一个涵盖个人、经济、信息和社会技术风险的GenAI危害分类法，（iii）阐述了GenAI引入的定性转变（成本崩溃、吞吐量、定制化、微细分、可追溯性差距和信任侵蚀），（iv）将近期的风险实现（2023-2025年）综合成一个紧凑的案例库，说明这些机制如何在欺诈、选举、骚扰、文档记录和供应链妥协中显现。然后，我们提出了一个缓解堆栈，将可追溯性基础设施、平台治理、制度工作流程再设计和公众韧性视为互补而非可替代的因素，并概述了一个专注于衡量认知安全性的研究议程。我们最后以生成式AI悖论作结：随着合成媒体变得无处不在，社会可能理性地完全不信任数字证据。
tldr: 生成式AI不仅制造深度伪造，它通过大规模、低成本的合成内容、身份和交互，系统性地破坏了我们共享的认知基础和信息验证机制，最终可能导致社会完全不信任任何数字证据。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了“生成式AI悖论”，强调了其对共享认知基础和验证实践的系统性威胁，而非仅仅是孤立的深度伪造。其创新在于将风险框架化为“合成现实”的层次结构，并提出了一个多层次的缓解策略。然而，其对未来风险的预测性较强，实际的系统性冲击仍有待观察。
motivation: 公共讨论往往将生成式AI的危害局限于“深度伪造”或错误信息的增量扩展，但这种观点忽略了更广泛的社会技术转变：即生成式AI能够大规模、低成本地制造连贯、可交互、个性化的合成现实环境，从而导致共享认知基础和机构验证实践的逐步瓦解。
method: 本文通过形式化“合成现实”的层次结构（内容、身份、交互、制度），扩展了生成式AI危害的分类法，阐述了其引入的定性转变（如成本崩溃、可追溯性差距），并综合了近期的风险实例来构建案例库。最后，提出了一个多层次的缓解措施堆栈。
results: 论文形式化了合成现实的层次结构，扩展了危害分类法，阐述了由生成式AI带来的定性转变（如成本崩溃、可追溯性差距），并构建了案例库来说明风险的体现。此外，还提出了一个包含溯源基础设施、平台治理、制度工作流程再设计和公众韧性的互补性缓解堆栈。
conclusion: 随着合成媒体的普及，社会可能理性地完全不信任数字证据，这就是生成式AI悖论。

title: VisNet: Efficient Person Re-Identification via Alpha-Divergence Loss, Feature Fusion and Dynamic Multi-Task Learning
authors: Anns Ijaz, Muhammad Azeem Javed
abstract: Person re-identification (ReID) is an extremely important area in both surveillance and mobile applications, requiring strong accuracy with minimal computational cost. State-of-the-art methods give good accuracy but with high computational budgets. To remedy this, this paper proposes VisNet, a computationally efficient and effective re-identification model suitable for real-world scenarios. It is the culmination of conceptual contributions, including feature fusion at multiple scales with automatic attention on each, semantic clustering with anatomical body partitioning, a dynamic weight averaging technique to balance classification semantic regularization, and the use of loss function FIDI for improved metric learning tasks. The multiple scales fuse ResNet50's stages 1 through 4 without the use of parallel paths, with semantic clustering introducing spatial constraints through the use of rule-based pseudo-labeling. VisNet achieves 87.05% Rank-1 and 77.65% mAP on the Market-1501 dataset, having 32.41M parameters and 4.601 GFLOPs, hence, proposing a practical approach for real-time deployment in surveillance and mobile applications where computational resources are limited.
zh_title: VisNet：通过 Alpha 散度损失、特征融合和动态多任务学习实现高效的行人重识别
translation: 行人重识别（ReID）是监控和移动应用中一个极其重要的领域，它要求高精度和最小的计算成本。最先进的方法虽然能提供良好的准确性，但计算成本很高。为了解决这个问题，本文提出了 VisNet，一个计算高效且有效的重识别模型，适用于实际场景。它是概念性贡献的结晶，包括具有多尺度自动注意力的特征融合、具有解剖学身体分割的语义聚类、用于平衡分类语义正则化的动态权重平均技术，以及用于改进度量学习任务的 FIDI 损失函数。多尺度融合了 ResNet50 的 1-4 阶段，没有使用并行路径，语义聚类通过使用基于规则的伪标签引入了空间约束。VisNet 在 Market-1501 数据集上实现了 87.05% 的 Rank-1 和 77.65% 的 mAP，拥有 32.41M 参数和 4.601 GFLOPs，因此，为计算资源有限的监控和移动应用中的实时部署提出了一种实用的方法。
tldr: VisNet 提出了一种高效的行人重识别模型，通过多尺度特征融合、语义聚类和动态多任务学习，在保持高精度的同时显著降低了计算成本，适用于资源受限的实际应用。
ai_comments: 该研究成功地在保持高精度的同时，显著降低了行人重识别模型的计算成本，这对于实际部署具有重要意义。通过多尺度特征融合、语义聚类和动态多任务学习等创新技术的结合，VisNet 提供了一个在效率和性能之间取得良好平衡的解决方案。然而，文中提到的“自动注意力”和“动态权重平均技术”的具体实现细节可以进一步阐述，以供未来研究参考。
motivation: 现有的行人重识别方法虽然准确率高，但计算成本也高，不适用于资源受限的实际场景。因此，需要一种既高效又准确的行人重识别模型。
method: VisNet 采用多尺度特征融合（融合 ResNet50 的 1-4 阶段）、带自动注意力的语义聚类（通过基于规则的伪标签引入空间约束）、动态权重平均技术（用于平衡分类语义正则化）以及 FIDI 损失函数。
results: VisNet 在 Market-1501 数据集上取得了 87.05% 的 Rank-1 准确率和 77.65% 的 mAP，参数量为 32.41M，计算量为 4.601 GFLOPs。
conclusion: VisNet 提出了一种计算高效且有效的行人重识别模型，通过多项创新技术实现了高精度和低计算成本的平衡，为在计算资源有限的监控和移动应用中进行实时部署提供了一种实用的方法。

title: Can Optimal Transport Improve Federated Inverse Reinforcement Learning?
authors: David Millard, Ali Baheri
abstract: In robotics and multi-agent systems, fleets of autonomous agents often operate in subtly different environments while pursuing a common high-level objective. Directly pooling their data to learn a shared reward function is typically impractical due to differences in dynamics, privacy constraints, and limited communication bandwidth. This paper introduces an optimal transport-based approach to federated inverse reinforcement learning (IRL). Each client first performs lightweight Maximum Entropy IRL locally, adhering to its computational and privacy limitations. The resulting reward functions are then fused via a Wasserstein barycenter, which considers their underlying geometric structure. We further prove that this barycentric fusion yields a more faithful global reward estimate than conventional parameter averaging methods in federated learning. Overall, this work provides a principled and communication-efficient framework for deriving a shared reward that generalizes across heterogeneous agents and environments.
zh_title: 最优传输能改善联邦逆强化学习吗？
translation: 在机器人和多智能体系统中，自主智能体群通常在略有不同的环境中操作，同时追求共同的高层目标。由于动力学差异、隐私限制和有限的通信带宽，直接汇集其数据以学习共享奖励函数通常是不切实际的。本文介绍了一种基于最优传输的方法，用于联邦逆强化学习（IRL）。每个客户端首先在本地执行轻量级的最大熵逆强化学习，以遵守其计算和隐私限制。然后，通过考虑其底层几何结构的Wasserstein质心来融合所得的奖励函数。我们进一步证明，这种质心融合比联邦学习中传统的参数平均方法能产生更忠实的全局奖励估计。总而言之，这项工作为推导能够跨异构智能体和环境泛化的共享奖励提供了一个原则性且通信高效的框架。
tldr: 为了在隐私受限和环境异构的联邦学习机器人系统中学习共享奖励，我们不直接平均参数，而是使用最优传输（Wasserstein质心）来融合每个客户端本地计算出的奖励函数，这样做能得到更准确的全局奖励估计。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于将最优传输（OT）理论应用于联邦逆强化学习（IRL）中的奖励函数聚合，利用Wasserstein质心来融合异构客户端的局部奖励估计，这比传统的参数平均方法更具几何结构感知能力。其重要性在于为在动态和隐私受限的异构多智能体系统中学习共享奖励提供了一个原则性且高效的框架。局限性在于摘要中未提及具体实验结果的量化或与现有SOTA方法的详细比较。
motivation: 在机器人和多智能体系统中，自主智能体群通常在略有不同的环境中操作，但追求共同的高层目标。由于动力学差异、隐私限制和有限的通信带宽，直接汇集数据以学习共享奖励函数通常是不切实际的。
method: 首先，每个客户端在本地执行轻量级的最大熵逆强化学习。然后，通过考虑底层几何结构的Wasserstein质心来融合得到的奖励函数。
results: 证明了这种质心融合比传统的联邦学习中的参数平均方法能产生更忠实的全局奖励估计。
conclusion: 这项工作为推导能够跨异构智能体和环境泛化的共享奖励提供了一个原则性且通信高效的框架。

title: ReMA: A Training-Free Plug-and-Play Mixing Augmentation for Video Behavior Recognition
authors: Feng-Qi Cui, Jinyang Huang, Sirui Zhao, Jinglong Guo, Qifan Cai, Xin Yan, Zhi Liu
abstract: Video behavior recognition demands stable and discriminative representations under complex spatiotemporal variations. However, prevailing data augmentation strategies for videos remain largely perturbation-driven, often introducing uncontrolled variations that amplify non-discriminative factors, which finally weaken intra-class distributional structure and representation drift with inconsistent gains across temporal scales. To address these problems, we propose Representation-aware Mixing Augmentation (ReMA), a plug-and-play augmentation strategy that formulates mixing as a controlled replacement process to expand representations while preserving class-conditional stability. ReMA integrates two complementary mechanisms. Firstly, the Representation Alignment Mechanism (RAM) performs structured intra-class mixing under distributional alignment constraints, suppressing irrelevant intra-class drift while enhancing statistical reliability. Then, the Dynamic Selection Mechanism (DSM) generates motion-aware spatiotemporal masks to localize perturbations, guiding them away from discrimination-sensitive regions and promoting temporal coherence. By jointly controlling how and where mixing is applied, ReMA improves representation robustness without additional supervision or trainable parameters. Extensive experiments on diverse video behavior benchmarks demonstrate that ReMA consistently enhances generalization and robustness across different spatiotemporal granularities.
zh_title: ReMA：一种用于视频行为识别的免训练即插即用混合增强方法
translation: 视频行为识别需要稳定的和具有判别力的表示来应对复杂时空变化。然而，现有的主流视频数据增强策略大多基于扰动驱动，通常引入不可控的变化，放大非判别性因素，最终削弱类内分布结构，并导致表示漂移，在不同时间尺度上效果不一致。为解决这些问题，我们提出了表示感知混合增强（ReMA），这是一种即插即用的增强策略，它将混合构建为一种受控的替换过程，以扩展表示同时保持类别条件的稳定性。ReMA集成了两个互补的机制。首先，表示对齐机制（RAM）在分布对齐约束下执行结构化的类内混合，抑制不相关的类内漂移，同时增强统计可靠性。然后，动态选择机制（DSM）生成运动感知的时空掩码来定位扰动，引导它们避开识别敏感区域，并促进时间一致性。通过联合控制混合的应用方式和位置，ReMA在没有额外监督或可训练参数的情况下提高了表示的鲁棒性。在多样化的视频行为基准上的广泛实验表明，ReMA在不同时空粒度上一致地提高了泛化能力和鲁棒性。
tldr: ReMA是一种新的、无需训练的视频增强方法，它通过智能地控制数据混合发生的位置和方式（使用RAM和DSM），在不引入额外参数的情况下，使视频表示更具鲁棒性和判别力，有效解决了传统扰动增强带来的问题。
ai_comments: ReMA的创新点在于将数据混合（Mixing）视为一种受控的替换过程，旨在扩展表示的同时保持类别条件稳定性，而不是简单地依赖扰动。它通过RAM和DSM两个机制实现了对混合过程的精细控制，特别是DSM的运动感知掩码机制，有效保护了对识别敏感的区域。该方法“免训练”（Training-Free）和“即插即用”（Plug-and-Play）的特性使其易于集成到现有模型中。局限性可能在于其对“表示感知”的假设是否在所有视频任务中都成立。
motivation: 现有的视频数据增强策略大多是基于扰动的，容易引入不可控的变化，放大非判别性因素，削弱类内结构，并导致表示漂移，在不同时间尺度上增益不一致。需要一种能够扩展表示同时保持类别条件稳定性的增强方法。
method: ReMA是一种即插即用的增强策略，它将混合操作构建为一个受控的替换过程。它集成了两个机制：1. 表示对齐机制（RAM），在分布对齐约束下执行结构化的类内混合，以抑制不相关的类内漂移并增强统计可靠性。2. 动态选择机制（DSM），生成运动感知的时空掩码来定位扰动，引导它们避开识别敏感区域，并促进时间一致性。
results: ReMA在多样化的视频行为基准测试中，一致地提高了不同时空粒度下的泛化能力和鲁棒性。
conclusion: ReMA通过联合控制混合的时机和位置，在不引入额外监督或可训练参数的情况下，提高了表示的鲁棒性，并在不同的时空粒度上一致地提高了泛化能力和鲁棒性。

title: On the Error Floor Evaluation of NOMA-Irregular Repetition Slotted ALOHA
authors: Estefanía Recayte
abstract: In this work, we provide a simple yet tight analytical approximation of the packet loss rate in the error floor region for a non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA)-based irregular repetition slotted ALOHA (IRSA) scheme. Considering an Internet of Things (IoT) scenario, users randomly select both the number of replicas based on a designed degree distribution and the transmission power from predetermined levels, while successive interference cancellation (SIC) is performed at the receiver. Our derived packet loss rate expression in the finite length regime is promptly evaluated. Its accuracy is validated through Monte-Carlo simulations, demonstrating a strong match across channel loads, including those beyond the low load regime
zh_title: 关于NOMA-不规则重复时隙ALOHA的错误地板评估
translation: 在这项工作中，我们为基于非正交多址接入（NOMA）的不规则重复时隙ALOHA（IRSA）方案在错误地板区域的分组丢失率提供了一个简单而紧密的分析近似。考虑到物联网（IoT）场景，用户根据设计的度分布随机选择副本数量和预定级别的传输功率，同时在接收端进行连续干扰消除（SIC）。推导的有限长度下的分组丢失率表达式得到了快速评估。其准确性通过蒙特卡洛模拟得到验证，在各种信道负载下，包括低负载以外的区域，都显示出高度的一致性。
tldr: 研究人员为NOMA-IRSA系统在错误地板区域的包丢失率提供了一个简单、准确的数学公式，该公式考虑了IoT场景下的功率和副本选择，并经仿真验证了其有效性。
ai_comments: 该研究的创新之处在于提出了一个用于NOMA-IRSA方案错误地板区域分组丢失率的简单而精确的近似分析方法。重要性在于为物联网场景下采用NOMA-IRSA的系统性能评估提供了高效的理论工具。局限性可能在于它是一个“近似”分析，其在极高负载下的精确性需要进一步验证。
motivation: 在物联网场景下，为NOMA-IRSA方案在错误地板区域的包丢失率提供一个简单而紧密的分析近似。
method: 推导了有限长度下的分组丢失率表达式，并通过蒙特卡洛模拟验证了其准确性。
results: 得出了有限长度下的分组丢失率表达式，并通过仿真验证了其在各种信道负载下（包括低负载以外的区域）的准确性。

title: Offline Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for 6G Communications: Fundamentals, Applications and Future Directions
authors: Eslam Eldeeb, Hirley Alves
abstract: The next-generation wireless technologies, including beyond 5G and 6G networks, are paving the way for transformative applications such as vehicle platooning, smart cities, and remote surgery. These innovations are driven by a vast array of interconnected wireless entities, including IoT devices, access points, UAVs, and CAVs, which increase network complexity and demand more advanced decision-making algorithms. Artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML), especially reinforcement learning (RL), are key enablers for such networks, providing solutions to high-dimensional and complex challenges. However, as networks expand to multi-agent environments, traditional online RL approaches face cost, safety, and scalability limitations. Offline multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) offers a promising solution by utilizing pre-collected data, reducing the need for real-time interaction. This article introduces a novel offline MARL algorithm based on conservative Q-learning (CQL), ensuring safe and efficient training. We extend this with meta-learning to address dynamic environments and validate the approach through use cases in radio resource management and UAV networks. Our work highlights offline MARL's advantages, limitations, and future directions in wireless applications.
zh_title: 面向6G通信的离线多智能体强化学习：基础、应用与未来方向
translation: 下一代无线技术，包括5G之后的网络和6G网络，正为车辆编队、智慧城市和远程手术等变革性应用铺平道路。这些创新是由海量的互联无线实体驱动的，包括物联网设备、接入点、无人机和自动驾驶汽车，这增加了网络复杂性，并需要更先进的决策算法。人工智能（AI）和机器学习（ML），特别是强化学习（RL），是这些网络的关键推动者，为高维度和复杂挑战提供了解决方案。然而，随着网络扩展到多智能体环境，传统的在线RL方法面临成本、安全和可扩展性限制。离线多智能体强化学习（MARL）通过利用预先收集的数据，减少了实时交互的需求，提供了一个有前途的解决方案。本文介绍了一种基于保守Q学习（CQL）的新型离线MARL算法，确保了安全高效的训练。我们将其与元学习相结合，以适应动态环境，并通过无线资源管理和无人机网络的用例验证了该方法。我们的工作强调了离线MARL在无线应用中的优势、局限性和未来方向。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于保守Q学习（CQL）的离线多智能体强化学习（MARL）算法，并结合元学习以适应动态环境，用于解决6G通信中的复杂决策问题，如无线资源管理和无人机网络。
ai_comments: 该研究为解决6G通信中日益增长的多智能体决策复杂性提供了一个创新的离线MARL解决方案。将CQL与元学习相结合，解决了安全性和适应性问题，具有重要的理论和实践意义。然而，对离线数据集的质量和代表性对算法性能的影响的进一步研究将是有益的。
motivation: 传统在线强化学习在多智能体环境（如6G通信）中面临成本、安全和可扩展性限制；离线MARL利用预收集数据，可降低实时交互需求，是更优的解决方案。
method: 提出了一种基于保守Q学习（CQL）的离线MARL算法，并扩展了元学习以处理动态环境。通过无线资源管理和无人机网络的用例进行了验证。
results: 所提出的离线MARL算法能够安全有效地进行训练，并适用于动态环境。在无线资源管理和无人机网络用例中得到了验证。
conclusion: 离线MARL为6G通信中的多智能体决策问题提供了一个有前景的解决方案，克服了在线RL的局限性。本文的方法展示了其在实际应用中的潜力。

title: Quantum King-Ring Domination in Chess: A QAOA Approach
authors: Gerhard Stenzel, Michael Kölle, Tobias Rohe, Julian Hager, Leo Sünkel, Maximilian Zorn, Claudia Linnhoff-Popien
abstract: The Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) is extensively benchmarked on synthetic random instances such as MaxCut, TSP, and SAT problems, but these lack semantic structure and human interpretability, offering limited insight into performance on real-world problems with meaningful constraints. We introduce Quantum King-Ring Domination (QKRD), a NISQ-scale benchmark derived from chess tactical positions that provides 5,000 structured instances with one-hot constraints, spatial locality, and 10--40 qubit scale. The benchmark pairs human-interpretable coverage metrics with intrinsic validation against classical heuristics, enabling algorithmic conclusions without external oracles. Using QKRD, we systematically evaluate QAOA design choices and find that constraint-preserving mixers (XY, domain-wall) converge approximately 13 steps faster than standard mixers (p<10^{-7}, d\approx0.5) while eliminating penalty tuning, warm-start strategies reduce convergence by 45 steps (p<10^{-127}, d=3.35) with energy improvements exceeding d=8, and Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR) optimization yields an informative negative result with worse energy (p<10^{-40}, d=1.21) and no coverage benefit. Intrinsic validation shows QAOA outperforms greedy heuristics by 12.6\% and random selection by 80.1\%. Our results demonstrate that structured benchmarks reveal advantages of problem-informed QAOA techniques obscured in random instances. We release all code, data, and experimental artifacts for reproducible NISQ algorithm research.
zh_title: 量子王-环支配在国际象棋中的应用：一种QAOA方法
translation: 量子近似优化算法（QAOA）在诸如MaxCut、TSP和SAT问题等合成随机实例上进行了广泛的基准测试，但这些实例缺乏语义结构和人类可解释性，对理解其在具有有意义约束的现实世界问题上的性能洞察有限。我们引入了量子王-环支配（QKRD），这是一个源自国际象棋战术位置的NISQ规模基准，提供了5000个结构化实例，具有one-hot约束、空间局部性和10--40量子比特的规模。该基准将人类可解释的覆盖率指标与针对经典启发式算法的内在验证相结合，无需外部预言机即可得出算法结论。利用QKRD，我们系统地评估了QAOA的设计选择，发现约束保持混合器（XY、畴壁）比标准混合器收敛速度快约13步（p<10^{-7}，d≈0.5），同时消除了惩罚调整；预热启动策略将收敛速度提高约45步（p<10^{-127}，d=3.35），并且能量改进超过d=8；条件风险价值（CVaR）优化得出了一个信息量为负的结果，其能量更差（p<10^{-40}，d=1.21），且覆盖范围没有改善。内在验证表明，QAOA在性能上优于贪婪启发式算法12.6%，优于随机选择80.1%。我们的结果表明，结构化基准揭示了问题信息驱动的QAOA技术在随机实例中被掩盖的优势。我们发布所有代码、数据和实验制品，以支持可复现的NISQ算法研究。
tldr: 该研究引入了一个名为QKRD的新基准，用于评估量子近似优化算法（QAOA）在具有实际约束的国际象棋问题上的表现。研究发现，特定类型的QAOA设计（如约束保持混合器和预热启动策略）比标准方法更快收敛并获得更好的结果，而CVaR优化则效果不佳。QKRD基准能够揭示QAOA在结构化问题上的优势，并且QAOA算法在性能上优于经典启发式算法。
ai_comments: 这项研究的一个显著优点是引入了一个新的、具有实际意义的基准（QKRD），它解决了现有合成基准的局限性。通过使用源自国际象棋的问题，该基准提供了人类可解释性和结构化约束，这对于评估量子算法在现实世界应用中的潜力至关重要。研究中对QAOA设计选择的系统性评估，特别是对约束保持混合器和预热启动策略的发现，为优化NISQ算法提供了宝贵的见解。然而，该研究的局限性在于其主要集中在QKRD基准上，可能无法完全代表所有类型的现实世界问题。此外，虽然CVaR优化的结果为负面，但其信息量仍有待进一步探讨其在其他场景下的适用性。总体而言，这项工作在推进NISQ算法的研究和基准测试方面具有重要意义。
motivation: 现有的量子近似优化算法（QAOA）基准测试通常使用缺乏语义结构和人类可解释性的合成随机实例，这限制了我们了解其在具有有意义约束的真实世界问题上的性能。因此，需要新的、具有结构化实例的基准来更好地评估QAOA。
method: 引入了一个源自国际象棋战术位置的量子王-环支配（QKRD）基准，该基准包含5000个结构化实例，具有one-hot约束、空间局部性和10-40个量子比特的规模。使用QKRD系统地评估了QAOA的设计选择，包括约束保持混合器、预热启动策略和CVaR优化，并将其与经典启发式算法和随机选择进行比较。
results: 约束保持混合器比标准混合器快约13步收敛；预热启动策略将收敛速度提高45步，并带来超过d=8的能量改进；CVaR优化在能量上表现更差（p<10^{-40}，d=1.21），且没有覆盖范围的优势。与贪婪启发式算法相比，QAOA的性能提高了12.6%，与随机选择相比提高了80.1%。
conclusion: 结构化基准（如QKRD）能够揭示问题导向的QAOA技术在随机实例中被掩盖的优势，并为可复现的NISQ算法研究提供了代码、数据和实验制品。

title: Depth-Synergized Mamba Meets Memory Experts for All-Day Image Reflection Separation
authors: Siyan Fang, Long Peng, Yuntao Wang, Ruonan Wei, Yuehuan Wang
abstract: Image reflection separation aims to disentangle the transmission layer and the reflection layer from a blended image. Existing methods rely on limited information from a single image, tending to confuse the two layers when their contrasts are similar, a challenge more severe at night. To address this issue, we propose the Depth-Memory Decoupling Network (DMDNet). It employs the Depth-Aware Scanning (DAScan) to guide Mamba toward salient structures, promoting information flow along semantic coherence to construct stable states. Working in synergy with DAScan, the Depth-Synergized State-Space Model (DS-SSM) modulates the sensitivity of state activations by depth, suppressing the spread of ambiguous features that interfere with layer disentanglement. Furthermore, we introduce the Memory Expert Compensation Module (MECM), leveraging cross-image historical knowledge to guide experts in providing layer-specific compensation. To address the lack of datasets for nighttime reflection separation, we construct the Nighttime Image Reflection Separation (NightIRS) dataset. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DMDNet outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both daytime and nighttime.
comment: This paper has been accepted by AAAI 2026
zh_title: 深度协同的Mamba与记忆专家用于全天图像反射分离
translation: 图像反射分离旨在将混合图像中的透射层和反射层分离开来。现有方法依赖于单一图像的有限信息，在两层对比度相似时容易混淆，在夜间场景下这一挑战更为严峻。为解决此问题，我们提出了深度记忆解耦网络（DMDNet）。它采用深度感知扫描（DAScan）来引导Mamba关注显著结构，促进沿着语义连贯性的信息流以构建稳定状态。深度协同状态空间模型（DS-SSM）与DAScan协同工作，通过深度调节状态激活的敏感度，抑制干扰层解耦的模糊特征扩散。此外，我们引入了记忆专家补偿模块（MECM），利用跨图像的历史知识来指导专家提供层特定的补偿。为了解决夜间反射分离数据集的缺乏问题，我们构建了夜间图像反射分离（NightIRS）数据集。大量实验表明，DMDNet在白天和夜间均优于现有最先进的方法。
tldr: 本研究提出了一种名为DMDNet的新网络，用于解决图像反射分离问题，特别是在夜间场景下。该网络结合了深度感知扫描（DAScan）和Mamba模型，以增强对显著结构的关注，并利用深度信息来稳定状态激活，减少模糊特征的传播。此外，它还引入了记忆专家补偿模块（MECM），利用跨图像的历史信息来提供特定层的补偿。研究还构建了一个夜间图像反射分离数据集（NightIRS），并在实验中证明了DMDNet在白天和夜间场景下均优于现有方法。
ai_comments: 该研究提出了一种创新的方法来解决图像反射分离的难题，特别是在夜间场景下。其亮点在于将深度信息与Mamba模型相结合，并引入了记忆机制来利用历史信息，这在处理具有挑战性的图像分离任务时具有潜力。然而，对于MECM如何具体实现跨图像知识的利用以及其计算成本的分析有待进一步深入。NightIRS数据集的构建对于推动该领域的研究具有重要意义。
motivation: 现有图像反射分离方法依赖于单一图像的有限信息，在透射层和反射层对比度相似时容易混淆，在夜间场景下问题尤为严重。
method: 提出深度记忆解耦网络（DMDNet），包括：1. 深度感知扫描（DAScan）引导Mamba关注显著结构，增强语义连贯性以构建稳定状态。2. 深度协同状态空间模型（DS-SSM）根据深度调节状态激活的敏感度，抑制模糊特征的传播。3. 记忆专家补偿模块（MECM）利用跨图像的历史知识指导专家提供层特定的补偿。4. 构建了夜间图像反射分离（NightIRS）数据集。
results: DMDNet在白天和夜间场景下均优于现有最先进的方法。
conclusion: 提出的DMDNet能够有效解决图像反射分离问题，尤其是在具有挑战性的夜间场景下，并且通过构建NightIRS数据集填补了相关数据集的空白。

title: Quantifier Elimination Meets Treewidth
authors: Hao Wu, Jiyu Zhu, Amir Kafshdar Goharshady, Jie An, Bican Xia, Naijun Zhan
abstract: In this paper, we address the complexity barrier inherent in Fourier-Motzkin elimination (FME) and cylindrical algebraic decomposition (CAD) when eliminating a block of (existential) quantifiers. To mitigate this, we propose exploiting structural sparsity in the variable dependency graph of quantified formulas. Utilizing tools from parameterized algorithms, we investigate the role of treewidth, a parameter that measures the graph's tree-likeness, in the process of quantifier elimination. A novel dynamic programming framework, structured over a tree decomposition of the dependency graph, is developed for applying FME and CAD, and is also extensible to general quantifier elimination procedures. Crucially, we prove that when the treewidth is a constant, the framework achieves a significant exponential complexity improvement for both FME and CAD, reducing the worst-case complexity bound from doubly exponential to single exponential. Preliminary experiments on sparse linear real arithmetic (LRA) and nonlinear real arithmetic (NRA) benchmarks confirm that our algorithm outperforms the existing popular heuristic-based approaches on instances exhibiting low treewidth.
translation: 在本文中，我们解决了傅里叶-莫茨金消元（FME）和柱状代数分解（CAD）在消除一组（存在性）量词时固有的复杂度障碍。为减轻这种影响，我们建议利用量化公式的变量依赖图中存在的结构稀疏性。利用参数化算法中的工具，我们研究了树宽（一个衡量图的树状特性的参数）在量词消除过程中的作用。为应用FME和CAD，我们开发了一个新颖的、基于依赖图树分解组织的动态规划框架，该框架也可扩展到一般的量词消除过程。至关重要的是，我们证明了当树宽为常数时，该框架对FME和CAD实现了显著的指数级复杂度改进，将最坏情况复杂度界限从双指数级降低到单指数级。对稀疏线性实数算术（LRA）和非线性实数算术（NRA）基准测试的初步实验证实，我们的算法在表现出低树宽的实例上优于现有的流行启发式方法。
tldr: 通过将树宽概念引入量词消除，并使用基于树分解的动态规划，将FME和CAD在低树宽下的复杂度从双指数级降至单指数级，并在稀疏算术基准测试中验证了其性能优势。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于将参数化算法中的“树宽”概念引入到量词消除问题中，并通过动态规划框架实现了在低树宽情况下的显著复杂度降低，解决了传统方法（如FME和CAD）在消除大量量词时的指数级复杂度瓶颈。其重要性在于为高效处理具有结构稀疏性的量化公式提供了一种理论和实践上的新方法。
motivation: 旨在克服傅里叶-莫茨金消元（FME）和柱状代数分解（CAD）在消除（存在性）量词块时固有的复杂度瓶颈。
method: 提出了一种新颖的、基于依赖图树分解的动态规划框架，用于应用傅里叶-莫茨金消元（FME）和柱状代数分解（CAD），该框架可扩展到一般量词消除过程。
results: 证明了当树宽为常数时，该框架在FME和CAD方面实现了显著的指数级复杂度提升，将最坏情况复杂度从双指数级降低到单指数级。初步实验表明，该算法在表现出低树宽的稀疏线性实数算术（LRA）和非线性实数算术（NRA）基准测试中优于现有流行的启发式方法。
conclusion: 当树宽为常数时，该框架为FME和CAD实现了显著的指数级复杂度改进，将最坏情况复杂度从双指数级降低到单指数级。

title: Multiagent Reinforcement Learning for Liquidity Games
authors: Alicia Vidler, Gal A. Kaminka
abstract: Making use of swarm methods in financial market modeling of liquidity, and techniques from financial analysis in swarm analysis, holds the potential to advance both research areas. In swarm research, the use of game theory methods holds the promise of explaining observed phenomena of collective utility adherence with rational self-interested swarm participants. In financial markets, a better understanding of how independent financial agents may self-organize for the betterment and stability of the marketplace would be a boon for market design researchers. This paper unifies Liquidity Games, where trader payoffs depend on aggregate liquidity within a trade, with Rational Swarms, where decentralized agents use difference rewards to align self-interested learning with global objectives. We offer a theoretical frameworks where we define a swarm of traders whose collective objective is market liquidity provision while maintaining agent independence. Using difference rewards within a Markov team games framework, we show that individual liquidity-maximizing behaviors contribute to overall market liquidity without requiring coordination or collusion. This Financial Swarm model provides a framework for modeling rational, independent agents where they achieve both individual profitability and collective market efficiency in bilateral asset markets.
zh_title: 多智能体强化学习在流动性博弈中的应用
translation: 利用群体方法进行金融市场流动性建模，以及利用金融分析技术进行群体分析，有潜力推动这两个研究领域的发展。在群体研究中，使用博弈论方法有望解释观察到的集体效用遵守现象，即使参与的群体成员是理性的、自利的。在金融市场中，更好地理解独立金融代理如何为市场改善和稳定进行自组织，将对市场设计研究大有裨益。本文将交易者收益取决于交易内总体流动性的流动性博弈（Liquidity Games）与去中心化代理使用差分奖励来使自利学习与全局目标保持一致的理性群体（Rational Swarms）相结合。我们提供了一个理论框架，在该框架中，我们定义了一个交易者群体，其集体目标是提供市场流动性，同时保持代理独立性。我们使用差分奖励在马尔可夫团队博弈框架下，证明了个体流动性最大化行为有助于整体市场流动性，而无需协调或串通。该金融群体模型提供了一个框架，用于模拟理性的、独立的代理，使其能够在双边资产市场中实现个体盈利和集体市场效率。
tldr: 本研究将流动性博弈与理性群体理论结合，使用差分奖励模型证明了独立的理性交易者可以通过最大化个体流动性来提升整体市场流动性，实现个体利润与集体市场效率的统一。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将流动性博弈（Liquidity Games）与理性群体（Rational Swarms）的概念相结合，并使用差分奖励（difference rewards）在马尔可夫团队博弈框架下进行理论构建。重要性在于为理解独立金融代理如何自组织以实现市场稳定和效率提供了一个新模型。局限性在于其理论框架是否能完全捕捉真实金融市场的复杂性有待进一步验证。
motivation: 在金融市场建模中使用群体方法，并在群体分析中使用金融技术，有望推动两个研究领域的发展。金融市场研究的动机是更好地理解独立金融代理如何自组织以改善和稳定市场。
method: 使用差分奖励（difference rewards）在马尔可夫团队博弈（Markov team games）框架下，定义了一个目标是提供市场流动性的交易者群体，同时保持代理独立性。
results: 证明了个体流动性最大化行为有助于整体市场流动性，而无需协调或串通。
conclusion: 该金融群体模型提供了一个框架，使得理性的、独立的代理能够在双边资产市场中同时实现个体盈利和集体市场效率。

title: HarmoniAD: Harmonizing Local Structures and Global Semantics for Anomaly Detection
authors: Naiqi Zhang, Chuancheng Shi, Jingtong Dou, Wenhua Wu, Fei Shen, Jianhua Cao
abstract: Anomaly detection is crucial in industrial product quality inspection. Failing to detect tiny defects often leads to serious consequences. Existing methods face a structure-semantics trade-off: structure-oriented models (such as frequency-based filters) are noise-sensitive, while semantics-oriented models (such as CLIP-based encoders) often miss fine details. To address this, we propose HarmoniAD, a frequency-guided dual-branch framework. Features are first extracted by the CLIP image encoder, then transformed into the frequency domain, and finally decoupled into high- and low-frequency paths for complementary modeling of structure and semantics. The high-frequency branch is equipped with a fine-grained structural attention module (FSAM) to enhance textures and edges for detecting small anomalies, while the low-frequency branch uses a global structural context module (GSCM) to capture long-range dependencies and preserve semantic consistency. Together, these branches balance fine detail and global semantics. HarmoniAD further adopts a multi-class joint training strategy, and experiments on MVTec-AD, VisA, and BTAD show state-of-the-art performance with both sensitivity and robustness.
zh_title: HarmoniAD：为异常检测协调局部结构与全局语义
translation: 异常检测在工业产品质量检测中至关重要。未能检测到微小缺陷常常会导致严重后果。现有方法面临结构-语义权衡：面向结构的模型（如基于频率的滤波器）对噪声敏感，而面向语义的模型（如基于CLIP的编码器）往往会遗漏精细细节。为解决此问题，我们提出了HarmoniAD，一个频率引导的双分支框架。特征首先由CLIP图像编码器提取，然后转换到频率域，最后解耦为高频和低频路径，用于对结构和语义进行互补建模。高频分支配备了细粒度结构注意力模块（FSAM），以增强纹理和边缘，用于检测微小异常，而低频分支使用全局结构上下文模块（GSCM）来捕获长距离依赖并保持语义一致性。这两个分支共同平衡了精细细节和全局语义。HarmoniAD进一步采用了多类联合训练策略，在MVTec-AD、VisA和BTAD上的实验表明，该方法在保持敏感性和鲁棒性的同时实现了最先进的性能。
tldr: HarmoniAD通过将特征分解到高频（结构）和低频（语义）通道，并分别使用注意力模块增强，解决了异常检测中对微小缺陷敏感性和全局理解不足的矛盾，实现了高性能。
ai_comments: 该方法创新性地结合了频率域分析与双分支结构（高频和低频），以解决传统模型在结构细节和全局语义之间的权衡问题。其重要性在于提高了工业检测中对微小缺陷的敏感性和整体鲁棒性。局限性是，其性能可能依赖于有效的频率分解和注意力模块的设计。
motivation: 工业产品质量检测中，漏检微小缺陷会导致严重后果。现有方法面临结构与语义的权衡：面向结构的模型对噪声敏感，而面向语义的模型（如基于CLIP的编码器）常常忽略精细细节。需要一个方法来同时处理结构细节和全局语义。
method: HarmoniAD是一个频率引导的双分支框架。它首先使用CLIP图像编码器提取特征，然后将特征转换到频率域，并解耦为高频和低频路径。高频分支使用细粒度结构注意力模块（FSAM）增强纹理和边缘，低频分支使用全局结构上下文模块（GSCM）捕获长距离依赖和保持语义一致性。最后，采用多类联合训练策略。
results: HarmoniAD在MVTec-AD、VisA和BTAD数据集上实现了最先进的性能，证明了其在检测微小异常方面的敏感性和整体鲁棒性。
conclusion: HarmoniAD通过多类联合训练策略，在MVTec-AD、VisA和BTAD数据集上实现了最先进的性能，同时保持了对微小缺陷的敏感性和对全局信息的鲁棒性。

title: MR-DAW: Towards Collaborative Digital Audio Workstations in Mixed Reality
authors: Torin Hopkins, Shih-Yu Ma, Suibi Che-Chuan Weng, Ming-Yuan Pai, Ellen Yi-Luen Do, Luca Turchet
abstract: Digital Audio Workstations (DAWs) are central to modern music production but often encumber the musician's workflow, tethering them to a desk and hindering natural interaction with their instrument. Furthermore, effective remote collaboration remains a significant challenge, with existing solutions hampered by network latency and asynchronous file sharing. This paper investigates the potential of Mixed Reality (MR) to overcome these barriers, creating an intuitive environment for real-time, remote musical collaboration. We employ qualitative and speculative design techniques to better understand: 1) how players currently use DAWs, and 2) to imagine a speculative future of collaborative MR-DAWs. To facilitate this discussion, we developed and evaluated the usability of a design probe, MR-DAW. An MR system enabling multiple, geographically dispersed users to control a single, shared DAW instance while moving freely in their local spaces. Our networked system enables each remote musician to use a physical foot pedal for collaborative looping, merging a familiar, hands-free interaction with a shared virtual session. Based on interviews and system evaluations with 20 musicians, we analyze current practices, report on the user experience with our MR system, and speculate on the future of musical collaboration in MR. Our results highlight the affordances of MR for unencumbered musical interaction and provide a speculative outlook on the future of remote collaborative DAWs in the Musical Metaverse.
zh_title: 混合现实中的协作数字音频工作站
translation: 数字音频工作站（DAW）是现代音乐制作的核心，但它们常常束缚音乐家的工作流程，将他们限制在办公桌前，并阻碍了与乐器的自然互动。此外，有效的远程协作仍然是一个重大挑战，现有解决方案受到网络延迟和异步文件共享的阻碍。本文研究了混合现实（MR）克服这些障碍的潜力，为实时、远程的音乐协作创造了一个直观的环境。我们采用了定性和推测性设计技术，以更好地理解：1）玩家目前如何使用 DAW，以及 2）设想一个推测性的协作 MR-DAW 的未来。为了促进这次讨论，我们开发并评估了一个名为 MR-DAW 的设计探测器的可用性。这是一个 MR 系统，允许地理上分散的多个用户控制单个共享的 DAW 实例，同时在各自的本地空间中自由移动。我们的网络系统使每位远程音乐家都能使用物理脚踏板进行协作式循环，将熟悉的免提交互与共享的虚拟会话相结合。基于对 20 位音乐家的访谈和系统评估，我们分析了当前的做法，报告了我们 MR 系统的用户体验，并推测了音乐元宇宙中音乐协作的未来。我们的结果突显了 MR 在不受约束的音乐交互方面的优势，并为音乐元宇宙中远程协作 DAW 的未来提供了推测性的展望。
tldr: MR-DAW 是一个混合现实系统，允许多个远程用户控制共享的数字音频工作站，通过脚踏板实现协作式循环，旨在克服传统数字音频工作站的限制并促进实时远程音乐协作。
ai_comments: 该研究在解决数字音频工作站（DAW）的固有局限性方面迈出了重要一步，特别是对于远程协作和自然交互而言。通过利用混合现实（MR）技术，MR-DAW 提出了一个引人入胜的解决方案，可以潜在地改变音乐制作和协作的方式。该研究的定性和推测性设计方法，加上实际的可用性评估，使其具有良好的说服力。然而，该研究的局限性可能在于实际部署的规模和复杂性，以及对网络基础设施的依赖性。未来的工作可以探索更广泛的 MR 平台集成、更先进的协作功能以及对不同音乐流派和用户技能水平的潜在影响。该研究为“音乐元宇宙”的概念提供了宝贵的见解，并为未来的研究和开发铺平了道路。
motivation: 传统的数字音频工作站（DAW）限制了音乐家的工作流程，将他们束缚在办公桌前，阻碍了与乐器的自然互动。此外，有效的远程协作仍然是一个重大挑战，现有解决方案受到网络延迟和异步文件共享的阻碍。
method: 该研究采用了定性设计和推测性设计技术，开发并评估了一个名为 MR-DAW 的设计探测器的可用性。该系统支持地理上分散的多个用户控制单个共享的 DAW 实例，同时在各自的本地空间中自由移动。该网络系统允许每位远程音乐家使用物理脚踏板进行协作式循环。
results: 对 20 位音乐家的访谈和系统评估表明，MR 具有促进不受约束的音乐交互的优势，并为音乐元宇宙中远程协作 DAW 的未来提供了推测性展望。
conclusion: MR-DAW 系统为克服传统 DAW 的局限性以及实现实时、远程音乐协作提供了一种有前景的解决方案，并为音乐元宇宙中协作 DAW 的未来发展指明了方向。

title: Joint Geometry-Appearance Human Reconstruction in a Unified Latent Space via Bridge Diffusion
authors: Yingzhi Tang, Qijian Zhang, Junhui Hou
abstract: Achieving consistent and high-fidelity geometry and appearance reconstruction of 3D digital humans from a single RGB image is inherently a challenging task. Existing studies typically resort to decoupled pipelines for geometry estimation and appearance synthesis, often hindering unified reconstruction and causing inconsistencies. This paper introduces \textbf{JGA-LBD}, a novel framework that unifies the modeling of geometry and appearance into a joint latent representation and formulates the generation process as bridge diffusion. Observing that directly integrating heterogeneous input conditions (e.g., depth maps, SMPL models) leads to substantial training difficulties, we unify all conditions into the 3D Gaussian representations, which can be further compressed into a unified latent space through a shared sparse variational autoencoder (VAE). Subsequently, the specialized form of bridge diffusion enables to start with a partial observation of the target latent code and solely focuses on inferring the missing components. Finally, a dedicated decoding module extracts the complete 3D human geometric structure and renders novel views from the inferred latent representation. Experiments demonstrate that JGA-LBD outperforms current state-of-the-art approaches in terms of both geometry fidelity and appearance quality, including challenging in-the-wild scenarios. Our code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/haiantyz/JGA-LBD.
zh_title: 联合几何外观人类重建在统一的潜在空间通过桥扩散
translation: 实现从单个RGB图像进行一致且高保真的3D数字人几何和外观重建是一个固有的挑战性任务。现有研究通常采用分离的几何估计和外观合成流程，这往往会阻碍统一重建并导致不一致性。本文提出了JGA-LBD，一个新颖的框架，将几何和外观的建模统一到一个联合的潜在表示中，并将生成过程形式化为桥扩散。考虑到直接整合异构输入条件（例如深度图、SMPL模型）会导致显著的训练困难，我们将所有条件统一到3D高斯表示中，然后可以通过共享的稀疏变分自编码器（VAE）进一步压缩到统一的潜在空间。随后，桥扩散的专门形式能够从目标潜在码的部分观测开始，并专门致力于推断缺失的组成部分。最后，一个专用的解码模块从推断的潜在表示中提取完整的3D人体几何结构并渲染新视图。实验表明，JGA-LBD在几何保真度和外观质量方面均优于当前最先进的方法，包括具有挑战性的真实场景。我们的代码将在https://github.com/haiantyz/JGA-LBD公开提供。
tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为JGA-LBD的新框架，通过统一的潜在表示和桥扩散模型，实现了从单张RGB图像进行一致且高保真的3D数字人几何和外观重建，克服了现有方法中几何和外观估计分离导致的模型不一致问题。
ai_comments: 该研究提出了一种创新的方法，通过统一的潜在空间和桥扩散模型来解决3D数字人重建中的几何和外观不一致问题，这在技术上是一个重要的进步。将异构输入统一为3D高斯表示是一个巧妙的解决方案，能够简化模型训练。然而，该方法在处理极端姿势或遮挡等复杂情况下的鲁棒性仍有待进一步验证。
motivation: 现有方法通常采用分离的几何估计和外观合成流程，这会阻碍统一重建并导致不一致性。
method: 该框架将几何和外观建模统一到联合潜在表示中，并通过桥扩散模型进行生成。为了解决异构输入条件（如深度图、SMPL模型）的训练难题，所有条件都被统一到3D高斯表示中，然后通过共享的稀疏变分自编码器（VAE）压缩到统一的潜在空间。桥扩散模型能够从部分观测的目标潜在码开始，推断缺失的部分。最后，一个专门的解码模块从推断的潜在表示中提取完整的3D人体几何结构并渲染新视图。
results: 实验证明，JGA-LBD在几何保真度和外观质量方面均优于当前最先进的方法，即使在具有挑战性的真实场景中也是如此。
conclusion: JGA-LBD框架成功地统一了3D数字人的几何和外观重建，并通过桥扩散模型实现了高质量的生成，优于现有技术。

title: Sparse Probabilistic Coalition Structure Generation: Bayesian Greedy Pursuit and $\ell_1$ Relaxations
authors: Angshul Majumdar
abstract: We study coalition structure generation (CSG) when coalition values are not given but must be learned from episodic observations. We model each episode as a sparse linear regression problem, where the realised payoff \(Y_t\) is a noisy linear combination of a small number of coalition contributions. This yields a probabilistic CSG framework in which the planner first estimates a sparse value function from \(T\) episodes, then runs a CSG solver on the inferred coalition set. We analyse two estimation schemes. The first, Bayesian Greedy Coalition Pursuit (BGCP), is a greedy procedure that mimics orthogonal matching pursuit. Under a coherence condition and a minimum signal assumption, BGCP recovers the true set of profitable coalitions with high probability once \(T \gtrsim K \log m\), and hence yields welfare-optimal structures. The second scheme uses an \(\ell_1\)-penalised estimator; under a restricted eigenvalue condition, we derive \(\ell_1\) and prediction error bounds and translate them into welfare gap guarantees. We compare both methods to probabilistic baselines and identify regimes where sparse probabilistic CSG is superior, as well as dense regimes where classical least-squares approaches are competitive.
zh_title: 稀疏概率联盟结构生成：贝叶斯贪心追逐与 L1 松弛
translation: 我们研究联盟结构生成（CSG）问题，在这种情况下，联盟的价值不是给定的，而是必须从经验观察中学习。我们将每个回合建模为一个稀疏线性回归问题，其中实现的收益 $Y_t$ 是少量联盟贡献的噪声线性组合。这产生了一个概率 CSG 框架，在该框架中，规划者首先从 $T$ 回合中估计一个稀疏价值函数，然后在推断出的联盟集上运行 CSG 求解器。我们分析了两种估计方案。第一种，贝叶斯贪心联盟追逐（BGCP），是一种贪心程序，模仿正交匹配追逐。在相干条件和最小信号假设下，一旦 $T  acksimeq K 	ext{ log } m$，BGCP 就能以高概率恢复真实的有利可图联盟集，从而产生福利最优结构。第二种方案使用 $\ell_1$ -惩罚估计器；在受限特征值条件下，我们推导出 $\ell_1$ 和预测误差界限，并将它们转化为福利差距保证。我们将这两种方法与概率基线进行比较，并确定了稀疏概率 CSG 优于某些情况，以及经典最小二乘法具有竞争力的密集情况。
tldr: 该研究提出了一种在联盟价值未知的情况下，从经验观察中学习联盟结构的方法，通过稀疏线性回归模型估计价值函数，并使用贝叶斯贪心追逐（BGCP）或 L1 惩罚估计器来识别有利可图的联盟，最终生成最优联盟结构。
ai_comments: 该研究在联盟结构生成领域提出了新颖的概率方法，特别是在联盟价值未知的情况下，通过稀疏学习来解决问题，具有重要的理论和实践意义。然而，实际计算复杂性和对模型假设的敏感性可能是在未来研究中需要考虑的方面。
motivation: 在联盟价值未知且需要从经验观察中学习的情况下，研究联盟结构生成（CSG）问题。
method: 将每个回合建模为稀疏线性回归问题，估计稀疏价值函数，然后运行CSG求解器。提出了两种估计方案：1. 贝叶斯贪心追逐（BGCP），一种贪心算法，模仿正交匹配追踪。2. 使用 L1 惩罚估计器。
results: 在相干条件和最小信号假设下，BGCP 能以高概率恢复真实的有利可图联盟集。在受限特征值条件下，L1 估计器具有预测误差界限，可转化为福利差距保证。研究还比较了两种方法与概率基线，并确定了稀疏概率 CSG 优于经典最小二乘法的模型。
conclusion: 研究提出的稀疏概率联盟结构生成框架，通过贝叶斯贪心追逐或 L1 惩罚估计，能够有效地在联盟价值未知的情况下学习并生成最优的联盟结构，并在特定条件下优于传统方法。

title: PQC standards alternatives -- reliable semantically secure key encapsulation mechanism and digital signature protocols using the rank-deficient matrix power function
authors: Juan Pedro Hecht, Hugo Daniel Scolnik
abstract: Post-quantum cryptography-PQC- aims to develop public-key primitives that are secure against adversaries using classical and quantum computing technologies. This study introduces novel protocols, a key encapsulation mechanism, a digital signature scheme, and special protection against linear attacks. Our purpose is to create reliable alternatives to current standards, seeking compact, fast, and secure replacements of the key interchange and digital signature in the TLS 1_3 protocol, which safeguards Internet traffic, allowing an easy post-quantum transition to protect current data from the harvest now, decrypt later threat.

title: Effects of Limited Field of View on Musical Collaboration Experience with Avatars in Extended Reality
authors: Suibi Che-Chuan Weng, Torin Hopkins, Shih-Yu Ma, Amy Banic, Ellen Yi-Luen Do
abstract:
During musical collaboration, visual cues are essential for communication between musicians. Extended Reality (XR) applications, often used with head-mounted displays like Augmented Reality (AR) glasses, can limit the field of view (FOV) of players. We conducted a study to investigate the effects of limited FOV on co-presence, gesture recognition, overall enjoyment, and reaction time.
  Initially, we observed experienced musicians collaborating informally with and without visual occlusion, noting that collaboration suffered with limited FOV. We then conducted a within-subjects study with 19 participants, comparing an unrestricted FOV holographic setup called HoloJam to Nreal AR glasses with a 52$^{\circ}$ limited FOV. In the AR setup, we tested two conditions: standard AR with a 52$^{\circ}$ FOV and a modified AR notification system called Mini Musicians.
  Results showed that HoloJam provided higher co-presence, quicker gesture recognition, and greater enjoyment. The Mini Musicians application reduced reaction time and maintained enjoyment compared to the standard AR setup. We conclude that limited FOV impacts musical collaboration, but notifications can improve reaction time and should be considered in future XR music collaborations.

title: Smart Fault Detection in Nanosatellite Electrical Power System
authors: Alireza Rezaee, Niloofar Nobahari, Amin Asgarifar, Farshid Hajati
abstract: This paper presents a new detection method of faults at Nanosatellites' electrical power without an Attitude Determination Control Subsystem (ADCS) at the LEO orbit. Each part of this system is at risk of fault due to pressure tolerance, launcher pressure, and environmental circumstances. Common faults are line to line fault and open circuit for the photovoltaic subsystem, short circuit and open circuit IGBT at DC to DC converter, and regulator fault of the ground battery. The system is simulated without fault based on a neural network using solar radiation and solar panel's surface temperature as input data and current and load as outputs. Finally, using the neural network classifier, different faults are diagnosed by pattern and type of fault. For fault classification, other machine learning methods are also used, such as PCA classification, decision tree, and KNN.

title: Applications of Secure Multi-Party Computation in Financial Services
authors: Brahim Khalil Sedraoui, Abdelmadjid Benmachiche, Amina Makhlouf, Chaouki Chemam
abstract: The concept of Secure Multi-Party Computation (SMPC) is a cryptographic service that allows generating analysis of sensitive data related to finance under the collaboration of all stakeholders without violating the privacy of the research participants. This article shows the increasing significance of privacy protection in the contemporary financial services, where various stakeholders should comply with stringent security and regulatory standards. It discusses the main issues of scalability, computational efficiency, and working with very large datasets, and it identifies the directions of future research to make SMPC protocols more practical and efficient. The results highlight the possibility of SMPC to facilitate safe, transparent, and trustful financial transactions in an ecosystem that is becoming more digital.

title: Multi-Satellite NOMA-Irregular Repetition Slotted ALOHA for IoT Networks
authors: Estefanía Recayte, Carla Amatetti
abstract: As the transition from 5G to 6G unfolds, a substantial increase in Internet of Things (IoT) devices is expected, enabling seamless and pervasive connectivity across various applications. Accommodating this surge and meeting the high capacity demands will necessitate the integration of NonTerrestrial Networks (NTNs). However, the extensive coverage area of satellites, relative to terrestrial receivers, will lead to a high density of users attempting to access the channel at the same time, increasing the collision probability. In turn, the deployment of mega constellations make it possible for ground users to be in visibility of more than one satellite at the same time, enabling receiver diversity. Therefore, in this paper, we evaluate the impact of multi-receivers in scenarios where IoT nodes share the channel following a non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA)irregular repetition slotted ALOHA (IRSA) protocol. Considering the impairments of satellite channels, we derive a lower bound of system performance, serving as a fast tool for initial evaluation of network behavior. Additionally, we identify the trade-offs inherent to the network design parameters, with a focus on packet loss rate and energy efficiency. Notably, in the visibility of only one extra satellite as receiver yields significant gains in overall system performance.

title: Two-Step Interference Cancellation for Energy Saving in Irregular Repetition Slotted ALOHA
authors: Estefanía Recayte, Leonardo Badia, Andrea Munari
abstract: We evaluate a modification of irregular repetition slotted ALOHA (IRSA) involving intermediate decoding and early transmission termination by some nodes, upon their decoding success. This is meant to avoid unnecessary transmissions, thereby reducing energy consumption. We expect this to be particularly useful at low loads, where most transmissions can be avoided as they do not often result in a collision and are therefore redundant. To validate this proposal, we observe that most of the literature related to IRSA considers an asymptotic heavily loaded regime; thus, we also present a model of energy consumption and success probability for frames of limited length and low offered loads. Thanks to our analysis, also confirmed by simulation, we are able to show that the proposed technique is able to reduce IRSA energy consumption by minimizing transmissions, while preserving performance gains over standard ALOHA. For example, we are able to get a 33% energy saving at offered loads around 10% without affecting throughput.

title: Bio-inspired Agentic Self-healing Framework for Resilient Distributed Computing Continuum Systems
authors: Alaa Saleh, Praveen Kumar Donta, Roberto Morabito, Sasu Tarkoma, Anders Lindgren, Qiyang Zhang, Schahram Dustdar Susanna Pirttikangas, Lauri Lovén
abstract: Human biological systems sustain life through extraordinary resilience, continually detecting damage, orchestrating targeted responses, and restoring function through self-healing. Inspired by these capabilities, this paper introduces ReCiSt, a bio-inspired agentic self-healing framework designed to achieve resilience in Distributed Computing Continuum Systems (DCCS). Modern DCCS integrate heterogeneous computing resources, ranging from resource-constrained IoT devices to high-performance cloud infrastructures, and their inherent complexity, mobility, and dynamic operating conditions expose them to frequent faults that disrupt service continuity. These challenges underscore the need for scalable, adaptive, and self-regulated resilience strategies. ReCiSt reconstructs the biological phases of Hemostasis, Inflammation, Proliferation, and Remodeling into the computational layers Containment, Diagnosis, Meta-Cognitive, and Knowledge for DCCS. These four layers perform autonomous fault isolation, causal diagnosis, adaptive recovery, and long-term knowledge consolidation through Language Model (LM)-powered agents. These agents interpret heterogeneous logs, infer root causes, refine reasoning pathways, and reconfigure resources with minimal human intervention. The proposed ReCiSt framework is evaluated on public fault datasets using multiple LMs, and no baseline comparison is included due to the scarcity of similar approaches. Nevertheless, our results, evaluated under different LMs, confirm ReCiSt's self-healing capabilities within tens of seconds with minimum of 10% of agent CPU usage. Our results also demonstrated depth of analysis to over come uncertainties and amount of micro-agents invoked to achieve resilience.

title: Intelligent Traffic Surveillance for Real-Time Vehicle Detection, License Plate Recognition, and Speed Estimation
authors: Bruce Mugizi, Sudi Murindanyi, Olivia Nakacwa, Andrew Katumba
abstract: Speeding is a major contributor to road fatalities, particularly in developing countries such as Uganda, where road safety infrastructure is limited. This study proposes a real-time intelligent traffic surveillance system tailored to such regions, using computer vision techniques to address vehicle detection, license plate recognition, and speed estimation. The study collected a rich dataset using a speed gun, a Canon Camera, and a mobile phone to train the models. License plate detection using YOLOv8 achieved a mean average precision (mAP) of 97.9%. For character recognition of the detected license plate, the CNN model got a character error rate (CER) of 3.85%, while the transformer model significantly reduced the CER to 1.79%. Speed estimation used source and target regions of interest, yielding a good performance of 10 km/h margin of error. Additionally, a database was established to correlate user information with vehicle detection data, enabling automated ticket issuance via SMS via Africa's Talking API. This system addresses critical traffic management needs in resource-constrained environments and shows potential to reduce road accidents through automated traffic enforcement in developing countries where such interventions are urgently needed.

title: OmniVaT: Single Domain Generalization for Multimodal Visual-Tactile Learning
authors: Liuxiang Qiu, Hui Da, Yuzhen Niu, Tiesong Zhao, Yang Cao, Zheng-Jun Zha
abstract: Visual-tactile learning (VTL) enables embodied agents to perceive the physical world by integrating visual (VIS) and tactile (TAC) sensors. However, VTL still suffers from modality discrepancies between VIS and TAC images, as well as domain gaps caused by non-standardized tactile sensors and inconsistent data collection procedures. We formulate these challenges as a new task, termed single domain generalization for multimodal VTL (SDG-VTL). In this paper, we propose an OmniVaT framework that, for the first time, successfully addresses this task. On the one hand, OmniVaT integrates a multimodal fractional Fourier adapter (MFFA) to map VIS and TAC embeddings into a unified embedding-frequency space, thereby effectively mitigating the modality gap without multi-domain training data or careful cross-modal fusion strategies. On the other hand, it also incorporates a discrete tree generation (DTG) module that obtains diverse and reliable multimodal fractional representations through a hierarchical tree structure, thereby enhancing its adaptivity to fluctuating domain shifts in unseen domains. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superior cross-domain generalization performance of OmniVaT on the SDG-VTL task.

title: Robust Uncertainty Quantification for Factual Generation of Large Language Models
authors: Yuhao Zhang, Zhongliang Yang, Linna Zhou
abstract: The rapid advancement of large language model(LLM) technology has facilitated its integration into various domains of professional and daily life. However, the persistent challenge of LLM hallucination has emerged as a critical limitation, significantly compromising the reliability and trustworthiness of AI-generated content. This challenge has garnered significant attention within the scientific community, prompting extensive research efforts in hallucination detection and mitigation strategies. Current methodological frameworks reveal a critical limitation: traditional uncertainty quantification approaches demonstrate effectiveness primarily within conventional question-answering paradigms, yet exhibit notable deficiencies when confronted with non-canonical or adversarial questioning strategies. This performance gap raises substantial concerns regarding the dependability of LLM responses in real-world applications requiring robust critical thinking capabilities. This study aims to fill this gap by proposing an uncertainty quantification scenario in the task of generating with multiple facts. We have meticulously constructed a set of trap questions contained with fake names. Based on this scenario, we innovatively propose a novel and robust uncertainty quantification method(RU). A series of experiments have been conducted to verify its effectiveness. The results show that the constructed set of trap questions performs excellently. Moreover, when compared with the baseline methods on four different models, our proposed method has demonstrated great performance, with an average increase of 0.1-0.2 in ROCAUC values compared to the best performing baseline method, providing new sights and methods for addressing the hallucination issue of LLMs.
comment: 9 pages, 5 tables, 5 figures, accepted to IJCNN 2025

title: Traffic-MoE: A Sparse Foundation Model for Network Traffic Analysis
authors: Jiajun Zhou, Changhui Sun, Meng Shen, Shanqing Yu, Qi Xuan
abstract: While pre-trained large models have achieved state-of-the-art performance in network traffic analysis, their prohibitive computational costs hinder deployment in real-time, throughput-sensitive network defense environments. This work bridges the gap between advanced representation learning and practical network protection by introducing Traffic-MoE, a sparse foundation model optimized for high-efficiency real-time inference. By dynamically routing traffic tokens to a small subset of specialized experts, Traffic-MoE effectively decouples model capacity from computational overhead. Extensive evaluations across three security-oriented tasks demonstrate that Traffic-MoE achieves up to a 12.38% improvement in detection performance compared to leading dense competitors. Crucially, it delivers a 91.62% increase in throughput, reduces inference latency by 47.81%, and cuts peak GPU memory consumption by 38.72%. Beyond efficiency, Traffic-MoE exhibits superior robustness against adversarial traffic shaping and maintains high detection efficacy in few-shot scenarios, establishing a new paradigm for scalable and resilient network traffic analysis.

title: Diamond: Design and Implementation of Breach-Resilient Authenticated Encryption Framework For Internet of Things
authors: Saif E. Nouma, Gokhan Mumcu, Attila A. Yavuz
abstract:
Resource-constrained Internet of Things (IoT) devices, from medical implants to small drones, must transmit sensitive telemetry under adversarial wireless channels while operating under stringent computing and energy budgets. Authenticated Encryption (AE) is essential for ensuring confidentiality, integrity, and authenticity. However, existing lightweight AE standards lack forward-security guarantees, compact tag aggregation, and offline-online (OO) optimizations required for modern high-throughput IoT pipelines.
  We introduce Diamond, the first provable secure Forward-secure and Aggregate Authenticated Encryption (FAAE) framework that extends and generalizes prior FAAE constructions through a lightweight key evolution mechanism, an OO-optimized computation pipeline, and a set of performance-tiered instantiations tailored to heterogeneous IoT platforms. Diamond substantially reduces amortized offline preprocessing (up to 47%) and achieves up to an order-ofmagnitude reduction in end-to-end latency for large telemetry batches. Our comprehensive evaluation across 64-bit ARM Cortex-A72, 32-bit ARM Cortex-M4, and 8-bit AVR architectures confirms that Diamond consistently outperforms baseline FAAE variants and NIST lightweight AE candidates across authenticated encryption throughput and end-to-end verification latency while maintaining compact tag aggregation and strong breach resilience. We formally prove the security of Diamond and provide two concrete instantiations optimized for compliance and high efficiency. Our open-source release enables reproducibility and seamless integration into IoT platforms.

title: Efficient Prediction of Dense Visual Embeddings via Distillation and RGB-D Transformers
authors: Söhnke Benedikt Fischedick, Daniel Seichter, Benedict Stephan, Robin Schmidt, Horst-Michael Gross
abstract: In domestic environments, robots require a comprehensive understanding of their surroundings to interact effectively and intuitively with untrained humans. In this paper, we propose DVEFormer - an efficient RGB-D Transformer-based approach that predicts dense text-aligned visual embeddings (DVE) via knowledge distillation. Instead of directly performing classical semantic segmentation with fixed predefined classes, our method uses teacher embeddings from Alpha-CLIP to guide our efficient student model DVEFormer in learning fine-grained pixel-wise embeddings. While this approach still enables classical semantic segmentation, e.g., via linear probing, it further enables flexible text-based querying and other applications, such as creating comprehensive 3D maps. Evaluations on common indoor datasets demonstrate that our approach achieves competitive performance while meeting real-time requirements, operating at 26.3 FPS for the full model and 77.0 FPS for a smaller variant on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin. Additionally, we show qualitative results that highlight the effectiveness and possible use cases in real-world applications. Overall, our method serves as a drop-in replacement for traditional segmentation approaches while enabling flexible natural-language querying and seamless integration into 3D mapping pipelines for mobile robotics.
comment: Published in Proc. IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2025)

title: Mapping Human Anti-collusion Mechanisms to Multi-agent AI
authors: Jamiu Adekunle Idowu, Ahmed Almasoud, Ayman Alfahid
abstract: As multi-agent AI systems become increasingly autonomous, evidence shows they can develop collusive strategies similar to those long observed in human markets and institutions. While human domains have accumulated centuries of anti-collusion mechanisms, it remains unclear how these can be adapted to AI settings. This paper addresses that gap by (i) developing a taxonomy of human anti-collusion mechanisms, including sanctions, leniency & whistleblowing, monitoring & auditing, market design, and governance and (ii) mapping them to potential interventions for multi-agent AI systems. For each mechanism, we propose implementation approaches. We also highlight open challenges, such as the attribution problem (difficulty attributing emergent coordination to specific agents) identity fluidity (agents being easily forked or modified) the boundary problem (distinguishing beneficial cooperation from harmful collusion) and adversarial adaptation (agents learning to evade detection).

title: The Role of Mixed-Language Documents for Multilingual Large Language Model Pretraining
authors: Jiandong Shao, Raphael Tang, Crystina Zhang, Karin Sevegnani, Pontus Stenetorp, Jianfei Yang, Yao Lu
abstract: Multilingual large language models achieve impressive cross-lingual performance despite largely monolingual pretraining. While bilingual data in pretraining corpora is widely believed to enable these abilities, details of its contributions remain unclear. We investigate this question by pretraining models from scratch under controlled conditions, comparing the standard web corpus with a monolingual-only version that removes all multilingual documents. Despite constituting only 2% of the corpus, removing bilingual data causes translation performance to drop 56% in BLEU, while behaviour on cross-lingual QA and general reasoning tasks remains stable, with training curves largely overlapping the baseline.
